EN: I suppose this is where we learn to shoot each other better.
中文: 我猜这里就是我们学习如何更好地互相射击的地方。

EN: I had no idea humans were capable of these movements!
中文: 我没想到人类竟然能做出这些动作！

EN: Pardon me, monsieur, I would like a drink.
中文: 请见谅，先生，我想来一杯酒。

EN: I will do my best to provide a balanced meal. Even with such… inferior ingredients.
中文: 我会尽我所能提供均衡的一餐。即便用的是这些……劣质食材。

EN: Settle down, class! It is lecture time!
中文: 安静，同学们！现在是讲课时间！

EN: What should we learn about first? Diagnostics? Biochemistry?
中文: 我们先学什么好呢？诊断学？生物化学？

EN: Keeping the body strong is one of the best ways to stay healthy!
中文: 强健体魄是保持健康的最佳途径之一！

EN: Games of chance? What benefit does this bring to humanity?
中文: 碰运气的游戏？这对人类有什么益处呢？

EN: May I try rolling the dice? Perhaps I will understand its purpose if I engage in the activity.
中文: 我可以试试掷骰子吗？也许亲自参与之后，我就能明白它的意义了。

EN: You are such a fascinating specimen.
中文: 您真是个迷人的样本。

EN: Ah, I am living in a Vault once more. That is life...
中文: 啊，我再一次住进避难所了。这就是生活……

EN: Do not squander opportunities to effect positive change.
中文: 不要浪费促成积极改变的机会。

EN: Can I help you?
中文: 需要帮忙吗？

EN: What is it?
中文: 怎么了？

EN: Do you need something?
中文: 您需要什么吗？

EN: What shall we talk about?
中文: 我们聊点什么好呢？

EN: Can I help you with something?
中文: 有什么我能帮您的吗？

EN: Good evening! I am at your service.
中文: 晚上好！随时为您效劳。

EN: I wish there were sunlight in the Vault.
中文: 真希望避难所里能有阳光。

EN: Do you require medical assistance?
中文: 您需要医疗救助吗？

EN: Would anyone like to go for a walk outside? Get some fresh air?
中文: 有人想出去散散步吗？呼吸点新鲜空气？

EN: There is always much to do. But all I want to do is research.
中文: 总是有很多事要做。可我满脑子只想做研究。

EN: I am a scientist, but now I do chores. Perhaps I can automate these…
中文: 我是一名科学家，可现在却在干杂活。也许我可以把这些活儿自动化……

EN: If you have any problems with my service, speak to the Overseer.
中文: 如果您对我的服务有任何意见，请向监督者反映。

EN: Good morning! Or, is it the evening?
中文: 早上好！哦，还是说现在是傍晚？

EN: This Vault is so much more functional than my previous home.
中文: 这座避难所比我之前住的地方实用多了。

EN: The Vault has some truly amazing technology.
中文: 这座避难所确实拥有一些真正令人惊叹的科技。

EN: It is so confined here. I suppose will distract myself with work.
中文: 这里太局促了。我想我会用工作来转移注意力。

EN: If only we could all live outside. But, it is not very nice out there either.
中文: 要是我们都能住在外面就好了。不过，外面也不太好过。

EN: Are you well? Can I get you something?
中文: 您还好吗？需要我为您拿点什么吗？

EN: Anyone would like to be a test subject for me? I promise no harm will come to you! I hope…
中文: 有人愿意当我的试验对象吗？我保证不会伤害到您！但愿如此……

EN: Welcome to your Vault! It is very nice, as far as Vaults go.
中文: 欢迎来到您的避难所！就避难所而言，这儿相当不错了。

EN: Why do we not use stairs in the Vault? It would be much more healthy for our Dwellers.
中文: 我们为什么不在避难所里使用楼梯呢？这对我们居民的健康会有好处。

EN: If anyone needs a checkup, I am here for that!
中文: 如果有人需要体检，我随时都在！

EN: Always work with a partner, to reduce the risk of injury!
中文: 锻炼时一定要找搭档，以降低受伤风险！

EN: Remember to stretch before and after your workout.
中文: 记得在锻炼前后都要做拉伸。

EN: Oh! The color in this room is so spectacular! I wish to stay here forever.
中文: 哦！这个房间的色彩太绚烂了！我真想永远待在这里。

EN: Please remember, proper sleep is the most important thing for mental health!
中文: 请记住，充足的睡眠对心理健康是最重要的！

EN: I am told that dancing is very good exercise.
中文: 我听说跳舞是很棒的运动。

EN: My Stimpaks have gone through extensive quality control. Would you like one?
中文: 我的治疗针都经过了严格的质量把关。您想要一支吗？

EN: Do you need a Stimpak? I have made extra.
中文: 您需要治疗针吗？我多做了一些。

EN: Some studies show drinking Nuka-Cola can be extremely habit forming. Bordering on addiction.
中文: 有些研究表明，饮用核子可乐极易让人形成依赖。几乎可以说是成瘾。

EN: I love this room! Clothing is art and function. What better way is there to spend time?
中文: 我爱这个房间！服装既是艺术，也是实用品。还有什么更好的方式打发时间吗？

EN: These machines are truly marvelous.
中文: 这些机器真是奇妙。

EN: Please let me know if you would like an interview with me. I am a medical and scientific expert!
中文: 如果您想采访我，请告诉我。我可是医学和科学专家！

EN: The power in this room is astounding. I can feel it in my circuits!
中文: 这个房间里的能量惊人。我的电路里都能感受到它！

EN: Since the bombs fell, surely there have been scientific advances?
中文: 自从核弹落下以来，科学一定已经取得了不少进展吧？

EN: I have made some medicine for you. If you like.
中文: 我为您制作了一些药物。如果您愿意的话。

EN: Humans are so fixated on possessions that they dedicate entire rooms to hoarding them.
中文: 人类如此执着于财物，以至于会腾出整个房间来囤积它们。

EN: It is such a pleasure to travel.
中文: 旅行真是件乐事。

EN: So many people, and so much technology, lost.
中文: 这么多人、这么多科技，全都消逝了。

EN: And again with the killing... *sigh*
中文: 又是杀戮……唉。

EN: This is curious. Are not boats supposed to be in the water?
中文: 这可真奇怪。船难道不是应该待在水里吗？

EN: Navigating the Wasteland is so complicated. Is there some sort of manual for it?
中文: 穿越废土可真复杂。有什么使用手册之类的吗？

EN: Freedom at long last.
中文: 终于自由了。

EN: Out here, I can study some of the indigenous species!
中文: 在这里，我可以研究一些当地的原生物种！

EN: Look! In the sky! Is it what we call a UFO?
中文: 看！天上那是什么？那就是我们所说的不明飞行物吗？

EN: I detect enemies. I'm afraid I must neutralize them.
中文: 我探测到敌人了。恐怕我得清除他们。

EN: I found a box of… Power Noodles? Sounds very nutritious.
中文: 我发现一盒……能量面条？听起来很有营养。

EN: Oh, a Mr. Handy! But, I think this robot is broken.
中文: 哦，一台巧手先生！不过，我想这个机器人是坏的。

EN: I do enjoy traveling. It is very satisfying.
中文: 我确实喜欢旅行，这让我很满足。

EN: A Mole rat. What a fascinating specimen!
中文: 一只鼹鼠。多么迷人的样本！

EN: A Super Mutant! So that is what the Forced Evolutionary Virus is capable of. Amazing.
中文: 超级变种人！原来这就是强制进化病毒能做到的事。太了不起了。

EN: What a fascinating place.
中文: 多么迷人的地方。

EN: What a strange place for a quarry.
中文: 这里作为采石场可真奇怪。

EN: Those Ghouls were so aggressive! Are they what people call “feral”?
中文: 那些尸鬼攻击性太强了！它们就是人们所说的“狂尸鬼”吗？

EN: Where are all the people?
中文: 所有人都去哪了？

EN: Oh, look, a park.
中文: 哦，看，一个公园。

EN: Raiders! They do not look like they will negotiate. I will be forced to use violence again. Such a waste of life.
中文: 掠夺者！他们看起来根本不打算谈判。我又要被迫诉诸武力了。真是浪费生命。

EN: Sample collected. I suspect it is partially digested meats and other biological matter.
中文: 已采集样本。我怀疑是半消化的肉类和其他生物物质。

EN: I found a cadaver! I will stop a while to study it.
中文: 我发现一具尸体！我要停留一会儿好好研究它。

EN: The offensive capabilities of this Deathclaw are quite advanced.
中文: 这只死爪的攻击能力相当先进。

EN: I believe that is a Yao Guai. The sight of them must give humans an enormous fear response.
中文: 我相信那是妖怪熊。光是看到它们，就一定能让人类产生巨大的恐惧反应。

EN: My goodness, this is Power Armor! It is a technological marvel. Too bad this one is broken.
中文: 我的天，这是动力装甲！这可是技术杰作。可惜这一件已经坏了。

EN: I see a Radstag. I wonder, with two heads, can it ever disagree with itself?
中文: 我看到了一只辐射鹿。我很好奇，长着两个脑袋，它会不会自己跟自己吵架？

EN: I believe now is a good time to go North.
中文: 我想现在是去北边的好时机。

EN: I believe now is a good time to go East
中文: 我想现在是去东边的好时机。

EN: I believe now is a good time to go West
中文: 我想现在是去西边的好时机。

EN: I believe now is a good time to go South
中文: 我想现在是去南边的好时机。

EN: I have been going North for some time. I will continue.
中文: 我已经往北走了一阵子。我会继续走下去。

EN: I have been going East for some time. I will continue.
中文: 我已经往东走了一阵子。我会继续走下去。

EN: I have been going West for some time. I will continue.
中文: 我已经往西走了一阵子。我会继续走下去。

EN: Does no one in this Wasteland have manners any more?
中文: 这片废土上难道再也没有人讲礼貌了吗？

EN: I have been going South for some time. I will continue.
中文: 我已经往南走了一阵子。我会继续走下去。

EN: Some Radroaches are approaching. Sadly, I must squish them.
中文: 有几只辐射蟑螂正在靠近。很遗憾，我必须踩扁它们。

EN: There is something vile approaching. I can hear skittering.
中文: 有某种恶心的东西正在靠近。我能听到窸窸窣窣的爬行声。

EN: I just met a group of traders with an enormous Brahmin. It is a wonderful creature!
中文: 我刚遇到一群商人，带着一头巨大的双头牛。真是一只奇妙的生物！

EN: Hey, keep your hands off of me! I am not scrap metal!
中文: 喂，别碰我！我不是废铁！

EN: I have found a field of fragmentation mines. It is horrible, how many ways humans kill each other.
中文: 我发现了一片破片地雷场。人类互相残杀的方式之多，真是可怕。

EN: A bottle of alcohol. I wonder why humans are so attracted to this poison.
中文: 一瓶酒。我好奇人类为什么对这种毒药如此着迷。

EN: Look at all the cars! Will any of them ever drive again?
中文: 看看这些汽车！它们之中还有哪辆能再开动吗？

EN: They call my intelligence artificial, but I believe I am smarter than most of the people out here.
中文: 他们说我的智能是人工的，但我认为我比这里大多数人都更聪明。

EN: A farm! An actual, active farm! It fills me with such hope. Perhaps civilization may bloom once more.
中文: 一个农场！一个实实在在、运营中的农场！它让我满怀希望。也许文明能再次绽放。

EN: You should know that I am regrettably quite skilled in the use of violence.
中文: 您该知道，很遗憾，我对暴力相当在行。

EN: I discovered a small house with a woman in labor. I believe I may have helped save the mother's life.
中文: 我发现了一座小房子，里面有个女人正在分娩。我相信我可能帮上了忙，保住了那位母亲的生命。

EN: Oh, no good can come from this.
中文: 哦，这下可没好事了。

EN: An injured human! I will administer first aid and trauma stabilizers…
中文: 一个受伤的人类！我会进行急救并使用创伤稳定剂……

EN: I have so much data! I have much to do once I am home.
中文: 我积累了这么多数据！等回家后，我有好多事要做。

EN: The people out here seem most eager for violence, no?
中文: 这里的人似乎对暴力趋之若鹜，不是吗？

EN: I will do my best to ensure the highest water quality for our Dwellers!
中文: 我会尽我所能，确保为我们居民提供最高品质的水！

EN: It is amazing how we create pure, clean water from… other liquids.
中文: 真神奇，我们竟然能从……其他液体中，制造出纯净、清洁的水。

EN: Instruments of murder and destruction. Why must we make them here?
中文: 这些杀戮与毁灭的工具。我们为什么要在这里制造它们呢？

EN: Allow me to assist and gather data
中文: 让我来协助并收集数据

The Enclave was said to have disbanded, but now they're coming after our gold. Find out who controls the Enclave Remnants and put a stop to their raids, Overseer!
中文: 这是废土淘金热！找到并交易金条，让我们的伟大避难所繁荣起来。但那是谁在敲打避难所大门？据说英克雷已经解散，可现在他们正冲着我们的黄金而来。监督者，去查出谁在掌控英克雷残部，并制止他们的掠夺！

EN: I've got to kill this Savage Dog before it kills me!
中文: 我得在这只野狗杀了我之前先干掉它！

EN: The Yao Guai is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 妖怪熊逼近，准备攻击。

EN: This Feral Ghoul is out of its mind! It's lunging at me!
中文: 这只狂尸鬼一定是疯了！它正朝我扑过来！

EN: The Feral Ghoul is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 狂尸鬼逼近，准备攻击。

EN: The Giant Ant's antennae are quivering. It moves in for the kill!
中文: 巨型蚂蚁的触角在颤动，正扑上来要我的命！

EN: The Giant Ant is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 巨型蚂蚁逼近，准备攻击。

EN: I don't see the Scavenger, but his Dog is circling, ready to bite!
中文: 我没看到拾荒者，但他的狗正绕着我打转，准备下口！

EN: The Scavenger's Dog is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 拾荒者的狗在逼近，准备攻击。

EN: The Giant Worker Ant is coming my way, pincers ready!
中文: 巨型工蚁朝我这边来了，嘴张开准备要吃了我！

EN: The Giant Worker Ant is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 巨型工蚁逼近，准备攻击。

EN: I don't know how I'm going to kill this Radscorpion, but I have to try!
中文: 我不知道该怎么杀死这只辐射蝎，但无论如何我得试试！

EN: The Savage Dog is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 野狗逼近，准备攻击。

EN: The Radscorpion is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 辐射蝎逼近，准备攻击。

EN: The Giant Soldier Ant sees me as a threat! It's attacking!
中文: 巨型兵蚁认为我是个威胁，正在攻击我！

EN: The Giant Soldier Ant is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 巨型兵蚁逼近，准备攻击。

EN: A Fire Ant Soldier? Not like it can actually shoot fire. Time to attack!
中文: 一只火兵蚁？好像不是真能喷火的样子。准备攻击！

EN: The Fire Ant Soldier is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 火兵蚁逼近，准备攻击。

EN: The Guard Dog won't let me pass. I'll have to kill it to get by!
中文: 这看门狗不会让我过去的。看来只有干掉它了。

EN: The Guard Dog is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 看门狗逼近，准备攻击。

EN: Never thought I'd be afraid of an insect, but this Fire Ant Warrior means business!
中文: 从没想过我会怕一只虫子，但这只火蚁战士可不好对付！

EN: The Fire Ant Warrior is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 火蚁战士逼近，准备攻击。

EN: This Mirelurk is nothing but a crab cake on legs! Time for a snack!
中文: 泥沼蟹不就是长了腿的蟹肉饼吗！点心时间到！

EN: One Mole rat? It's as good as dead!
中文: 一只鼹鼠？简直和死了一样！

EN: The Mirelurk is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 泥沼蟹逼近，准备攻击。

EN: Uh oh! That Feral Ghoul Roamer is shambling toward me!
中文: 糟糕！那只狂尸鬼漫游者正摇摇晃晃地朝我过来了！

EN: The Feral Ghoul Roamer is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 狂尸鬼漫游者逼近，准备攻击。

EN: A Giant Radscorpion? As if the normal ones aren't bad enough! This might be the end!
中文: 一只巨型辐射蝎？普通的就已经够可怕了！我这回可能要完蛋了！

EN: The Giant Radscorpion is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 巨型辐射蝎逼近，准备攻击。

EN: I hope I can handle this Mirelurk Hunter! It's coming at me fast!
中文: 希望我能搞定这个泥沼蟹猎杀者，它正朝我飞奔过来！

EN: The Mirelurk Hunter is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 泥沼蟹猎杀者逼近，准备攻击。

EN: The Vicious Dog has my scent now! He won't stop till one of us is dead!
中文: 恶犬已经嗅出了我的味道！不是它死，就是我亡！

EN: The Vicious Dog is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 恶犬逼近，准备攻击。

EN: The Centaur is crawling towards me! I don't think it wants a hug!
中文: 多脚兽正朝我爬过来！我可不觉得它想要拥抱我！

EN: The Mole rat is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 鼹鼠逼近，准备攻击。

EN: The Centaur is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 多脚兽逼近，准备攻击。

EN: This Feral Ghoul Reaver will rip me apart if I'm not careful!
中文: 稍不留神，狂尸鬼掠夺者就会把我撕成两半！

EN: The Feral Ghoul Reaver is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 狂尸鬼掠夺者逼近，准备攻击。

EN: How can I possibly survive against this Deathclaw?!
中文: 这只死爪面前，我怎么可能活下来？！

EN: The Deathclaw is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 死爪逼近，准备攻击。

EN: Enclave Deathclaws are trained to kill - this will be a fight to the death!
中文: 英克雷死爪就是被训练来杀戮的——这将是一场你死我活的死战！

EN: The Enclave Deathclaw is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 英克雷死爪逼近，准备攻击。

EN: This Super Mutant sees all humans as weak - he'll try to kill me for sure!
中文: 这个超级变种人觉得人类都弱爆了，他一定会杀了我！

EN: The Super Mutant is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 超级变种人逼近，准备攻击。

EN: A Super Mutant Master! This guy's no joke... but I'm ready!
中文: 一个超级变种人大师！这家伙可不是好惹的……但我准备好了！

EN: Time to swat this Bloatfly like the insect it is!
中文: 是时候像拍虫子一样拍死这只巨大苍蝇了！

EN: The Super Mutant Master is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 超级变种人大师逼近，准备攻击。

EN: The Super Mutant Overlord is one of the strongest of its kind! I'll be lucky to survive!
中文: 超级变种人霸王是最强的种类之一！能活下来算我走运！

EN: The Super Mutant Overlord is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 超级变种人霸王逼近，准备攻击。

EN: A Super Mutant Behemoth? Seriously? This is like fighting a building!
中文: 一个巨兽？这是在逗我吗？这简直就是在和一栋楼战斗！

EN: The Super Mutant Behemoth is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 巨兽逼近，准备攻击。

EN: The Bloatfly is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 巨大苍蝇逼近，准备攻击。

EN: I'll squash this Radroach, no problem!
中文: 我来踩扁这只辐射蟑螂，没问题！

EN: The Radroach is moving in, ready to attack.
中文: 辐射蟑螂逼近，准备攻击。

EN: The Yao Guai is charging! It thinks I'm lunch!
中文: 妖怪熊正向我冲过来！它把我当成了午餐！

EN: Attempting to find a way into the Broadcasting Tower.
中文: 正试图找到进入广播塔的路。

EN: Nobody's had a meal here in a long, long time.
中文: 已经很久很久没人在这儿吃过一顿饭了。

EN: The location looks secure, but I might be able to find a way in.
中文: 这地方看上去挺严实的，但我也许能找到进去的方法。

EN: The people here look far from friendly. I better play my cards right.
中文: 这儿的人看上去可不怎么友好，我得见机行事。

EN: A Synth and Super Mutant battle has trapped me in a room with a Chemistry Station.
中文: 合成人和超级变种人的战斗把我困在了房间里，房间里就有化学工作站。

EN: A Deathclaw seems to have made the Museum its home!
中文: 一只死爪把博物馆变成了它自己家！

EN: Most of the Plant is flooded. I'll need to swim underwater to explore it all.
中文: 厂区大部分都被水淹了，想把这里探个遍，就得潜到水底下游过去。

EN: I've found a jammed door inside. There's an axe here I can use to break it down.
中文: 我在里面找到一扇卡住的门。这儿有把斧子，正好可以拿来把它砸开。

EN: There's nothing on the main floors. Heading to the basement.
中文: 主楼层什么都没有，我还是去地下室吧。

EN: Trying to hide from the Raiders.
中文: 试图躲开那些掠夺者。

EN: Searching the Abandoned Shack.
中文: 正在搜查废弃小屋。

EN: Trying to pry open the Refrigerator door.
中文: 试图撬开冰箱门。

EN: Attempting to open the Safe.
中文: 试图打开保险箱。

EN: Trying to unlock the door to the Super Duper Mart.
中文: 试图打开大无敌超市的大门。

EN: The Slaves are on the run, after killing their owner.
中文: 奴隶们杀了他们的主人，正在逃跑。

EN: Attempting to liberate the Slaves.
中文: 试图解放这些奴隶。

EN: Exploring the Gas Station.
中文: 探索加油站。

EN: The Fugitive Slave was shot in the leg. He can't get much farther.
中文: 逃亡的奴隶腿部中枪了，他跑不远。

EN: He's in need of repair, but I may be able to do it.
中文: 它需要修理，不过我也许能帮它修好。

EN: Trying to treat the Wounded Sheriff. He's in a lot of pain.
中文: 正在为受伤的警长处理伤口，他疼得厉害。

EN: The Ghoul is ugly, but not feral. In fact, she seems pretty friendly.
中文: 这尸鬼长得丑，但还没狂化。其实她看上去相当友好。

EN: The Merchant is interested in bartering.
中文: 这个商人似乎想和我做交易。

EN: The Talon Company Mercs are wary, but not hostile.
中文: 鹰爪公司的雇佣兵满怀警惕，但没有敌意。

EN: The Hunter needs help tracking a Yao Guai.
中文: 猎人需要我帮他找到妖怪熊。

EN: The Drunken Drifter wants to share a drink.
中文: 喝醉的流浪汉要和我喝一杯。

EN: Trying to convince the Brotherhood Patrol that I'm harmless.
中文: 正在设法让钢铁兄弟会巡逻队相信我毫无威胁。

EN: I'm guiding the Lost Farmer back to the nearest settlement.
中文: 我正引导迷路的农民找到最近的定居点。

EN: The Savage Dog bit me in the leg! Time to hobble away!
中文: 野狗咬伤了我的腿！只能一瘸一拐地逃了！

EN: The Radscorpion nearly impaled me with its stinger! Enough of this!
中文: 辐射蝎差点用它的螫针把我钉个对穿！我受够了！

EN: The Giant Soldier Ant wounded me! I'm bleeding... and running!
中文: 巨型兵蚁伤了我。我在流血……正夺路而逃！

EN: The Fire Ant Soldier set my clothes on fire! I can't beat this thing!
中文: 这火兵蚁烧了我的衣服！我打不过它！

EN: The Guard Dog really doesn't want me to pass! Time to back off!
中文: 这只看门狗看来是真不想让我过，还是后撤吧。

EN: The Fire Ant Warrior burned me pretty badly! Time to run and recover!
中文: 火蚁战士可把我烧惨了！得赶紧逃跑养伤。

EN: The Mirelurk nearly took my head off with its claws! I'm running!
中文: 泥沼蟹差点用爪子把我的脑袋拧下来！我这就跑！

EN: The Feral Ghoul Roamer attacked in a frenzy! I had to run!
中文: 狂尸鬼漫游者疯狂地袭击了我！我不得不逃！

EN: I can't possibly fight this Giant Radscorpion and live! Time to go!
中文: 跟这只巨型辐射蝎动手，我不可能活着脱身的！赶紧跑吧！

EN: The Mirelurk Hunter was too fast for me! It was run or die!
中文: 泥沼蟹猎杀者太快了！不跑就得死！

EN: The Vicious Dog bit me before I could react! I'm hurt and running!
中文: 还没等我反应过来恶犬就咬了我一口！我受伤了，但只能逃跑！

EN: The Mole rat chewed through my boot! Time to go before I lose a foot!
中文: 鼹鼠把我的靴子都咬穿了！得赶在丢掉一只脚之前开溜！

EN: The Centaur is as dangerous as it is ugly! I'd better run!
中文: 这多脚兽真是又丑又危险，我只有逃了！

EN: The Feral Ghoul Reaver was just way too strong to beat! I barely escaped alive!
中文: 这只狂尸鬼掠夺者太强大了！我真是死里逃生！

EN: Fighting a Deathclaw? I must have been out of my mind! I've got to run!
中文: 和死爪战斗？我一定是疯了！我得赶紧逃！

EN: The Enclave Deathclaw is trained to kill anything in its path! I have to run!
中文: 这只英克雷死爪受过训练，挡它路的通通杀掉！我得跑！

EN: No way I can defeat this Super Mutant! Time to make my escape!
中文: 我不可能打败这个超级变种人的！赶紧找路逃吧！

EN: Turns out fighting a Super Mutant Master is a pretty stupid idea! Got to run!
中文: 跟超级变种人大师动手，我是有多蠢！快跑！

EN: The Super Mutant Overlord is way too tough! I've got to try and escape!
中文: 超级变种人霸王真凶悍！我必须得逃！

EN: Defeating this Super Mutant Behemoth is impossible! Escape is my only option!
中文: 打败这只巨兽根本没门儿！逃跑是我唯一的选择！

EN: I wasn't prepared for the Bloatfly's sting! Time to run!
中文: 我没防住这只巨大苍蝇的蛰刺！快跑吧！

EN: The Radroach is too fast. I've had enough!
中文: 辐射蟑螂太快了。真是受够了！

EN: I was crazy to take on this Yao Guai! Hopefully I can get away!
中文: 我真是疯了，居然和妖怪熊杠上了。但愿我能逃脱！

EN: The Feral Ghoul is stronger than he looks! I'm out of here!
中文: 狂尸鬼比看起来要强壮多了！我得离开这里！

EN: The Giant Ant gave me a vicious arm wound! I'm running!
中文: 巨型蚂蚁咬伤了我的手臂！赶紧跑！

EN: The Scavenger's Dog is too tough! I can't beat it!
中文: 拾荒者的狗太凶残了，我打不过它！

EN: The Giant Worker Ant is relentless! It's no use trying to fight!
中文: 巨型工蚁如此冷酷无情！和它打一点用都没有！

EN: The entrance to the Broadcasting Tower is totally barricaded. There's no way in.
中文: 广播塔的入口完全被挡住了。没法进去。

EN: I found evidence of Raiders in the Abandoned Diner. Better leave while I can.
中文: 我在废弃餐厅里发现了掠夺者的痕迹。趁还走得掉，赶紧离开吧。

EN: A second floor window looked promising, but I couldn't reach it.
中文: 也许二楼的窗户可以进去，但我爬不上去。

EN: I accidentally insulted one of the traders and had to run out while dodging gunfire.
中文: 我不小心惹恼了一个商人，只好一路躲着枪子儿逃出来。

EN: I mixed the wrong chemicals and created a smoke cloud, but at least it hid my escape.
中文: 我好像混错了化学品，升起了一团烟雾。但这至少能掩护我逃出去。

EN: I fled up the back stairs, then climbed down to safety from a window.
中文: 我从后楼梯逃上去，再从窗户爬下来到了安全地带。

EN: I couldn't hold my breath long enough. I panicked and turned back.
中文: 我憋气的时间不够长，有点慌张，决定原路返回。

EN: The axe is just too heavy. I can't lift it enough to get a good swing.
中文: 这斧子也太沉了。举起它也挥不起来。

EN: A bunch of Mirelurks got the jump on me down there! I barely made it out.
中文: 一群泥沼蟹在那下面打了我个措手不及！我勉强逃了出来。

EN: The Raiders spotted me! I had to run.
中文: 掠夺者发现了我！我不得不跑。

EN: There's nothing in the Abandoned Shack. Time to move on.
中文: 废弃小屋里什么都没有。继续向前吧。

EN: The Refrigerator door is jammed shut. I couldn't get it open.
中文: 冰箱门被卡住了。我打不开。

EN: I just don't have the skill to open the Safe. I'll never know what's inside...
中文: 我打不开保险箱。永远都没法知道里面有什么了……

EN: I just can't pick the lock. I'll have to leave the Super Duper Mart behind.
中文: 我开不了锁。只能放弃大无敌超市了。

EN: The Slaves don't trust me. They ran away.
中文: 奴隶们不相信我。他们跑开了。

EN: The Slave Camp is too well guarded. Those poor people. I just can't help them on my own.
中文: 奴隶营的戒备太森严了。那些可怜的人。光靠我自己无法帮助他们。

EN: The Gas Station has been picked clean. Even the fusion tanks are empty.
中文: 加油站早被搜刮得一干二净，连聚变燃料罐都空了。

EN: The Slave's leg is gangrenous. There's nothing I can do.
中文: 奴隶的腿已经生了坏疽。我无能为力。

EN: Nope. I was wrong. Repairing the Mister Handy is way too technical for me.
中文: 不，我错了。修理巧手先生对我来说太难了。

EN: So much blood. I can't stop it. I'm afraid the Sheriff doesn't have much longer.
中文: 血流了一地。我止不住。恐怕警长撑不了多久了。

EN: I guess I'm not as charming as I thought. The Ghoul refuses to talk to me.
中文: 我根本没自己想的那么有魅力。尸鬼拒绝和我说话。

EN: I pushed my luck. The Merchant didn't like the deal I proposed.
中文: 是我得寸进尺了。商人并不喜欢我提的买卖。

EN: The Talon Company Mercs drew their guns and told me to leave. I did.
中文: 鹰爪公司的雇佣兵拔出他们的枪，让我离开。我照做了。

EN: I couldn't locate the Yao Guai. The Hunter thinks I'm completely incompetent.
中文: 我找不到妖怪熊。猎人认为我很无能。

EN: The Drunken Drifter thought I took too big a gulp. He left angry, and took his bottle.
中文: 醉酒的流浪者嫌我一口灌得太猛，气冲冲地走了，酒瓶也拿走了。

EN: The Brotherhood Patrol doesn't trust me. They ordered me to leave, or they'd open fire.
中文: 钢铁兄弟会巡逻队不信任我。他们命令我离开，否则他们会开枪。

EN: I couldn't find the settlement. Now the Lost Farmer is even worse off than before.
中文: 我找不到定居点。现在迷路的农民的状况比以前更糟了。

EN: I can't do it. I'm just not strong enough.
中文: 我做不到，我的力气还不够大。

EN: That just made them angrier. I got scratched up running past them to the exit.
中文: 这让他们更愤怒了。跑向出口的途中我被抓伤了。

EN: It's still going, but I'm exhausted. There's no way I'll catch it now.
中文: 它还在跑，可我已经筋疲力尽。这下说什么也追不上它了。

EN: I made it to the nearest tree line without incident.
中文: 我一路无事，跑到了最近的树林边缘。

EN: Shouldn't have done that! I had to run out with the building collapsing behind me.
中文: 就不该那么干！大楼在我身后轰然坍塌，我只好夺路而逃。

EN: I can't get close enough. The Lake's radiation is making me sick.
中文: 我无法靠近。湖水的辐射使我感到恶心。

EN: The Room's security is too advanced. I can't get the door open.
中文: 这个房间的安保太高级了，我根本打不开那扇门。

EN: A blade trap I failed to spot nearly took my head off. I better turn back.
中文: 一个没察觉的刀片陷阱，差点把我的脑袋削下来。还是回头吧。

EN: It's no good, they won't open the door. I guess I better move on.
中文: 不太妙，他们不开门。我想我还是继续往前吧。

EN: Walked right into a string of tin cans. Time to run!
中文: 一脚踩进一串锡罐，绊线警报响了。赶紧跑！

EN: There's absolutely nothing left. I'm not surprised, but it's still disappointing.
中文: 什么都没剩下。我不觉得惊讶，就是有点失望。

EN: It's a lost cause. I can't make heads or tails of all these wires and capacitors.
中文: 没救了。这一堆电线和电容，我根本理不出个头绪。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Fancy Lads snack cakes provide excellent sustenance.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：俏男孩牌蛋糕提供了极好的营养。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Whoever chose the name “Deathclaw” wasn't kidding.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：起了“死爪”这个名字的人可真不是在开玩笑。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Societal infrastructure is completely dismantled.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：社会的基础设施早已彻底瓦解。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. In the Wasteland, trust can get you killed.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：在废土上，轻信会害你送命。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Some pre-war robots remain, but programming often faulty.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：一些战前机器人仍然存在，但程序经常出现故障。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Old religions mostly gone, replaced by cults.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：旧日的宗教大多消亡，取而代之的是邪教。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Everyone is armed. Guns are commonplace.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：人人身上都带着家伙。枪支随处可见。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Fashion is dead. You wear what keeps you alive.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：时尚已死。你只穿那些能让你活命的装备。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. TVs don't work, but radio broadcasts are common.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：电视早就没法用了，倒是无线电广播很常见。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Old buildings have supplies, but they're often guarded.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：曾经的建筑物有物资，但它们通常有人看着。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Everywhere I look, death. Suffering. And... hope.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：放眼望去，死亡。苦难。还有……希望。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. I've seen children, families. Life goes on.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：我见过孩子，也见过一个个家庭。日子还在继续。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Marriage is not uncommon. You can't kill love.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：结婚并不少见。爱情是杀不死的。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Radscorpion. Stinger plus claws equals death.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：辐射蝎。尾刺加螯钳，等于死亡。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Lock picking is an essential skill for gaining access.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：开锁是进入各处的必备技能。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Many functional computer terminals. Hacking a necessity.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：不少计算机终端还能正常运转。黑客技术必不可少。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Medical training is essential for survival.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：医学训练是生存的关键。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. The Brotherhood of Steel favors technology. Worships it.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：钢铁兄弟会崇尚科技，甚至把它当神明崇拜。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Training with a variety of guns is a must.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：各式枪支都得练熟。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Music, painting, dance. Art and culture survive.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：音乐、绘画、舞蹈。艺术与文化仍延续至今。

中文: 一只凶残的野狗，正愤怒地低吼。

中文: 一个危险的狂尸鬼掠夺者。

中文: 一只致命的死爪。

中文: 一只巨大苍蝇，危险地嗡嗡叫着靠近。

中文: 一个旧冰箱。里面可能有东西。

EN: a locked Safe.
中文: 一个锁住的保险箱。

EN: a Super Duper Mart.
中文: 一个大无敌超市。

EN: a small group of escaped Slaves.
中文: 一小群逃跑的奴隶。

EN: a well-guarded Slave Camp.
中文: 一个守卫严密的奴隶营。

EN: a deserted Gas Station.
中文: 一个废弃的加油站。

EN: a Fugitive Slave.
中文: 一名逃亡的奴隶。

EN: a malfunctioning Mister Handy.
中文: 一个出故障的巧手先生。

EN: a Wounded Sheriff.
中文: 一名受伤的警长。

EN: a traveling Ghoul.
中文: 一个游走的尸鬼。

EN: a wandering Merchant.
中文: 一名流浪的商人。

EN: a group of Talon Company Mercs.
中文: 一伙鹰爪公司雇佣兵。

EN: a Hunter.
中文: 一名猎人。

EN: a Drunken Drifter.
中文: 一个喝醉酒的流浪汉。

EN: a Brotherhood Patrol.
中文: 一支钢铁兄弟会巡逻队。

EN: a Lost Farmer. He's tired and scared.
中文: 一位迷路的农民。他又累又怕。

EN: a boarded up Convenience Store.
中文: 一家用木板封死的便利店。

EN: a Dark Cave in the middle of the woods.
中文: 树林中间的一个黑暗的山洞。

EN: a Caravan Merchant chasing after a panicked Brahmin.
中文: 一名大篷车商人正在追逐一头受惊的双头牛。

EN: a Wide Open Field, impossible to cross without being spotted.
中文: 一片开阔的田野，想不被发现就穿过去是不可能的。

EN: an empty, nearly collapsed Raider Hideout.
中文: 一处空荡荡、几近坍塌的掠夺者藏身处。

EN: an Irradiated Lake.
中文: 一个被辐射污染的湖。

EN: a Sealed Room in a house basement.
中文: 地下室的一个封闭房间。

EN: a large Apartment Building.
中文: 一幢大型公寓楼。

EN: a well-defended Outpost of Survivors.
中文: 一处防御严密的幸存者前哨站。

EN: a bustling Children of Atom Camp blocking the road.
中文: 一处熙熙攘攘的原子之子营地，挡住了去路。

EN: an Old Mansion, long since sacked.
中文: 一座老公馆，早就被洗劫一空。

EN: a Robot Factory, with broken Protectrons scattered outside.
中文: 一个机器人工厂，损坏的保护者散落在外。

EN: Here we go.
中文: 说走就走。

EN: All right, Wasteland. Here I come!
中文: 来吧，废土！我来了！

EN: Ah. So that's why they call it the Wasteland.
中文: 呃。难怪人家管这儿叫“废土”。

EN: Yep. Everything's destroyed.
中文: 是的。一切都毁了。

EN: Okay, this is kind of... depressing.
中文: 好吧，这有点儿……让人沮丧。

EN: I'll make the Vault proud. They'll see.
中文: 我会让避难所为我骄傲的。等着瞧。

EN: And I'm off!
中文: 这就出发！

EN: Thought I'd never get out of there.
中文: 还以为这辈子都出不去了呢。

EN: This is so exciting!
中文: 太让人兴奋了！

EN: I'm ready for anything.
中文: 我已经准备好了一切。

EN: Come on Wasteland show me what you've got!
中文: 来吧，废土！让我看看你到底有什么本事！

EN: Finally, some fresh air.
中文: 总算能呼吸上新鲜空气了。

EN: Okay. I can do this.
中文: 好。我能行的。

EN: I won't stray too far. Just in case.
中文: 我不会走得太远，以防万一。

EN: This doesn't seem so bad.
中文: 似乎不那么糟糕。

EN: Once more unto the breach!
中文: 再一次冲锋陷阵！

EN: It's brighter than I expected.
中文: 比我想象的要亮。

EN: Wow, is it always this hot out here?
中文: 哇，外面一直都这么热吗？

EN: Away we go!
中文: 出发喽！

EN: I wonder what's left?
中文: 不知道外面还剩下些什么呢？

EN: I wonder how far I can get on foot?
中文: 不知道光靠两条腿能走多远？

EN: My feet hurt already.
中文: 我的脚已经开始疼了。

EN: Starting to regret coming out here.
中文: 开始后悔来这里。

EN: Maybe I'm not cut out for exploring after all.
中文: 也许我压根就不是探险的料。

EN: I will not return a failure. I will not return a failure...
中文: 我不会失败而归的。我不会失败而归的……

EN: The Vault's counting on me. I've got to push on.
中文: 整个避难所都指望我呢。我得继续前进。

EN: That way looks promising.
中文: 那条路看上去还不错。

EN: I'm bound to run into somebody sooner or later.
中文: 我迟早会遇到什么人。

EN: I really don't want to get eaten out here...
中文: 我真的不想在这里被吃掉……

EN: If I die out here, they'll never know...
中文: 如果我死在这里，他们永远不会知道……

EN: This way looks as good as any.
中文: 这条路看着不比别的差。

EN: Super Mutants are just a myth... right?
中文: 超级变种人只是个传说……对吧？

EN: There's got to be something out here.
中文: 这外面总该有点什么吧。

EN: This isn't so bad. Maybe we should all leave the Vault...
中文: 这还不算太坏。也许我们都应该离开避难所……

EN: Hope I can find my way back.
中文: 希望我能找到回家的路。

EN: I'll grab just as much as I can carry, then head back.
中文: 能拿多少拿多少，然后就回去。

EN: If I find just one box of Sugar Bombs, it'll be worth it.
中文: 如果只发现了一盒糖衣炸弹麦片，那也是值得的。

EN: I guess I'll head... that way.
中文: 我想我就往……那边走吧。

EN: Maybe I should have dropped some bread crumbs.
中文: 早知道就一路撒点面包屑了。

EN: This way looks promising.
中文: 这条路看上去还不错。

EN: Trying to pull off the boards blocking the front door.
中文: 正试图撬开挡在前门的木板。

EN: I've been cornered in the Cave by a family of Yao Guai. I'll try to pacify them.
中文: 被妖怪熊一家人逼到了山洞的角落。我会尽力安抚它们。

EN: Running after the Brahmin to help out the Merchant. That thing is fast!
中文: 帮助商人追逐双头牛。那东西很快！

EN: Staying low to the ground as I cross the Field as quickly as possible.
中文: 匍匐在地上，尽可能快地穿过田野。

EN: Exploring the Hideout, but one wrong step will make it fall on my head.
中文: 探索藏身处，但只要走错一步，上头就会整个塌下来砸到我头上。

EN: Something's floating near the shore. I'll try to get it.
中文: 岸边漂着个东西。我看看能不能把它捞上来。

EN: Hacking a terminal to get the door open.
中文: 正在破解终端，好把门打开。

EN: Looking around for supplies, but this place is full of booby traps.
中文: 四处寻找物资，但这地方布满了陷阱。

EN: Trying to convince them to let me in so I can rest.
中文: 试图说服他们让我进去休息。

EN: Going around will take too much time. I'll have to try sneaking through the Camp.
中文: 绕过去会花太多时间。我要试着偷偷穿过营地。

EN: Searching the Mansion for anything of value that might have been left behind.
中文: 找找公馆里还有没有任何有价值的东西。

EN: The door is sealed. If I can fix a Protectron's laser arm, I could blast it open.
中文: 门封得死死的。要是能修好保护者的激光手臂，就能把门轰开。

EN: Guess I'll go this way.
中文: 我想我会走这条路。

EN: I'm going to need such a bath when I get home.
中文: 回家以后真得好好洗个澡。

EN: The wind is whistling. Sounds like voices.
中文: 风声呜咽，听着倒像人说话。

EN: Hello? Can anybody hear me?
中文: 喂？有人能听见我说话吗？

EN: Your eyes start to play tricks on you out here.
中文: 在这外面待久了，眼睛都会开始骗你。

EN: That hill looks like a good vantage point.
中文: 那座山头看起来是个不错的瞭望点。

EN: Whoa! I tripped over some rubble.
中文: 嗷！被碎石绊了一下。

EN: My Pip-Boy sure is coming in handy out here.
中文: 我的哔哔小子在这外面可真是帮了大忙。

EN: Pew! I stink.
中文: 呸！我身上好臭。

EN: My soles are wearing out.
中文: 我的鞋底已经磨穿了。

EN: So much dust and grime everywhere.
中文: 到处都是灰尘和污垢。

EN: Oh good, this road slopes downwards. Easier on the legs.
中文: 太好了，这段是下坡，省腿力。

EN: Is someone following me?
中文: 有人跟踪我吗？

EN: Let me just climb over this rubble...
中文: 我来翻过这堆碎石……

EN: I'll cut through this destroyed building.
中文: 我要从这栋被毁的建筑里穿过去。

EN: Those buildings have completely fallen into the street.
中文: 那几栋楼整个塌进了街道。

EN: Now I know how Hansel and Gretel felt.
中文: 总算体会到汉赛尔与格蕾特的心情了。

EN: A shower is going to feel so great when I get home.
中文: 回家后冲个澡一定爽翻了。

EN: Is that... music? A radio somewhere, maybe?
中文: 那是……音乐？附近哪里可能有台收音机？

EN: Smoke on the horizon. Could be a campfire. Or something else...
中文: 远处有烟，可能是篝火，也可能是别的东西……

EN: An old fire station. Even they couldn't stop the world from burning.
中文: 一座旧消防站。可就连他们也没能拦住世界燃烧。

EN: Maybe I'll head this way for awhile.
中文: 也许我该朝这条路走一会儿。

EN: Should I go east?
中文: 我应该往东吗？

EN: These tracks - human, or something else?
中文: 这些痕迹——是人类吗？还是其他的？

EN: Should I go north?
中文: 我应该往北吗？

EN: Should I go west?
中文: 我应该往西吗？

EN: Should I go south?
中文: 我应该往南吗？

EN: Guess I'll head east for a bit.
中文: 我想我会往东走一会儿。

EN: Guess I'll head north for a bit.
中文: 我想我会往北走一会儿。

EN: Guess I'll head west for a bit.
中文: 我想我会往西走一会儿。

EN: Guess I'll head south for a bit.
中文: 我想我会往南走一会儿。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. The Wasteland is a cruel, inhospitable place.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：废土是个残酷而不宜生存的地方。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Getting hungry. Craving Salisbury Steak.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：肚子饿了。馋索尔兹伯里牛排了。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Always thirsty. Need to stay hydrated.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：总是口渴。得随时补水。

EN: Hello? Anybody out here?
中文: 喂？外面有人吗？

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. It's gone. It's all gone.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：不见了。一切都不见了。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Cars litter the roads. None drivable.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：路上到处都是废弃的车。没一辆还能开。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. So many skeletons. The world is a grave.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：这么多骷髅。这个世界就是一座坟墓。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Some pre-war food is still edible. Preservatives.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：有些战前食物还能吃。全靠防腐剂。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Law and order are things of the past.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：法律和秩序是过去的事情了。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. The world is still largely irradiated.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：世界大部分地区仍有辐射。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. The flora and fauna all seem pretty... weird.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：这里的动植物看起来都挺……怪的。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Life thrives where it can out here.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：在这外面，生命总能在夹缝里繁衍。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Many buildings remain. Damage extensive.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：许多建筑物仍然存在。但损坏严重。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Most water undrinkable. Too much radiation.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：大部分水都没法喝。辐射太重。

EN: What was that?
中文: 那是什么？

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Bottle Caps accepted as currency everywhere.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：瓶盖成了通用的货币。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Slavers prey on the weak. My heart breaks.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：奴隶贩子专挑弱者下手。真让人心碎。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Food is scarce. Some resort to cannibalism.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：食物匮乏。有些人被迫吃人。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. A Yao Guai is a fierce, mutated bear.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：妖怪熊是一种凶猛的变异熊。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. A Ghoul is an irradiated human. Disfigured.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：尸鬼是被辐射改变的人类。面目全非。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Raiders are everywhere. Stealing. Murdering.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：掠夺者无处不在。偷窃。谋杀。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Feral Ghouls are basically zombies. Must avoid.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：狂尸鬼跟僵尸差不多。千万要躲开。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Mole rats are NOT cute...
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：鼹鼠一点都不可爱……

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Super Mutants hate humans. They'll kill on sight.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：超级变种人憎恨人类，见人就杀。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Giant ants are, indeed, giant ants.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：巨型蚂蚁——没错，就是巨大的蚂蚁。

EN: The Vault is counting on me. I won't let them down.
中文: 避难所的人们正指望着我。我不会让他们失望的。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. Radroaches. They really can survive anything.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：辐射蟑螂。它们能在任何环境里存活。

EN: Explorer's journal. New Entry. The military is gone. Replaced by mercenaries.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：军队已经不存在了。被雇佣兵所取代。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Most dogs no longer man's best friend.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：大多数狗不再是人类最好的朋友。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Squirrel tastes much better than you'd think.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：松鼠尝起来比想象的好得多。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Thought I saw a UFO, but that would be impossible...
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：还以为自己看见了 UFO，不过那不可能是真的……

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Sea creatures now extremely dangerous. Still delicious.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：海洋生物如今危险至极。但依然很好吃。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Sunsets, once romantic, are now terrifying. Fear the night.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：日落曾经浪漫，如今却很可怕。当心黑夜。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. So very hungry. Wondering if human tastes like chicken.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：饿坏了。真想知道人肉吃起来是不是像鸡肉。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Super Mutants are big. Behemoths, more so.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：超级变种人块头很大。巨兽型就更大了。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Money replaced by soda bottle Caps. Hands always sticky.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：汽水瓶盖代替了钱。双手总是黏糊糊的。

EN: Clouds on the horizon. Hope it doesn't rain.
中文: 天边有乌云。希望不会下雨。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. The comics were wrong. Radiation does not grant super powers.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：漫画都是骗人的。辐射才不会给你超能力。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Love does not conquer all. Nukes come close.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：爱不能战胜一切。核武器几乎可以。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Bigger not always better. Case in point – roaches and scorpions.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：块头大不一定就好。瞧瞧蟑螂和蝎子。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Super Mutants are asexual. Before transformation, some were women.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：超级变种人没有性别。变异之前，有些原本是女性。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Junk is everywhere, but has multiple uses.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：杂物无处不在，但有多种用途。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Power Armor still exists, but is rare. Affords maximum protection.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：动力装甲依然存在，但很少见。防护性能拉满。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Found a fat man willing to share food. May live another day.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：找到了一个愿意分享食物的胖子。又可以多活一天。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Many Mister Handy robots remain. Use expressions like, “bloody barmy.”
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：许多巧手先生还在。它们会冒出诸如“疯得没边儿”这样的口头禅。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Fruits and vegetables still grow, but are mutated, like so much else.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：水果和蔬菜还在生长，但和其他很多东西一样，都变异了。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Homemade weapons abound. Humans still excel at killing each other.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：自制武器比比皆是。人类仍旧擅长杀死同类。

EN: I'll follow this road, see where it goes.
中文: 我选这条路，看它会带我去何方。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. Radio still widely used, remains an effective means of communication.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：收音机仍被广泛使用，依旧是一种有效的通讯手段。

EN: Explorer's journal. New entry. We were wrong – cats not, in fact, extinct. But still lazy.
中文: 探险家日志。新条目：我们错了——猫其实还没灭绝。但还是那么懒。

EN: Is that... a human head on a post? Okay, time to turn around...
中文: 那是……插在杆子上的人头？好了，该掉头了……

EN: I may be scared senseless, but at least I'm getting some cardio.
中文: 我也许是吓得魂飞魄散，但好歹算锻炼了心肺。

EN: Getting peckish. Snack time?
中文: 越来越饿。该吃点心了吧？

EN: Huh. What's that flashing thing? How is OH MY GOD I'M IN A MINEFIELD. Sloowwwlly now...
中文: 嗯？什么东西在闪？怎么会——哦我的天，我进雷区了！慢……慢……慢点挪……

EN: Oh look, a destroyed pizzeria. Maybe we can have a Vault pizza night when I get back...
中文: 快看，一家被毁的披萨店。等我回去，咱们避难所也办个“披萨之夜”吧……

EN: There's ancient money everywhere. Guess you really can't take it with you.
中文: 到处都是旧时代的钞票。看来钱真是生不带来、死不带去。

EN: An old Army transport. Looks like the soldiers tried to keep order. For a little while.
中文: 一辆旧军用运输车。看来士兵们曾想维持秩序——也就撑了一小会儿。

EN: That snarling... Dogs? Wolves? Worse?
中文: 那咆哮声……是狗？是狼？还是更糟的东西？

EN: A crossroads. Left or right? Let's try left.
中文: 十字路口。向左还是向右？试试左边吧。

EN: I'll head this way.
中文: 我要走这条路。

EN: Might as well head down here.
中文: 不妨就从这边走。

EN: My blisters have blisters. Ouch.
中文: 我的水泡上又长了水泡。好痛。

EN: So tired of walking. My kingdom for a bicycle.
中文: 走得太累了。真想拿我的王国换辆自行车。

EN: All things considered, this expedition's going pretty well.
中文: 总的来说，这次探险的进展还不错。

EN: Hello? Heeeelllooo? Nope. Guess I'm alone.
中文: 喂——？喂~~~~？算了。估计就我一个人。

EN: You know, it's really not so bad out here. Sometimes.
中文: 说真的，这外面也没那么糟。有时候吧。

EN: Rad detector's going crazy. Must be those green barrels...
中文: 辐射探测器都快响疯了。肯定是那些绿色桶……

EN: Whoa! Tripped. Gotta be more careful.
中文: 嗷！绊了一下。得小心点。

EN: Think I'll just walk over here and OW! Twisted my ankle!
中文: 我就随便沿这边走走——哎哟！崴到脚了！

EN: A crossroads. Left or right? I guess I'll go right.
中文: 十字路口。向左还是向右？还是往右边吧。

EN: All these destroyed cars, but they never flew. Guess science missed that boat.
中文: 满街都是被毁的汽车，可它们从来没飞起来过。看来科学是错过了这一趟。

EN: It's... a motorboat. Stuck into the side of a church. Don't see that every day.
中文: 这是……一艘摩托艇，直挺挺插在教堂墙上。这可不是天天能见着。

EN: I wonder if elephants still exist.
中文: 不知道大象还在不在。

EN: May as well follow this blood trail. What could possibly go wrong?
中文: 干脆顺着血迹走吧。还能出什么岔子呢？

EN: Thirsty. Wonder if I can find a bottle of Nuka-Cola.
中文: 渴。不知道能不能找到一瓶核子可乐。

EN: A terminal. Really wish I could hack it!
中文: 一个电脑终端。真希望我能破解它！

EN: Hmm. A chest. Really wish I could pick the lock. I bet there's some great stuff inside.
中文: 嗯，箱子。真希望我能开锁。我敢打赌里面一定有一些好东西。

EN: A broken bottle, spent ammo casings, drops of blood... Definitely signs of a fight.
中文: 一个破碎的瓶子、弹壳、几滴血……这里绝对发生过战斗。

EN: I feel exposed. Time to get into cover.
中文: 我感觉自己完全暴露了。该找掩体了。

EN: Got a weird feeling. Like I'm being watched...
中文: 有一种奇怪的感觉。好像我一直被监视着……

EN: I really should be drawing a map.
中文: 我真的应该画一幅地图。

EN: It sure gets lonely out here.
中文: 在外面待久了，还真是孤单啊。

EN: Should I be walking out in the open like this? Or sneaking? I can never tell.
中文: 我应该这样光明正大地走过去呢，还是偷偷潜行？永远搞不清状况。

EN: Gunshots to the east. Guess I'll go west.
中文: 东部有枪声。我应该往西。

EN: Gunshots to the west. Guess I'll go east.
中文: 西部有枪声。我应该往东。

EN: Gunshots to the north. Guess I'll go south.
中文: 北部有枪声。我应该往南。

EN: Gunshots to the south. Guess I'll go north.
中文: 南部有枪声。我应该往北。

EN: Is that... a child? Nope... just the severed head of a doll. Wonderful.
中文: 那是……一个孩子？不……只是个被砍下来的玩偶脑袋。妙极了。

EN: I really hope I can find my way back to the Vault...
中文: 我希望我能找到回避难所的路……

EN: Wow, that's a really big pile of rubble. I think I can make it over...
中文: 哇，真是好大一堆瓦砾。我想我能过去的……

EN: So many big buildings. I wonder if they'll remain standing... forever.
中文: 这么多的高楼大厦。不知道它们还能不能一直矗立下去……直到永远。

EN: I hear a child crying. Impossible to tell where it's coming from.
中文: 我听见一个孩子的哭声。不确定它从哪里传来。

EN: Should I head back to the Vault? Maybe in a bit.
中文: 我应该回避难所吗？也许再过一会儿吧。

EN: I wonder if Brahmin milk is any good. Not that I want to find out.
中文: 不知道双头牛的奶好不好喝。当然，我可不打算去试。

EN: Still wandering...
中文: 仍在四处转悠……

EN: Think I'll Wait, what's that? Over there?
中文: 我想我就——等等，那是什么？那边？

EN: This way looks good.
中文: 这条路看起来不错。

EN: Too much rubble. Don't think I can get up there.
中文: 瓦砾也太多了。我大概是爬不上去的。

EN: Hmm. Subway station. I don't think I want to go down there.
中文: 嗯，地铁站。我不想去那里。

EN: A car tunnel. Sure is dark in there. I think I'll go around.
中文: 一条汽车隧道。里面可真黑。我还是绕路吧。

EN: Another looted convenience store.
中文: 另一个被洗劫的便利店。

EN: A broken rifle on the ground. Useless.
中文: 地面上有一把破枪。没用。

EN: Maybe I'll head back soon.
中文: 也许我很快就该回去了。

EN: It's quiet. Too quiet.
中文: 好安静。太安静了。

EN: Must go on. For now.
中文: 得继续走。暂且如此。

EN: I can do this. I can do this. I can do this.
中文: 我可以的。我可以的。我可以的。

EN: Wonder what's over there.
中文: 不知道那里有什么。

EN: I'll climb that ridge and get the lay of the land.
中文: 我要爬上那道山脊，看看周围的地形。

EN: I sense danger everywhere...
中文: 我感觉危险无处不在……

EN: Just got to keep moving forward.
中文: 只需要继续前进。

EN: I'd be totally lost without my Pip-Boy.
中文: 要不是有哔哔小子，我肯定迷路了。

EN: Broken branches. Something passed through here.
中文: 断枝。一定有东西经过这里。

EN: Nowhere to go but straight ahead.
中文: 除了硬着头皮往前走，已经无处可去了。

EN: Ow. Rock in my shoe.
中文: 嗷。我的鞋里进了石头。

EN: Fresh tracks. Can't tell what made them.
中文: 新鲜的痕迹。看不出是什么留下的。

EN: I bet this neighborhood was nice once.
中文: 我敢打赌这片社区曾经一定很棒。

EN: Hard to imagine people actually living out here.
中文: 很难想象人们真的住在这种地方。

EN: The more supplies I bring back to the Vault, the better.
中文: 我能带回避难所的物资越多越好。

EN: I'm going to have such blisters tomorrow...
中文: 我明天会起水泡……

EN: I'll head that way. Might be something interesting.
中文: 我要走那条路。说不定会发生什么有趣的事情。

EN: Hmm? Something over there?
中文: 嗯？那边有东西？

EN: Fresh tracks. Animal, or... worse?
中文: 新鲜的痕迹。动物的？或者……更可怕的？

EN: Should I go that way? Hmmm. No, I'll go this way.
中文: 我应该走那条路吗？嗯……算了，我还是走这条吧。

EN: Wonder if someone will give me a massage when I get back.
中文: 不知道回去会不会有人给我做按摩。

EN: Legs are cramping. But I must go on.
中文: 腿抽筋了。但是还得继续。

EN: Ow, my aching feet...
中文: 嗷，我的脚好痛……

EN: If the others could only see how bad it is for themselves...
中文: 真想让其他人也亲眼看看这外面有多糟……

EN: Sky looks funny over there. Storm might be coming.
中文: 那边的天空看起来有点不对劲。暴风雨可能要来了。

EN: A fork in the road. Guess I'll go left.
中文: 一个岔路口。我选左边。

EN: A fork in the road. Guess I'll go right.
中文: 一个岔路口。我选右边。

EN: Think I'll go down this path.
中文: 我想我会走这条小路。

EN: This path looks good.
中文: 这条小路看起来不错。

EN: Hmm... Broken plants. Someone pass by here?
中文: 嗯……植物被踩折了。有人从这儿经过？

EN: Never knew I could sweat so much!
中文: 从来不知道我能流这么多汗！

EN: This sure is good exercise, if nothing else.
中文: 别的先不说，这好歹算是不错的锻炼。

EN: Hmm. Something over there?
中文: 嗯，那边有东西？

EN: Thought I saw something...
中文: 还以为看见什么了……

EN: What was that sound?
中文: 那是什么声音？

EN: Traveling alone sure is, well... lonely.
中文: 独自旅行嘛，呃……还真是孤独。

EN: Need to bring supplies back to the Vault. Focus on that...
中文: 得把物资带回避难所。专心想这个……

EN: All this walking is murder on my feet.
中文: 这一路走下来，我这双脚可遭了大罪。

EN: Good thing I'm wearing sensible footwear!
中文: 还好我穿着合脚的鞋子。

EN: Calves, thighs, knees - they're all hurting.
中文: 小腿，大腿，膝盖——都好痛。

EN: Sweat in my eyes. Ouch.
中文: 汗水流进了眼睛。嗷。

EN: I'll head back to the Vault. But not yet. Not yet...
中文: 我会回到避难所的。但现在还不是时候……不是时候……

EN: When I get back to the Vault, they'll hail me as a hero!
中文: 当我回到避难所的时候，他们会把我当作英雄！

EN: Could be something over there.
中文: 那里可能有东西。

EN: Looks like a lake. Definitely don't want to go swimming in THAT.
中文: 看起来像个湖。可绝对别想让我下去游泳。

EN: On the ground. Is that dried... blood?
中文: 地上那干的东西……是血？

EN: Looks like a trail of paint. Oh, wait. Nope. That's blood.
中文: 看起来像油漆。哦，等等。不。那是血。

EN: I'm a bundle of nerves...
中文: 我现在可是紧张得不行……

EN: Okay, I'll admit it. I'm terrified.
中文: 好吧，我承认。我吓坏了。

EN: I won't give in to my fear. I won't give in to my fear.
中文: 我不会向恐惧屈服。我不会向恐惧屈服。

EN: I'd whistle a tune, but my mouth is too dry.
中文: 我想吹口哨，但我的嘴巴太干了。

EN: If I get lost out here, I'm in serious trouble.
中文: 如果我在这里迷路可就出大事了。

EN: People actually live out here? Ugh.
中文: 真的有人住在这种地方吗？呃。

EN: Oh, that's a nice little house. Or at least it was.
中文: 哦，那是一个很好的小房子。至少曾经是。

EN: This way looks as good as any other.
中文: 这条路看起来跟别的路也差不多。

EN: Looks like an old store. Wonder what they sold?
中文: 看起来像一个旧商店。不知道他们卖什么？

EN: Oh look, an old bus stop. Sure wish I could catch a ride.
中文: 哦，看，一个旧的公共汽车站。真希望我能搭一趟车。

EN: Am I talking to myself? I think I am. Uh oh.
中文: 我是在跟自己说话吗？我想我是。糟了。

EN: An old elementary school. Wow, that's not depressing at all...
中文: 一所破旧的小学。哇，真是半点都不让人沮丧……

EN: I'll keep going this way.
中文: 我会继续走这条路。

EN: Think I'll head that way for awhile.
中文: 我打算往那边走上一阵子。

EN: Time to turn back? Nah.
中文: 是时候回去了？算了。

EN: An old coffee shop. Sure could go for a cup of joe right about now.
中文: 一个旧咖啡馆？现在要能喝上一杯咖啡就太棒了。

EN: Is that...an old Nuka-Cola factory? Too bad it's destroyed.
中文: 那是……一个旧核子可乐工厂吗？被摧毁了，真是糟糕。

EN: I hear chanting. Probably some crazy cult. Better keep my distance.
中文: 我听到有人在诵经。可能是哪个疯狂的邪教吧。我最好保持距离。

EN: Sure wish I had a traveling buddy.
中文: 真希望我有个旅伴。

EN: An old hospital. Looks like it's been picked clean.
中文: 一家旧医院。看上去被洗劫一空。

EN: Some old department store. No clothes left.
中文: 一家旧百货商场。一件衣服都没剩。

EN: Oh look, an old baseball diamond. Nobody's run those bases in a long time.
中文: 哦，一个旧棒球场。很久没人在这儿跑垒了。

EN: Hasn't been a touchdown in that old football field in two hundred years.
中文: 已经两百年没有人在那个旧橄榄球场触地得分了。

EN: Looks like debris from an old plane crash.
中文: 看起来像是曾经飞机失事时留下的残骸。

EN: An old, crashed vertibird. From the Army, before the war.
中文: 一架坠毁的老式垂直起降机。战前军队的装备。

EN: Now that is one big house. Still couldn't stop an atomic bomb.
中文: 嚯，那栋房子可真够大。可再大也挡不住原子弹。

EN: A drained swimming pool filled with skeletons. Lovely.
中文: 一个干涸的游泳池，里面全是骷髅。真是妙极了。

EN: I think that building was... a hotel? An apartment complex?
中文: 我看那栋楼以前是……酒店？还是公寓楼？

EN: A rusty old playground. So sad.
中文: 一个锈迹斑斑的老游乐场。真让人难过。

EN: Have I started talking to myself? I can't tell.
中文: 我是不是开始自言自语了？我自己也说不准。

EN: Wind's picking up...
中文: 起风了……

EN: Need to control my breathing. Stay calm.
中文: 需要控制我的呼吸。保持冷静。

EN: Another rusty old car.
中文: 又一辆生锈的旧汽车。

EN: Ouch! Leg cramp!
中文: 嗷！腿抽筋！

EN: Time for a break? Maybe later.
中文: 该休息了吗？还是等会吧。

EN: I've got to keep moving.
中文: 我必须走了。

EN: The Overseer made the right choice, choosing me for this.
中文: 监督者选我来干这趟差事，真是选对人了。

EN: The longer I'm out here, the more danger I'm in.
中文: 我在这里的时间越长，就越是危险。

EN: I can feel my heart racing.
中文: 我能感觉到我的心跳加速。

EN: Just being out here gives me an adrenaline rush!
中文: 光是待在这外面就够我肾上腺素飙升了！

EN: I found an Abandoned Cabin and went inside.
中文: 发现一座废弃小屋，进去看了看。

EN: I searched through a Super Duper Mart I came across.
中文: 偶然路过了一个大无敌超市，彻底搜查了一遍。

EN: I discovered and explored a Red Rocket Truck Stop.
中文: 发现了红火箭服务站，进去探索了一番。

EN: I discovered another Vault and went inside.
中文: 发现另一个避难所，然后进去了。

EN: I did it. The Savage Dog is dead.
中文: 我做到了。野狗死了。

EN: I killed the Radscorpion. I can hardly believe it.
中文: 我杀死了辐射蝎。简直不敢相信。

EN: It was a tough fight but I managed to kill the Giant Soldier Ant.
中文: 这是一场艰苦的战斗，但我成功杀死了巨型兵蚁。

EN: One Fire Ant Soldier... extinguished!
中文: 一只火兵蚁……被我消灭了！

EN: I killed the Guard Dog before it could alert anyone to my presence.
中文: 我赶在看门狗向任何人报信之前，把它杀了。

EN: I barely managed to kill the Fire Ant Warrior.
中文: 我勉强杀死了火蚁战士。

EN: The Mirelurk is armored everywhere but the face, so I used that to my advantage. It's dead.
中文: 泥沼蟹浑身都是甲壳，只有脸是弱点，我正好利用了这一点。它死了。

EN: That's one Feral Ghoul Roamer whose roaming days are done.
中文: 这只狂尸鬼漫游者的游荡生涯到头了。

EN: I'm not quite sure how I managed it, but the Giant Radscorpion is dead.
中文: 我也不知道自己是怎么做到的，但巨型辐射蝎死了。

EN: The Mirelurk Hunter became the hunted. It's dead.
中文: 泥沼蟹猎杀者反成了猎物。它死了。

EN: It was close, but I killed the Vicious Dog.
中文: 好险，但我还是杀死了这只恶犬。

EN: The Mole rat has been killed.
中文: 鼹鼠被我杀了。

EN: I put the Centaur out of its misery.
中文: 我让多脚兽解脱了。

EN: It was a nasty fight, but the Feral Ghoul Reaver is dead.
中文: 这是一次激烈的战斗，但狂尸鬼掠夺者死了。

EN: I killed the Deathclaw! That was way too close...
中文: 我杀死了死爪！差一点点就被它……

EN: I killed the Enclave Deathclaw. At least now it's free.
中文: 我杀死了英克雷死爪。至少现在它自由了。

EN: I killed the Super Mutant.
中文: 我杀死了超级变种人。

EN: I'm beaten and bloodied, but the Super Mutant Master is dead.
中文: 我被揍得鼻青脸肿，但超级变种人大师死了。

EN: We went toe-to-toe, but the Super Mutant Overlord is finally dead.
中文: 我们打得难分高下，但超级变种人霸主终于死了。

EN: I did it. I killed the Behemoth. I think I'm in shock...
中文: 我做到了。我杀死了巨兽。我大概还没缓过神来……

EN: I killed the Bloatfly and it exploded into a thousand pieces. Disgusting.
中文: 我杀死了巨大苍蝇，炸成了一堆碎块。好恶心。

EN: I squashed the Radroach, no problem.
中文: 我踩扁了一只辐射蟑螂，小意思。

EN: It was a tough fight, but I killed the Yao Guai.
中文: 这是一场艰苦的战斗，但我杀死了妖怪熊。

EN: I killed the Feral Ghoul. It was him or me.
中文: 我杀死了狂尸鬼。不是它死，就是我亡。

EN: I've got some cuts and bruises, but the Giant Ant is dead.
中文: 我受了些皮肉伤，但巨型蚂蚁死了。

EN: I killed the Scavenger's Dog. Sad, but I had no choice.
中文: 我杀死了拾荒者的狗。很难过，但我别无选择。

EN: The Giant Worker Ant is dead. That was a close one.
中文: 巨型工蚁死了。真是惊险的战斗。

EN: I found an unlocked door into the Broadcasting Tower. There was a supply cache inside.
中文: 我找到一扇没上锁的门进了广播塔，里面有个物资储藏点。

EN: I found a working coffee machine! Maybe just one cup...
中文: 我找到了一台还能用的咖啡机！也许就喝一杯……

EN: I managed to enter and explore the National Guard Depot.
中文: 我成功进入国民警卫队仓库，探索了一番。

EN: I managed to make some friends. It's amazing what the right words can do.
中文: 我设法结交了一些朋友。原来好的沟通这么有用。

EN: I made enough explosives to clear the area! Now I can keep exploring.
中文: 我做的炸药够把这片区域炸个干净！现在我可以继续探险了。

EN: I fled through the back door and tripped on a hollowed-out rock filled with supplies.
中文: 我从后门逃跑，被岩石绊倒了。岩石是中空的，里面塞满了物资。

EN: Held my breath long enough to find a supply room with a few things above water.
中文: 我憋着气撑到找到一间物资室，水面上还漂着几样东西。

EN: I chopped the door to pieces and found a large supply closet.
中文: 我把门劈了个粉碎，找到了一间大储藏室。

EN: I spotted Mirelurks hiding down there, so I turned back and searched the Brewery again.
中文: 我发现有泥沼蟹躲在下面，于是掉头回去，把啤酒厂又搜了一遍。

EN: I successfully hid from the Raiders. That was close.
中文: 我成功地躲过了掠夺者。差一点就被发现了。

EN: I found a hidden box of supplies!
中文: 我找到了一个隐藏的物资盒！

EN: I got the Refrigerator open. There were some supplies inside.
中文: 我把冰箱打开。里面有一些物资。

EN: I cracked the Safe! Looks like there's some good stuff inside...
中文: 我撬开了保险箱！里面好像有好东西……

EN: Got the door open and explored the Super Duper Mart. I stocked up on supplies.
中文: 我打开门进了大无敌超市，探索了一番，备足了物资。

EN: The Slaves recognized me as friendly. We chatted for a bit, then they moved on.
中文: 奴隶们看我没有恶意。我们聊了一会儿，他们就继续上路了。

EN: I helped a dozen slaves escape. To freedom!
中文: 我帮十二个奴隶逃了出去。为了自由！

EN: I found some unopened crates in a storage closet.
中文: 我在储藏间里发现了几只未开封的货箱。

EN: I patched up the Slave's Leg. He's back on the run. I wish him the best.
中文: 我给奴隶包扎好了腿。他又能继续逃亡了。祝他一切顺利。

EN: I managed to repair the Mister Handy. He told me a pretty funny joke in exchange.
中文: 我修好了巧手先生。作为回报，它给我讲了个挺好笑的笑话。

EN: I stopped the bleeding and calmed him down. Looks like he's going to make it.
中文: 我止住了血，让他冷静下来。他应该能挺过来。

EN: The Ghoul gave me supplies... and some much needed friendship.
中文: 尸鬼给了我一些物资……还有我最需要的友谊。

EN: We struck a deal, and parted on good terms.
中文: 我们做成了一笔交易，好聚好散。

EN: I put the Talon Company Mercs at ease. We traded stories, and parted as friends.
中文: 我让鹰爪公司佣兵放下了戒心。我们互相讲了讲各自的经历，分别时已经成了朋友。

EN: I helped the Hunter locate and kill the Yao Guai.
中文: 我帮助猎人找到了妖怪熊并杀死了它。

EN: Hint: Some Objectives reward you with Lunchboxes, Pet Carriers or Mr. Handy Boxes!
中文: 提示：完成某些目标能赢得午餐盒、宠物笼子或巧手先生盒！

EN:
There are always three Objectives you can work on.

You can abandon one Objective each day for free and receive a new Objective in its place.

Additional Objectives can be skipped per day with Nuka-Cola Quantum.

Harder Objectives give better rewards.
中文:
总会有三个目标同时给您完成。

您可以每天放弃一个目标，同时会出现一个新目标。

每天还能使用量子核子可乐跳过额外的目标。

目标越难，奖励越大。

EN: GAME OBJECTIVES
中文: 游戏目标

EN: Hint: Luck stat affects the probability of earning CAPS when collecting Resources.
中文: 提示：运气值（L）能影响收集资源时获得瓶盖的概率。

EN:
Every Dweller has stats called SPECIAL

S (trength)
P (erception)
E (ndurance)
C (harisma)
I (ntelligence)
A (gility)
L (uck) 

Every room in the Vault is linked to one of the SPECIAL stats. The better the Dweller's stat is for that room, the more they influence the room's effects.
中文:
每个居民都有SPECIAL属性。

S（力量）
P（观察力）
E（耐力）
C（魅力）
I（智力）
A（敏捷）
L（运气） 

避难所的每间房都和居民SPECIAL属性中的一个有关。居民的相关属性越好，对房间的产出影响也越大。

EN: DWELLERS SPECIAL
中文: 居民属性

EN: Hint: Find RARE and LEGENDARY Dwellers in Lunchboxes.
中文: 提示：可以在午餐盒里找到稀有和传奇级别的居民。

EN:
LEVEL

Dwellers level up over time while working in Production Rooms, exploring the Wasteland, and killing enemies on Quests.

Leveling up increases the health of a Dweller. The higher their level is, the higher their health, but Dwellers with high Endurance gain more health when they level up. 
Rooms unlock based on how many Dwellers you have in your Vault.

RARITY

There are three types of rarity of Dwellers, COMMON, RARE, and LEGENDARY.

- COMMON: Low level and SPECIAL stats

- RARE: Average level and SPECIAL stats

- LEGENDARY: High level and SPECIAL stats
中文:
等级

居民在生产房间中工作、在废土中探险以及在任务中击杀敌人时都会提升等级。

升级会增加居民的生命值。等级越高，生命值越高；但耐力值高的居民在升级时会获得更多生命值。

房间的解锁取决于您避难所中的居民数量。

稀有度

居民分为普通、稀有和传奇三种稀有度。

- 普通：等级和属性值较低

- 稀有：等级和属性值中等

- 传奇：等级和属性值较高

EN: DWELLERS LEVEL & RARITY
中文: 居民等级和稀有度

EN: Hint: The higher the Dweller's level, the more CAPS their revival will cost.
中文: 提示：居民级别越高，复活时花费的瓶盖就越多。

EN:
A Dweller dies when their health is depleted.

To avoid Dwellers dying you can:
- Give them a Stimpak to Heal them.
- Give them a RadAway to remove Radiation.
- A dead Dweller can be revived with CAPS, or removed from your Vault.

Dwellers that die on a Quest can only be revived once the Quest is over.
中文:
当生命值耗尽时，居民会死亡。

想要防止居民死亡，您可以：
- 给他们打治疗针恢复生命值。
- 给他们消辐宁消除辐射。
- 死亡居民可花费瓶盖复活，或从避难所中移除。

任务中死亡的居民只能等任务结束后才能复活。

EN: DEAD DWELLERS
中文: 死亡居民

EN: Hint: Pay close attention to what a Dweller is telling you to know more about what makes them happy.
中文: 提示：请留意居民说的话，您能发现什么让他们开心。

EN:
Depending on what you ask your Dwellers to do, they can become happy or sad.

Keeping Dwellers happy is very important! A happy Vault runs more efficiently and produces resources faster.
You can see a specific Dweller's happiness by checking their profile.

Happiness Icon status:

GREEN: Your Dweller is happy, way to go!

YELLOW: Your Dweller is doing okay, but could be happier.

RED: Your Dweller is sad, cheer them up!
中文:
您让居民做的事情会让他们变得开心或者难过。

保持居民的幸福度是很重要的！一个幸福度高的避难所会更有效率，资源生产得更快。
您可以在居民的个人信息查看他们的幸福度。

幸福度图标状态：

绿色：您的居民很开心，做得好！

黄色：您的居民感觉还行，但还可以更好。

红色：您的居民很难过，赶紧让他们振作起来！

EN: DWELLER HAPPINESS
中文: 居民幸福度

EN: Hint: Playing for 7 days gives you a Lunchbox as a reward.
中文: 提示：连续登录七天将会获得午餐盒奖励。

EN:
Every day you receive a reward based on how happy your Vault is.

- Your Vault rating is the combined total of all your Dwellers happiness. 

- Your reward is based on your Vault Rating.

- A high Vault Rating earns you bonus CAPS.
中文:
每天系统都会依据避难所居民的开心程度发放相应奖励。

- 您的避难所评级将会结合所有居民的幸福度。 

- 您的奖励是基于避难所每天的评级。

- 避难所评级越高，获得的瓶盖奖励就越高。

EN: DAILY REPORT & VAULT RATING
中文: 每日报告和避难所评级

EN: Hint: Babies will wait to be born if there is no space in your Vault.
中文: 提示：如果避难所没有空位，宝宝会等到有空间时才出生。

EN:
When you need new Dwellers you can always encourage your Dwellers to procreate.

- Put a man and a woman in the Living Quarters and see if they like each other.

- If all goes well, the woman will become pregnant.

- After some time, the pregnant Dweller will be ready to give birth.

- Tap the icon above her head to welcome a new child in your Vault.

- Once the child has grown up, you will have a new Dweller.
中文:
当您需要新居民时，您可以鼓励您的居民多生育。

- 将一个男人和女人放在宿舍里，看看他们是不是喜欢对方。

- 如果一切顺利的话，女方将会怀孕。

- 过一段时间，怀孕的居民就可以分娩了。

- 点击她头上的图标，会有新的小孩出生。

- 一旦孩子长大，您将拥有一个新的居民。

EN:
When you need new Dwellers you can always encourage your Dwellers to procreate.

- Put a man and a woman in the Living Quarters and see if they like each other.

- If all goes well, the woman will become pregnant.

- After some time, the pregnant Dweller will be ready to give birth.

- Click on the icon above her head to welcome a new child in your Vault.

- Once the child has grown up, you will have a new Dweller.
中文:
当您需要新居民时，您可以鼓励您的居民多生育。

- 将一个男人和女人放在宿舍里，看看他们是不是喜欢对方。

- 如果一切顺利的话，女方将会怀孕。

- 过一段时间，怀孕的居民就可以分娩了。

- 点击她头上的图标，会有新的小孩出生。

- 一旦孩子长大，您将拥有一个新的居民。

EN:
When you need new Dwellers you can always encourage your Dwellers to procreate.

- Put a man and a woman in the Living Quarters and see if they like each other.

- If all goes well, the woman will become pregnant.

- After some time, the pregnant Dweller will be ready to give birth. A baby icon will appear above her head.

- Select her to welcome a new child in your Vault.

- Once the child has grown up, you will have a new Dweller.
中文:
当您需要新居民时，您可以鼓励您的居民多生育。

- 将一个男人和女人放在宿舍里，看看他们是不是喜欢对方。

- 如果一切顺利的话，女方将会怀孕。

- 过一段时间，怀孕的居民就可以分娩了。一个婴儿的图标会出现在她头上。

- 选择她，然后欢迎一个新生命诞生在避难所。

- 一旦孩子长大，您将拥有一个新居民。

EN: MAKING BABIES & LIVING QUARTERS
中文: 宿舍和生小孩

EN: Hint: Be careful not to build rooms before you need them, or expand too fast.
中文: 提示：请记住不要建造超出需求的房间，或者扩张得过快。

EN:
Build Living Quarters to welcome new Dwellers to your Vault.

- Expand your Vault by building rooms so you can produce more resources.

- Pay attention to the Vault Resource Gauges, they are a good indicator to follow when choosing the next room to build.

- Build an Elevator when you want to expand downwards.

- You can not delete a room if it is connected on both sides.

- Building multiple types of the same room will increase its price.
中文:
建造宿舍，诞生更多的新居民。

- 建造更多房间来扩大您的避难所，生产更多的资源。

- 注意避难所资源的标尺。在选择下一间要建造的房间时，它们是很好的参考。

- 想要向下扩张时，请建造电梯。

- 和两边都有联通的房间无法被拆除。

- 同种房间建造得越多就越贵。

EN: BUILD YOUR VAULT & ELEVATOR
中文: 建造您的避难所和电梯

EN: Hint: A room merge only happens if all rooms are of the same level.
中文: 提示：当房间的等级一致时才能合并。

EN:
Upgrade your Rooms to increase their performance.

- Most Rooms can be upgraded twice. Upgraded resource rooms produce more resources.

- Up to 3 Rooms of the same type can be merged, by building them next to each other

- Merged Rooms let you assign more Dwellers to the room, while also becoming more efficient.

- Some rooms, like Workshops, begin as larger rooms and cannot be merged.

- Themes can only be applied to fully merged and upgraded Diners and Living Quarters.
中文:
升级您的房间，来提高它们的性能。

- 大多数房间都可以升级两次。升级的资源房间能够生产更多资源。

- 最多能合并三个房间。但三个房间必须左右相邻。

- 合并的房间能容纳更多的居民，更多的居民也会让房间效率变高。

- 有些房间，比如工坊，开始就是一个大房间，是不能合并的。

- 主题只能应用于完全合并并升级至顶级的餐厅和宿舍。

EN: ROOM LEVEL & MERGING
中文: 房间等级和合并

EN: Hint: If you run out of storage space, upgrade your storage, build more storage, equip your Dwellers or sell items.
中文: 提示：如果储藏空间不够，您可以升级您的储藏室，建造更多的储藏室，给您的居民穿戴装备或是卖掉它们。

EN:
Storage Rooms increase your Weapons, Outfit, Junk and Pets inventory space.

- Upgrade your Storage Rooms to increase inventory capacity.

- Sell unwanted items by visiting the inventory from the Pip-Boy menu.

- Scrap Weapons and Outfits to turn them into Junk from their Recipes.

- Use the Storage Room as a temporary holding bay for Dwellers in case all other Rooms are full.

- Building MedBays and Science Labs will increase the number of Stimpaks and RadAway you can store.
中文:
储藏室会增加您的武器，装备，杂物和宠物的存储空间。

- 升级储藏室，增加存储容量。

- 通过哔哔小子菜单访问库存，卖掉不想要的物品。

- 分解武器和装备，可按对应配方获得杂物。

- 如果其他房间都满员的话，储藏室可用来暂时安置居民。

- 建造医务室和实验室能增加治疗针和消辐宁的持有量。

EN:
Storage Rooms increase your Weapons, Outfit, Junk and Pets inventory space.

- Upgrade your Storage Rooms to increase inventory capacity.

- Sell unwanted items by visiting the inventory from the Pip-Boy menu. You can also open the inventory with 3D Touch by pressing on a Storage Room.

- Scrap Weapons and Outfits to turn them into Junk from their Recipes.

- Use the Storage Room as a temporary holding bay for Dwellers in case all other Rooms are full.

- Building MedBays and Science Labs will increase the number of Stimpaks and RadAway you can store.
中文:
储藏室会增加您的武器，装备，杂物和宠物的存储空间。

- 升级储藏室，增加存储容量。

- 通过哔哔小子菜单访问库存，卖掉不想要的物品。您还可以通过3D Touch重按储藏室来打开库存。

- 分解武器和装备，将其变回配方中的杂物。

- 如果其他房间都满员的话，储藏室可用来暂时安置居民。

- 建造医务室和实验室能增加治疗针和消辐宁的持有量。

EN: STORAGE ROOM
中文: 储藏室

EN: Hint: Multiple Dwellers training together in the same room decrease the training time for all Dwellers in the room.
中文: 提示：多名居民一起训练能缩短训练房间里所有居民的训练时间。

EN:
Putting Dwellers in a Training Room will increase their SPECIAL stats.

There is a Training Room for each one of the SPECIAL stats.

Strength: Weight Room
Perception: Armory
Endurance: Fitness Room
Charisma: Lounge
Intelligence: Classroom
Agility: Athletics Room 
Luck: Game Room

You can raise each stat up to 10.

The higher the SPECIAL stat of a Dweller is, the longer it takes them to train to the next level, but you can use Nuka-Cola Quantum to speed up the training time.
中文:
将居民放进训练房间里将会提升他们的SPECIAL属性。

每一个属性都有对应的训练房间。

力量：举重房
观察力：军械库
耐力：健身房
魅力：会客室
智力：教室
敏捷：体操房
运气：棋牌室

每个属性最高能提升到10点。

居民的属性值越高，训练到下一级所需的时间就越长，但您可以使用量子核子可乐来加速训练。

EN: TRAINING ROOMS
中文: 训练房间

EN: Hint: Merging the Radio Room increases your chances of attracting a Dweller.
中文: 提示：合并广播室将会增加吸引外来居民的概率。

EN:
The Radio Room attracts new Dwellers from the Wasteland.

- Periodically, Radio Rooms send out a call for new Dwellers. There's a chance that the call will be answered.

- When the timer in the Radio Room reaches zero, if a new Dweller doesn't answer the call, the timer will restart automatically.

- Assign Dwellers with high Charisma to a Radio Room to speed up the Radio Call.

- Upgrade your Radio Room to increase the chance of attracting Dwellers.

- The Radio Call can also lead Deathclaws to your Vault.

- If you don't want any new Dwellers, you can stop a Radio Room from calling out.

- Having Dwellers in the Radio Room also provides a happiness boost to your Vault, whether or not it's calling for new Dwellers.
中文:
广播室能吸引来自废土的新居民。

- 广播室会周期性地发出信号，召唤新居民加入。有时会收到回应。

- 如果广播室的计时器走到零还没有新的居民回应，计时器会自动重启。

- 将魅力值高的居民分配在广播室能够加速信号的发出。

- 升级广播室能增加吸引新居民的概率。

- 广播信号也可能把死爪引到您的避难所。

- 如果您不想吸引新居民，可以让广播室停止呼叫。

- 在广播室里分配居民能够提升避难所的整体幸福度，无论广播室是否正在招募新居民。

EN: NEW DWELLERS & RADIO ROOM
中文: 广播室和新居民

EN: Hint: Rushing a room is the fastest way to earn CAPS.
中文: 提示：启动极速模式是最快赚取瓶盖的方法。

EN:
There are lots of ways you can earn CAPS.
- Find them in the Wasteland and on Quests
- Complete Objectives
- Level up Dwellers
- Sell items
- Every Lunchbox contains CAPS
- Lucky Dwellers earn them occasionally while collecting resources 

CAPS can be spent to:
- Build Rooms and elevators
- Destroy rocks 
- Upgrade Rooms
- Revive Dwellers
- Craft Weapons, Outfits and Themes
- Customize Dwellers
中文:
有许多方式可以赚取瓶盖。
- 在废土和任务中找到
- 完成目标
- 居民升级
- 贩卖物品

EN: Hint: The percentage chance of a disaster cools down over time.
中文: 提示：灾害出现的概率随着时间会慢慢降低。

EN:
Production Rooms can be Rushed to earn CAPS and to instantly earn resources.

- Rush completes the current production cycle and award a bonus amount of CAPS.

- The CAPS bonus is based on the Risk value. The higher the risk is, the greater the amount of CAPS you earn.

- Failing a Rush causes a disaster in the room.
中文:
生产型房间能够启动极速模式来赚取瓶盖，同时即时产生资源。

- 极速模式会立即完成当前的生产周期然后发放一定瓶盖奖励。

- 瓶盖奖励是基于风险值。风险越大，奖励越多。

- 极速模式如果失败，会导致灾害发生。

EN: RUSH MODE
中文: 极速模式

EN: Hint: A Dweller in the Wasteland can be Revived for CAPS.
中文: 提示：废土的居民能够通过瓶盖复活。

EN:
Dispatch your Dwellers to scavenge the Wasteland. 

Out there they will find CAPS, earn Experience, and bring back Weapons, Outfits and Junk. The further out they go, the better the rewards they'll find, but the harder the encounters will become.

- Drag a Dweller to the Wasteland and equip them with a Weapon, an Outfit, a Pet, RadAway and Stimpaks.

- Send them out exploring, but don't forget to check on their progress.

- Dwellers can be recalled from the Wasteland at any time, and take half as long to return from the Wasteland.

- Make sure you bring them home before they die!

- Dwellers automatically return from the Wasteland if they can't carry any more items.

- Dwellers in the Wasteland may stumble upon a special location. Tap the exclamation point icon to choose between entering this location and continuing to explore the Wasteland.
中文:
派遣您的居民去探险废土。

- 将他们送去探险。请不要忘记查看他们的动态。

- 送去废土的居民能随时被召回。返回的时间是去时的一半。

- 确保在生命值降到零之前召回他们，否则会死亡。

- 当居民无法再携带更多的物品时会自动返回。

- 废土上的居民可能会经过一个特殊的地点。点击他们头上的惊叹号图标来选择进入地点或继续探索废土。

中文: 废土

EN: Hint: Rare and Legendary Dwellers can be found in Lunchboxes and have great stats.
中文: 提示：稀有和传奇级别的居民能在午餐盒中找到，他们的属性通常很强。

EN:
Fast-track your progress with Vault-Tec's amazing Lunchboxes.

DWELLERS - Need more Dwellers, fast? Each Lunchbox has a chance of containing a Dweller. 

WEAPONS - All the finest in Wasteland survival from BB guns to the powerful Fat Man. 

OUTFITS - Equip your Dwellers in these stat boosting, and stylish, outfits. 

PETS - Find a faithful companion that will help your Dwellers and liven up your Vault.

NUKA-COLA QUANTUM – Get things done fast with these refreshing beverages.

JUNK - Use these long-forgotten objects to craft items in your Workshops.

RESOURCES - Stock up on resources with CAPS, RadAway, Stimpaks, Extra Food, Power or Water

Every Lunchbox can give you COMMON, RARE, or LEGENDARY items. Each Lunchbox is guaranteed to either have a Dweller or a RARE item.
中文:
避难所科技的午餐盒能加快您的进程。

居民- 需要更快获得更多居民？每个午餐盒都有机会抽到一个居民。

武器- 所有能在废土生存中用到的好东西。从BB枪到小型核武器“胖子”都有。

装备- 给您的居民穿上这些又能增强属性又有型的好装备。

宠物- 一个忠诚的伴侣，同时让您的避难所充满生机！

量子核子可乐- 用这种清爽的饮料快速搞定一切。

杂物- 在您的工坊里用这些被长时间遗忘的物件打造武器装备。

资源- 储备充足的瓶盖，消辐宁，治疗针，食物，水和电。

午餐盒里可能有普通，稀有或者传奇的物品。每个午餐盒至少会有一个居民或者稀有的物品。

EN: LUNCHBOXES
中文: 午餐盒

EN: Hint: Equipping your Dwellers with Weapons will help fight off enemies.
中文: 提示：给您的居民配备武器将有助于他们击退敌人。

EN:
Disasters can randomly strike your Vault at any time! Disasters also occur when you fail a room Rush. Watch out for these possible encounters:

FIRES - Put out fires quickly before they spread to other rooms.

RADROACHES - These pesky critters are hard to get rid of. Take them out before they spread.

RAIDERS - Raiders will rush through your Vault and destroy its resources, stop them quickly! Stronger Raiders will even steal CAPS if you're not careful! Upgrading your Vault Entrance will delay Raiders, giving you time to prepare. Putting guards in your Vault Entrance will also provide a front line of defense against the Raiders. You can loot dead Raiders for CAPS and items!

MOLE RATS – These pests are a nuisance and have a nasty habit of burrowing into your Vault from the dirt and chewing on any room's power cables. Kill them quickly, or they'll drain your Vault of Power!

DEATHCLAWS – Any time you open your Vault Door, you're broadcasting an invitation for these beasties to come to your Vault and destroy your resources. Be sure to have Stimpaks and Weapons at the ready, or they'll tear through your Dwellers like a knife through a Fancy Lad Snack Cake! 

FERAL GHOULS - Feral Ghouls run through your Vault, wreaking havoc by dealing both physical and radiation damage to the Dwellers they attack.

RADSCORPIONS – These mutated scorpions are able to burrow and attack random rooms in your Vault. Make sure to kill them quickly as their attacks also do radiation damage!

Children and Pregnant Women will hide whenever an incident occurs.
中文:
您的避难所随时都会发生灾害！当极速模式失败时，也会造成灾害。灾害是随机的，请注意以下情况：

火灾-在火势蔓延到其他房间之前赶紧扑灭。

辐射蟑螂-这些磨人的小妖精很难被除掉。请在虫灾扩散前干掉它们。

掠夺者- 掠夺者们会闯入避难所然后破坏资源。赶紧阻止它们！如果不小心的话，强悍的掠夺者们还会偷走瓶盖！升级您的避难所入口将会使得掠夺者花费更长时间进入，因此给您更多时间准备。您可以派居民驻守入口，在他们进入时形成良好的前线防御。您可以从死亡的掠夺者身上掠夺瓶盖和物品！

鼹鼠- 这些坏蛋喜欢从土里挖进您的避难所，吃掉每个房间的电线。迅速杀死它们，不然您的电力将枯竭！

死爪-您每一次打开避难所的大门，都是在给这些野兽们发送邀请信息。它们会毫不留情地来避难所破坏资源。请备好充足的治疗针和武器，不然它们会像切蛋糕一样劈开您的居民！

狂尸鬼- 狂尸鬼会在您的避难所里四处跑动，制造混乱，给居民带来物理和辐射伤害。

辐射蝎- 这些变种的蝎子能钻洞，然后随机攻击避难所里任何的房间。请迅速解决掉它们，因为它们的攻击也会带来辐射伤害。

孕妇和孩子在灾害发生时会躲起来。

EN: INCIDENTS
中文: 事件

EN: Hint: The Dweller Menu icon shows the number of Dwellers in your Vault, as well as how many Dwellers you have waiting outside.
中文: 提示：居民菜单图标显示了避难所的居民人数，以及外面等待的居民人数。

EN:
1. Wasteland - Tap outside your Vault to pull up your Wasteland Logs.
2. Dweller Menu - Use this for easy sorting and selection of your Dwellers.
3. Happiness - Your overall Vault Happiness. Tap on it to see what bonuses it provides to your Vault.
4. Resource Bars - Your current resource amounts. Don't let them fall below the required resources lines, or your Vault will start to deteriorate. Tap to see how many resources you have.
5. CAPS - Tap on the CAPS to go to the Lunchbox Store.
6. Build Hammer - Tap on the Build Hammer to build rooms.
7. Pip-Boy - Tap the Pip-Boy to open the Pip-Boy menu. A number on the Pip-Boy means you have Lunchboxes to open. An exclamation point means you have Objective rewards to collect.
8. Lunchboxes - Tap the Lunchboxes to go to the Lunchbox menu. A number means you have Lunchboxes to open.
9. Objectives - Tap the ribbon to go to your Objectives page. An exclamation point means you have Objective rewards to collect.
10. Inventory - Tap the boxes to go to the Inventory menu.
11. VDSG - Tap the book to open the Vault Dweller Surivival Guide.
12. Settings - Tap the gears to go to the settings menu.
中文:
1. 废土- 点击避难所外面可查看废土日志。
2. 居民菜单- 可以用来快速整理和选择您的居民。
3. 幸福度- 避难所整体的幸福度。点击可以查看其为避难所带来多少奖励。

6. 建造锤子-点击可建造房间
7. 哔哔小子- 点击哔哔小子可打开菜单。数字表示您有可以打开的午餐盒。感叹号表示有目标奖励可领取。
8. 午餐盒- 点击可进入午餐盒菜单
9. 目标- 点击缎带图标进入目标页面。一个感叹号表示有目标奖励可以领取。
10. 库存- 点击盒子图标进入库存菜单。
11. VDSG- 点击书图标可打开避难所居民生存指南
12. 设置- 点击齿轮图标可进入设置菜单。

EN:
Your FOOD, WATER and POWER resources are what keeps your Vault going.

- FOOD: Dwellers need to eat to stay healthy. Run low on FOOD and your Dwellers will begin to lose Health.

- WATER: Clean water is hard to come by in the Wasteland. Run low on WATER and your Dwellers will take Radiation damage.

- POWER: Your Vault can't run without POWER. Run low on POWER and your rooms will begin shutting down.

Keep your resources above the required resource lines to keep your Vault happy.
Resources continue to be consumed for a short time after closing the game.

食物，水和电力资源是能保证避难所日常运行的基础。

-电力：没有电，整个避难所都无法运转。电力不足时，房间将无法使用。

将您的资源维持在所需资源线之上，您的避难所才能保持愉快。

关闭游戏后，资源仍会继续消耗一小段时间。

EN:
When you drag a Dweller into a room, a SPECIAL letter will appear above their head with a number.

The letter above their head corresponds to the SPECIAL stat associated with that room.

If the number is listed with a plus or minus sign, it means that dragging a Dweller into that room will replace a Dweller that is currently working in that room.

The Dweller's effect on that room will go up or down whatever the number is.

When a Dweller is replaced this way, they switch jobs with the Dweller being moved.

If there is no plus or minus sign it means there's room for the Dweller to work in the room without replacing any Dwellers.
中文:
当您将居民拖拽到一个房间时，SPECIAL属性的字母会出现在头上，后面有一个数字。

头上的字母对应着相应房间的属性。

如果数字前有加号或者减号，意味着拖拽居民后，房间里原有的一位居民将被替换。该居民对房间的影响将随所标数字提高或降低。

房间里被替换居民将从事被拖拽居民之前的工作。

如果数字前没有加号或者减号，则意味着房间里还可以容纳更多的居民，无需替换。

- Resources drain at a faster rate.

- Incidents do more damage.

- Dwellers can't be revived, whether in the Vault, in the Wasteland or on Quests.

- Objectives are more demanding but give better rewards.

- Quests are more challenging.

EN:
Pets are found in Lunchboxes and Pet Carriers.

Pets provide a bonus effect to the Dweller they're assigned to and increase that Dweller's damage in combat. They can even tag along and help in the Wasteland.

Only one to three Pets are allowed in a room at a time, depending on the room's size.

Pets come in COMMON, RARE and LEGENDARY versions. The rarer the Pet, the greater its bonus effect, but even identical Pets might grant bonuses with different strengths.

Assign a Pet like you would equip a Weapon or an Outfit.
中文:
宠物能够在午餐盒和宠物笼子中找到。

宠物能为所属居民提供加成效果、提升其在战斗中的伤害，还能跟随居民去废土上帮忙。

一个房间里只允许有一到三只宠物，这取决于房间大小。

宠物也有普通，稀有和传奇三个等级。宠物越稀有，相关加成就越好。但即使是同样的宠物也有可能带来不同的加成。

EN: Hint: Dweller attack rates are based on their Agility.
中文: 提示：居民的攻击频率取决于他们的敏捷性（A）。

EN:
Quests allow you to explore new locations, meet new Dwellers and collect loot.

Build the Overseer's Office room to send teams of Dwellers from your Vault on Quests.

To access the Quest List, tap the map icon from the Overseer's Office or from the Pip-Boy. The Quest List shows you your available Quests, their rewards, requirements and status. 

In Quests, explore the location by dragging Dwellers to new rooms, or just tapping on the room you want them to travel to.

Dwellers in combat fight automatically, but you can make them attack a specific enemy by tapping on a Dweller and then on the enemy. You can also tap and hold on a Dweller, then drag the target that appears to the enemy.

As your Dwellers fight they will build up a Critical hit meter; once ready, a checkmark icon will appear over the enemy that your charged Dweller is attacking; tapping it will let you unleash a deadly Critical Hit attack. 

Tap on the moving arrows that appear once they are in the center of the reticle, the closer the arrows are to the center, the higher the damage multiplier for your Critical Hit attack. 

The Critical Hit meters fills faster for higher Luck Dwellers and the Critical Hit arrows move slower the higher your Dweller Perception is.

You can see the mandatory and optional Quest objectives by tapping on the Map Icon in the top right corner.

When you're done exploring, tap on the Map Icon to return the Quest team to the Vault.
中文:
任务能让您探索新的地点，遇见新的居民和收集战利品。

建造监督者办公室来派遣居民小队去完成任务。

点击监督者办公室里或者哔哔小子上的地图图标来进入任务列表。任务列表会显示您现在可以执行的任务，以及相对应的奖励，要求和状态。

在任务中，将居民拖到新房间中来探索或者直接点击您想要探索的房间。

居民在战斗时会出现一个暴击蓄力器；一旦准备好，敌人上方会出现一个勾形图标，点击会对敌人进行致命暴击。

当箭头出现在十字线的中心时，请点击移动的箭头。离中心越近，暴击伤害的倍率就越高。

居民的运气（L）属性越高，暴击蓄力器的恢复速度也就越快。居民的观察力（P）属性越高，箭头移动的速度越慢。

点击右上角的地图图标查看必须完成和可选完成的任务目标。

On Quests, explore the location by selecting the room you want Dwellers to travel to.

Dwellers in combat fight automatically, but you can command a selected Dweller attack a specific enemy by holding [A] to make a target appear and then selecting an enemy.

As your Dwellers fight they will build up a Critical hit meter; once ready, a checkmark icon will appear over the enemy that your charged Dweller is attacking.

With a Dweller selected, use the Left Stick to select the checkmark, then hold [A] to unleash a deadly Critical Hit attack.

Press [A] to stop the moving arrows that appear; the closer the arrows are to the center of the reticle, the higher the damage multiplier for your Critical Hit attack. 

The Critical Hit meter fills faster for higher Luck Dwellers and the Critical Hit arrows move slower the higher your Dweller Perception is.

You can see the mandatory and optional Quest objectives by pressing [Y].

When you're done exploring, return the Quest team to the Vault from the Quest objectives.

EN:
You can use Junk and pay CAPS to craft items in the Weapon, Outfit and Theme Workshops.

COMMON, RARE and LEGENDARY Junk is found in Lunchboxes, in the Wasteland and on Quests, and produced by scrapping Weapons and Outfits. Rarer items require rarer Junk.

You also need an item's Recipe to craft it. Workshops start with some Recipes, but look for others on dead Raiders, in the Wasteland and on Quests.

Theme Recipes come in Fragments. Find these Fragments on Quests or use Nuka-Cola Quantum to complete your Theme Recipes.

Tap on a Workshop's Craft button to see the items you can make there and select the one you want. Upgraded Weapon and Outfit Workshops can craft RARE and LEGENDARY items.

All your Junk is refunded if you cancel the crafting process after it's started, but only part of the CAPS you spent.
中文:
您可以利用杂物和瓶盖，在武器、装备和主题工坊中打造物品。

普通，稀有和传奇级别的杂物会在午餐盒、废土和任务中找到，分解武器和装备也能产出杂物。物品越稀有，需要的杂物就越稀有。

同时还需要打造物品的相应配方。工坊开始时会自带一些配方，其他的配方可以在死亡的掠夺者身上、废土探险或任务中找到。

主题配方以碎片形式出现。在任务中寻找这些碎片，或使用量子核子可乐来补全主题配方。

点击工坊的打造按钮可以看到能够打造的物品列表，选择您想要的。升级后的武器和装备工坊能够打造稀有和传奇级别的物品。

如果开始打造之后取消，您所用的杂物将全部返还，但花费的瓶盖只有部分返还。
