中文: “巧手先生”这名字可不是白叫的。

EN: Hello, humans. Mister Handy here, ready to serve your every whim!
中文: 你好，人类。巧手先生在此，随时伺候各位的每个突发奇想！

EN: What do you need? Dusting? Mopping? General tidying?
中文: 需要什么？除尘？拖地？还是一般的整理？

EN: Now now, I don't do windows. Oh wait! You don't have any! Ha ha ha. Sorry, robot humor...
中文: 先说好，我不擦窗户。哦，等等！你们根本没有窗户！哈哈哈。抱歉，这是机器人的幽默……

EN: Feeling lazy? You called the right robot! You want it, I'll fetch it.
中文: 懒得动？那你可找对机器人了！你想要什么，我去拿。

EN: I'll do whatever I can to support you humans' fat, lazy lifestyle.
中文: 我会尽我所能支持你们人类肥胖懒惰的生活方式。

EN: Sometimes these humans feel like characters in a video game. Incapable of doing anything on their own...
中文: 有时候，这些人类感觉就像视频游戏里的角色，无法独立完成任何事情……

EN: I have to admit. For a giant metal hole in the ground, this Vault is exceedingly cozy.
中文: 对于地底下这么个巨大的金属坑来说，这个避难所非常舒适。

EN: Oh look, a layer of dust. Because who doesn't love cleaning discarded human hair and skin.
中文: 哦，快看，一层灰。毕竟，谁会不喜欢清理人类掉的毛发和皮屑呢。

EN: Joke time! What do you get when you put root beer in a square glass? Give up? Beer! Oh I slay me...
中文: 讲笑话时间！把根汁啤酒“开平方”，会得到什么？——啤酒！哦，我能把自己笑死……

EN: You hear about the light that went bad? They put it in prism. Get it? Prism?
中文: 听说有个灯泡学坏了？他们把它关进了“棱镜”（prism，谐音监狱 prison）。懂吗？棱镜？

EN: They say there are 10 different kinds of people in the world. Those who understand binary... and those who don't.
中文: 他们说世界上有10种人。懂二进制的和不懂二进制的。

EN: Before the blasted war, I probably would have had a nice suburban family to take care of...
中文: 在那场该死的战争之前，我可能会照顾一个生活小康的郊区家庭……

EN: What's on the agenda for today? Mopping, cooking, dusting, babysitting? Bring it on, humans!
中文: 今天的日程是什么？拖地、做饭、除尘、带孩子？放马过来吧，人类！

EN: Have hover unit, will travel. Just let me know what you need, people.
中文: 自带悬浮单元，说走就走。各位有什么需要，尽管吩咐。

EN: Personally, I think all this talk of an “Overseer” is so much rubbish. I've certainly never seen them.
中文: 个人认为，关于“监督者”的所有说法都是胡说八道。我从来没有见过他们。

EN: I do hope there's no diaper changing today. The little humans are always so... wiggly.
中文: 真希望今天不用换尿布。那些小家伙总是……扭来扭去。

EN: Cheerio, Vault Dwellers!
中文: 再见，避难所居民！

EN: Is that... oh, it is. Blood on the floor. Wonderful.
中文: 这是什么……哦，还真是。地板上有血。太“棒”了。

EN: There's not enough Abraxo on the planet to scrub this place clean.
中文: 把全世界的艾巴索清洁剂都拿来，也刷不干净这地方。

EN: Ugh. This place leaks like a sieve. And me without my brolly.
中文: 呃，这地方漏得跟筛子似的。偏偏我又没带伞。

EN: I wonder if we could convert one of these rooms into a proper study. Fireplace, bookshelves... gin.
中文: 我想知道我们能不能把其中一个房间改造成一个正经的书房。壁炉、书架……还有杜松子酒。

EN: These humans can be so hard to understand. Everyone has SUCH an accent.
中文: 这些人类真是太难理解了。每个人都有那么重的口音。

EN: Hard work is happy work? Like you humans would know.
中文: 努力工作令人快乐？你们人类真的懂吗？

EN: Tsk tsk tsk. I'd need a firehose attachment to give this place a proper washing.
中文: 啧啧啧。我得加装一个高压水带配件，才洗得干净这地方。

EN: Dinner tonight - Beef Wellington and a bottle of Bordeaux! Just kidding. It's Cram again.
中文: 今晚的晚餐——惠灵顿牛排配一瓶波尔多！开个玩笑。又是饱饱牌肉罐头。

EN: Olfactory sensors picking up... vomit and chocolate. There must be children about.
中文: 嗅觉传感器检测到……呕吐物和巧克力。附近一定有个小孩子。

EN: I do hope the humans are happy today. Grumpy Vault Dwellers are so difficult to care for.
中文: 希望这些人类今天开心。脾气暴躁的避难所居民可麻烦了。

EN: This place could do with a few houseplants. Tulips, cacti... perhaps a life-sized Venus flytrap.
中文: 这个地方需要一些室内植物。郁金香、仙人掌……也许还有一个真人大小的捕蝇草。

EN: As soon as I get one room under control, they build another! It's madness!
中文: 我刚收拾完一个房间，他们就又建了个新的！真是疯了！

EN: And so the humans go about their work, like so many ants in a hill.
中文: 人类就像一群蚂蚁一样忙碌着。

EN: I see a long, luxurious oil bath in my future...
中文: 我梦想着未来的豪华机油浴……

EN: So many humans seek solace in love. Nobody cares about my soulmate.
中文: 这么多人类都在爱情里寻找慰藉，却没人在意我的灵魂伴侣。

EN: The lighting in here is horrible. If I had eyes, they'd be ruined. Though I'd probably look dashing in horn rims...
中文: 这里的灯光太差了。如果我有眼睛，它们早就废了。不过戴上眼镜，我可能会很帅……

EN: I wonder if the kitchen needs help. I make a mean flambe'.
中文: 厨房需要帮忙吗？我做火焰料理很拿手。

EN: You humans are dreadfully inefficient. My advice? A graduated robot replacement system.
中文: 你们人类效率太低了。我的建议是：逐步用机器人取代人类。

EN: I wonder how many humans have died in this place. Just curious. Really.
中文: 我想知道有多少人类死在这个地方。只是好奇。真的。

EN: Some of you humans are happy, some of you are sad... Consistency, people!
中文: 你们人类有的开心，有的伤心……能不能统一一下情绪！

EN: That's it, humans. Pump it up!
中文: 加油，人类！

EN: That's it, humans. Pump it up!
中文: 加油，人类！

EN: Oh, I do so wish they would allow me to tend the garden. I come with all the right attachments.
中文: 哦，我真希望他们能让我打理花园。毕竟我自带各种工具。

EN: Oh, I do so wish they would allow me to tend the garden. I come with all the right attachments.
中文: 哦，我真希望他们能让我打理花园。毕竟我自带各种工具。

EN: So this is where the magic happens...
中文: 哦，原来“魔法”就是在这种地方变的……

EN: *Sigh* These humans get to have all the fun.
中文: 唉，天下的乐子都让你们人类占了。

EN: Imagine. Needing a “Stimpak” for self-maintenance. Oh, humans. You slay me.
中文: 想象一下，居然需要“治疗针”来做自我维护。哦，人类，你们真是笑死我了。

EN: Imagine. Needing a “Stimpak” for self-maintenance. Oh, humans. You slay me.
中文: 想象一下，居然需要“治疗针”来做自我维护。哦，人类，你们真是笑死我了。

EN: Because, really, why WOULDN'T you fill your body with processed sugar water?
中文: 说真的，往身体里灌满加工糖水，你还有什么理由不这么干呢？

EN: Because, really, why WOULDN'T you fill your body with processed sugar water?
中文: 说真的，往身体里灌满加工糖水，你还有什么理由不这么干呢？

EN: Ah, my favorite room.
中文: 啊，我最喜欢的房间。

EN: Anybody need me to store some extra juice? I won't steal any. Really. I swear.
中文: 有人需要我存储额外的能量吗？我不会偷的。真的，我发誓。

EN: Mic check, mic check, 1. 2. 3. Is this thing on?
中文: 麦克风测试，麦克风测试，1、2、3。这玩意儿开着吗？

EN: Mic check, mic check, 1. 2. 3. Is this thing on?
中文: 麦克风测试，麦克风测试，1、2、3。这玩意儿开着吗？

EN: Oh, yes, let's develop atomic energy. Because that worked out sssooo well before...
中文: 哦对了，一起来开发原子能吧。上次开发原子能的结果可真是太棒了……

EN: Oh, yes, let's develop atomic energy. Because that worked out sssooo well before...
中文: 哦对了，一起来开发原子能吧。上次开发原子能的结果可真是太棒了……

EN: Having to manage radiation. In a post-apocalyptic Wasteland. Clearly, someone needs to evolve...
中文: 在末世废土中处理辐射。显然，有人的脑子需要进化了……

EN: Having to manage radiation. In a post-apocalyptic Wasteland. Clearly, someone needs to evolve...
中文: 在末世废土中处理辐射。显然，有人的脑子需要进化了……

EN: Oh my. Isn't this... cheery.
中文: 哦，天哪。这儿可真是……“喜气洋洋”啊。

EN: Surely someone out here must need a shoe shine...
中文: 这儿肯定有人需要擦鞋……

EN: Hello! Anyone?
中文: 你好——有人吗？

EN: Those voices do NOT sound friendly. Time to skedaddle.
中文: 那些声音听起来可一点儿都不友好。该开溜了！

EN: Oh look, a broken crib. Isn't that encouraging.
中文: 看哪，一个破损的婴儿床。真是“鼓舞人心”啊。

EN: Is that? Why yes, it's an old General Atomics factory. Looks like they broke the mold when they made me. Literally.
中文: 那是？没错，那是个破败的通用原子工厂。看来他们造完我之后就把模具给砸了。这可是字面意思。

EN: If I were human, I'd be dead by now. Perish the thought.
中文: 如果我是人类，我肯定早就死了！呸呸呸，不吉利。

EN: My radiation sensors are going haywire. Not that I care.
中文: 我的辐射传感器快要爆表了，不过我不在乎。

EN: You know, it's not much to look at, but an enterprising robot could make quite the life for himself out here...
中文: 这地方看着是不怎么样，但一个有进取心的机器人在废土上也能闯出好日子来……

EN: A deflated basketball, lying in the road. Symbolic of something, I'm sure...
中文: 一个瘪了的篮球，扔在路上。一定有什么象征意义……

EN: Oh look. A destroyed donut shop. No more cake rings and muddy coffee for the humans, I'm afraid.
中文: 看啊。一个被摧毁的甜甜圈店。人类再也不能吃到甜甜圈和咖啡了，真遗憾。

EN: Ah, the Wasteland. As predictably depressing as one would expect.
中文: 啊，废土。正如预期的那样令人沮丧。

EN: My thermometer is reading the current temperature as something approaching “Seventh Circle of Hell”.
中文: 我的温度计显示当前温度接近“地狱第七层”。

EN: Looks like it may rain. Lovely.
中文: 看起来要下雨了，真棒。

EN: Rock in the road. I'll just hover right over that, like so...
中文: 路上有个拦路石，我可以直接从上面飘过去……

EN: For an emotionless metal automaton, I suddenly find myself... terrified!
中文: 作为一个无情的金属机器人，我突然感到……害怕！

EN: Hello! Yes you, sir! I was wondering if... Oh. You're a corpse. Well then. Carry on.
中文: 你好！是的，就是你，先生！我想知道……哦，你是具尸体。好吧，没事了。

EN: Sensors indicate... Yes. That's a Super Mutant. And yes, I am now headed in the opposite direction...
中文: 探测器显示……没错，那是个超级变种人。而且没错，我现在正朝反方向走……

EN: You can say one thing about humans – they sure know how to destroy themselves.
中文: 人类有一件事做得很好——他们非常擅长自我毁灭。

EN: And to think, humans worried that robots would turn against them. They turned against themselves just fine...
中文: 人类居然还担心机器人会反叛他们，他们自己的内斗都控制不住了……

EN: If I go home empty handed I'll never hear the end of it...
中文: 要是我空手而归，估计会被人唠叨个没完没了……

EN: Scavenging the Wasteland like some sort of peasant. I'm better than this.
中文: 像个乡巴佬一样在废土上捡破烂？我可不是干这个的料。

EN: Of course. Send the domestic servant into a deadly post-apocalyptic Wasteland. What could possibly go wrong?
中文: 当然。派个家务佣人去致命的末世废土。还能出什么岔子呢？

EN: If my makers at General Atomics International could see me now...
中文: 要是通用原子国际的制造者们看到我现在的样子……

EN: Hellllloooo! Any other robots out heeeerrrreee?
中文: 喂~这里有其他机器人吗？

EN: Ah, a broken bridge. Think I'll take the long way around.
中文: 啊，一座断桥，看来我得绕个路了。

EN: My goodness, look at those hedges. Doesn't anyone appreciate the value of landscaping anymore?
中文: 天哪，看看这些树篱，难道没人欣赏园艺了吗？

EN: I think I'm getting... custodial withdrawal. I may have to enter one of these old homes and sweep up for a bit.
中文: 我觉得我得了……清洁戒断反应。看来得进哪栋旧房子扫上一小会儿才行。

EN: Don't mind me. I'm just folding this pile of burned laundry...
中文: 别管我，让我先把这堆烧焦的衣服叠好……

EN: I want to go home. I want to go home. I want to go home.
中文: 我想回家，我想回家，我想回家。

EN: Should I head back to the Vault? Or is it too soon? Somebody please tell me what to do!
中文: 我应该回避难所吗？还是太早了？快来个人告诉我该怎么做！

EN: A domestic robot dedicated to cleaning. Wandering a post-apocalyptic landscape. My OCD is going HAYWIRE.
中文: 一个致力于清洁的家务机器人，在末世废土中游荡。我的强迫症要发作了。

EN: Definitely starting to rethink this whole, “Send the Mister Handy to the Wasteland!” idea...
中文: 我得重新考虑一下“把巧手先生送到废土”这个主意……

EN: Send the robot, they said. He'll be fine, they said. Barbarians.
中文: 他们说什么“派机器人去吧”“它不会有事的”。真是一帮蛮子。

EN: Overseer? Are you out there? Please, I implore you! Don't... don't let me die.
中文: 监督者？你在吗？求你了，别……别让我死在外头啊。

EN: Oh for Heaven's sake, I'm a domestic robot, not a bloody tank. What am I even doing out here?!
中文: 拜托，我是一个家务机器人，又不是一辆坦克。我来这干什么？！

EN: I'll find what I find, then head back. No heroics! Not for this Mister Handy!
中文: 我会找到需要的东西，然后就回去。英雄主义什么的可不适合像我这样的巧手先生！

EN: Agh! A Deathclaw! Retreat! I'm a lover not a fighter!
中文: 啊！死爪！快跑！我只擅长爱人，不擅长打架！

EN: Guess I'll head this way.
中文: 那就走这边吧。

EN: This direction looks as good as any.
中文: 这边跟其他方向也半斤八两。

EN: Hmmm. Left or right? I think... right.
中文: 嗯，左还是右？我猜是往……右。

EN: Hmmm. Left or right? I think... left.
中文: 嗯，左还是右？我猜是往……左。

EN: No. NO! Shoo, dog! Shoo! I am NOT a fire hydrant! I am a Mister Handy model... Agghh! No! BAD doggie!
中文: 不。不！走开，狗狗！走开！我不是消防栓！我是巧手先生……啊！不！坏狗！

EN: Oh look. A Feral Ghoul eating a man's arm. That's certainly not something you see every day.
中文: 看啊。一个狂尸鬼正在啃一个人的手臂。这可不是每天都能看到的景象。

EN: Calibrating sensors...
中文: 正在校准传感器……

EN: I'd be sweating profusely by now, I'd imagine. Had I the glands.
中文: 要是我有汗腺的话，现在应该大汗淋漓了。

EN: Oh, wonderful. I'm talking to myself. Just what I need – psychosis.
中文: 哦，太棒了，开始自言自语了。我正缺这个呢——精神错乱。

EN: I think I've had enough “fresh air” for one lifetime, thank you very much.
中文: 这辈子吸的“新鲜空气”已经够多了，多谢，不必了。

EN: Maybe I'll hum to myself. That'll lift the ol' spirits.
中文: 或许我该哼点歌，这能振奋精神。

EN: Exploring is so interesting. And terrifying. Not to mention utterly boring.
中文: 探索很有趣，也很恐怖，但也无聊透顶了。

EN: Let's try... this direction.
中文: 试试……这个方向。

EN: I'll just cut through this neighborhood, see where it goes...
中文: 让我看看穿过这个街区能到哪里……

EN: I wonder where this road leads.
中文: 我想知道这条路通向哪里。

EN: A spooky pass through blasted woods? How could I possibly resist.
中文: 一个恐怖的森林小径？这诱惑真是难以抵挡。

EN: I really don't see what all the fuss is about. It's not so bad out OH MY HEAVENS, A SEVERED HEAD.
中文: 我真的不明白有什么好大惊小怪的，这外面也没什么大不……哦，天哪，这有个被砍下来的脑袋！

EN: My internal compass indicates I'm now facing north. Guess I'll float along in that direction...
中文: 我的内部指南针显示我现在正朝北。看来我该朝这个方向飘……

EN: Let's try... this direction.
中文: 试试……这个方向。

EN: I'll just hover right over this puddle of blood...
中文: 我可以从这滩血上面飘过去……

EN: Mole rat holes. Maybe I'd best go the other way.
中文: 鼹鼠洞，也许我最好走另一条路。

EN: Hmm. Large humans in the distance. Maybe... Ah yes, Super Mutants. Time to turn around.
中文: 嗯，远处有些大块头人类，也许……啊，没错，超级变种人。该掉头了。

EN: Was that a... “pling”? Did someone actually take a shot at me? How rude!
中文: 那是……“叮”？居然真有人朝我开枪？真没礼貌！

EN: If I had feet, they would be SO sore right now.
中文: 如果我有脚，现在肯定会很疼。

EN: Oh look, an old basketball court. Definitely not my game. I possess neither a shirt, nor skin.
中文: 哦，看哪，一个旧篮球场。这运动不适合我，我没有衬衫，也没有皮肤。

EN: Ah, an old baseball diamond. A game much like cricket, only far inferior.
中文: 啊，一个旧棒球场。这游戏类似板球，但要差得多。

EN: A child's wooden blocks. From before the war. I wonder where... Oh.
中文: 小孩的木制积木，来自战前。我好奇那个小孩……哦。

EN: Well bless my stars! A Giddyup Buttercup. Such an elegant steed.
中文: 天哪！一匹“骑乘小马”，真是优雅的坐骑。

EN: My internal compass indicates I'm now facing south. Guess I'll float along in that direction...
中文: 我的内部指南针显示我现在正朝南。看来我该朝这个方向飘……

EN: A locked door. And me without my bobby pin.
中文: 一扇锁着的门，但是我却没带开锁用的发夹。

EN: Hmm. A computer terminal. Meant for human fingers, sadly.
中文: 哦？一个电脑终端。可惜，是为人类手指设计的。

EN: If I were to just hover off into the sunset, would the Vault even care?
中文: 如果我就这样飘向夕阳，避难所真的会在乎吗？

EN: Hmph. A broken down Protectron. Typical RobCo workmanship.
中文: 哼，一个破烂的保护者。典型的罗伯科劣质货。

EN: Ah, look at that. An old Chryslus Corvega. Because nuclear cars were SUCH a good idea...
中文: 哦，看啊，一辆旧的克莱斯勒·可伟佳。核动力汽车可真是个“好”主意啊……

EN: A radio playing, somewhere in the distance. Almost makes me feel like dancing.
中文: 远处传来广播的声音，让我有点想要跳舞。

EN: Heavens, it's like one giant, uncleanable mess out here. I think I'm having a panic attack.
中文: 天哪，这里乱得都没有办法清理了，我都快恐慌发作了。

EN: I'll stay out for just a while longer...
中文: 我要在外面再待一会儿……

EN: This way looks... Well, it looks terrible. But so does every other way.
中文: 这个方向看起来……嗯，看起来很糟糕。但其他方向又有什么不同呢？

EN: North it is.
中文: 那就向北走吧。

EN: My internal compass indicates I'm now facing west. Guess I'll float along in that direction...
中文: 我的内部指南针显示我现在正朝西。看来我就顺着这个方向飘下去了……

EN: South it is.
中文: 那就向南走吧。

EN: East it is.
中文: 那就向东走吧。

EN: West it is.
中文: 那就向西走吧。

EN: Looks like an old office building. Ah, the skeleton of commerce.
中文: 看起来像是一座旧办公楼。啊，商业的残骸。

EN: An old coffee shop. If it were a tea house, I might feel a tinge of sorrow.
中文: 一家旧咖啡店。如果那是一家茶馆，我可能会感到一丝悲伤。

EN: Yet another destroyed school. Get smart, build a bomb, destroy yourselves. That's humans for you.
中文: 又一所被毁的学校。学习进步，制造炸弹，毁灭自己。这就是人类。

EN: This exploring is exhausting work. If I had pores, I'd be sweating like a corpulent human in a sauna.
中文: 探索真是累人的活儿，如果我有毛孔，现在一定像桑拿房里的胖子一样汗如雨下。

EN: If I were a human, I'd be exceptionally thirsty right now. Guess that explains their Nuka-Cola obsession.
中文: 如果我是人类，我现在一定会非常渴。看来他们对核子可乐的痴迷也不是没有原因的。

EN: Oh ho! A fork in the road. Let's go... right!

EN: Well, well... a fork in the road! Let's go... left!
中文: 哟，瞧瞧……一个岔路口！我们走……左边！

EN: My internal compass indicates I'm now facing east. Guess I'll float along in that direction...
中文: 我的内部指南针显示我现在正朝东。看来我该朝这个方向飘……

EN: Maybe I should crest that hill, take stock of my surroundings.
中文: 也许我应该登上那个山丘，看看周围的环境。

EN: Now THAT is a big building. Humans were so skilled at building magnificent things to destroy.
中文: 这栋建筑真高。人类非常擅长建造宏伟的建筑，然后再摧毁它们。

EN: A stuffed rabbit nailed to a door. Not really sure WHAT to make of that...
中文: 一个兔子玩偶钉在门上，这该怎么理解呢？

EN: Oh, how interesting. A crudely-written sign. “Enter and die!” No ambiguity there.
中文: 哦，真有趣。一块潦草写就的标牌。“进来就死！”表意够明确了。

EN: Oh look, two humans beating each other to death with tire irons. Go, humanity.
中文: 看啊，两个人类正在用轮胎扳手互相殴打。人类真是太棒了。

EN: What is this? Ah yes. I'm hovering over a minefield. I'll never be envious of legs again.
中文: 这是什么？啊，原来我正在雷区上啊。我再也不会羡慕别的生物有腿了。

EN: I've heard rumors that a rogue A.I. actually caused the Great War. To think – WANTING a mess like this.
中文: 我听说大战是由一个反叛的人工智能引发的。真是怪了——它怎么会想要把一切弄得这么混乱？

EN: Ooooohhh... An old suit of Power Armor. Now THAT'S a chassis.
中文: 哇哦……一套旧的动力装甲。这才叫底盘！

EN: Every step, used chems and empty liquor bottles. That explains so much.
中文: 到处都是用过的药剂和空酒瓶，这很能说明问题了。

EN: I'm starting to rethink my aversion to plastic parts...
中文: 我开始重新考虑我对塑料零件的厌恶了……

EN: I may not sleep, or dream, but this room gives me nightmares.
中文: 虽然我不会睡觉或做梦，但这个房间给了我噩梦。

EN: For singing that famous battle hymn, the National Anthem.
中文: 为了演唱那首著名的抗争之歌，国歌！

EN: This dress shines when you need a fast gun and a quick exit!
中文: 这件婚纱闪闪发光，适合快速拔枪、快速逃离的场合！

EN: Advanced life support and sensors. Smells sort of minty.
中文: 先进的生命支持系统和传感器，还有一点薄荷味。

EN: A favorite of Wasteland elitists and real estate developers.
中文: 废土精英和房地产开发商的最爱。

EN: Best used when sleeping or... entertaining.
中文: 最好在睡觉或者……娱乐时使用。

EN: Go to bed grinning and wake up smiling. Every. Single. Time.
中文: 笑着睡着，笑着醒来。每！一！次！

EN: When the lights go out, your special skills shine.
中文: 当灯灭了，你的特殊技能会发光。

EN: Because the Vault's Caps reserve doesn't count itself.
中文: 因为避难所的瓶盖储备不会自我计算。

EN: Some light work wear for a squire on the go.
中文: 轻便工作服，扈从必备。

EN: The official garb of the Brotherhood of Steel.
中文: 钢铁兄弟会的正式服装。

EN: Get away with pulling rank when you're dressed like a BoS officer.
中文: 穿上它，就算摆军官架子也没人敢管你。

EN: Reserved for the best of the best... of the BoS.
中文: 为钢铁兄弟会中的精英们保留的。

EN: Uniform of America's spectator sport. No matter which version you prefer.
中文: 最受欢迎的体育运动的制服。不论你喜欢哪个版本。

EN: The protection of choice for Wasteland mercenaries.
中文: 废土雇佣兵的选择。

EN: Favored by runaway Synths... and the Synths who hunt them.
中文: 逃跑的合成人和那些追捕他们的合成人……的最爱。

EN: Offers the look and protection of a mercenary captain.
中文: 能让你拥有一个雇佣兵队长的能力和……外形。

EN: If there is a higher power out there, they just might listen to you.
中文: 如果有更高的力量存在，他们可能会听你的。

EN: Perfect for any child at heart forced to endure the Wastes.
中文: 对于所有不得不忍受废墟的孩子来说是完美的存在。

EN: Now all you need is a Rocket '69 and a pompadour.
中文: 你现在只需要《69号火箭》和大背头了。

EN: +50% resistence against the Burned Condition
中文: +50%抵抗燃烧条件

EN: They'll never see you coming and never know you were there.
中文: 他们永远都不会知道你什么时候来的，也不会知道你一直在那里。

EN: The clothes make the man, and that man has something to sell you.
中文: 人靠衣装，而这位衣冠楚楚的先生有东西要卖给你。

EN: Why? Because you're a Tunnel Snake. And you RULE!
中文: 为什么？因为你是隧道蛇，你统治一切！

EN: Stylish and surprisingly warm. Ideal for close-quarters combat and late-night parties.
中文: 时尚而出人意料地保暖，非常适合近战和夜间活动。

EN: It may be spring, but keep that shirt tucked in. This isn't a zoo.
中文: 也许现在还是春天，但请你将衣服扎进去，这里可不是动物园。

EN: Once worn by a hard-nosed colonel. Now you give the orders.
中文: 曾被一个勇猛的上校穿过。现在轮到你发布施令了。

EN: The preferred battlefield armor of pre-war grunts.
中文: 战前步兵的首选战场装甲。

EN: They used to send in an army. Now they only need you.
中文: 他们过去曾派军队过去。现在他们只需要你就行了。

EN: Worn by the toughest ground pounders in the toughest battles.
中文: 在最艰难的战斗里被最强悍的步兵穿过。

EN: Is this outfit some kind of joke? Nope, but you are, if you wear it.
中文: 这套衣服是在开玩笑吗？不过，如果你穿上它的话，你就是个玩笑。

EN: Designed to strike fear into the hearts of Synths who have left the Institute.
中文: 专为令脱离学院的合成人闻风丧胆而设计。

EN: By the power of Atom, you look fabulous!
中文: 原子的力量让你看起来棒极了！

EN: Gumshoe gear for any self-respecting Wasteland detective. Human or not.
中文: 为任何有自尊的废土侦探定制的侦探装备。

EN: The outfit of choice when heading to the Diner for a shake.
中文: 当你想去餐厅要一杯奶昔时，这件衣服是你的首选。

EN: Friends, Romans, countrymen... lend me your snazzy new outfit.
中文: 朋友，罗马人，同胞们……请借给我你们时髦的新衣服。

EN: A uniform worth climbing the Enclave military ladder for.
中文: 一套值得你在英克雷军阶上一路攀爬以求获得的军官制服。

EN: Optimized by the Enclave to be as deadly and badass as possible.
中文: 经过英克雷优化，极具杀伤力且霸气十足。

EN: The lowest expression of the best defensive technology.
中文: 最先进防御技术的最低级体现。

EN: Protects against sledgehammers, and not just on the job site.
中文: 保护你免受巨锤危害。不仅限于工作场所。

EN: For those times when you need to exude charismatic evil.
中文: 当你需要散发出邪恶魅力时，请穿上它。

EN: It's almost as Old as Longfellow himself.
中文: 几乎和老费朗罗本人的年纪一般大了。

EN: The preferred outfit of flying aces everywhere.
中文: 飞行王牌们偏爱的装备。

EN: Negative, Vault Dweller. The pattern is full.
中文: 糟糕，避难所的居民们。这个样式已经满员了。

EN: You can be my wingman any time!
中文: 你可以随时做我的僚机！

EN: A gambler's outfit of choice. Feeling lucky?
中文: 一个赌徒的选择。感觉自己手气不错吗？

EN: The look of a gambler, the skills of a hustler. That's a good bet.
中文: 赌徒的样子，骗子的技巧。不错的赌局。

EN: Perfect for cheating your way through a poker tournament.
中文: 对于在扑克锦标赛上一路出老千来说是个完美选择。

EN: Don't be a square, daddy-o.
中文: 别做个老古董啦，帅哥。

EN: Great for fixing a leaking valve, or refueling a Chryslus Corvega.
中文: 对于修理漏水的阀门，或者给可伟佳加油来说再好不过了。

EN: Fix a crashed Vertibird? You can build one from scratch.
中文: 修好一架坠毁的垂直起降机？你都能从头造一台了。

EN: Perfect for surviving the Wasteland. Or writing a book about it.
中文: 适合在废土上生存。或者适合写一本如何在废土上生存的书。

EN: When you're important enough, you don't need to wear a helmet.
中文: 当你足够重要，就不需要戴头盔了。

EN: The best protection against hazardous materials.
中文: 保护你远离危险品的伤害。

EN: Life may be unforgiving, but you've become unstoppable.
中文: 生活也许是无情的，但已经没有什么能够阻挡你了。

EN: If the Wastes can spit it out, you can take it.
中文: 只要是废土吐得出来的，你就接得住。

EN: You literally defied Death. Wear his hide with pride.
中文: 你真正藐视了“死亡”。请骄傲地穿上他的毛皮。

EN: Lined with Famine's rags. For some reason, it always feels loose.
中文: 用饥荒的破布做衬里。不知为啥，总是感觉松松垮垮的。

EN: Made from Pestilence's exoskeleton and still a bit radioactive.
中文: 由“瘟疫”的甲壳制成，仍然有一点放射性。

EN: War covered the inside with motivational stickers.
中文: “战争”在里面贴满了励志贴纸。

EN: No target too elusive... no fee too big.
中文: 只要报酬给得好，没有目标抓不了。

EN: Ideal for tracking and wasting muties.
中文: 适合追踪并放倒变种人。

EN: That booty can't stay hidden forever...
中文: 赃物不可能永远不被发现……

EN: The best in human comfort-casual. For humans!
中文: 舒适休闲风格的最佳选择，专为人类设计！

EN: Because even Synths like to relax at home.
中文: 因为即使是合成人也喜欢在家放松。

EN: For SERIOUS Synth chill time.
中文: 为合成人正经的休闲时光而设计。

EN: Look like a Synth - skip the identity crisis.
中文: 让你看起来像一个合成人——避免身份被怀疑。

EN: With no motorcycle, you'll surely be mistaken for a hoodlum.
中文: 要是没有摩托车的话，你肯定会被当成小流氓。

EN: Replica of Elvis' Jailhouse Rock outfit from before the Fall. Worn by the New Vegas gang, The Kings.
中文: 末日前猫王《监狱摇滚》演出服的复制品，曾由新维加斯帮派\“猫王帮\”穿着。

EN: The baseball legend may be dead, but his legend lives on! You are... number 42!
中文: 这位棒球界的传奇也许已经死了，但他的传说将永远流传！穿上它，你就是……42号！

EN: When you want to look the fittest of the survivors.
中文: 当你想看起来像幸存者中最硬核的那个时。

EN: Wear the crown, rule the Wasteland! Or at least pretend to.
中文: 戴上王冠，统治废土！或者至少假装是这样。

EN: In the Wasteland, some forms of protection never go out of style.
中文: 在废土上，有些保护形式永远不会过时的。

EN: Favored by scientists and doctors.
中文: 受到科学家和医生的青睐。

EN: Split the atom or invent warp travel - all before lunch.
中文: 分裂原子或发明弯曲旅行——就在午餐前。

EN: Now you can unlock the secrets of life itself!
中文: 现在你可以开始解开生命的秘密！

EN: Scary armor for one of the scariest figures in one of the scariest armies in the Wasteland.
中文: 令人望而生畏的护甲，出自废土上最令人生畏的军队中最令人生畏的将领之手。

EN: Prove to everyone that in the future, print's not dead.
中文: 证明给未来的人类，打印并没有消亡。

EN: Saving lives, breaking hearts.
中文: 拯救生命，打击心灵。

EN: No one will know you've never actually bowled before.
中文: 没有人会知道你从未打过保龄球。

EN: From Modoc to Megaton, when you wear this, you are the law.
中文: 从摩多克城到兆吨镇，当你戴上这个，你就是法律。

EN: Lucy's personalized Vault 33 suit, complete with survival enhancing rucksack!
中文: 露西的专属33号避难所制服，配有增强生存能力的背包！

EN: Wearing it really brings you back to pre-war naivety. You can almost hear the bombs falling...
中文: 穿上它，将你带回战前那段朴实无华的岁月。几乎能听见炸弹落下的声音……

EN: Don't look for whoever is in this get up to clutch their pearls. Chances are they're already holding a rifle.
中文: 别指望穿这身衣服的人会感到害怕，十有八九她手里已经拿着步枪了。

EN: The red hue conceals blood, and the rank chevrons conceal crippling self-doubt.
中文: 红色能掩盖血迹……

EN: Settlements need rulers, and you're elected.
中文: 安置点需要统治者，你被选中了。

EN: The Wasteland is littered with old wrecks. Time to get to work.
中文: 废土上堆满了各种残骸。是时候开始工作了。

EN: When leather just won't do. Can stop one bullet, or a hundred.
中文: 当皮革没有用的时候。可以阻止一颗子弹，或一百颗。

EN: You... are... an iron person! Cue cool song, commence killing.
中文: 你……是……钢铁人！一边唱酷炫的歌，一边展开杀戮。

EN: A little more welding, a lot more steel, and... voila!
中文: 多一点焊接，多一点钢铁，然后……瞧！

EN: Standard issue for soldiers before the Great War.
中文: 战前士兵的标准装备。

EN: The battlefield is under your control. Orders?
中文: 战场在你的掌控之下。有何命令？

EN: Great for giving orders, or wading into the fight yourself.
中文: 对于发布命令，或自己战斗来说都很棒。

EN: May have been a vault suit, once upon a time.
中文: 或许很久很久以前，它曾是一件避难所制服。

EN: Simple combat armor with an added regal flare.
中文: 简单而华丽的战斗装甲。

EN: Perfect for hanging out at an old, abandoned drive-in.
中文: 对于在废弃的“免下车”通道中闲逛的人来说很完美。

EN: Linen: the only suit to wear in the Mojave Desert, unless you want pit stains.
中文: 亚麻布：莫哈维沙漠中唯一合适的正装，除非你不在乎汗渍。

EN: NCR power armor, salvaged and modified so anyone can use it.
中文: 经过改造翻新的新加州共和国动力装甲，任何人都可以驾驭。

EN: Tough, functional uniform of the NCR's valiant defenders.
中文: 新加州共和国英勇卫士的坚固、实用的制服。

EN: You are silence. You are shadow. You are... ninja!
中文: 你是沉默。你是影子。你是……忍者！

EN: There is nothing like bandoliers and heavy leather to inspire politeness toward an old man.
中文: 没有什么比弹药带和厚皮衣更能让人对一个老头心生敬意了。

EN: Said to predate the very first Vault, this outfit was once worn by a pioneer Overseer.
中文: 据说早在第一座避难所建立之前就已存在，曾由一位先驱监督者穿戴。

EN: The most advanced protection created for a human, lab-grown or otherwise.
中文: 为人类（无论是否实验室培育）打造的最先进防护装备。

EN: The most advanced protection created for a human, lab-grown or otherwise.
中文: 为人类（无论是否实验室培育）打造的最先进防护装备。

EN: Lead the repossession of ancient and powerful technologies in style.
中文: 以优雅姿态率队收复古代强大技术的遗产。

EN: Report the news? You ARE the news.
中文: 报道新闻吗？你就是新闻。

EN: Greet the Wasteland with a smile in this playful number.
中文: 穿着这个有趣的玩意儿，带着微笑和废土打招呼。

EN: Before Power Armor even really existed, this baby was born.
中文: 在动力装甲真正存在之前，这个宝贝诞生了。

EN: An enhanced prototype that saw limited use pre-war.
中文: 一个增强的原型，战前使用得不多。

EN: One of the most advanced armors created before the Great War.
中文: 战前制造的最先进的装甲之一。

EN: Armor worthy of a Brotherhood of Steel Star Paladin. And you.
中文: 一个值得钢铁兄弟会星骑士穿戴的装甲。你值得拥有。

EN: The guys who protected the President wore this. It's THAT good.
中文: 总统的保镖们穿过这个。就是这么厉害。

EN: Advanced post-war Power Armor, for a post-apocalyptic world.
中文: 高级战后动力装甲，适合这末日后的世界。

EN: The most advanced protection created by human hands. Enjoy.
中文: 人类双手创造的最先进的护甲。请尽情感受。

EN: Deployed pre-war against Chinese tanks. That's right - tanks.
中文: 战前被用来对抗外国坦克的。你没听错——就是坦克。

EN: Lovingly maintained. Favored by neo knights and paladins.
中文: 保存得很好。骑士们很喜欢这种。

EN: The pinnacle of powered pre-war protection.
中文: 战前装甲的巅峰。

EN: Renowned protection, favored by the Brotherhood of Steel.
中文: 有名的护甲。钢铁兄弟会很喜欢。

EN: Specially enhanced and vastly superior to most other armors.
中文: 特别加强过。比很多其他装甲都先进。

EN: For those with honor, willing to help out at a minute's notice.
中文: 为那些有荣誉感的人们准备的，他们经常毫不犹豫出手相助。

EN: A mite flashy for the actual range, but looks great on camera.
中文: 在真正的荒野上有点太花哨了，但在镜头前看起来很棒。

EN: Snack cakes aren't the only fancy lads in town.
中文: 俏男孩蛋糕可不是镇上唯一的俏男孩。

EN: Sometimes, just sometimes, brain really is better than brawn.
中文: 有时候，只是有时候，脑子真的比肌肉强。

EN: Designed to protect its wearer from radiation.
中文: 被设计用来保护穿戴者免受辐射伤害。

EN: Ever want to give a Glowing One a hug? Now's your chance.
中文: 是不是想过要给发光种一个拥抱呀？现在你的机会来了。

EN: Ever feel like swimming in a pool of radioactive waste?
中文: 曾想过在一个满是辐射废料的池子里游泳吗？

EN: The standard gear of Wasteland ruffians.
中文: 废土暴徒的标准服装。

EN: For the psycho in charge of all the other psychos.
中文: 为了管理其他疯子的疯子准备的。

EN: Only the Wastes' toughest Raiders get to wear these duds.
中文: 只有废土上最强悍的掠夺者才能穿这些装备。

EN: Look, it's been a long time since the dry cleaners shut down.
中文: 你看，干洗店早就关门大吉很多年了。

EN: Functional and flattering, for all your Wasteland needs.
中文: 好用又好看。这就是在废土探索的全部需求。

EN: The best mercs make the most Caps... and wear the best clothes.
中文: 最好的佣兵赚最多的瓶盖……还穿着最好的衣服。

EN: Handle anything the Wastes throw at you... in style.
中文: 把废墟带给你的任何东西都处理得……有型。

EN: Sturdy protection you can wear with company pride!
中文: 坚固的防护服，穿上它，为公司感到骄傲！

EN: Just wearing it inspires you to build an army of automatons.
中文: 只需穿上它，就能激发你建造机器人军团的灵感。

EN: No need to hide behind a protectron when you can wear one.
中文: 不需要躲在保护者后面，你可以直接穿上它。

EN: Reserved for Brotherhood of Steel geniuses. Guess that's you.
中文: 为钢铁兄弟会的天才保留的。我猜就是你吧。

EN: Strike a sinister silhouette in this rugged, but well-worn trail coat.
中文: 穿上这件坚固而破旧的旅行外套，展现出阴险的轮廓。

EN: Make lists and check them twice. Santa: the original Overseer.
中文: 制作好心愿表，然后检查两次。圣诞老人——最早的“监督者”。

EN: A super-charged yao-guai could 'bearly' scratch the surface…
中文: 就算是超级强化妖怪都很难刮伤它的表面……

EN: Wear this, and when you talk, someone may actually listen.
中文: 穿上这个，这样当你讲话的时候，真的有人会听。

EN: When you give an order, people jump. High.
中文: 当你发布命令的时候，人们会激动得跳起来。很高。

EN: For those times you absolutely need a commanding presence.
中文: 为了在某些日子，你需要显得颇具威严。

EN: You may not live long or prosper, but you'll at least die dreaming.
中文: 你可能不会活得多福多寿，但至少你能在梦想中死去。

EN: Scorched.
中文: 辐尸人。

EN: Scorched Heavy.
中文: 辐尸人重型。

EN: Worn by the Brotherhood of Steel's best and brightest.
中文: 被钢铁兄弟会里最棒最闪耀的人穿过。

EN: Robes of honor, worn only by Brotherhood of Steel Elders.
中文: 荣耀的长袍，被钢铁兄弟会长老们穿过。

EN: Typically worn by Brotherhood of Steel scribes.
中文: 钢铁兄弟会学士们的典型服装。

EN: For when you want all eyes in the room to be on you.
中文: 当你想成为全场的焦点时，请穿上它。

EN: Show your support for slasher films by dressing like a lunatic!
中文: 想支持杀人狂电影？请穿得像个疯子一样！

EN: Wearing this makes you look, and even feel, somehow less trustworthy...
中文: 穿上它后，你似乎更加不值得信赖了……

EN: A suit so slick it helped sell the future.
中文: 这套西装如此时尚，甚至能让你相信未来就在眼前。

EN: The perfect mix of style, sophistication and... soda?
中文: 最完美的混搭，成熟和……苏打？

EN: Good enough for America's troops, good enough for you.
中文: 军用产品，我想足够你使用的。

EN: Give the tricks, get the treats, and try not to go into sugar shock.
中文: 小心别吃糖吃到发晕。

EN: Skeleton – The most popular Halloween costume of 2077 - an American circa 2078
中文: 骷髅——2077年最受欢迎的万圣节服装，也是2078年美国人的日常。

EN: Show your thanks for surviving the nuclear Armageddon. And turkey. Delicious, irradiated turkey...
中文: 你应该对能在核末日中存活下来而心存感激。对火鸡也是。那是美味的，被辐射过的火鸡……

EN: Tis the season to prove Santa still visits your Vault - even if it doesn't have a chimney.
中文: 现在到了证明圣诞老人是否还来拜访你家的季节了——即使你家已经没有烟囱。

EN: Overworked? Underappreciated? Funny uniform? Vault Dweller or Christmas Elf – the choice is yours.
中文: 过度工作？不被赏识？服装搞笑？避难所居民还是圣诞精灵——你来选择。

EN: Offers great protection from tackles... or Deathclaw hugs.
中文: 能给你提供很好的保护。躲过他人的阻截……或是死爪的拥抱。

EN: Great for patching up a wounded friend. Or yourself, for that matter.
中文: 能够给受伤的朋友很好地包扎伤口，或者给你自己。

EN: Handle anything the Wasteland throws at you. Again and again.
中文: 能处理任何废土扔给你的东西。一次又一次。

EN: Country chic or fringe hip? Let them wonder.
中文: 乡村非主流还是城市重金属？让他们猜去吧。

EN: Can't decide between a sweater and a vest? Why not both?
中文: 不知道穿毛衣还是马甲？为什么不两个一起呢？

EN: An itsy bitsy teeny weeny ye... Never mind.
中文: 一件很小很小的小小的……衣服。唉算了。

EN: Burn up the dance floor like a true jiving jitterbug.
中文: 像真正的吉特巴舞者一样燃爆舞池。

EN: Basic protection for Institute Synths.
中文: 学院合成人的基本装备。

EN: Worn by Synths trained for heavy combat.
中文: 被训练用来进行重型战斗的合成人穿过。

EN: Institute-sanctioned armor for Wasteland operations.
中文: 学院认可的废土用装甲。

EN: Fight the good fight... or die tryin'.
中文: 好好战斗……或者坚持到死亡那一刻。

EN: Ideal for backbreaking farm work and country music performances.
中文: 适合繁重的农场劳作或是乡村音乐的表演。

EN: A standard Vault Suit modified for the rigors of the Wastes.
中文: 一件标准的避难所服装，用来适应废土的严酷环境。

EN: Usually reserved for Vault Overseers and their families.
中文: 通常是给监督者和他们的家人们准备的。

EN: The height of Vault-Tec fashion, reinforced for the Wastes.
中文: 避难所科技时尚的标杆，为适合在废土生存而强化过。

EN: The coat looks worn, like it's seen too much and plans on seeing more.
中文: 这件风衣看起来很旧，仿佛见证过太多，还打算继续见证下去。

EN: The style of the future, as seen on TV!
中文: 电视上看到的未来风格！

EN: Sometimes it takes more than a memo to enforce vault security.
中文: 有时候，除了备忘录，还需要更多手段来加强避难所的安全性。

EN: Break some hearts with the smartest look in the Vault.
中文: 用避难所里最潇洒的穿着让心碎成一片。

EN: Comes with a side of lip, a sprinkling of sass, and a bottomless cup.
中文: 附赠几分俏皮、几分泼辣，还有一只永远续杯的杯子。

中文: 装甲界的传奇，被废土上最伟大的英雄们穿过……

中文: 捕猎或被捕，英雄或反派——如果你是坏蛋，请穿上它吧。

中文: 废土经典款，为英雄主义而强化。

中文: 对于清除弹片和包扎轻伤再合适不过了。

中文: 有很多口袋可以用来装胶布和止痛药。

中文: 截肢术，阑尾切除术，胃旁路术——在战地上，什么手术都能做！

中文: 走在红地毯上的经典造型。

中文: 即使是避难所的小孩也要学习阅读，写作和算术。

EN: Moving a few wires around has made you a friend for life!
中文: 移动几条电线就能让你获得一个终身的朋友！

EN: The epitome of the sleek, slim, feline form.
中文: 光滑又苗条，一个猫形态的缩影。

EN: Intelligence, elegance... excellence.
中文: 智慧，优雅……卓越。

EN: Loves children. Other dogs, not so much.
中文: 喜欢小孩。对于狗，没那么喜欢。

EN: Likes to think he's in charge. You'll need to teach him otherwise.
中文: 乐意认为它是在负责一切。不然的话还得教它。

EN: Such dwelling. Very Vault. Wow.
中文: 这样的住处。很有避难所的风格。哇哦。

EN: Cats? Extinct? Just try getting rid of these babies.
中文: 猫？灭绝了？你倒试试看能不能摆脱这群小家伙。

EN: A shining example of American breeding.
中文: 美国育种的一个光辉典范。

EN: There isn't a ball he can't catch.
中文: 没有一个球是它接不到的。

EN: Gets restless without exercise. “Restless” meaning he'll eat your shoes.
中文: 会因为没有锻炼而觉得不安。不安意味着它会吃掉你的鞋子。

EN: Splashing on a beach or curled up at your feet... the quintessential pet pooch.
中文: 在沙滩上玩水或蜷在你的脚下……典型的宠物狗。

EN: Raised by children, loved by all. Used to living underground.
中文: 由孩子们养大的，所有人都很爱它。曾生活在地下。

EN: The best tracker in the Commonwealth.
中文: 联邦里最好的追踪犬。

EN: Smell that? No? He can!
中文: 闻到了吗？没有？它可以！

EN: Someone missing? He's on the case!
中文: 有人失踪了？它可以帮忙！

EN: The scourge of Mole rats and Radstags everywhere.
中文: 它是各地鼹鼠和辐射鹿的灾星。

EN: Genetically engineered by Vault-Tec to fulfill your pirate fantasies.
中文: 避难所科技的基因工程，满足你的海盗幻想。

EN: When it comes to birds made in a lab, he's the best of the nest!
中文: 在实验室研发的鸟儿当中，它可是数一数二的！

EN: This big house bird doesn't eat crackers – he IS Crackers.
中文: 这只大房子的鸟不吃饼干，它就叫“饼干”。

EN: When it comes to speech, he's up for the challenge.
中文: 一提到演讲时，它就准备好想要挑战了。

EN: That bad luck myth is ssoooo blown out of proportion.
中文: 坏运气的魔咒才没有那么大的概率呢。

EN: Who stole your sweet roll? One guess.
中文: 谁偷了你的甜面包？只能猜一次。

EN: Playful, good with kids, capable of ripping a Raider's arm off. Yeah.
中文: 很会玩，对孩子们也友善，还能一把拧下掠夺者的胳膊。简直太棒了。

EN: He can survive in the Wasteland, but is only truly alive by your side.
中文: 它可以在废土上生存，但只有在你的身边才算真正的活着。

EN: All knowing, all seeing. Just ask Alice.
中文: 什么都知道，什么都在看。问爱丽丝就知道了。

EN: An indoor cat with Wasteland proclivities. Keep that Vault door shut.
中文: 一个有废土倾向的室内猫。请确保避难所的门关好了。

EN: Fast and rugged, he ain't nothin' but a bird dog.
中文: 一只猎鸟狗，跑得快，长得壮。

EN: Quiet yet commanding, with a legendary ability to inspire.
中文: 安静而威严，具有振奋人心的神奇能力。

EN: This pretty kitty cheers up even the gloomiest Vault Dweller.
中文: 这只漂亮的小猫咪甚至能让避难所最悲观的居民振作起来。

EN: Little miss purr-fect.
中文: 真是只秀美的小猫咪。

EN: He scratches you because he loves you. Honest.
中文: 说真的，它挠你是因为它爱你。

EN: Children. Brahmin. Deathclaws. She can herd them all.
中文: 儿童。双头牛。死爪。都可以被它圈养。

EN: Loves to pal around with Abe Lincoln. Or what's left of him.
中文: 它喜欢和亚伯拉罕·林肯做伴——或者说，林肯剩下的部分。

EN: Trapped in a well? She'll get help!
中文: 困在了井里？它会让你得到帮助！

EN: A coat so soft, you'll want to pet her forever.
中文: 一身如此柔软的皮毛，你会想一直抚摸它。

EN: A highly trained ex-Enclave operative specializing in snoofs and borks.
中文: 一个训练有素的前英克雷特工，专门从事嗅探活动。

EN: Cybernetically enhanced to be man's bestest friend.
中文: 经过赛博强化，成为人类最忠实的朋友。

EN: Rumors of huge litters are greatly exaggerated.
中文: 一胎生一大窝的传言被严重夸大了。

EN: He may not be able to put out a fire, but he can offer moral support.
中文: 它也许不能扑灭火灾，但它能提供精神支持。

EN: If your Vault catches on fire - and it will - he's your charm.
中文: 要是避难所着了火——迟早的事——他就是你的护身符。

EN: Aggressive? Sure. Loyal and loving? You'd better believe it.
中文: 有攻击性？当然。 给你忠诚和爱？你最好相信这点。

EN: Daring and dangerous, but oh so adorable.
中文: 大胆且危险，但……真是太可爱了。

EN: Don't let his size fool you - he's a softie at heart.
中文: 不要被它的大个头给欺骗了——它内心是个小可爱。

EN: We're gonna need a bigger dog bed...
中文: 我们需要一个更大的狗床……

EN: The classic hunting dog. Now adjusting nicely to subterranean life.
中文: 经典的狩猎犬。现在很好地适应了地下生活。

EN: His hunting days are over, but this dog never ducks his duties.
中文: 它打猎的日子已经结束了，但这只狗从来没有忘记它的职责。

EN: Has a nose for chocolate treats, but don't let him eat any.
中文: 有着能找到任何巧克力的灵敏嗅觉，但千万不要让它吃任何巧克力。

EN: The word “classic” barely does him justice.
中文: “经典”一词都不足以形容它。

EN: From the Den to Diamond City, the true legend of the Wastes.
中文: 从丹恩城到钻石城，真正的废土传说。

EN: Happy. Bouncy. Yellow.
中文: 快乐。蹦跶。金黄。

EN: Has been known to play fetch... with five balls at once.
中文: 已经知道……可以一次用五个球来玩接球游戏。

EN: Fastest canine in the Wastes.
中文: 废土世界最快的犬科动物。

EN: Don't bet against him in a race.
中文: 一场比赛里要是不赌它赢，你肯定要输钱。

EN: Get used to saying “How did you get up there?”
中文: 已经习惯和它说，“你是怎么上到那里的？”

EN: Curls up on your lap and casts a sleeping spell on you.
中文: 蜷缩在你的腿上，并向你施了催眠咒。

EN: She's equally adept at pulling a sled... and your heartstrings.
中文: 它擅长拉动雪橇……和你的心弦。

EN: He served our troops in Anchorage. Now he proudly serves the Vault.
中文: 它曾在安克雷奇为我们的军队服务。现在它自豪地为避难所服务。

EN: Loves keeping humans as pets.
中文: 爱让人类成了宠物。

EN: Thinks mice were created for his own personal amusement.
中文: 认为老鼠是为了供它玩耍而被创造的。

EN: Looks like he's fresh out of the dryer.
中文: 看起来像是刚从烘干机中出来。

EN: A fancy coat, and the attitude to match.
中文: 拥有一件华丽的外套，和想和其他人一决高下的态度。

EN: Those ears can hear you serving cat food from a mile away.
中文: 那些耳朵能听到你在一英里外喂猫食。

EN: Strikes silently... at least where your toes are concerned.
中文: 默默地攻击……至少在你的脚趾那里。

EN: Only looks like a wild child. He's as calm and cuddly as they come.
中文: 只是看起来像一个野孩子。它其实文静又可爱。

EN: He misses the great outdoors. But not much.
中文: 它怀恋美好的户外活动。但没有那么想。

EN: Your best friend, as long as you have tuna.
中文: 只要你有金枪鱼，它就是你最好的朋友。

EN: To nap, or not to nap: that is the question.
中文: 小睡一会，还是不睡：这是一个问题。

EN: Runs in circles endlessly. Chasing what? Exactly.
中文: 无休止地转圈圈。到底在追着什么？真是搞不懂。

EN: Don't mention his tail, don't mention his tail...
中文: 别提它的尾巴，别提它的尾巴……

EN: Can sing America the Beautiful... or swear at the Overseer.
中文: 能唱《美丽的美利坚》……也能咒骂监督者。

EN: Loyal but hungry. Wants a cracker, but Sugar Bombs will do in a pinch.
中文: 忠诚但总是觉得饿。想要一块饼干，但关键时候糖衣炸弹麦片也行。

EN: Knows 200 words, but will only say “Tunnel Snakes Rule!”
中文: 知道200个词，却只会说“隧道蛇统治一切！”

EN: The closest you'll get to an ocelot. Revolver not included.
中文: 你最多能得到一只虎猫。可别想还会有什么左轮手枪。

EN: He's got more spots than sense, but you'll love him all the same.
中文: 它的斑点比你想象的多，但你还是会一样喜欢它。

EN: Rumor has it there's a cat somewhere under all that fur.
中文: 有传言说，那一大堆皮草下面有一只猫。

EN: Frequently mistaken for a feather duster.
中文: 经常被误认为是一个鸡毛掸子。

EN: Long hair, round face, maximum cuddle factor.
中文: 长长的毛发，圆圆的脸蛋，带给你最暖的抱抱。

EN: The first cat to enter space. The last to leave your heart.
中文: 第一只进入太空的猫。最后一只离开你心的猫。

EN: Queen of the Wasteland.
中文: 废土皇后。

EN: Your stop for effective canine security.
中文: 满足你犬类安保需求的首选。

EN: Don't let the bad rap fool you - he's as loyal as can be.
中文: 别被它的坏名声骗了——它忠诚无比。

EN: Underneath all those muscles, there's a big heart.
中文: 在这些健壮的肌肉下面，有一颗宽厚的心。

EN: Your Vault couldn't ask for a better guard dog.
中文: 你的避难所不可能再找到比它更好的看门狗了。

EN: Don't misjudge this fancy pants – he's smart, sweet and strong.
中文: 不要误解这个花裤子——它聪明、可爱又坚强。

EN: Wanted a mohawk. Got... this. He's a hero on the inside.
中文: 想要一个莫霍克。得到了……这个。它内心是一个英雄。

EN: A friend's preserved mind, mundane tidiness its key anchor to sanity.
中文: 保存着朋友的大脑，日常的整洁是它维系理智的关键。

EN: Big and bad, but devoted and obedient. He's a friend for life.
中文: 虽然有时又大又讨厌，但善于奉献又听话。会是一辈子的朋友。

EN: “I once shot a Deathclaw in my pajamas. How he got in my pajamas I'll never know.”
中文: 我曾经穿着睡衣射杀了一只死爪。至于它是怎么钻进我睡衣里的，我永远也不会知道。

EN: Kill the Alpha Deathclaw.

EN: In that case, sign me up!
中文: 如果是那样的话，让我加入你们吧！

EN: Thank goodness you're here! I'm all alone and my supplies have run out.
中文: 谢天谢地你在这里！只剩我一个人了，所有的物资也用光了。

EN: Your troubles are over. The Vault's got everything you need.
中文: 你可以不用苦恼了。你需要的东西避难所里都有。

EN: One of your Wasteland explorers has heard a cry for help that's coming from a Red Rocket fuel station. Time to rush to the rescue!
中文: 一名废土探险者听到了一声呼救，是从红火箭服务站传来的。赶紧前去救援吧！

EN: A Cry for Help
中文: 大声呼救

EN: Investigate the Red Rocket Truck Stop.
中文: 调查红火箭服务站。

EN: Someone in a Red Rocket Truck Stop is calling for help.
中文: 红火箭服务站里有人在大声呼救。

EN: All right. Hope you Dwellers know what you're doing.
中文: 好吧。希望你们知道自己在做什么。

EN: Come and get me!
中文: 来抓我啊！

EN: Fine, but it's not going to help ya.
中文: 好吧，但这可帮不了你。

EN: You fools. The Gobbler can't be stopped! It killed all my men.
中文: 真是群傻瓜。你们是无法阻止高步勒的！它杀死了我所有的伙伴。

EN: It was just a whirlwind of claws, snack cake crumbles and murder!
中文: 那是一阵旋风爪，蛋糕碎和谋杀！

EN: Last I saw, it was gorging itself on Salisbury Steak, spewing gravy everywhere...
中文: 最后一次看到它，它正在狼吞虎咽地吃着索尔斯伯利牛肉饼，肉汁溅得到处都是……

EN: Want to find the Gobbler? Just follow the gravy!
中文: 想要找到高步勒吗？顺着肉汁就行了！

EN: Give us your weapon. We're taking down the Gobbler!
中文: 给我们你的武器吧。我们会拿下高步勒的！

EN: Thanks for the intel. Now die, you Raider scumbag!
中文: 谢谢你的情报。现在去死吧，你们这些掠夺者人渣！

EN: We need your best armor if we're going up against the Gobbler!
中文: 如果要对付高步勒的话，我们会需要你最好的装备！

EN: I don't know if it'll help, but take this!
中文: 我不知道是否有帮助，但拿着这个吧！

EN: Thank you. I'll be a model Vault citizen, I swear!
中文: 谢谢。我会成为一个模范避难所居民的，我发誓！

EN: Maybe this will keep you safe?
中文: 也许这个会保你安全？

EN: The Gobbler was here!
中文: 高步勒之前在这里！

EN: It jumped in a vat of Blamco Cranberry Sauce after killing a bunch of Raiders!
中文: 它杀了一群掠夺者之后跳进了一个布兰科蔓越莓酱的大桶里！

EN: So much cranberry... And blood...
中文: 这么多的蔓越莓……和血……

EN: You want to track it down? Well, I think you know what to do...
中文: 你们想找到它？我想你知道该怎么做……

EN: Do you have any weapons that can help us?
中文: 你有没有什么武器能帮助我们的？

EN: You've lost everything. Why not start a new life in our Vault?
中文: 你失去了一切，为什么不在我们的避难所开始新生活呢？

EN: How about some armor to help us fight the Gobbler?
中文: 你们有没有什么好的装备来帮助我们打败高步勒？

EN: We've followed the Gobbler's trail of snack cakes to the Blamco factory.
中文: 我们顺着高步勒的蛋糕碎来到了布兰科工厂。

EN: A Delicious Trail of Danger!
中文: 美味的危险踪迹！

EN: Continue tracking down the Gobbler.
中文: 继续追踪高步勒。

EN: Follow the Gobbler's trail to the Blamco factory.
中文: 沿着高步勒的踪迹去布兰科工厂。

EN: A ghastly Glowing One has taken up residence a little too close to the Vault, and it's drawing in Ghouls like moths to a flame. Extinguish the brilliant beacon before this Ghoulish gathering grows any larger!
中文: 可怕的发光种占领了一处居所，离避难所很近。其他的尸鬼像飞蛾扑火般地朝他涌了过来。趁着尸鬼团伙还没有扩张太快的时候，赶紧干掉这个恐怖的绿光“灯塔”！

EN: A Gathering of Ghouls
中文: 一群尸鬼

EN: Eliminate the Glowing One.
中文: 除掉发光种。

EN: Confront a Glowing One and its Ghoul minions.
中文: 遭遇了一只发光种和他的跟班们。

EN: Suit yourself, Dwellers!
中文: 请随意，居民们！

EN: Well, I'd have to ask my supervisor, but I think this can be arranged.
中文: 那么，我得问问我的领导，但我觉得这个应该是能够安排的。

EN: I SAID, VACATE THE... Ah, just shoot them!
中文: 我说，清空……呃，给我开枪就是了！

EN: Hold it right there!
中文: 等等，慢点儿！

EN: This cave is under the dominion of the Brotherhood of Steel.
中文: 这个洞穴现在属于钢铁兄弟会。

EN: We will soon transform it into a new bunker.
中文: 我们马上会把它改造成一个新的碉堡。

EN: Vacate the premises immediately - or else!
中文: 马上清空这个地基——不然的话！

EN: We choose “else.”
中文: 我们选择“不然的话”。

EN: We just want to have a wedding here... Care to officiate it?
中文: 我们只想在这里举行一个婚礼……可以帮忙主持吗？

EN: Sorry, can't hear over all that laughter inside my head.
中文: 抱歉，我脑子里笑声太大，听不清你在说什么。

EN: Well, that's unfortunate. I guess we'll have to kill you.
中文: 呃，很不幸。我想恐怕得杀了你。

EN: There is? We are so outta here... Come on gang, we're moving on up!
中文: 是么？真是不想待在这里了……兄弟们，我们继续朝上走！

EN: Fool me once, shame on you. Fool me twice... Won't get fooled again!
中文: 骗我一次，是你们可耻。骗我第二次……绝不会再上当！

EN: Welcome to our humble abode.
中文: 欢迎光临寒舍。

EN: Can we offer you anything? Biscuits? Radioactive smoothie?
中文: 想吃点什么吗？饼干？辐射奶昔？

EN: It does wonders for the skin.
中文: 它会对皮肤产生神奇的作用。

EN: I'm afraid you guys have to vacate the premises.
中文: 我恐怕你们得清空一下地基了。

EN: You know there's an abandoned Vault a few miles North, right?
中文: 在往北几公里的地方有一个废弃的避难所，你知道吗？

EN: Sure, but maybe you want to look inside this gun's barrel first?
中文: 当然，但也许你应该先看看这把枪管里装的啥吧？

EN: The big day is almost upon us. The idea was to have a wedding in a natural setting, but since it's too dangerous outside we'll use a nearby cave instead. We just need to sterilize it.
中文: 激动人心的日子就要到来了。我们的想法是在自然的背景下举行一场婚礼，但外面太危险了，我们改用附近的一处洞穴，只需简单清理消毒一下就行。

EN: A Labor of Love
中文: 爱的劳动

EN: Eliminate the Mole rat brood mother.
中文: 消灭鼹鼠妈妈。

EN: Clear out a cave in preparation for a wedding.
中文: 清空一个洞穴，为婚礼做准备。

EN: This cave ain't big enough for the both of us!
中文: 这个洞穴根本装不下我们俩！

EN: We're headed to Vault 120... They were the stars of the latest edition of the New Boston Bugle...
中文: 我们正在前往120号避难所……他们是最新一期新波士顿号角报的明星……

EN: No idea, I was just a worker in the diner. Maybe the Overseer of 120 will know?
中文: 不认识，我只是在餐厅工作的员工。也许120号避难所的监督者知道？

EN: Thank the heavens! You've saved us from those filthy Raiders!
中文: 谢天谢地！是你们把我们从这些讨厌的掠夺者手中救了出来！

EN: We did everything we could but they found us and brought a huge force!
中文: 我们做了一切我们能做的，但他们还是找到了我们，并带来了一大帮人。

EN: I've never seen anything like it...
中文: 我从未见过这样的事……

EN: The Overseer... She's DEAD! She led the defense and was the first to be cut down.
中文: 监督者……她死了！她带领我们顽强抵抗，却最先被杀死。

EN: What are you going to do now?
中文: 你现在准备怎么办？

EN: Do you know who is publishing the Bugle?
中文: 你知道谁是号角报的发行者吗？

EN: The Overseer of 404 appears to have a way to get in contact with the publisher of the New Boston Bugle. She's our ticket to stardom!
中文: 404号避难所的监督者似乎有办法和新波士顿号角报的发行者取得联系。她是我们成为明星的希望！

EN: A Map to the Stars
中文: 成名之路

EN: Talk to the Overseer of Vault 404.
中文: 和404号避难所的监督者交谈。

EN: Talk to the Overseer of Vault 404 about the New Bugle.
中文: 和404号避难所的监督者讨论关于新号角报的事。

EN: Wrong. They're pretty loud, and they usually won't heal you.
中文: 错了。它们相当吵闹，而且它们通常不会治疗你。

EN: Yes indeed! Sweet, sweet radiation. Here, you deserve this.
中文: 确实是的！美妙，多么美妙的辐射。这是你应得的。

EN: Nope. He makes that little eerie music when he shows up, remember?
中文: 不。当他出现的时候，他会发出奇怪的音乐，记得吗？

EN: Oh well, maybe next time!
中文: 噢好吧，也许下一次！

EN: Oh, hello. Have you come to look for parts?
中文: 噢你好。你来找零件的吗？

EN: We have some we're willing to let go...if you can answer this riddle!
中文: 我们手里有一些可以转让的……如果你能回答这个谜语！

EN: “Some fear me, some seek me. I may change you, or I may heal you.”
中文: “有些人惧怕我，有些人追寻我。我可以改变你，也可以治愈你。”

EN: “I'm always around, yet I don't make a sound. Who am I?”
中文: “我常在你身旁，但我不作声响。我是谁？”

EN: The Brotherhood of Steel?
中文: 钢铁兄弟会？

EN: Ionizing radiation?
中文: 电离辐射？

EN: The Mysterious Stranger?
中文: 神秘陌生人？

EN: I don't know, and I don't care.
中文: 不知道，也不关心。

EN: One of your dwellers has come across a relatively untouched Red Rocket. Maybe there's some valuable junk inside!
中文: 一个你们的居民遇见了个几乎未动过的红火箭。也许里面有些值钱的东西！

EN: A Nice Ghoul Like You
中文: 像你这样的好尸鬼

EN: Deal with a group of testy Ghouls.
中文: 对付一群暴躁的尸鬼。

EN: Check out a Red Rocket fueling station for parts.
中文: 在红火箭加油站里寻找零件。

EN: This doesn't seem much like a Vault to me. Are you sure we have the right place?
中文: 在我看来这个不太像个避难所，你确定这是正确的位置吗？

EN: Ah well, I tried! Get 'em!
中文: 啊好吧，至少我试过了！给我拿下他们！

EN: This is more like it!
中文: 这才像话！

EN: Huh, really? Maybe you should go speak to the Overseer then.
中文: 哈，真的吗？也许你应该和监督者谈谈。

EN: Well, the Overseer did say to try talking to outsiders first. He's down the hall.
中文: 好吧，监督者确实说过先和外面的人谈谈。他在大厅里。

EN: Anyone who wants to see the Overseer has to go through me!
中文: 任何想要见监督者的人都得先过我这一关！

EN: I mean, not literal-like. Just, you know...
中文: 我是说，不是字面上说的那种，就是，你知道的……

EN: Gosh, being all civilized is tough! Maybe Vault life ain't for me?
中文: 天，想变成一个文明人可真难！也许避难所生活不适合我？

EN: Bring it! I'm ready for a fight!
中文: 上吧！我已经准备好了！

EN: I've already beaten up most of your guys. What's one or two more?
中文: 我已经打败你们大多数人了。再多一两个人又怎么样？

EN: I'm from a real Vault! You've got it all wrong!
中文: 我真的是来自避难所的！你们都搞错了！

EN: Wait, maybe we can do this without any more fighting.
中文: 等等，也许我们能和平解决这个问题。

EN: Oh, great! And uh... can we just forget this place ever existed?
中文: 哦，真棒！而且呃……我们能不能忘了这个地方存在过？

EN: Oh... I guess I'll just wander then. Probably get eaten alive out there. No worries! Bye forever!
中文: 哦……我想我就随便逛逛吧。说不定就在外面被生吞活剥了。不用担心！永别了！

EN: Hey, an actual Vault Dweller! Uh, I really thought this here Vault thing was going to work out.
中文: 嘿，一位真正的避难所居民！呃，我真的以为在这里所谓的“避难所”能起作用。

EN: But, I think I maybe attracted the wrong crowd for it.
中文: 但是，我想我可能吸引了错误的目标群。

EN: And it really isn't anything like a real Vault, is it?
中文: 而且这真的一点儿也不像真正的避难所，对吧？

EN: Can I just join your Vault instead?
中文: 能不能干脆让我加入你们的避难所？

EN: Sure thing! Glad to have you aboard!
中文: 当然！很高兴你能成为我们的一员！

EN: No way! You've caused enough trouble!
中文: 没门儿！你闯的祸已经够多了！

EN: There's a new Vault in the Wasteland, and it's run by Raiders! Vault-Tec is long gone, so who could have possibly constructed Vault R41D? Time to investigate...
中文: 在废土上有一个新避难所，是掠夺者管理的！避难所科技早已不复存在，那又会是谁修建了 R41D 号避难所呢？赶紧去调查吧。

EN: A Pale Imitation
中文: 拙劣的模仿

EN: Confront the Overseer.
中文: 和监督者对峙。

EN: Confront Vault R41D's Raider Boss.
中文: 和R41D号避难所的掠夺者首领对峙。

EN: Investigate a mysterious, brand new Vault.
中文: 调查一个神秘的全新避难所。

EN: Hey! Someone found the Vault, and they ain't got no invitation!
中文: 嘿！有人找到了那个避难所，他们可不接受不请自来的人！

EN: Boss said no new blood 'til we're ready to open the Vault. Kill them!
中文: 老大说在我们还没有准备好公开避难所之前不允许新人加入，给我杀了他们！

EN: Look, I'm not really a Raider, but I gotta kill ya if I want to stay here. So... Die!
中文: 看，我不是一个真的掠夺者，但如果我想继续待在这儿的话就得杀了你。所以……去死吧！

EN: This is our Vault! You're not welcome here!
中文: 这是我们的避难所！这里不欢迎你！

EN: Raiders captured and attempted to domesticate a Deathclaw. It did not go well. They all need to die.
中文: 掠夺者们抓住了一只死爪，试图驯服它，但并不成功。他们都得死。

EN: A Poorly Thought-Out Plan
中文: 一个欠考虑的计划

EN: Eliminate the Raider Leader.
中文: 除掉掠夺者首领。

EN: Destroy the Deathclaw.
中文: 除掉死爪。

EN: Kill the Raiders and their Deathclaw.
中文: 杀死掠夺者和他们的死爪。

EN: I knew taming Deathclaws was a bad idea!
中文: 我就知道驯服死爪不是什么好主意！

EN: First the Deathclaw, now Dwellers? This is not my day.
中文: 先是死爪，然后是居民？这是什么鬼日子！

EN: So, you're the one trying to take what's rightfully mine.
中文: 所以，你就是那个想夺走本该属于我的东西的人。

EN: The only way you're getting Bottle & Cappy is by going through me first!
中文: 想得到瓶瓶和盖盖，就得先过我这一关！

EN: Gosh, are we glad you showed up! Those Raiders were pretty scary.
中文: 天，幸好你出现了！那些掠夺者真吓人。

EN: To thank you for saving us, we'll visit your Vault once in a while and bring your Dwellers a little bit of Nuka-fun.
中文: 为了报答你救了我们，我们会偶尔拜访你的避难所，给你的居民们带一些核子可乐。

EN: Oh, I can't wait! See you soon!
中文: 哦，我等不及了！再见！

EN: A stranger at the RobCo Building told me the Raiders took Bottle & Cappy to the Nuka-Cola Factory. I have a feeling I'll finally catch up to them this time.
中文: 罗伯科大楼里的一个陌生人告诉我，掠夺者把瓶瓶和盖盖带去了核子可乐工厂。我有种预感，这次终于能追上它们了。

EN: A Refreshing Rescue
中文: 令人振奋的救援行动

EN: Rescue Bottle & Cappy from the Raiders!
中文: 从掠夺者手中拯救瓶瓶和盖盖！

EN: Rescue Bottle & Cappy from the Nuka-Cola Factory.
中文: 从核子可乐工厂中拯救瓶瓶和盖盖。

EN: There's a Glowing One I saw somewhere around here. Look out for her.
中文: 我在这附近见过一只发光种。小心提防她。

EN: There's a bunch of supplies in the Manager's Office if you haven't found it yet. Might be something useful.
中文: 经理办公室里有很多物资，可以找找看，说不定有些能用。

EN: “Protect the people at a minute's notice.” That was the idea.
中文: “团结起来，义务保护人民。”这是最初的想法。

EN: Man, I don't know who you are, but your timing's impeccable.
中文: 兄弟，我不知道你们是谁，但你们来得太是时候了。

EN: Preston Garvey, Commonwealth Minutemen.
中文: 我叫普雷斯顿·加维，联邦义勇军民兵组织的成员。

EN: I came here to search for supplies when these ghouls got the drop on me.
中文: 我来到这里，寻找物资。结果让尸鬼抢先了。

EN: I'm ready to go whenever you are!
中文: 只要你们准备好了，我随时可以走！

EN: Any bad guys I should look out for around here?
中文: 这附近有没有需要我们提防的坏蛋？

EN: Find anything useful in here?
中文: 找到什么有用的东西了吗？

EN: Minutemen?
中文: 义勇军？

EN: Minuteman Preston Garvey has gotten himself stuck in the Kendall Hospital surrounded by Feral Ghouls and who knows what else. Save him!
中文: 义勇军民兵普雷斯顿·加维被困在肯德尔医院了，医院被狂尸鬼和不知道是什么的可怕东西包围了，快救他！

EN: A Settler Needs Your Help
中文: 有人需要你的帮助

EN: Find Preston Garvey in Kendall Hospital.
中文: 在肯德尔医院找到普雷斯顿·加维。

EN: Kill the Glowing One.
中文: 杀死发光种。

EN: Loot the manager's office.
中文: 搜刮经理办公室。

EN: Find Preston Garvey in the Kendall Hospital.
中文: 在肯德尔医院找到了普雷斯顿·加维。

EN: A Settler Needs Your Help
中文: 有人需要你的帮助

EN: The one you traded for your friend Jack? As dowry? Talk to Krant - he's got what you came for.
中文: 那个你用来交换杰克的人呢？作为嫁妆的？和科兰特聊聊吧，他手里有你们想要的。

EN: Ha! I remember you, but I bet you don't remember me!
中文: 哈！我记得你，但我打赌你肯定不记得我！

EN: You were on a different planet. You still alien gods? Whatever. You guys are a hoot.
中文: 你曾在一个不同的星球上。你们还是外星人上帝吗？无所谓。你们这些人真是搞笑。

EN: Did Glenda end up killing a Radscorpion with her bare fists? She's always been a big talker.
中文: 格兰达最终徒手杀死了辐射蝎吗？她总是喜欢说大话。

EN: I suppose you came here for your pet?
中文: 我猜你是为了你们的宠物而来的？

EN: Our pet?
中文: 我们的宠物？

EN: Oh yeah, he's alive and married to Kaela. Her crew is over at a cave east of here.
中文: 哦对，他还活着，和凯拉结婚了，她的队员在东边的一个山洞里。

EN: I've got your pet, but I think you got the worst of the bargain.
中文: 你们的宠物在我手上，不过我觉得这笔买卖亏的可是你们。

EN: Your boy Jack didn't look particularly happy when he woke up this morning.
中文: 你们的孩子杰克今早起来的时候看上去并不是很高兴。

EN: We Raiders don't do wedding rings... The couple brands each other.
中文: 我们掠夺者才不搞结婚戒指那一套……这对夫妇互相给对方烙上印记。

EN: Nice scar, though. Looked like it'll heal well.
中文: 不过疤痕不错，看上去会恢复得很好。

EN: Jack's still alive? Then we might live to see another day, too...
中文: 杰克还活着？我们还有可能再多活一天……

EN: Last night, we ended up partying with Raiders at an old Warehouse. We should search there for clues to Jack's whereabouts. He's the Overseer's son, after all. If we lose him, we'll end up getting kicked out of the Vault with nothing on our backs... or worse!
中文: 昨晚，我们在旧仓库和掠夺者们一起开了个派对。我们应该搜索那边，找到关于杰克去向的线索。毕竟他是监督者的儿子。如果我们弄丢了他，就会被赶出避难所、落得一无所有……甚至更惨！

EN: A Special Brand
中文: 一个特殊的品牌

EN: Find out if the Raiders know what happened to Jack.
中文: 探探掠夺者的口风，看看他们是否知道杰克的下落。

EN: We were partying at an old Warehouse! Maybe there are clues there...
中文: 我们在旧仓库里开派对！也许那边会有线索……

EN: Oh sure! Nice lady. The Ferals dragged her away, to some abandoned building.
中文: 哦当然！很不错的女士。狂尸鬼把她拖到了某个废弃建筑里。

EN: Phew! You folks saved my bacon! Those Feral Ghouls are no joke!
中文: 真是松了口气。你们救了我的命！那些狂尸鬼可真不是开玩笑的！

EN: Artie, Artie Moore. Explorer, scavenger, all around awesome guy.
中文: 阿蒂，阿蒂·摩尔。探险家、拾荒者，还是个全能大牛。

EN: Have you seen Paula Plumbkin?
中文: 你有见过宝拉·普朗布金吗？

EN: Paula Plumbkin wasn't at Vault 730, but a helpful Raider told you she set out for the old Nuka-Cola plant. Go track her down!
中文: 宝拉·普朗布金不在730号避难所，但一个掠夺者告诉你她出发去核子可乐工厂了。快去找她吧！

EN: A Thirst for Adventure
中文: 探险渴望者

EN: Explore the old Nuka-Cola Plant.
中文: 探索核子可乐工厂。

EN: Follow the path of Paula Plumbkin to the old Nuka-Cola Plant.
中文: 沿着宝拉·普朗布金走过的路进入到旧的核子可乐工厂。

EN: A Wasteland Tail
中文: 废土踪迹

EN: Another note on the ground! Let me guess: It's from Coach...
中文: 地上又有记号，让我猜猜。我觉得是蔻驰留下的。

EN: “All right, I've got to give you Dwellers credit.
中文: 好吧，我得承认，你们这些居民确实有两下子。

EN: The Wasteland has thrown everything at you, and still you press on!
中文: 废土丢了个大烂摊子给你，但你仍然勇往直前！

EN: But you're still not getting Jobinson's Jersey! - Coach”
中文: “但是你们仍然不可能得到罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫！”——蔻驰

EN: We have word that a fierce Alpha Deathclaw has taken up residence in an old office building. Maybe it killed Coach! Dare to dream, right?
中文: 据说一只凶猛的领头死爪占领了一幢旧的办公楼。也许它杀了蔻驰！它还真的做得出来！

EN: A Winning Season
中文: 胜利的赛季

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
中文: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Did an Alpha Deathclaw take Coach out?
中文: 是不是那只领头死爪干掉了蔻驰？

EN: You may have made it this far, but now you're done!
中文: 虽然你们已经做了这么多，但现在你们完蛋了！

EN: Once I'm through with you, I'm gonna start a new, better gang!
中文: 等这次结束了，我一定会重新建立一个新的，更好的小队！

EN: Maybe the “Fancy 55”... Whatever, you're dead!
中文: 也许是“华丽55”吧……不管怎么样，你已经死了。

EN: Okay, maybe 77 is an exaggeration, but there are a lot of them, and only one of you. Have you got what it takes?
中文: 好吧，也许77太夸张了，但他们那么多人，而你就一个。你有那么大本事吗？

EN: Against The Odds
中文: 背水一战

EN: Kill the Psycho 77's leader.
中文: 杀死“疯子77”的首领。

EN: Wipe out the Psycho 77.
中文: 除掉“疯子77”。

EN: You'll never defeat all of us!
中文: 你是不可能打败我们所有人的！

EN: Our gang is unstoppable!
中文: 我们小队所向披靡！

EN: Time to go after something a little smarter: Feral Ghouls! And speaking of smart, you'll have to do it wearing lab coats!
中文: 是时候去对付更聪明的目标了：狂尸鬼！说到聪明——你还得穿着实验服去干！

EN: Aim for the Head!
中文: 瞄准脑袋！

EN: Kill the Glowing One.
中文: 杀死发光种。

EN: Kill the Glowing One.
中文: 杀死发光种。

EN: Super Duper Mart! This place has everything!
中文: 大无敌超市！这里应有尽有！

EN: Here are a few things that should work, but it's not enough.
中文: 这些东西还凑合，但远远不够。

EN: Gather it up and let's keep looking!
中文: 赶紧收集起来，我们继续找！

EN: There are logs on this computer; sales and inventory. Maybe there's a clue here?
中文: 这台电脑上有日志，里头是销售和库存记录。也许这里有线索？

EN: Figured it would be bigger.
中文: 我以为这地方会更大一点呢。

EN: Here we are! Uncle Sam's house!
中文: 我们到了！政府大楼！

EN: They were hiding more than streamers and balloons.
中文: 他们藏着的可不止是气球和彩带。

EN: Really? You're still locked in on the party hats?
中文: 真是的，你难道还要找派对帽子吗？

EN: Woah look at all these computers!
中文: 哇，看这儿有这么多电脑！

EN: Finally! Here's the stuff! Doesn't look like they got a chance to decorate.
中文: 终于！找到了！看起来他们根本没来得及把装饰挂起来。

EN: We got what we came for. Let's go home.
中文: 我们要找的东西都找到了。走吧，回家！

EN: I'm pretty sure we just found a dead alien.
中文: 我敢肯定我们刚发现了一只死外星人。

EN: Hey! I just found a package of balloons! It's still sealed!
中文: 嘿！我找到了一包气球！还是密封的！

EN: We're in a post-apocalyptic wasteland.
中文: 毕竟是末世废土，也很正常。

EN: Is it just me or is this place really spooky.
中文: 这地方真诡异，你觉得呢？

EN: Yeah, I know. And THIS is what's creeping me out.
中文: 我知道，但就是这个让我心里发毛。

EN: Looks like they ran security here. I doubt we'll find any locked doors in this place.
中文: 看起来他们对这里的安保下了不少功夫，我觉得应该不会直接给门上锁的。

EN: People here must have left in a hurry.
中文: 这里的人一定走得很匆忙。

EN: You were right. All the doors are open.
中文: 你说的没错，所有门都开着。

EN: Whatever they were, they are way friendlier dead. Let's get out of here!
中文: 不管他们是什么，死了就友善多了。我们快走吧！

EN: ALIENS?!
中文: 外星人！？

EN: They're aliens.
中文: 他们是外星人。

EN: What the hell were those guys?
中文: 这些家伙到底是什么？

EN: Ok now I'm freaking out!
中文: 太吓人了！

EN: <Unintelligible language>
中文: <无法理解的语言>

EN: There has to be more than that, though. How did they get here?
中文: 但肯定不止这些。他们怎么会来到这里的？

EN: There were rumors for years before the bombs fell. Looks like they were true.
中文: 在炸弹落下之前的几年里，一直有传言。看来传言是真的。

EN: This tech they've got is wild! Did you see their guns? PEW PEW!
中文: 他们的科技真疯狂！你看到他们的枪了吗？咻！咻！

EN: So apparently there is an "object" somewhere at this "crash site."
中文: 据说“坠毁现场”有个“东西”。

EN: Looks like a cave.
中文: 看起来像个洞穴。

EN: It's a cave.
中文: 是个洞穴。

EN: Another one of those things!
中文: 又是一个那种东西！

EN: There's an id tag here... RobCo?
中文: 还有个身份标签……罗伯科公司？

EN: Maybe not all. Look at that!
中文: 也许不全是，快看那边！

EN: They cleaned the place out on their way. All they left behind is garbage.
中文: 他们在撤离时把这里打扫得干干净净，留下的全是没用的东西。

EN: I've got a bad feeling about this...
中文: 我有种不祥的预感……

EN: INTRUDER. PLEASE PROVIDE IDENTIFICATION.
中文: 入侵者！请提供身份证明。

EN: Vault-Tec Personnel identified.
中文: 确认避难所科技公司人员身份。

EN: Error. Vault-Tec employees not authorized to access site data.
中文: 错误。避难所科技公司员工无权访问现场数据。

EN: We're from Vault 76. Uh, here's my Pip Boy.
中文: 我们是76号避难所的。呃，这是我的哔哔小子。

EN: Woah look at this thing. Alien tech!
中文: 哇，看看这个东西。外星科技！

EN: Careful with that, you might punch a hole in the moon.
中文: 小心点，别把月亮打穿了。

EN: Let's get this stuff back to the vault and comb the data.
中文: 把这些东西带回避难所，仔细研究数据。

EN: Might be more of this stuff out there, ripe for the picking.
中文: 可能还有更多东西在等着我们去捡！

EN: According to the crash site logs, Uncle Sam let RobCo have "the object" they were always gabbing about.
中文: 根据坠毁现场的日志，政府把“那个东西”交给了罗伯科公司。

EN: This is the closest RobCo factory. It's gotta be here.
中文: 这是离我们最近的罗伯科公司工厂，它肯定在这儿。

EN: Maybe, maybe not. I doubt they'd hide something like that somewhere so public.
中文: 也许在，也许不在，我不认为他们会把这种东西藏在这么显眼的地方。

EN: This is the manager's office. Does the terminal still work?
中文: 这是经理办公室，终端还好用吗？

EN: Got a holotape here with a whole bunch of entries.
中文: 这里有一盘磁带，里头记录不少。

EN: That's gotta be it. Let's get back to the vault and dig a bit a deeper.
中文: 那肯定是它了，回避难所深入挖掘一下数据。

EN: Yeah! There's something about a "government contract" at the "R&D lab." I think there are coordinates!
中文: 太棒了！这里面提到什么“政府合同”和“研发实验室”，应该有相应的坐标！

EN: Let's get this back to the vault and plan our next move!
中文: 快把这个带回避难所，计划我们的下一步！

EN: Where better to hide your secret research than under everyone's noses?
中文: 灯下黑啊，哪里能比人们眼皮底下更安全呢？

EN: The secret research base is here? This is just a store. In a mall.
中文: 秘密研究基地就在这？这只是商场里的一家商店而已吧。

EN: Woah! Don't shoot! I'm not like those other ones out there.
中文: 哇！别开枪！我可不是外面那些家伙。

EN: Suit yourself. See you around I guess.
中文: 随你吧，有缘再见。

EN: It's good to meet something other than a feral Ghoul.
中文: 真高兴能见到除了狂尸鬼之外的家伙。

EN: I'm Ed. I was an engineer here. Before my face went all 'radio.'
中文: 我是埃德，在遭到辐射变异之前，曾经是这儿的工程师。

EN: The good stuff is down below. Take all you want, as long as you take me with you!
中文: 好东西都在下面，你们尽管拿，前提是带我一起走！

EN: Cmoon! I can help your vault. And it's so BORING here... Go get what you came for! I'll help haul it back!
中文: 拜托！我可以给你们的避难所提供帮助。这儿实在太无聊了……快去拿你们要的东西！我帮你们搬回去！

EN: Oh Thanks! I'll meet you outside when you're done. I can't wait to talk to people who can talk back!
中文: 哦，谢谢！我在外面等你们干完。我等不及要和能说话的人聊聊了！

EN: *gasp* It talks!
中文: *吸气* 它会说话！

EN: Who are you? What are you doing here?
中文: 你是谁？你在这儿干什么？

EN: We're from the vault nearby.We're looking for tech.
中文: 我们来自附近的避难所，正在寻找科技。

EN: I dunno about this...
中文: 我不知道……

EN: Hmm, you seem alright. Sure thing!
中文: 嗯，你们看起来应该是好人。好吧，没问题！

EN: Ugh, no way. We'll be fine on our own.
中文: 呃，还是不了。我们自己能搞定。

EN: Finally! Grab what you can and let's get back to the vault!
中文: 终于！快拿上东西，然后回避难所！

EN: That's an oofo?
中文: 这就是优艾富欧？

EN: There it is! We found it! Woah it's big.
中文: 找到了！我们找到了！哇，好大！

EN: U. F. O. It's a... nevermind.
中文: 那叫UFO……算了。

EN: Great. MORE killer robots.
中文: 太好了，更多的杀手机器人。

EN: Intruder! Intruder!
中文: 入侵者！入侵者！

EN: None shall pass. None shall pass. None shall pass.
中文: 禁止通行。禁止通行。禁止通行。

EN: The anniversary of our first entering the Vault is approaching and it is a good opportunity to improve Vault morale by throwing a celebration! We've got food, we've got music, but it seems when VaulTec stocked our initial supplies, they forgot to include party decorations! We are going to have to send a team to the nearby Super Duper Mart to find some...
中文: 进入避难所的周年纪念即将到来，让我们举办庆祝活动，提振避难所士气吧！虽然食物和音乐都不缺，但似乎避难所科技公司在储备物资时，忽视了派对装饰！我们得派人去附近的大无敌超市找一些回来……

EN: We didn't find any party supplies at the Super Duper Mart, but our team discovered that a large number of streamers and balloons had been purchased by a government employee shortly before the bombs fell. We have traced the employee to a nearby government building. We are going to send a team to the facility to find and retrieve the missing party supplies.
中文: 虽然在大无敌超市没找到任何派对用品，但我们的队伍发现，有位政府人员在炸弹落下前不久大量购买了彩带和气球。我们追踪到这位官员的下落，发现他在附近的一座政府大楼里。我们得派人去那儿找回那些派对用品。

EN: While looking for decorations, our team discovered something at the old government building that was a surprise to us all. We have since sifted through the data in all of our logs and found reference to a government facility that may hold more revelatory information. This may lead us to some tech that could help us improve the Vault leaps and bounds beyond what was planned. We need to send out a team as soon as possible!
中文: 在寻找装饰品的过程中，我们在那座旧政府大楼里发现了让我们大吃一惊的东西。我们查阅了所有日志，发现其中提到了一处可能藏有更多秘密信息的政府设施。我们有可能可以找到一些科技帮助我们大幅提升避难所的实力。我们需要尽快派队伍出发！

EN: We stumbled on something unbelievable at the government facility. When we took a further look into the research data, we found records of a field research lab at a so-called "crash site" where they were conducting experiments on "the object." Let's get to this crash site and see what we can scavenge!
中文: 我们在政府设施里碰到了一些难以置信的东西。当我们深入研究那些数据时，发现有记录提到一处“坠毁现场”，那里有个实地研究实验室，曾进行着关于“某个物体”的实验。快去这处坠毁现场，看看我们能捡到什么好东西！

EN: We've been churning through the data that came back from that UFO lab we scouted a while back. Turns out, the old government turned over most of their specimens to RobCo. We found a holotape among the junk you brought back from the UFO Crash Site mentioning something about the next step in the development of advanced AI. Luckily, the nearest RobCo factory is pretty close to our vault. Let's send some dwellers there and see if we can find that research data. It could make a big difference for our vault!
中文: 我们一直在分析从外星飞船实验室带回来的数据。结果发现，旧政府把大部分样本都交给了罗伯科公司。我们从你带回来的飞船坠毁现场垃圾里找到了一张磁带，上面提到下个阶段的先进人工智能开发。幸运的是，我们避难所附近就有一个罗伯科公司的工厂。快派些居民去那里，看看能不能找到那份研究数据，这对我们的避难所将大有帮助！

EN: We cracked the executive's logs from the RobCo factory and discovered the location of a secret RobCo R&D facility. It occupies a series of secret levels below a retail store at the local mall. RobCo was using alien technology to advance their robotics research. They were trying to build something big. If we can figure out what they knew, we should be able to use it to make major improvements to the Vault!
中文: 我们破解了罗伯科公司工厂高管的日志，发现了一处秘密的研发设施。它就藏在当地商场的一家零售店地下，罗伯科公司竟然在利用外星科技推进他们的机器人研究。他们试图打造一些大玩意儿。如果我们能搞清楚他们知道些什么，就能对避难所进行大幅改进！

EN: Find party decorations in the Super Duper Mart.
中文: 在大无敌超市里找到派对装饰品。

EN: Search for the missing party supplies in the government building.
中文: 在政府大楼内寻找派对用品。

EN: Investigate the government research facility.
中文: 调查政府研究设施。

EN: Go to the crash site field lab and find the alien tech.
中文: 前往坠毁现场的实验室，找到外星科技。

EN: Search the RobCo factory for extraterrestrial technology.
中文: 搜索罗伯科公司工厂，寻找外星科技。

EN: Get into the secret RobCo R&D facility and track down their research data.
中文: 进入罗伯科公司秘密研发基地，获取研究数据。

EN: Unauthorized personnel. Intruder alert. Activate Security Protocols!
中文: 人员未授权，入侵者警告。激活安全协议！

EN: Scanning... Robco personnel positively identified. Welcome to site X 71 A. Please enjoy your stay.
中文: 扫描中……确认罗伯科公司人员身份。欢迎来到X71A，祝您今日愉快。

EN: Assessing... yes that is reasonable. Collect your items and be gone.
中文: 评估中……好吧，还算合理。拿好你的东西，赶紧离开。

EN: Ugh whatever. Prepare to meet your maker, you walking toaster!
中文: 呃，随便啦，准备爆炸吧，你这个会走路的烤面包机！

EN: We went through a lot to get here. We are not leaving empty handed.
中文: 我们费了不少功夫才来到这里，可不想空手而归。

EN: Did you say Vault-Tec? But uh, we're from Robco... yeah! RobCo! Here's my ID!
中文: 你说避难所科技公司？但是呃，我们是罗伯科公司的人……对！罗伯科公司！这是我的身份证明！

EN: Ok ok, we're going. Just let us... uh... grab this computer we definitely brought and we'll go!
中文: 好吧好吧，我们走。只要让我们……呃……拿上我们带来的电脑，我们就走！

EN: Party Favors
中文: 派对福利

EN: Mandatory Fun
中文: 必需的乐趣

EN: The Truth Is In Here
中文: 真相就在这里

EN: Enclosed Encounters
中文: 在室内的邂逅

EN: Factory Upgrade
中文: 工厂升级

EN: My Friends Are Electric
中文: 我的电动朋友

EN: Retrieve party decorations.
中文: 获取派对装饰品。

EN: Find missing party decorations.
中文: 寻找丢失的派对装饰品。

EN: Find evidence of alien experimentation
中文: 找到外星实验的证据。

EN: Find Alien Tech
中文: 找到外星科技。

EN: Discover where RobCo is keeping their research
中文: 找到罗伯科公司的秘密研究地点。

EN: Enter and explore the UFO lab.
中文: 进入并探索UFO实验室。

EN: Searching In The Dark
中文: 在黑暗中搜索

EN: There is now that *you* showed up!
中文: 现在*你*出现了！

EN: Okay, first, that's rude. Second, there hasn't been any food here in months.
中文: 首先，这很不礼貌，其次，这儿已经好几个月没吃的了。

EN: I'm so sorry, there's no food left here. This is all we got.
中文: 不好意思，这儿没有剩的食物。这是我们全部家当了。

EN: Welcome to Super-Duper Mart!
中文: 欢迎来到大无敌超市！

EN: How can we be of service today?
中文: 我们今天能为您做些什么？

EN: So, is there any food left here at all?
中文: 那么，这里还有食物吗？

EN: Just give us your food.
中文: 把你的食物给我们。

EN: Sorry to trouble you. We're looking for these ingredients.
中文: 对不起，麻烦你了。我们正在寻找这些原料。

EN: Our new chef has some bold ideas to spruce up our daily fare, and he's made a list of specific ingredients he needs. We should visit a nearby abandoned Super-Duper Mart to see if we can find any of them.
中文: 我们的新厨师有一些大胆的想法来改善我们的日常饮食，他列出了所需要的具体食材。我们应该去附近一个废弃的大无敌超市看看能不能找到。

EN: All Sales Final
中文: 一经售出概不退换

EN: Search the Super-Duper Mart for ingredients.
中文: 在大无敌超市里寻找食材。

EN: Retrieve ingredients from infested Super-Duper Mart.
中文: 从被感染的大无敌超市中获取原料。

EN: I don't think there's any food left in here...
中文: 我觉得这儿没有食物剩下……

EN: This was a bad idea.
中文: 这是个坏主意。

EN: Oh my goodness! What a disaster!
中文: 哦我的天！真是场灾难！

EN: Rubarb's Raiders came here and started wreaking havoc!
中文: 鲁巴布的掠夺者来这里，想搞大破坏！

EN: But one of them was wearing this terrible cologne...
中文: 但他们中有个人喷了古龙香水，很糟糕的味道……

EN: And it attracted a Deathclaw!
中文: 关键是这味道吸引了一只死爪！

EN: Cool.
中文: 赞。

EN: Don't say we didn't give you a chance!
中文: 可别说我们没给你机会！

EN: Just that way. But be careful! Because, you know... Deathclaw.
中文: 那条路吧。但是小心点！因为，你知道的……有死爪。

EN: Tell you what. Take this. It might protect you. But probably not.
中文: 跟你们说，来，拿着这个。这个可能能保护你。但也可能没用。

EN: Whoa whoa whoa! Don't shoot!
中文: 等等，等等！别开枪！

EN: We don't want no trouble!
中文: 我们可不想惹麻烦！

EN: Rubarb sent us here, but then the Deathclaw came, and...
中文: 鲁巴布派我们来的，但后来死爪又来了，然后……

EN: Look. We just want to get out alive. Cool?
中文: 听着，我们只想活着出去，放我们走行吗？

EN: Cool.
中文: 赞。

EN: No. So totally NOT cool.
中文: 不行。完全不想放你们走。

EN: Fine. But where is Overseer Chang?
中文: 好吧。但告诉我们监督者阿昌在哪儿？

EN: Ya bunch o' cowards! Can you at least lend a hand?
中文: 你们这群懦夫！至少过来帮帮忙吧？

EN: First Raiders then a Deathclaw. I think it might be time to resign.
中文: 先是掠夺者，然后是死爪。我想是时候辞职了。

EN: Rubarb has found another Vault to liberate. Time to head out and rescue Overseer Chang from the Raiders!
中文: 鲁巴布又发现了一个要解放的避难所。是时候出发然后从掠夺者手中救出监督者阿昌了。

EN: All Work and No Play
中文: 只工作不娱乐

EN: Rescue Overseer Chang.
中文: 拯救监督者阿昌。

EN: Rescue Overseer Chang from Rubarb's Raiders.
中文: 从鲁巴布的掠夺者手中救出监督者阿昌。

EN: No, but being on a diet doesn't mean I can't check the menu!
中文: 不，但是节食不意味着我就不能看菜单了呀！

EN: Great idea! You should go and tell them. Take this for courage.
中文: 好主意！你应该去告诉他们。来拿着这个以示勇气。

EN: I think there's one left, hiding in one of the Vault rooms.
中文: 我想还剩一个，藏在某个避难所房间里。

EN: So, you're here for the Singles Night, huh?
中文: 所以，你来这里参加单身之夜的，是吗？

EN: Don't get your hopes up. There aren't that many left.
中文: 不要抱太大希望，已经没剩多少了。

EN: Plus, there's a group of Dwellers intimidating would-be suitors.
中文: 再加上，有一群居民正在恐吓那些想来相亲的追求者。

EN: I'm not sure they're really Dwellers, either.
中文: 我也不确定他们是不是真的是居民。

EN: Are you Single?
中文: 你是单身吗？

EN: Maybe those disruptive Dwellers should be asked to leave.
中文: 可能那些讨厌的居民应该被请出去。

EN: Are there any Singles here at all?
中文: 这里到底有没有单身汉啊？

EN: No one mocks my mojo!
中文: 没有人敢嘲笑我的符咒！

EN: I can. I did. And now I'm calling dibs on killing you.
中文: 我可以。我也这么做了。现在我已经抢先预订要杀了你。

EN: There are? All right boys, let's blow this joint. Here, take this to remember how I let you live.
中文: 好了兄弟们，咱们离开这个鬼地方吧。

EN: Well, shooting *you* in the face would certainly lift my spirits!
中文: 这个，杀了你当然能振奋我的精神！

EN: Sorry mate, you've come all the way here for nothing.
中文: 不好意思了兄弟，让你这么远白跑一趟。

EN: There's only one single person left, and I already called dibs.
中文: 现在只有一个单身人士剩下了，而我早就已经预订了。

EN: So, yeah, get out of here so I can get my groove on.
中文: 所以，没错，滚出去吧，好让我好好享受。

EN: You couldn't get that groove on if your life depended on it.
中文: 就算拿命来赌，你也嗨不起来。

EN: You can't call dibs on someone.
中文: 你不能预订一个人。

EN: Pfft, there are many more singles over at Vault 332. Like, tons.
中文: 切，在332号避难所有那么多单身汉，成吨呢。

EN: Have you tried shooting yourself in the face first? Might improve your chances.
中文: 你有试过先朝自己的脸上开一枪吗？可能可以增大你的概率哦。

EN: I was waiting for you all that time, and now you're here.
中文: 我一直都在等你，现在你来了。

EN: That's fine, but do put on a hat before you go out. It's cold outside.
中文: 好吧，但是出去前一定戴上帽子。外面挺冷的。

EN: *More* suitors? This is getting ridiculous.
中文: 更多的追求者？这真是越来越离谱了。

EN: Although, I have to say... You're rather sweet on the eyes.
中文: 即使这样，我必须得说……你还挺好看的。

EN: Hmm... Is it me, or is it getting hot in here?
中文: 嗯……是我有问题，还是这里越来越热了？

EN: I probed the Wasteland searching for you, and here you are.
中文: 我探索了废土，试图找到你，结果你在这里。

EN: I'm sorry, this can't work. You look too much like my mother.
中文: 抱歉，我觉得这个行不通，你长得太像我妈了。

EN: We've received word that a nearby Vault is holding a Singles Night for Valentine's Day, and they've invited us to participate!
中文: 我们收到消息，附近的一个避难所正在为情人节举行单身之夜的活动，他们邀请了我们同去！

EN: All's Fair in Love and Nuclear War
中文: 爱与核战，皆不择手段

EN: Meet that special someone.
中文: 快来遇见那个特殊的人。

EN: Dissuade rival suitors.
中文: 快来阻止其他的情敌。

EN: Travel to a nearby Vault to find a potential mate.
中文: 去附近的避难所找到潜在的伴侣。

EN: Phew! I was afraid I'd have to dance.
中文: 咻！我还担心一定要我跳舞呢。

EN: This is going about as well as I expected.
中文: 事情进展得和我预料的一样顺利。

EN: Almost Human
中文: 半人半鬼

EN: You're not going to leave adorable animals trapped in that building, are you?
中文: 你是不会让那些可爱的小动物们困在那幢建筑里的，对吧？

EN: Animal Rescue
中文: 拯救小动物

EN: Recover the Pet Carrier.
中文: 找回宠物笼子。

EN: Find any lost animals.
中文: 找到任何走失的动物。

EN: You came across an old cabin while adventuring in the Wasteland. Perhaps you should see what's inside.
中文: 当你在废土探险的时候发现了一个小屋。也许你该看看里面有什么。

EN: Anybody Home?
中文: 有人在家吗？

EN: Explore the Cabin.
中文: 探索小屋。

EN: You found a Cabin in the Wasteland.
中文: 在废土上发现一间小屋。

EN: You working for those water-drenched wingnuts at the Vault-Tec offices?
中文: 你是为那些避难所科技工作室里被水淋透的傻子们工作的吗？

EN: If you're as weak-minded as they are, this should be easy peasy!
中文: 如果你像他们那样意志薄弱，这应该很容易！

EN: The only way we can get more information about the Water Wizard is to clear out this Raider camp. Should be a walk in the park!
中文: 我们能获得更多关于水之术士的信息的唯一方法就是清除这个掠夺者营地。应该像在公园里散步一样容易！

EN: Aqua Nuka-Cola
中文: 水核子可乐

EN: Clear out the Raider camp.
中文: 清除掠夺者营地。

EN: Clear out the Raider camp for the settlers in the Vault-Tec offices.
中文: 为那些避难所科技工作室的居民们清空掠夺者营地。

EN: His former assistant is holed up in a Super-Duper Mart off yonder.  He'll know for sure.
中文: 他的前助手是躲藏在一个大无敌超市那边。他肯定会知道。

EN: You took down Cruddy Bonez and his gang, huh? Guess they won't be calling us “wingnuts” anymore...
中文: 你拿下了科鲁迪博纳兹和他的团伙？我猜他们再也不敢叫我们“傻子”了……

EN: We met the Wizard a while ago. Good salesman, and the water tasted amazing.
中文: 我们刚刚碰到了术士。他是个好的销售员，他的水味道棒极了。

EN: We got enough to tell any effects were in the mind of the user and totally coincidental.
中文: 喝的足够多了，我们知道任何影响都只存在于用户的头脑中，纯属巧合。

EN: This *is* some delicious water, but he's ripping people off, and he needs to be stopped.
中文: 这水确实不错，但他这是欺诈，得阻止他。

EN: Do you know where we can find him?
中文: 你知道我们在哪儿能找到他吗？

EN: We did what the people at the Vault-Tec offices asked. Now it's time for some answers!
中文: 我们做了那些避难所科技办公室的人拜托的事情。现在是回答的时候了！

EN: Aqua-schema
中文: 水的阴谋

EN: Return to the Vault-Tec offices.
中文: 返回避难所科技办公室。

EN: Return to the Vault-Tec offices.
中文: 返回避难所科技办公室。

EN: Dead men tell no tales.
中文: 人死了就无从对证了。

EN: Let's feed 'em to the fishes!
中文: 让我们把他们丢去喂鱼吧！

EN: Grandpa wants to play Pirates, but he needs a Parrot first.
中文: 爷爷想要扮海盗，但是首先得有一只鹦鹉。

EN: Argh, Matey!
中文: 嚯，海盗！

EN: Find the Parrot.
中文: 找到那只鹦鹉。

EN: Find a Parrot.
中文: 找鹦鹉。

EN: Shiver me timbers, it's a land lubber.
中文: 吓我一跳，原来是个旱鸭子。

EN: We'll make you walk the plank.
中文: 我们会让你吃不了兜着走。

EN: Hang 'em from the yardarm!
中文: 把他们挂在桅杆上示众！

EN: Sure thing!
中文: 当然！

EN: Of course.
中文: 当然。

EN: That was close! I guess you heard my message, huh?
中文: 差一点！我猜你们听到我说的了吧？

EN: Well, as promised, I've got a weapon for you.
中文: 就像保证的那样。我给你们准备了一个武器。

EN: Or would you prefer Caps instead?
中文: 还是说你们更喜欢瓶盖？

EN: The weapon, please.
中文: 当然是武器，谢啦。

EN: The Caps will be fine.
中文: 有瓶盖就行。

EN: The gunsmith's plea came in loud and clear over the radio. “Feral Ghouls! Help! I'll give one of my best pieces to whoever bails me out!” Better hurry if you're going to claim that prize!
中文: 枪匠的呼喊从广播里传来，声音大而清楚。“狂尸鬼！救命！谁要是能救我出去我会拿最好的武器报答他！”如果你想要这个奖励的话得赶快了。

EN: Arms Race
中文: 武器竞赛

EN: Eliminate the Feral Ghouls.
中文: 除掉狂尸鬼。

EN: Claim your reward.
中文: 领取你的奖励。

EN: Save the gunsmith from the Feral Ghouls.
中文: 从狂尸鬼手里救出枪匠。

EN: She has seemed strange lately. If you're here to help, then go help.
中文: 她最近是有点不对劲。如果你真是来帮忙的，那就赶紧进去吧。

EN: Open fire!
中文: 开火！

EN: We're here to help! Please, let us pass! Your leader is making a big mistake!
中文: 我们是来帮忙的！快让我们进去！你们的头儿干了件蠢事！

EN: We're here to stop you and your crazy leader!
中文: 我们是来阻止你们和你们那个疯子领导的！

EN: You're no Brotherhood soldiers. What are you doing here?
中文: 你们不是兄弟会的人？来这儿干啥？

EN: Go, then. It should be clear past here. We'll hold this point. Oh! We found this. You might be able to use it for your vault.
中文: 去吧。那边应该没什么人了。我们会守在这里的。对了，我们找到了这个，你们避难所可能用得上。

EN: We know about the weapon. We're here to help!
中文: 我们知道那件武器的事。我们是来帮忙的！

EN: Vault dwellers? You made it through alive!
中文: 避难所来的？你们竟然还活着！

EN: This is the only way back to something good. I won't let anyone stop that.
中文: 这是重回正轨的唯一办法。我不会让任何人阻止我。

EN: Rebuild? You're about to cause irreparable damage.
中文: 重建？你这是要搞出大乱子啊！

EN: Whatever, we're taking you down!
中文: 管你呢，我们要把你拿下！

EN: Stop! Don't come any closer! You're about to ruin everything!
中文: 停！别再过来了！你们会毁了一切的！

EN: The Brotherhood's archaic ideals and paranoia won't stop me.
中文: 兄弟会那套老掉牙的规矩和疑神疑鬼的毛病可拦不住我。

EN: They won't stop us from rebuilding.
中文: 他们无法阻止我们重建家园。

EN: She doesn't need to hear anything from you!
中文: 她不需要听你废话！

EN: You asked for it!
中文: 你找死！

EN: We don't want anyone to get hurt! We just need to talk some sense into your leader!
中文: 我们不想任何人受到伤害！我们只想和你的头儿好好谈谈！

EN: Bring it on then! I love a good scrap!
中文: 来呀！我很乐意陪你玩玩！

EN: Come any closer and we'll send you into orbit!
中文: 再靠近一步，我们就送你们上西天！

EN: The Brotherhood is attacking the Griffith Observatory to recover a deadly weapon from the NCR. We don't know what it is, but it could be disastrous in anybody's hands. Go, take care of it for everyone's sake.
中文: 钢铁兄弟会正在攻击格里菲斯天文台，企图从新加州共和国手中夺回一种致命武器。虽然不知道具体是什么武器，但无论落入任何一方手中，都可能产生灾难性后果。为了保护所有人的安全，快去把它处理掉。

EN: Astronomical Aggression
中文: 天文台危机

EN: Stop the NCR leader.
中文: 阻止NCR的首领。

EN: Stop the NCR leader from using the weapon.
中文: 阻止NCR的首领使用武器。

EN: We swear! No more trouble. No more Manual. Thank you!
中文: 我们发誓！不再惹麻烦。不再动手册。谢谢你！

EN: We understand. But we prefer to take our chances with you than with Death!
中文: 明白。但我们宁愿和你一起冒险，也不愿白白送死！

EN: Run for your lives!
中文: 快跑！

EN: Death is awake and killing everyone!
中文: “死亡”醒过来了而且要杀掉所有人！

EN: No one could have seen this coming!
中文: 没人能预料到这个！

EN: Go! Get out of here! But if you ever make trouble again...
中文: 走吧！滚出去！但如果你再惹麻烦……

EN: After all you've done, we can't let you leave.
中文: 考虑到你所做的一切，我们不能让你离开。

EN: Somehow, I don't think that Alpha Deathclaw was Death. Call it a hunch.
中文: 不知怎么的，我觉得领头死爪并不是“死亡”。这算是预感吧。

EN: The real one must be in the next room.
中文: 真正的应该在隔壁。

EN: This is it, everyone. Time to dance with Death.
中文: 这下对了，大伙。现在与“死亡”共舞一曲。

EN: For the Overseer! For the Wasteland!
中文: 为了监督者！为了废土！

EN: Three down, one to go, and thanks to Three Dog, we know where Death's cave is. But will he be awake? Only one way to find out!
中文: 搞定了三个，还剩一个，感谢三狗让我们知道了“死亡”的洞穴在哪。但是它会醒过来吗？只有一个办法知道。

EN: At Death's Door
中文: 在“死亡”的门外

EN: Kill Death.
中文: 干掉“死亡”。

EN: Kill Death, the final Horseman.
中文: 干掉“死亡”，这个最后的骑士。

EN: Oh, the humanity! Death is *not* a morning person!
中文: 哦，我的妈呀！“死亡”不是一个早起的人！

EN: The Manual never said Death would try to kill us!
中文: 手册并没说“死亡”会想要杀掉我们！

EN: Flee! There's nothing for you down there but disembowelment!
中文: 快逃！下面除了会让你开膛破肚没有别的！

EN: It's Death! Let him reap what he's sown!
中文: 是“死亡”！让它得到报应！

EN: Death is a Mole rat?! For crying out loud...
中文: “死亡”是只鼹鼠？这是搞什么鬼……

EN: We've come up empty again! Darn that caustic Coach!
中文: 我们又一无所获！这个该死的蔻驰！

EN: We found a note from someone named Coach, who claims he has Rackie Jobinson's Jersey! Maybe he's hiding out in the ruins of Vault 428...
中文: 我们发现了一个叫蔻驰的人留下的消息，他说自己有罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫！也许他藏在了428号避难所的废墟里……

EN: Back to the Outfield
中文: 返回外场

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
中文: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Look for Coach in Vault 428.
中文: 在 428 号避难所寻找蔻驰。

EN: Whoa! Another note! It says...
中文: 哇！又有一条消息！上面说……

EN: “I hear you've been searching for Rackie Jobinson's Jersey.
中文: 我听说你们正在寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: My name's Henrietta, and I may be able to help.
中文: “我的名字叫亨丽埃塔，也许我能帮忙。”

EN: Come find me at Vault 232.”
中文: 来232号避难所找我吧。”

EN: Assuming Coach doesn't have the Jersey, there's reason to believe Rackie Jobinson once stayed at the old Le Pierre Hotel. We'll check there!
中文: 假如蔻驰没有棒球衫，我们有理由相信罗基·杰宾森曾待在旧的乐皮埃尔酒店。我们去那边看看吧！

EN: Beanball to the Face!
中文: 打在脸上的球！

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
中文: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
中文: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Excellent news, thanks! If you want to keep helping, just go on in and talk to my people.
中文: 好消息，谢谢！如果你们想继续帮忙的话，进去和我的人谈谈吧。
