EN: Hello, welcome to the Weekly Exposition!
中文: 你好，欢迎来到每周博览会！

EN: I'll be with you in a moment. Let me just finish hanging this lampshade here...
中文: 我马上就来。先让我把这个灯罩挂在这儿……

EN: There, that looks nice.
中文: 好了，看起来不错。

EN: I'm the editor of the newspaper. How can I help you?
中文: 我是报纸的编辑。需要帮忙吗？

EN: One of your reporters discovered that Pestilence is a Glowing Radscorpion.
中文: 你的一个记者发现“瘟疫”是一只发光辐射蝎。

EN: He's been around long enough to be a legend to children and veterans alike.
中文: 他已经待了太长的时间，足以成为儿童眼里的传奇，就像那些退伍军人一样。

EN: Maybe the hunger comes with age? No known Glowing One is as old.
中文: 也许“饥饿”年纪大了？没有哪只已知的发光种是老的。

EN: Absolutely. The non-feral ones makes the decisions for the whole pack.
中文: 当然。由那些不狂化的尸鬼为整个群落做决定。

EN: Yes. He probably has no idea he's gathered such a following.
中文: 对。他可能不知道他已经聚集了这么多追随者。

EN: Hi! I write about the Hungry. We have multiple undercover Ghouls in the field with them.
中文: 你好！我正在写关于“饥饿者”的。我们有多个卧底尸鬼在现场与他们一起。

EN: Did you know Famine is an ancient Glowing One with an insatiable appetite?
中文: 你知道“饥荒”是一只古老的发光种吗？他有着无法被满足的胃口。

EN: The Hungry Horde just follows him around, enthralled by his radioactive aura.
中文: “饥饿部落”一直紧跟着他，它们被它的放射性光环迷住了。

EN: It heals them, but somehow also makes them much hungrier than usual.
中文: 它可以治愈他们，但不知何故，也使得它们比以往更饥饿。

EN: What do you mean by “ancient”?
中文: 你说的“古代”是什么意思？

EN: Why is Famine so hungry?
中文: 饥荒为何如此饥饿？

EN: Is the Hungry Horde made entirely of Ghouls?
中文: “饥饿部落”全部是由尸鬼组成的吗？

EN: Is Famine feral?
中文: “饥荒”很凶残吗？

EN: He's trying to be the War people expect, but it seems he's not very good at it.
中文: 他想成为人们所期望的“战争”，但似乎他并不擅长。

EN: Killed six Deathclaws with his bare hands, for one, but it's a myth! The truth is long gone.
中文: 曾赤手空拳杀死了六只死爪，一只手，但这只是一个传说！早已无法搞清真相。

EN: Conquest. Everyone can join the Warshippers, at least, but those who don't are attacked.
中文: 征服。每个人都可以加入“战争崇拜者”，至少，那些不加入的就会被攻击。

EN: That's a good question, but no one knows. Same for the other Horsemen. It can't be coincidence...
中文: 这是个好问题，但没有人知道。其他“骑士”也是这样。这不可能是巧合……

EN: Hello, I write the War and Warshipper stories with what the undercover reporters send me.
中文: 你好，我在写关于“战争”和“战争崇拜者”的故事，那个卧底记者寄给我的。

EN: War himself is just a Raider Boss in over his head, I think.
中文: 我觉得，“战争”只是一个能力不足的掠夺者首领。

EN: A night of heavy drinking birthed some tall tales of miraculous feats.
中文: 一夜痛饮催生了些关于神迹伟业的夸张传闻。

EN: And now suddenly he finds himself with a cult following and the mantle of a Horseman.
中文: 现在，他突然发现自己有了一群邪教崇拜者和一个骑士披风。

EN: Why do you think he's in over his head?
中文: 你凭什么认为他能力不足？

EN: What feats do the rumors say he performed?
中文: 那些传闻说他有什么功绩？

EN: What does War want?
中文: “战争”需要什么？

EN: Why did they start calling him War in the first place?
中文: 一开始为什么他们叫他“战争”？

EN: They'll mention Nuka-Cola. If you reply with “eagle,” they'll know you're a friend.
中文: 他们会提到核子可乐。如果你回答“鹰”，他们会知道你是朋友。

EN: Yes? I'm the handler for all the undercover reporters.
中文: 是吗？我是所有卧底记者的监督者。

EN: I keep them as safe as possible. Call them back in when things get too hot.
中文: 我尽可能保证他们的安全。当事情闹得太大的时候召回他们。

EN: What do you want? I'm busy with this puzzle here, so make it quick.
中文: 你要干什么？我正忙着解这个谜，所以动作快点。

EN: See? I've almost got a picture of cute kittens playing with yarn.
中文: 看到了吗？我差点就搞到一张可爱小猫玩毛线的照片了。

EN: We're Vault Dwellers trying to help. Is there any way to identify your reporters?
中文: 我们是试图帮助的避难所居民。有什么办法可以识别出你的记者吗？

EN: Me? I'm just the intern! I listen to Galaxy News Radio for alerts and stories.
中文: 我？我只是实习生！我靠听银河新闻电台来了解紧急情况和故事。

EN: Shh... Listen! Three Dog's coming on with breaking news.
中文: 嘘……听！三狗正在播报突发新闻。

EN: Oh no! A settlement's caught between the Pests and the Hungry!
中文: 哦不！有个定居点正夹在“害虫”和“饥饿者”之间腹背受敌！

EN: Someone needs to help them!
中文: 有人需要帮助他们！

EN: A reporter for the Weekly Exposition newspaper, undercover as a Pest, told us about Pestilence and asked us to relay a message to his editor. He also said there are reporters hidden among the Hungry and the Warshippers, so let's go to the Exposition's offices and find out what they know!
中文: 《每周博览会报》的一名记者，正以“害虫”的身份做卧底，他把“瘟疫”的事告诉了我们，并请我们给编辑转达一条消息。他还说，有些记者藏在“饥饿者”和“战争崇拜者”中间，所以我们去博览会办公室，看看他们知道些什么！

EN: Beat Reporting
中文: 打报告

EN: Visit the offices of the Weekly Exposition.
中文: 参观每周博览会的办公室。

EN: Talk to the editor.
中文: 与编辑交谈。

EN: Visit the offices of the Weekly Exposition.
中文: 参观每周博览会的办公室。

EN: He was the most qualified, obviously. What's that, Overseer? You want to go with them? I suppose I could run things while you're gone...
中文: 他显然最有资格。监督者你怎么了？你想和他们一起去？你不在我应该也行的……

EN: Wait! I think our Overseer wants to go with you. He says it'll help diplomatic relations between our two Vaults.
中文: 等等！我想我们的监督者想和你一起去。他说这有利于两个避难所的外交关系。

EN: No, I'm not! Tell them I'm not crazy, Overseer! What's that? Oh, you want to go with them? I guess that would be all right...
中文: 不，我不是！监督者，告诉他们我没有疯！那是什么？哦，你想和他们一起去？我想应该可以……

EN: Vault 850 is saved!
中文: 850号避难所得救了！

EN: Me? The Overseer? No, our Vault is run by this dog.
中文: 我？监督者？不不不，我们避难所的监督者是这只狗。

EN: He's such a good boy! He sent the distress signal!
中文: 它真是个乖孩子！求救信号就是它发出来的！

EN: How'd a dog get to be Overseer?
中文: 狗怎么会是监督者呢？

EN: Well, we're glad to have helped...
中文: 我们很高兴能帮助……

EN: We're almost 100% certain that you're crazy.
中文: 我们可以百分百确定你疯了。

EN: The Overseer from Vault 850 has sent us a distress signal! The catch is the Overseer is apparently a dog...
中文: 850号避难所的监督者给我们发来了求救信号！关键问题在于：这位监督者貌似是一只狗……

EN: Beware of Over-dog!
中文: 请注意“管理狗”！

EN: Find the Overseer of Vault 850.
中文: 寻找850号避难所监督者。

EN: Go to Vault 850 and find the Overseer.
中文: 前往850号避难所，找到监督者。

EN: Clever Alpha Deathclaw, hiding in that Red Rocket Fuel station to ambush unsuspecting travelers. There's only one way to deal with a threat like that.
中文: 聪明的领头死爪，藏在了红火箭加油站里伏击误入的旅行者。对付这种威胁只有一个办法。

EN: Big Trouble
中文: 大麻烦

EN: Eliminate the Alpha Deathclaw.
中文: 除掉领头死爪。

EN: Eliminate the Alpha Deathclaw lurking in the Red Rocket Fuel Station.
中文: 除掉埋伏在红火箭加油站的领头死爪。

EN: How did that thing fit through the door?
中文: 那个大家伙是怎么穿过那扇门的？

EN: At our Warehouse up the street. You kept claiming you were aliens from mothership Zeta.
中文: 在那条街上我们的仓库里。你一直说自己是来自泽塔航母的外星人。

EN: YOU! You goons! You left me here surrounded by Radscorpions!
中文: 你！你们这些呆子！把我留在这儿和一群辐射蝎在一起！

EN: We let you party with our crew because we thought you were cool...
中文: 我们让你们和我们一起嗨是因为我们以为你很酷……

EN: But you ditched me! Not that I care...
中文: 但是你们抛弃了我！虽然说我并不在乎……

EN: Playing fetch with Radscorpions is a fun way to pass the time!
中文: 和辐射蝎玩接球是很好打发时间的方式！

EN: We were partying with Raiders? We don't... remember... any of this. Where was this party?
中文: 我们要和掠夺者一起开派对？我可……不记得……有这么回事！派对是在哪儿办的？

EN: It's New Year's day... and the Vault threw one heck of a party last night. But the Overseer's son, Jack, is missing and we need to find him! We know he was with us before the clock struck 12, but everything afterwards is a blur. And we're all wearing Radiation Suits. We must have been at the Corvega Auto Plant at some point...
中文: 新年第一天……昨夜避难所举行了隆重的派对活动。但是监督者的儿子杰克失踪了。我们必须找到他！现在只知道12点之前他还和我们在一起，但之后发生了什么完全是一片模糊，我们都穿着防辐射服，所以我们应该是去过可伟佳自动化工厂……

EN: Blackout
中文: 断片

EN: Search for Jack in the Corvega Auto Plant.
中文: 在可伟佳自动化工厂里寻找杰克。

EN: The Overseer's son, Jack, is missing after a crazy New Year's party!
中文: 监督者的儿子，杰克，在一场疯狂的新年派对之后消失了！

EN: I... Ah... Umm... ATTACK!!!!
中文: 我……啊……呃……给我攻击！！！！

EN: You people just don't take a hint, do you? Leave now or face the consequences...
中文: 你们这些人就是学不乖是吗？赶紧离开，不然后果自负！

EN: The COMPLETE and TOTAL pillaging and annihilation of your Vault, of course!
中文: 我们会彻彻底底搜刮和剿灭你们的避难所！

EN: As for The Editor... you'll never find him!
中文: 至于那名编辑……你们永远都不会找到他！

EN: No? Because it says right here on the masthead that the New Boston Bugle is published out of the Nuka-Cola Warehouse.
中文: 学不乖又怎样？这里说得清清楚楚新波士顿号角就是从核子可乐仓库里发行出来的。

EN: Turns out the New Boston Bugle is some kind of con - our only lead is the Bugle Boy who is holed up in a Super-Duper Mart. Time to track him down and extract some information!
中文: 到头来新波士顿号角报是某种骗局，而我们唯一的线索就是号角男孩。他现在被关在了大无敌超市里。去找到他然后询问点信息吧。

EN: Boogie Woogie Bugle Boy
中文: 摇滚少年号角男孩

EN: Find the Bugle Boy.
中文: 找到号角男孩。

EN: Find the Bugle Boy.
中文: 找到号角男孩。

EN: Yeah, they took Bottle & Cappy over to Vault 177. Be careful.
中文: 是的，他们把瓶瓶和盖盖带到177号避难所。请小心。

EN: Thanks! I thought those rats were going to eat me.
中文: 谢谢！我以为那些老鼠要吃了我。

EN: Better than being stuck with those Raiders from Nuka-World.
中文: 至少比和那些核子世界来的掠夺者关在一起强。

EN: I snuck away from them just before they left.
中文: 就在他们准备离开之前我悄悄溜走了。

EN: Did the Raiders have Bottle & Cappy with them?
中文: 掠夺者们和瓶瓶盖盖在一起吗？

EN: Bottle & Cappy have been kidnapped from Nuka-World by Raiders! They were last spotted at an abandoned factory. Head out there and rescue them before it's too late!
中文: 瓶瓶和盖盖在核子世界被掠夺者们绑架了！最后一次被发现是在一座废弃的工厂里。赶紧去那里救他们，不然就太迟了！

EN: Bottlecap Blues
中文: 忧郁的瓶盖

EN: Find any trace of Bottle & Cappy at the abandoned factory.
中文: 在废弃工厂寻找任何有关瓶瓶和盖盖的线索。

EN: Track down Bottle & Cappy's kidnappers.
中文: 追踪瓶瓶和盖盖的绑匪。

EN: So, you're the one who's going to take down Bash, huh?
中文: 所以，你就是那个想拿下“暴击”的人？

EN: That Raider's not too bright, but he's plenty dangerous.
中文: 那个掠夺者不怎么机灵，但还是挺危险的。

EN: You shoot him, he's just going to get mad at ya.
中文: 你如果拿枪射他，他会发疯的。

EN: You're going to have to take him down hand-to-hand!
中文: 你可能必须要和他肉搏才能拿下他！

EN: The Raider Boss known as “Bash” has made one too many enemies. Claim the bounty on his head!
中文: 一位叫“暴击”的掠夺者首领树敌无数。取下他的人头去领赏金吧！

EN: Bounty: Bash
中文: 悬赏：“暴击”

EN: Kill Bash.
中文: 杀死掠夺者“暴击”。

EN: Take down the Raider Boss Bash and claim your reward!
中文: 拿下掠夺者首领“暴击”，领取奖赏！

EN: You! You crash Bash's bash! Bash gonna smash!
中文: 你！你击溃了“暴击”的暴击！他会撕碎你！

EN: Wait. Are you here to take on “Butcher?” Seriously?
中文: 等等。你来这里是为了拿下“屠夫”？你是认真的？

EN: Uh, good luck, I guess. If you come back, bounty's all yours.
中文: 呃，祝你好运吧。如果你能顺利回来，赏金都是你的。

EN: If you don't... well, I'm sure you'll be fine.
中文: 如果你没回来的话……这个，我相信你会没事的。

EN: Nice knowing you.
中文: 很高兴认识你。

EN: There's a bounty on an Alpha Deathclaw known as “Butcher.” Don't worry. I'm sure it's just a nickname. But take her down and you'll earn yourself a hefty prize.
中文: 有一个悬赏公告，要求杀死领头死爪“屠夫”。不用担心。我相信这个肯定只是个昵称。但把它拿下，你会得到一笔丰厚的奖金。

EN: Bounty: Butcher
中文: 悬赏：“屠夫”

EN: Kill “Butcher.”
中文: 杀死死爪“屠夫”。

EN: Eliminate the Alpha Deathclaw known as “Butcher” to collect your bounty!
中文: 除掉领头死爪“屠夫”，领取奖赏！

EN: Hmm. You here about the bounty?
中文: 嗯。你来这是为了赏金的？

EN: Well, 'Ol One-Eye's the meanest Radroach you ever met.
中文: 呃，“独眼龙”会是你们见过的最卑鄙的辐射蟑螂。

EN: Old beast ate my favorite pair of socks!
中文: 讨厌的怪物把我最喜欢的袜子吃掉了！

EN: You put him down, there's a reward in it for you.
中文: 你把它拿下，这儿有奖励给你。

EN: Someone's put a bounty on the head of a meddlesome Radroach known as 'Ol One-Eye. Swat that bug and claim your reward!
中文: 有人出钱悬赏一只辐射蟑螂的脑袋。这只横行霸道的蟑螂名叫“独眼龙”，去拍死这只害虫然后领取奖励吧！

EN: Bounty: 'Ol One-Eye
中文: 悬赏：“独眼龙”

EN: Kill 'Ol One-Eye.
中文: 杀死辐射蟑螂“独眼龙”。

EN: Help 'Ol One-Eye shuffle off this mortal coil and collect your bounty!
中文: 终结“独眼龙”的生命，领取赏金！

EN: Oh good. You must be the one who's going to take down Shiner.
中文: 哦太好了。你应该就是那个能拿下“闪闪”的人。

EN: You ought to know, that Ghoul's got seriously thick skin.
中文: 你要知道，那个尸鬼有着很厚很厚的皮肤。

EN: Energy weapons are about the only thing that'll pierce his scabby hide.
中文: 能量武器是唯一能够穿透它粗糙外皮的东西。

EN: Good luck.
中文: 祝你好运。

EN: The Glowing One known as “Shiner” has made trouble for the last time. Put him on ice to claim your reward.
中文: 不能再让发光种“闪闪”惹麻烦了。干掉它，然后领取奖励。

EN: Bounty: Shiner
中文: 悬赏：“闪闪”

EN: Kill Shiner.
中文: 杀死尸鬼“闪闪”。

EN: Take down the Glowing One known as Shiner and claim your reward!
中文: 拿下那个叫“闪闪”的发光种，领取赏金！

EN: Here to collect on “Snips?”
中文: 是来领取“剪刀手”的赏金的吗？

EN: Well, you ought to know, that Radscorpion's got a hide like a vault door.
中文: 不过，你要知道，那只辐射蝎的壳和避难所的门一样厚。

EN: Sure hope you brought in the big guns for this one.
中文: 希望你们这次来带的都是大枪。

EN: But you take him down, I'll make it worth your while.
中文: 只要你能拿下它，我的奖赏绝不会让你们失望。

EN: There's a bounty out on “Snips,” a Glowing Radscorpion. Put down that pest and the reward's as good as yours.
中文: 外界正悬赏一只叫做“剪刀手”的发光辐射蝎。拿下那只害虫，大把的奖赏就是你的了！

EN: Bounty: Snips
中文: 悬赏：“剪刀手”

EN: Exterminate “Snips.”
中文: 消灭“剪刀手”

EN: Exterminate the Glowing Radscorpion known as “Snips” and claim the bounty on its carapace!
中文: 消灭发光辐射蝎“剪刀手”，然后拿着它的壳领取赏金吧！

EN: Thank goodness you're here!
中文: 谢天谢地你来了！

EN: That Yak's been stealing our food and stinking the place to high heaven!
中文: 那只叫“牦牛”的鼹鼠妈妈一直在偷我们的食物，并让整个地方都臭翻了天！

EN: You're not going to want to get close to her, though.
中文: 但你绝对不会想要靠近它。

EN: Make sure you use some kinda rifle or you're apt to yak yourself!
中文: 请确保你用的是步枪，不然倒霉的可是你自己！

EN: The Mole rat brood mother known as “Yak” has stolen her last snackcake! Whack Yak to claim your reward.
中文: 一只叫做“牦牛”的鼹鼠妈妈偷走了最后一块“俏男孩”蛋糕！除掉它然后领取你的奖励。

EN: Bounty: Yak
中文: 悬赏：“牦牛”

EN: Whack Yak.
中文: 除掉鼹鼠“牦牛”。

EN: Take down the Mole rat brood mother known as Yak and claim your reward!
中文: 拿下鼹鼠妈妈“牦牛”，领取奖励！

EN: I could have SWORN this was the one. Guess not.
中文: 我本来发誓这次一定能找到，但好像并不能。

EN: There's an old Wilson Automatoys factory we never checked out. Maybe Coach, and Rackie Jobinson's Jersey, are there...
中文: 那儿有一个旧的威尔逊原子玩具厂，我们没有查看过。蔻驰和罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫说不定会在那儿。

EN: Breaking all the Records
中文: 打破所有记录

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
中文: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
中文: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: We got a back issue from Vault 819. Until then all we had to read was an old copy of “One Ghoul, Two Ghoul.”
中文: 我们从819号避难所那里得到了一本过期报刊。在那之前我们只有一本旧的《一只尸鬼，两只尸鬼》影印本可以读。

EN: That's right! We're heading out to hunt some Raiders - I'm destined to be a front page star! Vault 819 look out!
中文: 你说的对！我们这就出发去追捕那些掠夺者—我注定会成为封面明星！819号避难所可得小心啦！

EN: Thanks for helping us with our infestation problem!
中文: 感谢你们帮我们解决了虫灾问题！

EN: Our people have been running off on quests of derring-do in hopes of capturing the Bugle's eye...
中文: 他们希望能引起号角报的注意

EN: No one's left to keep the joint clean!
中文: 居然没人留下来打理这个地方！

EN: How did you get ahold of a copy of the Bugle?
中文: 你是怎么拿到一份号角报的？

EN: So you can get in the Bugle by kicking butt and taking names?
中文: 所以靠打架揍人扬名就能上号角报？

EN: What's this about a New Boston Bugle? It's a chance to have our exploits published for all the world to see! Fame! Fortune! Caps!
中文: 新波士顿号角报到底意味着什么？是一次让我们的伟大功绩举世皆知的机会！代表着名气！钱财！瓶盖！

EN: Broadsides
中文: 舷侧

EN: Learn about the New Boston Bugle.
中文: 认识新波士顿号角报。

EN: Find out about the New Boston Bugle.
中文: 找到关于新波士顿号角报的信息。

EN: Travellers have told us of a small squad of ex-Brotherhood of Steel types setting up some kind of commune in the area. Apparently they've got survivors, Ghouls, and raiders all living in supposed harmony together. Go investigate this community and see if the rumors are true. These people could make good allies and trade partners.
中文: 旅行者告诉我们，有一小队前钢铁兄弟会成员在该地区建立了一个某种类型的公社。显然，他们成功地让幸存者、尸鬼和掠夺者和谐地生活在一起。去调查这个社区，看看传言是否属实。这些人有可能成为很好的盟友和贸易伙伴。

EN: Brotherhood of Feels
中文: 温馨兄弟会

EN: Contact the Soldiers
中文: 联系士兵

EN: Make contact with the strange group of survivors.
中文: 与奇怪的幸存者群体联系。

EN: Hunter Big Wes has put out a series of challenges for anyone brave enough. The first is to bag a Glowing Radroach. Time to lock and load!
中文: 猎人大维斯为勇者们准备了一系列挑战。第一件事就是抓住一只发光辐射蟑螂。给枪上好膛，准备出发吧！

EN: Bug Hunt
中文: 抓虫达人

EN: Kill the Glowing Radroach.
中文: 杀死发光辐射蟑螂。

EN: Kill the Glowing Radroach in the factory.
中文: 杀死工厂里发光辐射蟑螂。

EN: Mole rats! Is there any creature more sneaky or disgusting? Grab a flamer and clear out a nest of those tunnelling terrors.
中文: 鼹鼠！还有什么生物比它更卑鄙更恶心吗？拿起火焰喷射器来消灭这一窝“隧道恐怖分子”吧。

EN: Burnout
中文: 烧光

EN: Clear out the Mole rat nest.
中文: 捣毁鼹鼠巢穴。

EN: Put a nest of pesky Mole rats to the torch.
中文: 一把火烧了这一窝讨厌的鼹鼠。

EN: That's still indicative of a quality establishment!
中文: 这仍然是好企业的象征！

EN: That was boeuf bourguignon, and it was spectacular!
中文: 那是勃垦地牛肉，真是太不可思议了！

EN: You try making marzipan without any almonds!
中文: 你试着做不加杏仁的杏仁软糖！

EN: Egads! The Dwellers found us!
中文: 天哪！那些居民发现了我们！

EN: Well, you may have survived my cooking...
中文: 好吧，你可能承受住了我的烹饪……

EN: But you won't survive my shooting!
中文: 但是你将无法从我的枪口下逃脱！

EN: Bad food, bad service... I give this place one star.
中文: 烂食物，烂服务……这地方我给一星评价。

EN: You cooked your last meal, chef.
中文: 你做了你这辈子的最后一顿烹饪，厨师。

EN: You'll pay for using rolled fondant on all your cakes!
中文: 你会为在所有的蛋糕上使用软糖而付出代价的！

EN: As it turns out, the chef *really* was trying to kill us all. Seems he's with a band of Raiders who've been eyeing our Vault. He fled as soon as he was exposed, but we know he's set to meet other Raiders at an abandoned Red Rocket.
中文: 事实证明，厨师之前是真的想害死我们所有人。看来他是一伙觊觎我们避难所的掠夺者的同伙，他一露馅便逃走了，但我们知道他打算在一个废弃的红火箭加油站与其他掠夺者会合。

EN: By Hook or by Cook
中文: 用钩或用煮

EN: Kill the Chef.
中文: 干掉厨师。

EN: Kill the renegade chef.
中文: 干掉叛变的厨师。

EN: Engage! Engage!
中文: 开火！开火！

EN: Uh-oh.
中文: 哦。

EN: The cloaking fields are working!
中文: 隐形场有用！

EN: Oh look, a surface Dweller...
中文: 哦看，一个地表居民……

EN: Good thing our experimental cloaking fields are up.
中文: 好事情，我们实验隐形场起作用了。

EN: This way we can study it in its natural habitat without being seen.
中文: 这样我们就可以在它的自然栖息地研究它而不被看见。

EN: Shh, it's coming our way...
中文: 嘘，它正朝我们这边过来……

EN: You guys know I can see you, right?
中文: 嘿兄弟们，你们知道我能看见你们，对吧？

EN: I feel a sudden urge to shoot that area of empty space, right there.
中文: 我突然有一种冲动想去朝那个空地开枪，就在那里。

EN: I'm going to pretend I didn't see and hear that.
中文: 我要假装我没有看到和听到。

EN: One of your dwellers has heard cries coming from an abandoned cabin. They should investigate to see if anyone needs help!
中文: 你的一个居民听到一个废弃的小屋里发出叫声。他们应该调查看看是否有人需要帮助！

EN: Cabin Fever
中文: 幽居病

EN: Investigate the noises coming from the cabin.
中文: 调查来自小屋里的噪音。

EN: Investigate strange sounds coming from a derelict cabin.
中文: 调查一个废弃小屋发出的奇怪声音。

EN: While exploring the Wasteland, one of your Dwellers discovered a spooky cabin in the middle of nowhere. It's not haunted... probably.
中文: 正在探索废土的居民在某个荒郊野岭发现了一处阴森的小屋。大概没有……闹鬼吧。

EN: Cabin Without The Woods
中文: 神秘小屋

EN: Eliminate the Ghouls.
中文: 除掉尸鬼。

EN: Eliminate the Ghouls in the Abandoned Cabin.
中文: 除掉废弃小屋里的尸鬼。

EN: That flea bag ran off with the others. Probably to Vault 199. It'll be the first place we look once we're finished with you!
中文: 那个家伙一定是和其他人一起逃走了。说不定是199号避难所。干掉你们之后我们就立刻去那里。

EN: Intruders! You must be the ones that freed our prisoners.
中文: 入侵者！那个把我们的囚犯放走的人一定是你们。

EN: We didn't spend all that time tying them up and keeping them alive, just for them to run away! Talk about rude.
中文: 我们没有将他们绑住，还保证他们活着，结果他们居然逃跑了！什么玩意！

EN: No one appreciates good captors these days!
中文: 这年头可没有人会感激好心的牢头！

EN: So Bigsby isn't here anymore?
中文: 所以比格斯比不在这里了吗？

EN: I need to search an old warehouse to try and find Bigsby. The Raiders are using it as a hideout, so I'll need to be careful.
中文: 我得去搜搜那座旧仓库，看看能不能找到比格斯比。掠夺者把它当成了藏身处，所以我得小心点。

EN: Canine Recovery
中文: 寻找狗狗

EN: Find Bigsby.
中文: 找到比格斯比。

EN: Look for Bigsby in the old warehouse.
中文: 在旧仓库里寻找比格斯比。

EN: Do you know how long it took me to set this up?
中文: 你们知道我花了多长时间才把这个装好吗？

EN: I was going to have an army of Radroaches at my disposal.
中文: 我本来会有一个军队的辐射蟑螂来供我支配。

EN: And now, you've ruined everything!
中文: 而现在，一切都被你们给毁了！

EN: You're going to pay!
中文: 你们会付出代价的！

EN: A strange, high-pitched sound is coming through over the radio. The signal seems to originate from an old, abandoned builidng.
中文: 一个奇怪而刺耳的声音从广播里传来。信号好像是从一幢废弃的旧建筑里发出的。

EN: Can't Stop The Signal
中文: 无法停止信号

EN: Find the signal's source.
中文: 寻找信号源。

EN: Investigate a strange radio broadcast.
中文: 侦查一个奇怪的无线电广播站。

EN: There's a large stash of Caps out there in the Wasteland with your name on it.
中文: 废土上有一大笔瓶盖储备，上面写着你的名字。

EN: Caps Run
中文: 瓶盖大作战

EN: Recover the main stash of Caps.
中文: 追回主要的瓶盖储备。

EN: Find more stashes of Caps.
中文: 发现更多的瓶盖储备。

EN: Find more stashes of Caps.
中文: 发现更多的瓶盖储备。

EN: Find the hidden stash of Caps.
中文: 发现隐藏的瓶盖储备。

EN: There's a lost and lonely animal who'd love to come home to your Vault. Too bad some hungry Ghouls found it first.
中文: 有一只孤单的迷路小动物想和你一起回避难所的家。但令人讨厌的是一些饥饿的尸鬼先发现了它。

EN: Captured Critter
中文: 拯救小动物

EN: Rescue the Pet from the hungry Ghouls.
中文: 从饥饿的尸鬼手中救出宠物。

EN: Save a lost Pet from some hungry Ghouls.
中文: 从一些尸鬼手中拯救迷失的宠物。

EN: No Jersey in sight. Though I do see a nice polyester leisure suit.
中文: 没有看见棒球衫。倒是发现了一套不错的休闲西装。

EN: If Coach was at Lakeville Library, he checked out of there a long time ago. Maybe he went to Fallon's Department Store for some slacks to match that Jersey...
中文: 就算蔻驰到过莱克维尔图书馆，他也很早就离开了。也许他去肥伦百货商店，想找条裤子配上那件棒球衫……

EN: Cheap Beer in the Bleacher Seats
中文: 看台座椅上的廉价啤酒

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
中文: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
中文: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Hurray! Here. We saved up and want you to have this present!
中文: 噢耶！拿着吧，这是我们特意保存下来的，现在我们希望你能拥有它！

EN: We see how it is, smoothskins! Get out of here.
中文: 我们看到了它是怎样的。赶紧滚吧，“光滑皮肤”们！

EN: You're here! Santa didn't forget about us.
中文: 你来了！看来圣诞老人没有忘记我们。

EN: We've been very good Ghouls this year!
中文: 今年我们尸鬼都很乖哦！

EN: You'll let him know that, won't you?
中文: 你会告诉他的，对吧？

EN: Of course! He'll be here real soon with a “Ho ho ho!”
中文: 当然！很快他就会带着他那招牌式的“嗬嗬嗬！”的笑声来这里了。

EN: Sorry, all Ghouls are on the naughty list this year. You get nothing.
中文: 抱歉，所有的尸鬼今年都上了我的“坏孩子”名单。你们什么礼物都拿不到了。

EN: Hmph. Fine. But tell Santa we deserve more next year!
中文: 呃，好吧。但是你告诉圣诞老人，明年可得给我们更好的东西！

EN: Die, smoothskins!
中文: “光滑皮肤”们，去死吧！

EN: You're Santa's Helpers, huh?
中文: 你是圣诞老人的助手，对吧？

EN: We think we deserve more than just “cheer” this year.
中文: 我们觉得今年应该得到比“鼓励奖”更好的东西。

EN: And it'll be easier to just kill you and take your things!
中文: 而且直接杀了你，然后拿走你的东西貌似更容易！

EN: You can't kill us! What would Santa think? That's permanent naughty list stuff.
中文: 你不能杀了我们！而且你们觉得圣诞老人会怎么想？那会让你们永远留在“坏孩子”的黑名单上！

EN: No one's stealing Christmas this year! En garde!
中文: 今年谁也别想偷走圣诞节！接招吧！

EN: Think we got something right up your alley.
中文: 我觉得有样东西正合你们的心意。

EN: Here you are.
中文: 给你。

EN: Heh. Right you are.
中文: 嘿，你说得没错。

EN: Well, all right, maybe the holidays aren't dead after all!
中文: 那么，好吧，也许节日什么的还没有完全消亡！

EN: Hey there, smoothskins. Name's Jim. I'm in charge around here.
中文: “光滑皮肤”们，你们好啊。我叫吉姆，是这片的负责人。

EN: Thanks for bringing a little holiday cheer our way.
中文: 谢谢你们给我们这里带来了一点节日的气息。

EN: In the spirit of things, I'd like to send you home with a gift.
中文: 秉着节日的传统，我想送一个礼物给你们带回家。

EN: So, what do you want for Christmas, smoothskins?
中文: 所以，“光滑皮肤”们，你们想要什么圣诞礼物呢？

EN: Guns. Lots of guns.
中文: 枪。很多很多的枪。

EN: We're fashion nuts. Some new outfits, please!
中文: 我们是时尚达人，所以想要新衣服，拜托了！

EN: Nothing wrong with bottlecaps.
中文: 瓶盖永远不会嫌多。

EN: We don't need anything. We just enjoy helping out!
中文: 我们什么都不需要。我们只是乐于助人！

EN: Everyone forgets those poor Ghouls need holiday cheer, too!
中文: 每个人都忘了那些可怜的尸鬼们也想过节！

EN: Cheer for the Ghouls
中文: 为尸鬼制造节日气氛

EN: Speak to the Ghoul Leader.
中文: 和尸鬼首领聊聊。

EN: Talk to the Ghouls.
中文: 和尸鬼聊天。

EN: Talk to the Ghouls.
中文: 和尸鬼聊天。

EN: Spread Christmas cheer!
中文: 传播圣诞的节日气氛！

EN: Really? Thanks! We were wondering how to get rid of it. We even tried this!
中文: 真的吗？谢谢！我们想知道如何摆脱它。我们甚至试过这个！

EN: All right, have it your way!
中文: 好吧，照你说的做！

EN: You guys actually eat that? We could kill you, but this actually sounds worse...
中文: 你们真的吃了那个？我们可以杀了你，但吃那个听着更糟……

EN: What do you want, Dwellers?
中文: 你们想要什么，居民们？

EN: There is nothing of value in this place, only junk.
中文: 这个地方没有有价值的东西，只有垃圾。

EN: You should turn around and leave.
中文: 你们应该掉头离开。

EN: We're just here to clean the gray goo off the machinery.
中文: 我们只是来清理这些机器上的灰色粘液。

EN: Not before we get what we came for.
中文: 除非我们得到我们想要的。

EN: Our chef wants us to bring back processed cheese, and we will.
中文: 我们的厨师希望我们带回加工奶酪，我们会的。

EN: The chef is happy - and surprised - that you made it back in one piece! He now requires processed cheese, AKA gray gold, the miracle food that endures the passage of time and nuclear war. Some may be left in the old Cheese Factory.
中文: 厨师很高兴——也很惊讶——你完好无损地把它带回来了！他现在需要加工过的奶酪，也就是灰金奶酪，这种神奇的食物能经受住时间和核战争的考验。有些可能留在老奶酪厂。

EN: Cheese, Please!
中文: 请给我奶酪！

EN: Retrieve cheese paste from the factory.
中文: 从工厂取回芝士酱。

EN: Kill the Glowing One.
中文: 杀死发光种。

EN: Obtain processed cheese from the abandoned factory.
中文: 从废弃的工厂取回加工过的奶酪。

EN: We came here with grate expectations.
中文: 我们怀着极大的期望来到这里。

EN: This place seems uncontaminated by cheese...
中文: 这个地方似乎没有奶酪……

EN: Do Ghouls like Gouda?
中文: 尸鬼喜欢豪达奶酪吗？

EN: So you're the Pain Train? Don't make me laugh!
中文: 所以你就是“会痛的火车”？别逗了！

EN: You ain't railroading us!
中文: 可别想在我们身上铺铁轨！

EN: One of your Dwellers won't stop calling themselves “The Pain Train.” Let's make that nickname a reality...
中文: 你的一位居民一直称自己是“会痛的火车”。我们来让他梦想成真……

EN: Choo-Choo!
Kill the Raider Boss.
中文: 杀死掠夺者首领。

EN: Send a lone Vault Dweller with a Railway Rifle out to wreak havoc!
中文: 派一位拿着射钉步枪的居民去搞一场大破坏吧！

EN: He'll give us free stuff? All right. You Dwellers can pass.
中文: 他会免费给我们东西？好吧，你们这些居民可以走了。

EN: You're dead, and the North Pole is next!
中文: 你死定了。北极是下一个目标！

EN: Well, well, it's Santa's little helpers!
中文: 嗬嗬，原来是圣诞老人的小帮手来了！

EN: Make it quick. We got settlements to pillage!
中文: 动作快点，我们还有定居点要去抢呢。

EN: Santa's watching you. Be nice or he won't give you presents!
中文: 圣诞老人正在看着你。最好表现好点，不然什么礼物都得不到！

EN: Santa sends the gift... Of death! Eat lead!
中文: 圣诞老人送来了……死亡之礼！尝尝我的子弹吧！

EN: You know what? Why not? “Twinkle twinkle little star...”
中文: 你知道吗？为什么不呢？“一闪一闪亮晶晶……”

EN: Time to rumble!
中文: 开打时间到！

EN: Santa's Helpers, huh?
中文: 圣诞老人的小帮手，是吧？

EN: Well, we've been really naughty this year.
中文: 好吧，我们今年恐怕不怎么乖。

EN: Now hand over everything you got!
中文: 现在，把你们所有的东西都给我交出来！

EN: All we have is holiday cheer! Now let's sing some songs!
中文: 我们只有欢快的节日气氛！让我们一起来唱唱歌吧！

EN: The only thing we're giving you is a fist to the face!
中文: 我们能给你的唯一东西就是砸在脸上的拳头！

EN: Done!
中文: 搞定！

EN: Ha! Here you go.
中文: 哈！来，给你。

EN: Christmas is cancelled!
中文: 圣诞节取消了！

EN: I'm Boss McScrooge. I used to hate Christmas.
中文: 我是首领麦斯克鲁奇。我一度很讨厌圣诞节。

EN: But you Dwellers with all your cheer have changed my mind!
中文: 但是你们这些居民改变了我！

EN: So let's hand out some presents!
中文: 所以就让我们来分发一点礼物吧！

EN: How about some fancy new clothes?
中文: 你们觉得一些漂亮的新衣服怎么样？

EN: How about cash? Lots of cash.
中文: 钱怎么样？很多很多的钱。

EN: You're still on the naughty list, McScrooge. Time to die!
中文: 你还在“坏孩子”名单上。是时候去死了！

EN: Yes, even Raiders need a little Holiday spirit!
中文: 是的，即使是掠夺者也需要一点节日精神的！

EN: Christmas at the Raider Camp
中文: 掠夺者窝点的圣诞节

EN: Speak to Boss McScrooge.
中文: 和首领麦斯克鲁奇谈谈。

EN: Talk to the Raiders.
中文: 和掠夺者们谈谈。

EN: Talk to the Raiders.
中文: 和掠夺者们谈谈。

EN: Spread Christmas cheer!
中文: 传播圣诞的节日气氛！

EN: Looks like we're on the naughty list!
中文: 我们好像上了“坏孩子”名单！

EN: Ho Ho Hole in your head!
中文: 脑子有洞！

EN: Give my regards to Santa!
中文: 代我向圣诞老人问声好！

EN: A group of Raiders that have been preying on the locals is using a Super Duper Mart as their headquarters. Time to take down their leader!
中文: 一群掠夺者在掠夺当地的居民，他们占领了大无敌超市当总部，快去拿下他们的首领！

EN: Clean-Up On Aisle Five
中文: 清空5号通道

EN: Kill the Raider Boss at the Super Duper Mart.
中文: 杀死大无敌超市的掠夺者首领。

EN: Kill the Raider Boss at the Super Duper Mart.
中文: 杀死大无敌超市的掠夺者首领。

EN: What kind of coffin do you want, paper or plastic?!
中文: 你喜欢什么样的棺材，纸的还是塑料的？！

EN: Time to make a mess. Clean up on aisle five!
中文: 是时候大干一场了。清空5号通道！

EN: The motel is almost ready! But those Khans left a mess and it attracted a bunch of vermin. Let's get them out before we open the doors.
中文: 旅馆快准备好了！但大汗帮留下了一堆乱摊子，引来了一大堆害虫。开门之前，先把它们清掉。

EN: Room Service
中文: 客房服务

EN: Clean up the motel
中文: 清理那家汽车旅馆。

EN: Clear the motel of dangerous creatures before opening.
中文: 开业之前清除旅馆里的危险生物。

EN: Ah! Don't shoot! We're just hiding out here! We're in love!
中文: 啊！别开枪！我们只是在这里藏身的！我们是相爱的！

EN: What? They can't? I've been living a lie!
中文: 什么？它们不会吗？我一直活在谎言中！

EN: Oh! Uh, I hope this is enough.
中文: 哦！嗯，希望这些够。

EN: Oh… okay! I'm outta here! He's just going to grab our stuff and follow after. Promise!
中文: 哦……好吧！我走！他就是去拿我们的东西，然后跟上来。保证！

EN: Robots can't love you.
中文: 机器人不会爱上你的。

EN: You can stay if you pay your bill.
中文: 交了钱就可以住。

EN: We're just here to clean up.
中文: 我们只是来打扫的。

EN: All right, we cleared the building! Now we can open. Is there a big red ribbon somewhere, or…?
中文: 好了，楼里清干净了！现在可以开业了。有大红绸带什么的吗，还是……

EN: Oh, you know. Managed things. Look, we're all part of the team. Let's stop sweating the details!
中文: 哦，你懂的，管理工作。听着，我们都是团队的一员。别纠结细节了！

EN: Now that's what I like to hear. I'll go get the chems!
中文: 这正是我想听到的。我去拿化学品！

EN: Of course! I mean, look, I'm resourceful, I'll figure it out. Don't worry. Come on, we've known each other for days!
中文: 当然！我的意思是，看，我很有应变能力，会搞定的。别担心。来嘛，我们认识都好几天了！

EN: WE did? What did you do?
中文: 我们？你干了什么？

EN: Woohoo! Let's party!
中文: 耶！派对时间！

EN: Are you qualified for this?
中文: 你有资格做这个吗？

EN: Well, this place is supposed to be ready. Where's Mr. Manager?
中文: 嗯，这地方应该准备好了。经理大人在哪？

EN: Ugh, actually it's still pretty gross. And I think I hear bugs. Let's clean up.
中文: 唔，其实还是挺恶心的。而且我好像听到虫子的声音。打扫干净吧。

EN: How about clearing Vault 840 of those nasty Ghouls? Good luck, soldier!
中文: 去清理掉840号避难所那些讨厌的尸鬼怎么样？祝你们好运，战士们！

EN: Thanks for wiping those filthy things out for us.
中文: 谢谢你们为我们清除这些丑陋的家伙。

EN: You know, you'd make quite a good soldier yourself.
中文: 你知道吗，你会成为一名很好的士兵。

EN: Keep this up and we'll make you an honorary member of the Brotherhood!
中文: 如果你能保持这种状态，我们想让你成为钢铁兄弟会光荣的一员！

EN: Thanks. What else can I do to help?
中文: 谢谢。我还能做点什么帮助你们吗？

EN: There's a group of soldiers called the “Brotherhood of Steel” that insist the Vault would be an ideal outpost! To meet their standards, we're going to have to provide a little bit of fire support. We'll start at the nearby machine parts factory.
中文: 有一群士兵叫“钢铁兄弟会”，他们坚持认为避难所将会是理想的哨所！为了满足他们的标准，我们必须提供点火力支援。先从附近的机械配件厂开始吧。

EN: Clearing A Path
中文: 清空小路

EN: Clear a path for the Brotherhood of Steel squad at the factory.
中文: 为工厂里的钢铁兄弟会小队清空道路。

EN: Provide fire support at the machine parts factory.
中文: 在机械配件厂提供火力支援。

EN: Climbing the Ranks
中文: 迈向巅峰

EN: Oh yeah. We've been watching him, waiting for the right time to strike. Try the old Super Duper-Mart about a click north of here.
中文: 试试从这里往北约一公里处的旧大无敌超市吧。

EN: I'm all that's left. I suppose that's what you get when you stand up to thugs and yellow journalists.
中文: 我就是所剩无几的人之一。这大概就是和暴徒还有小报记者作对的下场。

EN: That ridiculous Bugle “Boy” and his Editor... Soon as I saw them I could tell they were hucksters, and I wasn't buying the act!
中文: 那个可笑的号角“男孩”和他的编辑……我一看就知道他们是骗子，我根本不会买他们的账！

EN: “Have it your way!” the Bugle “Boy” said. Then came the biggest Raider attack I've ever experienced. It was a bloodbath.
中文: “那走着瞧吧。”号角“男孩”说道。于是就上演了我平生最大规模的掠夺者袭击。真是一场血战。

EN: I've had uncles younger than that Boy. I don't know how so many others fell for it. Guess that's what buying false hope will get you.
中文: 我有个叔叔比那个“男孩”还年轻。都不知道为什么有那么多人会信那一套。我想这告诉我们不要相信天上会掉馅饼。

EN: Do you know where he is?
中文: 你知道他在哪儿吗？

EN: It seems like if you get mentioned in the New Boston Bugle, you end up with your head on a Raider pike. Now we have to figure how to NOT make the front page!
中文: 据说只要你在新波士顿号角报里被提到，你最终的结局就是脑袋被挂在掠夺者的长矛上。现在我们得想办法怎么才能不上封面头条！

EN: Collateral Murder
中文: 连环谋杀案

EN: Meet the Settlers at the RobCo Plant.
中文: 去见罗伯科工厂里的居民们。

EN: Find the first group of settlers to get attacked by Raiders.
中文: 寻找第一波被掠夺者袭击的居民们。

EN: We have unsophisticated palates!
中文: 我们还是有单纯的味蕾的！

EN: Not yet, but we'll do that right after killing you!
中文: 还没有，但我们杀死你后马上就这么做！

EN: Yeah, but how fun would *that* be?
中文: 是的，但是那该会有多有趣？

EN: You should have stayed in your Vault, Dwellers!
中文: 你应该待在你的避难所里！

EN: First we're going to kill you...
中文: 首先我们要杀了你……

EN: ...and then we'll have that Mr. Handy roast you up real good!
中文: ……然后我们会让巧手先生把你烤得好好的！

EN: You shouldn't. Mr. Handy robots are terrible at cooking.
中文: 这样不好吧。巧手先生机器人在烹饪方面很糟糕。

EN: Does that mean you've already taken it out of its box?
中文: 这是否意味着你已经把它从盒子里拿出来了？

EN: ...or you could just surrender and give us the Mr. Handy.
中文: ……或者你可以投降，把巧手先生交给我们。

EN: Let me check if I have change first.
中文: 我先检查一下是否有零钱。

EN: Yeah, I  got that - you know, *before* you over-explained it.
中文: 是的，我知道-你知道，在你过分解释一切之前。

EN: Tempting... but no.
中文: 很诱人……但不要。

EN: Ah, you must be the buyer.
中文: 啊，你一定是买家。

EN: Don't worry, it's still in mint condition.
中文: 别担心，它仍然处于全新状态。

EN: I was very tempted to open the box, but didn't.
中文: 我很想打开盒子，但我没有。

EN: How will you be paying?
中文: 你要怎么支付呢？

EN: Do you take lead?
中文: 你们收铅（子弹）吗？

EN: You're the one who'll pay! With your life! Because we'll kill you!
中文: 你就是那个要付出代价的人！用你的生命！因为我们会杀了你！

EN: Give us the box and you'll live.
中文: 把盒子给我们，你就会活下去。

EN: We've heard that local Raiders have found a brand-new Mr. Handy, still in his original box, in an abandoned industrial building. We should try to get our hands on this collector's item before those Raiders ruin it.
中文: 我们听说当地的掠夺者在一个废弃的工业建筑里发现了一个崭新的巧手先生，他还在他的原来的盒子里。我们应该设法在这个宝贝被掠夺者破坏之前拿回它。

EN: Collector's Edition
中文: 珍藏版

EN: Retrieve the Mr. Handy Box.
中文: 找回巧手先生盒子。

EN: Retrieve a brand-new Mr. Handy from Raiders.
中文: 从掠夺者手里找回全新的巧手先生。

EN: What good is a Mr. Handy if you keep it in its box?
中文: 如果你只是把巧手先生放在盒子里，他能做什么呢？

EN: Maybe it's the limited edition Mr. Handy, with enhanced sarcasm module...
中文: 也许这是限量版的巧手先生，有着增强版的讽刺模块……

EN: What would Raiders do with a Mr. Handy anyway?
中文: 掠夺者会对巧手先生做什么呢？

EN: Major shocker - Rackie Jobinson's Jersey isn't here.
中文: 真是震惊——罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫居然不在那里。

EN: No luck in the General Atomics factory, but there's always the abandoned Vault 616.
中文: 在通用原子工厂里一无所获。但还好有一个被遗弃的616号避难所可以去看看。

EN: Conference on the Mound
中文: 土堆上的会议

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
中文: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
中文: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Everybody wants to be famous - well I'll tell this story for a good long time!
中文: 人人都想出名 - 这个故事我可以讲好久了！

EN: The Vault has received word of a TV pilot filming nearby. It's almost certainly a trap, but send your most physically attractive Dwellers dressed for the part just in case.
中文: 避难所得到消息，说附近正在拍电视节目。这肯定是个陷阱，但以防万一还是派你最具魅力的居民打扮一番去试镜吧。

EN: CoveWatch!
中文: 溪谷勘察！

EN: Explore the building.
中文: 探索建筑。

EN: Auditions for a TV Show, or trap? Probably trap.
中文: 是真的电视节目试镜？还是个陷阱？应该是陷阱吧。

EN: You fell for it? There's no water anywhere NEAR here!
中文: 你居然信了？这附近根本就没有水。

EN: More suckers... Get 'em!
中文: 一群废物……抓住他们！

EN: Again, with the coming up empty. Argh!
中文: 再一次，一无所获。哎！

EN: Still no sign of Coach, or Rackie Jobinson's Jersey. Time to venture farther out. No risk, no reward!
中文: 还是没有蔻驰或是棒球衫的影子。该去更远的地方了。不入虎穴，焉得虎子！

EN: Covering All the Bases
中文: 占领所有基地

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
中文: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Search farther out for Coach and the Jersey.
中文: 去更远的地方搜寻教练与棒球衫。

EN: I said “Let our hunger consume you”!
中文: 我说：“让我们的饥饿吞噬你”！

EN: Scrumptious meaty Dwellers also on Death's trail. Delicious.
中文: 鲜嫩多肉的居民们也在追踪“死亡”的行踪。美味。

EN: But are they hungry enough? As hungry as the Hungry? I think not.
中文: 但是他们够饿吗？像“饥饿者”那样饥饿？我想是没有的。

EN: Famine alone will gorge himself on Death and enjoy those tasty Horseman calories.
中文: 单是“饥荒”就会把“死亡”吞食殆尽，好好享用这些“骑士”的美味卡路里。

EN: Let our hunger consume you!
中文: 让我们的饥饿吞噬你！

EN: Wait a sec! Can we just talk about th-
中文: 等一下！我们可以谈谈—

EN: Your lies can't be heard over the sound of how unworthy we are!
中文: 你们根本就不配让我们听到你们的谎言！

EN: Like flies to a carcass, everyone comes to see what Death leaves behind.
中文: 就像苍蝇飞到尸体上一样，每个人都来看看“死亡”留下的痕迹。

EN: The fourth Horseman is elusive, but the Pests will be the ones to find him.
中文: 第四骑士是难以捉摸的，但“害虫”们会找到他。

EN: And when Pestilence is the final Horseman, we shall be unworthy no more.
中文: 当“瘟疫”成为最后的骑士时，我们将不会毫无价值了。

EN: Blessed be the irradiated!
中文: 愿辐射保佑我们！

EN: But your entire philosophy makes no sense! And “Pests” is a stupid name!
中文: 但你们整体的理念毫无意义！还有“害虫”是一个愚蠢的名字！

EN: We know Death well. In fact, our Overseer might be able to help you. We'll be in touch...
中文: 我们很了解“死亡”。事实上，我们的监督者也许能帮助你。我们会保持联系……

EN: Who goes there? Other Vault Dwellers! It's nice to meet you.
中文: 是谁在那里？

EN: We're from Vault 144. We were trading partners with Vault 672.
中文: 我们来自于144号避难所。我们是672号避难所的贸易伙伴。

EN: We hadn't heard from them in weeks, so we came to investigate.
中文: 我们几个星期没有收到他们的消息了，所以我们就来调查。

EN: As you can tell, it seems they were attacked, with no survivors! Do you know who did it?
中文: 正如你所知道的，他们似乎被攻击，没有幸存者！你们知道是谁干的吗？

EN: Have you heard of the Horsemen? We were told it was Death cultists, so we're looking for clues.
中文: 你们听说过“骑士”吗？我们被告知他们是“死亡”的教徒，所以我们正在寻找线索。

EN: Huzzah! We now have a truce with War until the other Horsemen are dealt with! To that end, War claims that the servants of Death attacked Vault 672. So we're off to investigate and look for any clues they may have left behind...
中文: 好哇！我们现在正和“战争”处在休战状态，直到其他“骑士”被处理好为止！为此，“战争”声称，“死亡”的仆人们正攻击672号避难所。所以我们要调查并寻找他们可能留下的线索……

EN: Crime Scene Investigation
中文: 犯罪现场调查

EN: Search for clues about Death.
中文: 寻找“死亡”有关线索。

EN: Search for clues about Death in Vault 672.
中文: 在672号避难所中寻找“死亡”的线索。

EN: That's too bad. Well, at least let me reward you for your trouble.
中文: 太糟了。不过，至少让我对你们的遭遇有所补偿吧。

EN: Suit yourself. Well, at least let me reward you for your trouble.
中文: 随便你吧。不过，至少让我对你们的遭遇有所补偿吧。

EN: You could have fooled me. Well, at least let me reward you for your trouble.
中文: 你本来可以骗过我的。不过，至少让我对你们的遭遇有所补偿吧。

EN: Sorry you feel that way. Well, at least let me reward you for your trouble.
中文: 抱歉你会那么觉得。不过，至少让我对你们的遭遇做点补偿。

EN: That was a fine piece of work, civilian.
中文: 那活儿干得不错，平民。

EN: You ever think about joining the Brotherhood of Steel?
中文: 你有想过加入钢铁兄弟会吗？

EN: Maybe one day, but I don't think I'm ready yet.
中文: 也许有一天吧，但我觉得自己还没准备好。

EN: Heck no! I'd rather stay in my Vault.
中文: 才不要呢，我宁愿待在自己的避难所里。

EN: I was never cut out to be a soldier.
中文: 我从来就不是当士兵的料。

EN: No way! Soldiers caused this mess in the first place.
中文: 没门！最初的混乱就是那些士兵造成的。

EN: Star-Paladin Cross was collecting technology from a Super-Duper Mart when he was accosted by a Deathclaw. Lend him a hand.
中文: 星骑士克罗丝正在大无敌超市收集相关技术，但不幸被死爪盯上了，快帮帮他。

EN: Crossing Paths
中文: 十字路口

EN: Provide fire support for Star-Paladin Cross.
中文: 为星骑士克罗丝提供火力支援。

EN: Provide fire support for Star-Paladin Cross.
中文: 为星骑士克罗丝提供火力支援。

EN: And throw away all those Caps? I don't think so!
中文: 扔掉那些瓶盖么？我不要！

EN: Okay, now that's just offensive.
中文: 好吧，真是冒犯。

EN: It won't? We thought that was the whole point. Well, the heck with this then!
中文: 不会吗？我们还以为那个就是关键呢。好吧，这就见鬼了！

EN: You shouldn't be here, smoothskin!
中文: 你们不应该在这里的，“光滑皮肤”！

EN: The security honcho is ours. We were paid a handsome sum for his head!
中文: 那个安保老板是我们的。有人付了一笔漂亮的钱给我们来取他的脑袋！

EN: Harkness is a friend of our Vault. I suggest you leave now.
中文: 哈克尼斯是我们避难所的朋友。我建议你现在就走。

EN: Prepare to die, zombie scum!
中文: 准备受死吧，僵尸败类！

EN: You know a “handsome sum” won't actually make you handsome, right?
中文: 你知道一个“漂亮的钱”实际上不会使你漂亮，对吧？

EN: You can have this weapon. I call it “Dart,” because it always hits the  bullseye.
中文: 你们可以拥有这个武器。我叫它“飞镖”，因为它总是击中靶心。

EN: Use this weapon! I call it the “Dart.” Don't ask.
中文: 拿着这个武器！我叫它“飞镖”，别问为什么。

EN: I'm not a big shot, just a guy doing his job. Here, this is for you.
中文: 我不是一个大人物，只是一个家伙在做他的工作。拿着，这是给你的。

EN: Finally, you're here. I was beginning to worry.
中文: 终于，你在这里。我开始担心。

EN: The Ghouls were hot on my trail. I believe they were sent to kill me.
中文: 尸鬼很狂热地追踪我。我相信他们是被派来杀我的。

EN: They were probably hired by those who want to destroy your Vault.
中文: 他们可能是被那些想摧毁你们避难所的人雇来的。

EN: Here, take these documents to your Overseer. They'll know what to do.
中文: 这里，把这些文件带给你们的监督者。他（她）会知道该怎么做。

EN: Great. Anything else?
中文: 太棒了。还有别的吗？

EN: What if the Ghouls follow me back to the Vault?
中文: 如果尸鬼跟着我回避难所怎么办？

EN: So, how come a big shot like you got owned by a bunch of Ghouls?
中文: 那么，像你这样的大人物怎么会被一群尸鬼打得满地找牙？

EN: We've received a transmission from Harkness, Rivet City's chief of security, about important information he wants to give us in person. Put on your best clothes and meet him at the abandoned Super-Duper Mart north of the Vault.
中文: 我们从铆钉城安保长官哈克尼斯那里收到一条讯息，他要亲自给我们传达一些重要信息。穿上你最好的衣服，在避难所北边被遗弃的大无敌超市见见他。

EN: Dart of Harkness
中文: 哈克尼斯的飞镖

EN: Talk to Harkness.
中文: 和哈克尼斯说话。

EN: Meet with security chief Harkness.
中文: 会见安保长官哈克尼斯。

EN: Cleanup in aisle one.
中文: 清理一号通道。

EN: Can I talk to the manager?
中文: 我能和经理谈一下吗？

EN: Hmm, maybe you could scare them away with Ghost Costumes from the old costume factory nearby!
中文: 恩，也许你们可以扮鬼把他们从附近旧的服装厂吓跑！

EN: Wow, I'm glad you're here. Those Raiders almost got me!
中文: 哇，我真高兴你们在这。那些掠夺者差点就抓到我了！

EN: They're after anyone who gets near Vault 31.
中文: 任何靠近31号避难所的人，都会被他们追杀。

EN: It's not really haunted. I think they started that story to keep people away.
中文: 我没有真的觉得闹鬼，我想他们编出那个故事只是为了把人们吓跑。

EN: Then it's time to turn the tables on those Raiders.
中文: 所以现在该和那些掠夺者对峙一下了。

EN: Herb Vest told me that people who go to Vault 31 end up missing. I'm going to head to Vault-Tec's offices to learn more about the Vault's past.
中文: 赫伯韦斯特告诉我所有那些去了31号避难所的人最后都失踪了。我正要去避难所科技的总部调查一下这个避难所的过去。

EN: Days Gone Bye
中文: 曾经的日子

EN: Track down information about Vault 31's past.
中文: 查找关于31号避难所历史的信息。

EN: Search the Vault-Tec offices for information about Vault 31.
中文: 搜索避难所科技的办公室来查找31号避难所的信息。

EN: Oh! Easy there! The other specimens have resisted my treatments.
中文: 哦！别紧张！其他样本都抵御了我的改造。

EN: These two individuals have shown some sign of potential for social serenity.
中文: 这两个个体表现出了一定程度的冷静和社会性。

EN: Please, lower your arms, you have nothing to fear from them!
中文: 请放下武器，你们不用害怕他们！

EN: No! My babies!
中文: 不！我的孩子们！

EN: They are! And I hope to convert more to such behaviour. Please see yourselves out, I have much more work to do!
中文: 没错！我希望更多的死爪能变成这样。快走吧，我还有很多工作要做！

EN: Of course! My chance of survival would be utterly infinitesimal! But I trust science! And my two friends here.
中文: 当然怕！在它们的爪子下，我的生存机会微乎其微！但我相信科学！我还有两个朋友呢。

EN: You can't tame a deathclaw. Get out of the way, we'll take care of them.
中文: 死爪是没法驯服的。让开，我们会处理它们。

EN: Wow. They really are just kinda chilling out!
中文: 哇，他们真的相当放松！

EN: Aren't you afraid they might turn on you?
中文: 你不怕它们会攻击你吗？

EN: Well, ok then. You seem ok, so we're going to go. Good luck!
中文: 好吧，你看起来状态还不错。那我们走了，祝你好运！

EN: Some of our foragers talked to a traveller recently who claimed he was looking for a colony of death claws in the area on which he planned to conduct "social experiments." They're worried he might be just taking a circuitous rout to getting himself eaten. Go to this area nearby where Deathclaws are known to gather and see if you can save the poor fool from himself.
中文: 我们的几个采集者最近和一个旅行者聊天，他说他正在该地区寻找死爪聚集地，还计划在那里进行“社会实验”。他们担心他可能会自讨苦吃。去附近这个死爪聚集地，看看能不能救救这个可怜的家伙。

EN: A Dearth of Claws
中文: 缺爪之痛

EN: Find the deathclaw scientist.
中文: 找到死爪科学家。

EN: Find the would-be deathclaw scientist.
中文: 找到那个想研究死爪的科学家。

EN: Hmm, where's the Overseer?
中文: 嗯，监督者在哪里？

EN: She must be waiting for us on one of the upper floors.
中文: 她一定在楼上的某个地方等我们。

EN: Listen! Three Dog's on the air.
中文: 听！三狗正在直播。

EN: He's telling everyone where all the cults are so Settlers can steer clear of them!
中文: 他正在告诉大家各个邪教都在什么地方，这样能方便居民们避开他们！

EN: Keep fighting the Good Fight, Three Dog.
中文: 继续打好仗，三狗。

EN: But it won't matter if we can't stop the Horsemen. Let's find this Overseer!
中文: 但如果我们不能阻止骑士的话就没所谓了。我们去找监督者吧！

EN: We are Death's wake-up call!
中文: 我们是“死亡”的警钟！

EN: We are Death's wake-up call!
中文: 我们是“死亡”的警钟！

EN: We are Death's wake-up call!
中文: 我们是“死亡”的警钟！

EN: No, not at all. I was going to say... uh... oh, whatever. We are Death's wake-up call!
中文: 不，一点都不。我正要说……呃……哦，无所谓了。我们是“死亡”的警钟！

EN: The shadow of Death, as defined in Article 8, Subsection c, is upon you!
中文: 死亡的阴影，如第8条第c款所定义的，就在你身上！

EN: Death will awaken when the quota is met. It's all there in the Manual.
中文: 当配额满足时“死亡”就会苏醒。手册里都写了。

EN: So we spill your blood today not out of malice, but to help meet that quota.
中文: 所以我们今天让你们流血不是出于恶意，而是为了帮助你达到这个配额。

EN: We hope your final moments meet the Manual's minimum happiness requirements.
中文: 我们希望您最后的时刻幸福度能满足手册的最低要求。

EN: The Death cultitsts are Dwellers from Vault 144? I did not see that coming.
中文: “死亡”教徒是来自144号避难所的居民吗？这我还真没料到。

EN: Can you at least tell us where Death is first? You know we'll find out eventually.
中文: 你能至少告诉我们“死亡”在哪里吗？你知道我们最终会发现的。

EN: So Death is sleeping and you're killing people to wake him up. That isn't insane at all.
中文: 所以“死亡”正在睡觉，你杀了人来叫醒他。这一点都不疯狂。

EN: You're about to shout out your cult motto, aren't you?
中文: 你要喊出你的邪教座右铭，是不是？

EN: In Vault 672, we met Dwellers from Vault 144 who are familiar with Death, the mysterious fourth Horseman. As promised, their Overseer contacted us and set up a meeting where she'll tell us what she can! But she doesn't want to reveal the location of her Vault, so we'll be joining her in an abandoned building...
中文: 我们遇到了来自144号避难所、熟悉“死亡”的居民……她会把她知道的一切告诉我们！

EN: Death Revealed?
中文: “死亡”出现？

EN: Talk to the Overseer of Vault 144.
中文: 跟144号避难所的监督者交谈。

EN: Listen to Three Dog's broadcast.
中文: 听三狗的广播。

EN: Learn the truth about Death from the Overseer of Vault 144!
中文: 从144号避难所的监督者处了解“死亡”的真相！

EN: Strange, it was sunny before we walked in...
中文: 奇怪的是，在我们走进去之前，天是晴朗的……

EN: ...and now it's dark outside, with rolling thunder in the distance.
中文: ……现在外面很黑，远处雷声隆隆。

EN: Very ominous.
中文: 很不祥。

EN: Okay, but just so you know, we tend to use metric around here.
中文: 好的，不过提醒你，我们这儿一般用公制。

EN: Eating Cram in the boudoir. I still have the tins if you want to see them.
中文: 在闺房里吃东西。如果你想看罐头，我还有。

EN: No sir, I don't think so.
中文: 不，先生，我不这么认为。

EN: I say, we were beginning to worry! I'm Reginald, the head butler.
中文: 我是雷金纳德，首席管家。

EN: It happened right after the host and guests had retired for the night.
中文: 此事发生在主人和客人们各自回房就寝之后。

EN: They're waiting for you to question them in the adjacent chambers.
中文: 他们在等着你在隔壁房间审问他们。

EN: The game is afoot! Let's proceed!
中文: 游戏正在进行中！让我们继续！

EN: Not so fast. Where were *you* on the night of the murder?
中文: 没有那么快。谋杀案发生的那天晚上你在哪里？

EN: Reginald, Reginald... Dutch, is it?
中文: 雷金纳德，雷金纳德……荷兰人，是吗？

EN: We mostly just collect old junk and resell it... but we're very industrious about it!
中文: 我们通常只是收集旧的垃圾然后转卖……但是我们对此非常勤奋！

EN: Coincidentally enough, trying to find clever ways to murder Mr. Peabody.
中文: 很巧的是，他想找到谋杀皮博迪先生的好办法。

EN: Don't get any funny ideas! It's bad enough Peabody tried to seduce my wife...
中文: 不要有任何可笑的想法！皮博迪想勾引我妻子已经够糟的了……

EN: You can't keep us cooped up in here, you know? We have rights!
中文: 你不能把我们关在这里，知道吗？我们有个人权利！

EN: I'm Rod Murphy, rich but vulgar industrialist, and this is my trophy wife Priscilla.
中文: 我是罗德·墨菲，富有但粗俗的实业家，这是我的妻子普莉希拉。

EN: We haven't done anything wrong. We certainly didn't *kill* anyone!
中文: 我们没做错什么。我们当然没有杀任何人！

EN: Not since we got here, anyway...
中文: 我们当然没杀任何人！反正自从我们来到这里就没杀过人……

EN: An industrialist? In this day and age?
中文: 一个实业家吗？在这个时代？

EN: What were you doing when Mr. Peabody was murdered?
中文: 皮博迪先生被谋杀时你在干什么？

EN: I had a cat named Priscilla, once.
中文: 我曾经养过一只叫普莉希拉的猫。

EN: Got her son addicted to Rock-papers-scissors, then sucked him dry by always picking Rock.
中文: 她让儿子迷上了剪刀石头布，然后总是出石头让他一败涂地。

EN: Oh, she's not a Ghoul, she's just very, very old.
中文: 哦，她不是尸鬼，她只是非常非常老了。

EN: Resuscitating Lady Worthington after she tried to nibble on a blueberry scone.
中文: 沃辛顿夫人试图咬一口蓝莓烤饼后苏醒过来。

EN: Hello! This is Lady Elizabeth Worthington, and I'm her attendant Agatha.
中文: 你好！这是伊丽莎白·沃辛顿夫人，我是她的侍从阿加莎。

EN: Alas, the Lady can't hear too well, so you'll have to direct your questions to me.
中文: 唉，那位女士听不太清楚，所以你得直接问我。

EN: The Lady deeply respects Mr. Peabody, whom she's known for years.
中文: 这位女士非常尊敬皮博迪先生，她认识他很多年了。

EN: She won't even hold a grudge for the fact he basically ruined her family.
中文: 她甚至不会怨恨他毁了她的家庭。

EN: How did he ruin her family?
中文: 他怎么毁了她的家庭？

EN: Was that before or after she was Ghoulified?
中文: 那是在她变成尸鬼之前还是之后？

EN: What were you doing at the time of the murder?
中文: 谋杀案发生时你在干什么？

EN: I guess it would depend on how much suffering he'd go through first.
中文: 我想这要看他先受了多少苦。

EN: Sixty-four times, if I recall correctly.
中文: 64次，如果我没记错的话。

EN: I'm sorry, my niece has a poor memory. I'm sure she can't recall what happened last night.
中文: 对不起，我侄女记性不好。我肯定她记不起昨晚发生的事了。

EN: Ah, the detective! I am Commodore Tramiel, and this is my niece Vicky.
中文: 啊，侦探！我是特拉米尔准将，这是我侄女维琪。

EN: So someone finally did old Peabody in, huh? Well, can't say I'm surprised.
中文: 终于有人把皮博迪干掉了？我一点不惊讶。

EN: The man had lots of enemies! More crooked than a Turkish blade, he was.
中文: 这个人有很多敌人！他的人格比土耳其弯刀还要扭曲。

EN: If you ask me, the killer deserves a medal. One that could complement this array, here.
中文: 它配得上我这一排勋章。

EN: Are you saying you wanted him dead?
中文: 你是说你想让他死？

EN: Turkish blade, huh? Did you know Peabody was stabbed to death?
中文: 土耳其弯刀，是吧？你知道皮博迪是被刺死的吗？

EN: What about you, Vicky? Did you see anything?
中文: 你呢，维琪？你看到什么了吗？

EN: Only when I go on a violent rampage, so...every other week, maybe?
中文: 只有当我暴跳如雷的时候，所以……也许每隔一周？

EN: Oh sure! He'd disown me, I'd thrust sharp objects at him... The usual.
中文: 哦，当然！他会和我断绝关系，我会用锋利的东西戳他……没什么大不了的。

EN: All my siblings met grisly fates, usually when playing by the cliffside.
中文: 我所有的兄弟姐妹都遭遇了可怕的命运，通常是在悬崖边玩耍的时候。

EN: I'll remember that next time I go on a violent, murderous rampage.
中文: 我将记住这一点，下一次我将进行暴力的、血腥的暴行。

EN: Hello! I'm Alvin Peabody, sole heir to my father's baseball card fortune.
中文: 你好！我是阿尔文·皮博迪，我父亲棒球卡财产的唯一继承人。

EN: I'm afraid I won't be of much help, I have no memory of last night.
中文: 我恐怕帮不了你的忙，我对昨晚的事已记不得了。

EN: All I know is I woke up this morning with a bloody dagger in my hand.
中文: 我只知道今天早上我醒来时手里拿着一把血淋淋的匕首。

EN: Father would know, I kind of remember him screaming my name.
中文: 父亲会知道的，我记得他喊叫着我的名字。

EN: Do you often suffer such memory losses?
中文: 你经常遭受这样的失忆吗？

EN: Did you get along well with your father?
中文: 你和你父亲相处得好吗？

EN: You're the only heir?
中文: 你是唯一的继承人？

EN: I must say I appreciate your candor.
中文: 我得说我很欣赏你的坦率。

EN: Not surprised, you can never trust the “nouveau riche.”
中文: 这并不奇怪，你永远不能相信“暴发户”。

EN: Huh. Who knew such a monster hid behind those thick nerdy glasses?
中文: 嗯。谁知道在那些厚实的书呆子眼镜后面竟然藏着这么一个怪物？

EN: I guess it all adds up. Here, Mr. Peabody would have wanted you to have this.
中文: 我想这一切都说明了问题。这里，皮博迪先生想让你拿到这个。

EN: Strangely enough, he's the one who sent for you. Guess he didn't think this through.
中文: 奇怪的是，是他叫你来的。我猜他没有想清楚。

EN: So, did you find out who did it?
中文: 你知道是谁干的吗？

EN: Was it the jealous industrialist, or the ruined matriarch?
中文: 是嫉妒的实业家，还是被毁的女家长？

EN: Perhaps it was the retired soldier, or Peabody's psychotic son?
中文: 也许是退役士兵，或者是皮博迪的精神病儿子？

EN: Please tell us, we all took bets.
中文: 请告诉我们，我们出过赌注了。

EN: It was Rod Murphy, the industrialist.
中文: 是实业家罗德·墨菲。

EN: Lady Worthington's attendant Agatha did it.
中文: 沃辛顿夫人的随从阿加莎干的。

EN: The Commodore is the murderer.
中文: 准将就是凶手。

EN: It's obviously his son. You didn't need me for that.
中文: 很明显是他的儿子。你不需要我告诉你这点。

EN: Egads! We've just received word that William Peabody III, Esq., has been found murdered in his bedchambers. We must send our brightest detective and his trusty sidekick to solve this gruesome mystery!
中文: 天哪！我们刚刚得到消息，威廉·皮博迪三世先生被发现死在他的卧室里。我们必须派我们最聪明的侦探和他值得信赖的助手去解开这个可怕的谜团！

EN: Death and Denial
中文: 死亡和否定

EN: Solve the Murder of William Peabody.
中文: 解决威廉·皮博迪谋杀案。

EN: Interrogate first group of suspects.
中文: 审讯第一组嫌疑犯。

EN: Interrogate second group of suspects.
中文: 审问第二组嫌疑人。

EN: Solve a murder mystery.
中文: 解决一个谋杀之谜。

EN: This “manor” has seen better times...
中文: 这个“庄园”早已破落……

EN: You just can't get good help these days.
中文: 这些天你就是找不到好帮手。

EN: Our new dog is acting worried. What is it, boy? You want us to follow? Maybe it's delicious food, like Cram, or Brahmin steak, or… Deathclaw meat!
中文: 我们的新狗狗看起来很担心。怎么了，小家伙？你想让我们跟着你走？也许是有什么好吃的，比如饱饱牌肉罐头，或者双头牛肉排，或者……死爪肉！

EN: Death Meat
中文: 死爪肉

EN: Kill the Alpha Deathclaw
中文: 消灭首领死爪。

EN: Follow the dog back to Novac… what could be waiting for us there?
中文: 跟着狗狗回到诺瓦克……那里等着我们的是什么？

EN: What are these Deathclaws doing at our motel?
中文: 这些死爪在我们旅馆里干什么？

EN: Well, they're no good for business. Gotta kick em out.
中文: 嗯，它们对生意不好。得把它们赶走。

EN: Doesn't hurt to ask!
中文: 问问也无妨！

EN: Gee, that would be bad. At least let's go check their intestines for keys.
中文: 哎呀，那可糟了。至少去检查一下它们的肠子里有没有钥匙。

EN: Maybe they just wanted a room.
中文: 也许它们只是想订个房间。

EN: I wonder if they would pay rent.
中文: 不知道它们愿不愿意交房租。

EN: I hope they didn't eat any clients.
中文: 希望它们没有把客人吃掉。

EN: ROOOOOAAARR!
中文: 吼嗷！

EN: Grawrrrarlllgr!
中文: 嘎嗷嗷！

EN: That'll be our Alpha. Nobody get beheaded!
中文: 那就是头头了。谁都别被砍头！

EN: Oh, hey, a ribcage. Looks fresh. Yikes.
中文: 哦，嘿，一个肋骨架。看起来很新鲜。吓人。

EN: This is not great for our public image as a safe place to stay.
中文: 这对我们作为安全住宿场所的公众形象非常不利。

EN: Don't interfere! We need medicine!
中文: 别妨碍我们！我们需要药！

EN: Something will have to be done about those Deathclaws! Apparently there's a doctor who can make a strong poison that will keep them away for good. Let's go talk to her!
中文: 必须对这些死爪采取点行动了！显然有个医生能调制一种强效毒药，可以让它们永远不再靠近。去跟她谈谈吧！

EN: Fetch Quest
中文: 跑腿任务

EN: Talk to Doc
中文: 与医生交谈。

EN: Talk to a doctor about a Deathclaw pesticide.
中文: 和一位医生谈谈关于死爪驱虫剂的问题。

EN: I don't know who you are… but you have to help! We're being raided!
中文: 我不认识你……但你一定要帮我们！我们被袭击了！

EN: Oh, thank you! Our doctor is upstairs somewhere… please hurry!
中文: 谢谢你！我们的医生在楼上某处……请快点！

EN: I know, right? Please do what you can! Our doctor is upstairs somewhere!
中文: 就是！请尽力而为！我们的医生在楼上某处！

EN: Oh, yeah, you look tough! Go get 'em!
中文: 哦，是啊，你们看起来挺强的！去给他们点颜色看看！

EN: We'll take care of it. If you take care of us.
中文: 我们来处理，你来照顾我们。

EN: Those raider scum! In a house of science?!
中文: 那帮掠夺者！在科学殿堂？！

EN: Don't worry. We'll take them down.
中文: 别担心。我们会搞定他们。

EN: Ah! They finally found me… I guess you'll want to…
中文: 啊！他们终于找到我了……我想你们是要……

EN: Oh, you're not raiders. What, uh... can I do for you?
中文: 哦，你不是掠夺者。嗯，有什么……我能帮你？

EN: Oh, sure. Just use this poison on every egg you see and kill the adults. Should be easy for you!
中文: 哦，当然。就用这种毒药喷在你看到的每个蛋上，然后杀掉成年的。对你来说应该很容易！

EN: Oh, dear. Sounds serious. You'll have to kill the Alphas, and use this poison on their eggs. Good luck!
中文: 哦，亲爱的。听起来很严重。你需要杀掉头头，然后用这种毒药喷在它们的蛋上。祝你好运！

EN: You got anything to deal with Deathclaws?
中文: 你有什么对付死爪的东西吗？

EN: Doctor, we've got a case of the Deathclaws.
中文: 医生，我们感染了死爪。

EN: Anybody here? Isn't this supposed to be a bustling science hub?
中文: 有人在吗？这里不是应该是个热闹的科学中心吗？

EN: I hope we can find our Deathclaw expert here…
中文: 希望我们能在这里找到我们的死爪专家……

EN: Now we have some Deathclaw poison. I guess we should spray the nest near the motel to get rid of the problem, rather than the motel itself.
中文: 现在我们有了死爪毒药。我想我们应该去喷洒旅馆附近的巢穴来根治问题，而不是喷旅馆本身。

EN: Deathicide
中文: 死爪灭除

EN: Spray the Deathclaw nest
中文: 喷洒死爪巢穴。

EN: Kill the adult Deathclaws (1/2)
中文: 消灭成年死爪（1/2）。

EN: Kill the adult Deathclaws (2/2)
中文: 消灭成年死爪（2/2）。

EN: Spray the Deathclaw nest with poison.
中文: 用毒药喷洒死爪巢穴。

EN: Humans. Pray, do not attack me. I do not share the violent tendancy of my brethren.
中文: 人类。请不要攻击我。我不像我的同类那样好斗。

EN: I have been a voluntary prisoner here, for the sin of desiring a less violent lifestyle for my people.
中文: 因为向往和平生活，我在这里自愿成为囚犯，为我同族的罪愆受罚。

EN: Now, I am free. What compelled you to this savage place?
中文: 现在，我自由了。是什么让你来到这个蛮荒之地？

EN: And you are here to exterminate them, no doubt. I do not begrudge you. They could not be reasoned with.
中文: 你们无疑是来消灭它们的。我不怪你。它们无法以理服之。

EN: Do not fret, I will not stop you. I will look for more like me, who seek peace, and likely die alone.
中文: 别担心，我不会阻止你们。我会去寻找和我一样追求和平的同类，然后大概孤独地死去。

EN: Ah. Humans are no different, after all. I am the last of your foes. Now perish!
中文: 啊。原来人类没什么不同。我是你最后一个敌人。现在，去死吧！

EN: Your, uh, brethren attacked our motel.
中文: 你的，嗯，同类袭击了我们的旅馆。

EN: Killing your family and poisoning your eggs?
中文: 杀你家人，毒你的蛋？

EN: Dealing with pests, and you're one of them!
中文: 对付害虫的，你就是其中之一！

EN: It's the Deathclaw eggs… how should we do this?
中文: 这是死爪的蛋……我们该怎么处理？

EN: Surgical precision!
中文: 外科手术级别的精准！

EN: EXTERMINATE!!!
中文: 消灭！！！

EN: <Carefully spray only the eggs>
中文: <仔细喷洒蛋>

EN: <Wildly spray the whole room>
中文: <疯狂喷洒整个房间>

EN: Room please!
中文: 订房！

EN: This decor is horrible!
中文: 这装修真是难看！

EN: Hungry! Hungry!!!
中文: 饿！好饿！！！

EN: Apparently our anti-Deathclaw spray is like honey to feral Ghouls. Clear them out so we can get running again!
中文: 显然我们的死爪驱虫剂对狂尸鬼就像蜂蜜一样有吸引力。把他们清掉，旅馆才能重新运营！

EN: Ghoul Down, Boy
中文: 尸鬼，趴下！

EN: Clear out the feral Ghouls
中文: 清除那些狂尸鬼。

EN: Clear feral Ghouls out of the motel so it can run again.
中文: 清除旅馆里的狂尸鬼以便重新营业。

EN: AAAUGH NO PLEASE DON'T- oh, it's you. Wow!
中文: 啊啊啊求求你别——哦，是你。哇！

EN: I have to say, Some of our clients are pretty aggressive! I want hazard pay!
中文: 不得不说，我们有些客人还挺凶的！我要额外的危险津贴！

EN: What?! I… well, you make a good point. Here, it's all I've got on me. Let's call it even.
中文: 什么？！我……嗯，你说得有道理。来，这是我身上所有的。两清了。

EN: Ugh. You're right, of course. All right, back to work, I suppose…
中文: 唉，你说得对。好吧，看来我得继续回去工作了……

EN: Fine! I will! … Ah, who am I kidding? I got nowhere else to go.
中文: 好！我去！……唉，我又能上哪儿呢？

EN: I saved you. You should pay me.
中文: 我救了你，你该付钱给我。

EN: What do you want? It's the wasteland.
中文: 你要什么？这可是废土。

EN: Nah. Go find another job if you want.
中文: 那就去别处找工作吧。

EN: Bleehh… b… bed! Smell! NICE!
中文: 嗯……床！ 香！好！

EN: Want… MATE… Aaaagh!
中文: 想……伴侣……啊啊啊！

EN: Nnnnaaaahh!
中文: 噶啊！

EN: Brrrroooooke!
You want A mate? Fine, just get out!
中文: 你想要一个伴侣？好，先出去！

EN: You want TO mate?! Fine, just pay up!
中文: 你想在这里找对象？！好，先交钱！

EN: Deathclaw Dee-Lite
中文: 死爪迪莱特

EN: Deal!
中文: 成交！

EN: You want to play it rough? Then let's go!
中文: 你们想硬碰硬吗？那来吧！

EN: Alright, alright! Don't shoot!
中文: 好吧，好吧！别开枪就行！

EN: Here, these are all the Caps I've got.
中文: 给你们，这些是我全部的瓶盖。

EN: They're yours if you let me go!
中文: 如果你们放了我的话，这些都是你们的！

EN: Hand over those Caps, and you can walk out of here.
中文: 把这些瓶盖交过来，我们就让你活着走出去。

EN: No deal. You're going to pay for what you did.
中文: 不行。你要为你的行为付出代价。

EN: Red Rachel is a ruthless Raider boss, and she's stolen some of your supplies. Take back what's yours, and teach that reckless rogue a lesson!
中文: 红瑞秋是一个凶残的掠夺者首领。她偷走了一些你们的物资。拿回本属于你的东西，然后给这些莽夫们一点颜色看看！

EN: Den of Thieves
中文: 深入丹恩城

EN: Reclaim the lost supplies.
中文: 追回丢失的物资。

EN: Confront the Raider Boss.
中文: 对抗掠夺者首领。

EN: Reclaim the stolen supplies from the Raiders.
中文: 追回被掠夺者窃取的物资。

EN: Detective Case Files
中文: 侦探的案件档案

EN: Oh well. I tried to warn you...
中文: 哦。我试图警告你……

EN: Have this as a token of our appreciation.
中文: 以此表达我们的感谢。

EN: Well, I guess you can have that. We don't really need it.
中文: 这个，我想你可以拿着。我们真的不需要它。

EN: Hold it right there, Dweller.
中文: 站住，避难所居民。

EN: The Brotherhood of Steel is requisitioning any tech found in this location.
中文: 钢铁兄弟会正在回收在这个位置发现的任何技术。

EN: For your own safety, please evacuate this area.
中文: 为了您自身的安全，请撤离本区。

EN: No, I think I'll just stay and take what I want.
中文: 不，我想我会留下来带走我想要的。

EN: All right, I'll just show myself out, then.
中文: 好吧，我这就自己出去。

EN: Come on, can't you guys share anything here?
中文: 拜托，你们不能在这里分享什么吗？

EN: One of your Dwellers found an abandoned Red Rocket truck stop! Maybe there's some valuable junk inside...
中文: 你的一个居民发现了一辆废弃的红色火箭卡车站！也许里面有一些有价值的垃圾……

EN: Dibs at the Red Rocket
中文: 谁先到红火箭

EN: Look for valuable junk.
中文: 寻找有价值的垃圾。

EN: Look through Red Rocket for useful junk.
中文: 搜寻红火箭寻找有用的垃圾。

EN: Very well. Here's what we have!
中文: 非常好。这是我们有的东西！

EN: I think we can spare a few implements of destruction.
中文: 我们可以给你们一些搞破坏的道具。

EN: I think we have something right up your alley!
中文: 我们有一些东西，可能正合你们口味！

EN: It's the diplomats from the Vault!
中文: 是来自避难所的外交家！

EN: We have a gift for you, but our settlement can only send you back with one thing.
中文: 我们有一个礼物要送给你们。但你们只能选一样。

EN: What would you like?
中文: 你们想要哪种？

EN: Caps. Precious, precious bottlecaps.
中文: 瓶盖。宝贝又珍贵的瓶盖。

EN: We'll take whatever weapons you have.
中文: 你们有什么武器的话就给我们吧。

EN: Our Vault has great fashion sense. We want more outfits.
中文: 我们是个讲时尚的避难所。我们想要更多的衣服。

EN: A local settlement wants to make contact with our Vault! We should send some diplomats.
中文: 一个当地的定居点试图联系我们避难所！我们应该派一些外交家去。

EN: Diplomatic Mission!
中文: 外交任务！

EN: Talk to the settlers.
中文: 和定居点的居民交谈。

EN: Send a team in Formal Wear out to talk to a settlement.
中文: 派遣一队着装正式的居民去和安置点的代表交谈。

EN: That's *point* 22. Here, let me show you.
中文: 那是“点22”（.22口径）。且听我说。

EN: ...or very small values of 5. All right, you can go through.
中文: ……或5里非常小的值。好吧，你可以过去了。

EN: Okay, maybe that was a little *too* simple...
中文: 好吧，也许那有点太简单了……

EN: Hold it right there, mouthbreathers!
中文: 等等，你们这些用嘴呼吸的家伙！

EN: In order to continue, you must prove your math skills.
中文: 为了继续下去，你必须先证明你们的数学技能。

EN: Since you guys don't look too smart, we'll start with a simple one.
中文: 既然你们看起来不太聪明，我们就从简单的开始。

EN: Does 2 + 2 equal 5?
No, 2 + 2 is 22, like the caliber.
Only for very large values of 2.
中文: 只有2里非常大的值。

EN: Two and two are four.
中文: 二加二等于四。

EN: Wrong, the two are considered to be of equal value! Kill them!
中文: 错了，这两个被认为是同等价值的！杀了他们！

EN: Indeed, it is! Here's your reward.
中文: 的确，它是！这是你的奖励。

EN: I think I'll make a scatter plot... of your brains!
中文: 我想我会做一个散点分析……关于你的大脑的！

EN: You guys got here just in time to help settle an argument.
中文: 你们来得正好，到这里来帮助解决一场争论。

EN: Can you tell us if 1 is the same as 0.999...?
中文: 你能告诉我们1和0.999是一样的吗？

EN: That's 0.9 with an infinitely repeating decimal.
中文: 这是一个无限重复小数点0.9。

EN: No, 1 is larger than 0.999...
Yes, 1 is equal to 0.999...
Here, check out my infinitely repeating firearm.
中文: 来，见识见识我这把无限连发枪吧。

EN: Normally I'd agree with you, but I'm feeling negative today.
中文: 通常我同意你的意见，但今天我并不想。

EN: Maybe this was true once, but that's no longer the case.
中文: 也许曾经如此，但如今已不是这样了。

EN: I can't add anything to this, you won fair and square.
中文: 我不能添加任何东西，你赢得光明正大。

EN: That sounds rational.
中文: 听起来有道理。

EN: So, you've managed to get this far...impressive!
中文: 所以，你居然答对了这么多……真让人印象深刻！

EN: We'll move to another quadrant if you can answer this simple test.
中文: 如果你能回答这个简单的测试，我们就移到另一个象限。

EN: Be warned: 90% of those who tried to solve this got it wrong!
中文: 警告：90%回答这个问题的人都会搞错！

EN: What is 6÷2(1+2)?
6÷2(1+2) = 9. Final answer.
Easy: 6÷2(1+2) equals 1.
The equation is ambiguous, and meant to trick people.
中文: 方程是模棱两可的，存在就是为了骗人的。

EN: Let me count out the answer with gunshots.
中文: 让我用枪声来算出答案。

EN: There's a new Raider gang, Euler's Angels, terrorizing the Wasteland's perimeter! Without going on a tangent, we need to send our smartest Dwellers to reduce the threat these radicals pose, and solve this acute situation.
中文: 有一个新的掠夺者帮派，欧拉的天使，在废土为非作歹！闲话少说，我们得派最聪明的居民去化解这些激进分子的威胁，解决当前的危急局面。

EN: Divide and Conquer
中文: 分而治之

EN: Defeat the Raider Boss.
中文: 打败掠夺者首领。

EN: Defeat the Raiders.
中文: 击败掠夺者。

EN: Defeat the Raiders.
中文: 击败掠夺者。

EN: Defeat the Euler's Angels.
中文: 击败欧拉天使。

EN: This is the square root of all evil.
中文: 这是万恶的平方根。

EN: “Go forth and multiply,” they said...
中文: “出去然后做乘法吧，”他们说……

EN: That's not what we meant!
中文: 我们不是那个意思！

EN: You from that Vault? You bring the things we wanted?
中文: 来自避难所？带了我们想要的东西了吗？

EN: Well, we forgot the Caps and snacks... but here are the guns!
中文: 好吧，我们忘了瓶盖和吃的了……但是我们有枪！

EN: We'll find out what you have when we kill ya!
中文: 等我们杀了你们，就自然知道你们都有啥了！

EN: Well darn. I really wanted the snacks!
中文: 该死。我真的很想吃东西！

EN: Huh, then we could write better ransom notes! You got a deal!
中文: 呃，那我们就能写出更好的勒索信了！成交！

EN: It isn't? Well, shoot. I guess you can just have him, then. He's been eating too much food anyway.
中文: 它不是吗？好吧，真烦。我想你们可以带走它了。它也太能吃了。

EN: You must be the dog's owner!
中文: 你们一定是那只狗的主人！

EN: Fork over the guns, Caps, and snacks!
中文: 交出你们的枪，瓶盖和吃的！

EN: I wouldn't want to shoot you in front of the dog. It's sensitive.
中文: 我可不想在这狗面前杀你。它挺敏感的。

EN: We don't have any of those things, moron. Now hand over the dog!
中文: 白痴，你说的这些东西我们都没有。现在赶紧把狗交出来！

EN: I've got your guns right here!
中文: 你们的枪就在我这儿！

EN: We bring something better: the gift of knowledge. Give us the dog, and we'll teach you to write.
中文: 我们带来了更好的礼物——知识。把狗交出来，我们会教你怎么写字。

EN: You're gravely mistaken. That isn't even our dog.
中文: 恐怕你大错特错了。它甚至都不是我们的狗。

EN: A hastily written and grammatically incorrect note was left outside the Vault door: “IF U EVAR WANT TOO SEE YOU'RE DOG AGAN, COME TWO ARE BIG BILDING AND BRING GUNZ, CAPS, AND SNAX.” It must've been written by some really stupid Raiders, because we don't even have a missing dog. But if those jerks really do have a kidnapped canine, it still needs rescuing!
中文: 避难所门口发现一张字迹潦草且满篇错字的字条。“如果泥门还想再见到那支狗，就来吾萌的房子，记住必许带上枪，瓶改和次的。”一定是那些愚蠢的掠夺者写的，因为我们根本就没有什么走失的狗。但是如果这些混蛋真的绑架了一个小家伙，我们还是要去救它。

EN: Dog Gone
中文: 丢失的小狗

EN: Teach the Raiders a lesson and rescue the missing dog.
中文: 拯救丢失的小狗，给掠夺者一个教训。

EN: Save a kidnapped pooch from a band of Raiders.
中文: 从一帮掠夺者手里救出被绑架的小狗。

EN: Hah! Over our dead bodies.
中文: 哈！从我的尸体上踩过去。

EN: I keep telling them to be gentle.
中文: 我一直和他们讲要温柔点。

EN: They would never eat my gift.
中文: 他们绝对不会吃掉我的礼物。

EN: My Ghouls are lonely, so I got them a pet.
中文: 我的尸鬼们很寂寞，所以我送了一只宠物给他们。

EN: We're here to rescue Fido!
中文: 我们到这里来是为了救菲多！

EN: Can a Ghoul even take care of a pet?
中文: 尸鬼能照顾好一只宠物吗？

EN: You mean you got them lunch.
中文: 你的意思是你送给他们一顿午餐。

EN: Someone let Fido out without a leash. Guess you'll need to get him back.
中文: 有人没给菲多栓链子就让它跑了出来。你们应该把它找回来。

EN: Dog Shelter
中文: 狗狗避难所

EN: Rescue Fido.
中文: 拯救菲多。

EN: Rescue Fido from the Ghouls.
中文: 从尸鬼的手中救出菲多。

EN: Looks like we need to correct your behavior!
中文: 看来我们需要纠正你的行为！

EN: The Brotherhood sent you, didn't they? The mutt's ours! They can't have him!
中文: 是兄弟会派你来的吧？那条杂种是我们的！和他们无关！

EN: I think we'll stick around. You don't look like you'd make the best pet owners.
中文: 我想我们会留下来。你们看起来不像合格的宠物主人。

EN: No need for that. We can help you look for... what was it, a dog?
中文: 没必要这样。我们可以帮你找……是什么来着，一条狗？

EN: Come on, we gotta find that dog, Wilzig might not be enough!
中文: 来吧，我们得找到那条狗，威尔齐格可能不够！

EN: What? what are you looking at? Get out of here or there'll be trouble!
中文: 什么？你在找什么？快滚，不然有你好受的！

EN: You passed by a run down refueling station on your way back to Filly and you heard odd noises coming from inside. What could it be? You won't know until you find out!
中文: 你在返回菲利镇的路上经过一个破旧的加油站，听到里面传来的奇怪声音。那会是什么呢？只有进去才能知道！

EN: Codename: DOG
中文: 代号：狗狗

EN: Find a new friend...
中文: 找到新朋友……

EN: Investigate strange sounds at the Red Rocket.
中文: 调查红火箭加油站的奇怪声音。

EN: There's a working radio here and it sounds like Three Dog's on the air.
中文: 这里有一台打开的收音机，听起来像三狗正在直播。

EN: “Hello chilllldddreeenn! Join the Warshippers and serve War, the mightiest Horseman!”
中文: “你们好啊，孩诶诶诶诶子滋滋滋滋滋滋们嗯嗯嗯嗯！加入“战争崇拜者”，为“战争”效忠吧，他是最伟大的‘骑士’！”

EN: What?! These Warshippers must be forcing him to spread propaganda.
中文: 什么？！一定是这些“战争崇拜者”们强迫他这么做宣传的。

EN: We need to save him!
中文: 我们需要拯救他！

EN: With those cute little blue suits of yours that are *so* intimidating, right?
中文: 穿着你们那些可爱的蓝色小套装真是太吓人了，对吧？

EN: Oh no! The Pests have come to take our outfits! I'm shaking in my boots. Not.
中文: 哦不！“害虫”来抢我们的装备了！我在颤抖。不。

EN: You certainly don't look very hungry. Those Ghouls must be fattening you up for later.
中文: 你看起来不太饿。那些尸鬼肯定会等你养肥了之后再说。

EN: Death finally makes a move and decides to send *you*? That's rather anticlimactic.
中文: 还真是有点虎头蛇尾呢。

EN: Looky here, someone got through all the rookies. What, you think you can take us?
中文: 看这里，有人打败了那些菜鸟。怎么，你们觉得能打败我们？

EN: No matter. The message is out. “You can't stop the signal,” after all.
中文: 不管了。消息已发出。毕竟“你不能阻止信号传播”。

EN: Raiders will come from all over to serve War. Or else face his wrath. And his morning breath.
中文: 否则就要面对他的怒火。还有他的晨间口臭。

EN: Now, before we introduce you to our weapons, tell me. Which Horseman sent you?
中文: 现在，在亮出我的武器之前，告诉我。哪位“骑士”派你来的？

EN: None of them. We're Vault Dwellers and we'll stop the Horsemen.
中文: 没谁。我们是避难所的居民，我们会阻止“骑士”。

EN: Pestilence. Blessed be the irradiated!
中文: “瘟疫”。辐射保佑着我们！

EN: Famine. Let our hunger consume you!
中文: “饥荒”。让我们的饥饿吞噬你！

EN: Death. But we haven't picked a slogan yet.
中文: “死亡”。但我们还没有想好口号。

EN: Nope. But the Pests are greedy for protective gear. You could use some to lure them into a trap...
中文: 不。但“害虫”们正觊觎着这些美好的装备。你可以用一些来引诱他们进入陷阱……

EN: You kids sure know how to fight the good fight! Doggone heroes is what ya are. Thanks!
中文: 你们这些孩子一定知道如何打好仗！你们就是那些该死的英雄。谢谢！

EN: Come to me for info? Well a war of cults is brewin' out there, with Settlers caught in the crossfire.
中文: 来向我打听情报？外面正在酝酿一场邪教间的战争，定居者被夹在交火之中。

EN: War, Famine and Pestilence, whoever they are, are all vying for power.
中文: “战争”，“饥荒”和“瘟疫”，无论他们是谁，都在争夺权力。

EN: But Death is a no-show. Just rumors in the nuclear wind for now.
中文: 但“死亡”没有出现。只是有些传闻。

EN: Do you know where we can find any of the Horsemen's cults?
中文: 你知道我们在哪里可以找到任何和“骑士”有关的邪教吗？

EN: Famine and Pestilence are out there, whoever they are, with followers to spare. War and Death are the other infamous Horsemen of the Apocalypse. Are they terrorizing the Wasteland as well? If anyone knows, it's Three Dog at Galaxy News Radio. Let's go talk to him.
中文: “饥荒”和“瘟疫”就在那里，无论他们是谁，追随者都大有人在。“战争”和“死亡”是臭名昭著的“末日骑士”。他们在废土肆虐吗？如果有人知道，一定是银河新闻电台的三狗。我们去跟他谈谈。

EN: Dogs of War
中文: 战争之犬

EN: Talk to Three Dog.
中文: 和三狗交谈。

EN: Listen to Three Dog's broadcast.
中文: 听三狗的广播。

EN: Kill the Warshippers.
中文: 杀掉“战争崇拜者”。

EN: Talk to Three Dog about the Horsemen of the Apocalypse.
中文: 与三狗谈论末日骑士。

EN: Make war, not love!
中文: 制造战争，而不是爱！

EN: All hail War!
中文: 战争万岁！

EN: Rest in war!
中文: 安息在战争中！

EN: There it is! The... Wait... no. That's a ripped football uniform.
中文: 找到了！是……等等……不对。是一件扯烂的足球服。

EN: Getting closer though, right?!
中文: 但还是越来越近了，对吧？

EN: If I were a conniving Coach, where would I be? Maybe in the gym of Harriet Tubman High School? It's worth a shot...
中文: 如果我是那个狡猾的教练，我会去哪儿呢？也许会去哈丽特塔布曼高中的体育馆吧？那地方值得一试……

EN: Do it for the Bat Boy!
中文: 为了蝙蝠男孩！

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
中文: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
中文: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Well, lookee here!
中文: 好，看这里！

EN: Seems like we have ourselves some ginger-lovers!
中文: 看起来我们有一些红发爱好者！

EN: No mercy!
中文: 毫不留情！

EN: I don't think it's supposed to be literal...
中文: 我不认为这应该是字面……

EN: Pfft. Thinking is for chumps, and losers, and gingers!
中文: 呵呵。思考是为笨蛋，失败者，红发人准备的！

EN: Them's fightin' words! Attack!
中文: 他们这是找打！攻击！

EN: Did you know gingers have no souls?
中文: 你们知道，红法人没有灵魂吗？

EN: Better dead than a redhead!
中文: 有红头发的话，还不如去死。

EN: Don't you agree, Dwellers?
中文: 居民们，你们不觉得是这样吗？

EN: I think you're about to get your wish.
中文: 我想你们会实现愿望的。

EN: Is that really what you think, boyo?
中文: 你们真的是那么想的吗？

EN: I guess we'll have to agree to disagree.
中文: 看来我们只能求同存异了。

EN: A bonnie lass once broke me heart, and I couldn't deal with it.
中文: 美丽的姑娘曾经伤了我的心，可我不知道该怎么办。

EN: That's exactly what a ginger lover would say!
中文: 这正是一个红发爱好者会说的话！

EN: Ireland's lack of snakes goes back to the last ice age!
中文: 爱尔兰无蛇的历史可以追溯到上一个冰河时代！

EN: Hello there, Dwellers.
中文: 你们好呀，避难所居民们。

EN: Come to join our fight against the *real* red menace?
中文: 来加入我们对抗真正的红色威胁吗？

EN: We gotta stop the carrot tops!
中文: 我们必须阻止那些长者胡萝卜颜色头发的家伙们！

EN: What do you say?
中文: 你们觉得怎么样？

EN: Why such hate for redheads?
中文: 为什么这样讨厌红头发？

EN: I say you care way too much about hair color.
中文: 我想说你太在乎头发颜色了。

EN: I say it's time to get all Saint Paddy on you Snakes!
中文: 我说是时候让所有的爱尔兰人对付你们这些蛇了！

EN: A band of Raiders known as the Snakes has been targeting Settlers with red hair, calling them “gingers” and claiming they are inferior beings. We need to drive these Snakes out of the neighborhood, for good!
中文: 一伙被称为“蛇”的掠夺者正在针对红头发的居民，称他们为“生姜”，声称他们是下等人种。我们得把这些人赶走。

EN: Driving the Snakes Out
中文: 把“蛇”赶出去

EN: Defeat the Raider Boss.
中文: 打败掠夺者首领。

EN: Defeat the Raiders.
中文: 击败掠夺者。

EN: Defeat the Raiders.
中文: 击败掠夺者。

EN: Defeat a band of Raiders hostile to redheads.
中文: 打败一伙敌视红发人的掠夺者。

EN: You know, someone told me Alpha Deathclaws are an endangered species...
中文: 话说有人告诉我领头死爪是濒临灭绝的物种……

EN: Well, we're all going to be endangered if you don't take those monsters down!
中文: 呃，你们要是不除掉那些怪兽，我们全都得濒危！

EN: Two Alpha Deathclaws have decided to make their home at the old Grotton Depot. Yikes! Time to bring out the big guns!
中文: 两只领头死爪决定把旧的格罗顿仓库当做他们的家。太可怕！是时候拿出大家伙（枪）了！

EN: Duo of Destruction: Alpha Deathclaws
中文: 双重毁灭：领头死爪

EN: Kill the first Alpha Deathclaw.
中文: 杀死第一只领头死爪。

EN: Kill the second Alpha Deathclaw.
中文: 杀死第二只领头死爪。

EN: Put down an angry pair of Alpha Deathclaws!
中文: 放倒一对发怒的的领头死爪！

EN: Gosh. I could see the glow halfway across the waste. Good luck in there.
中文: 天。隔着大半个废土都能看见那绿光。上帝保佑。

EN: A pair of Glowing Ones have taken over an old Fusion Core factory. Toss those Ghouls out on their keisters!
中文: 两只发光种占领了一处旧的聚变核心工厂。赶紧解决掉他们。

EN: Duo of Destruction: Glowing One (x2!)
中文: 双重毁灭：发光种(x2!)

EN: Eliminate the first Glowing One.
中文: 除掉第一只发光种。

EN: Eliminate the second Glowing One.
中文: 除掉第二只发光种。

EN: Put down the pair of Glowing Ones at the old Fusion Core factory!
中文: 拿下旧聚变核心工厂的一对发光种！

EN: Those roaches are wrecking our home! Please! Get rid of 'em!
中文: 这些蟑螂正在破坏我们的家！消灭它们！

EN: Two Glowing Radroaches have chased the residents of the “Nuclear Arms Apartments” out of their home. Time for a little exterminating.
中文: 两只发光辐射蟑螂把“核子武器公寓”的居民赶出了家门。是时候杀杀虫了。

EN: Duo of Destruction: Glowing Radroaches
中文: 双重毁灭：发光辐射蟑螂

EN: Eliminate the first Glowing Radroach.
中文: 除掉第一只发光辐射蟑螂。

EN: Eliminate the second Glowing Radroach.
中文: 除掉第二只发光辐射蟑螂。

EN: Exterminate the pair of Glowing Radroaches residing at the Nuclear Arms Apartments!
中文: 消灭核子武器公寓里的发光辐射蟑螂！

EN: Thank goodness you're here! We're no match for those chitinous creeps! Take them down for us? Please?
中文: 谢天谢地你在这里！我们可不是这些硬壳怪物的对手！能帮我们消灭它们吗？求求你们了！

EN: Two Glowing Radscorpions are causing havoc in Vault 512! Squash those bugs good!
中文: 两只发光辐射蝎正在512号避难所里兴风作浪！赶紧碾压这些害虫们！

EN: Duo of Destruction: Glowing Radscorpions
中文: 双重毁灭：发光辐射蝎

EN: Eliminate the first Glowing Radscorpion.
中文: 消灭第一只发光辐射蝎。

EN: Eliminate the second Glowing Radscorpion.
中文: 消灭第二只发光辐射蝎。

EN: Exterminate both of the Glowing Radscorpions in Vault 512!
中文: 消灭512号避难所里的两只发光辐射蝎！

EN: If you came for the dog food, you're out of luck. Those momma Mole rats were hungry. Take care of them, will ya?
中文: 如果你们是为了狗粮来的，那么可不走运了。那些鼹鼠妈妈可是饿了，你们帮我们解决下吧？

EN: Two Mole rat brood mothers have been spotted at the nearby dog food factory. It's about time someone took them down.
中文: 两只鼹鼠妈妈被发现出现在了附近的狗粮工厂。是时候有人拿下它们了。

EN: Duo of Destruction: Mole Rat Brood Mothers
中文: 双重毁灭：鼹鼠妈妈

EN: Eliminate the first Mole rat brood mother.
中文: 除掉第一只鼹鼠妈妈。

EN: Eliminate the second Mole rat brood mother.
中文: 除掉第二只鼹鼠妈妈。

EN: Eliminate the two Mole rat brood mothers at the old dog food factory!
中文: 消灭旧狗粮工厂里的两只鼹鼠妈妈。

EN: Dig for GOLD! It's your patriotic duty!
中文: 挖金子去！这可是爱国职责！

EN: Nothing is more important than the National Gold Reserves!
中文: 没有什么比国家黄金储备更重要的了！

EN: Ask not what your country can do for you, but how you can GET MORE GOLD for your country!
中文: 不要问国家能为你做什么，问问你能为国家多搞到多少黄金！

EN: We've discovered the remains of a secret Enclave base. What strange and horrifying stuff will we find?
中文: 我们发现了一座秘密英克雷基地的遗址。不知道能找到什么奇怪又骇人的东西？

EN: Golden Neighbors
中文: 黄金好邻居

EN: Look for valuables
中文: 寻找贵重物品

EN: Look for clues about the Enclave
中文: 寻找关于英克雷的线索

EN: Explore a ruined Enclave base nearby.
中文: 探索附近一座废弃的英克雷基地。

EN: I still can't believe there was an Enclave base so close to our vault.
中文: 我还是不敢相信，离我们避难所这么近就有一座英克雷基地。

EN: And we get to explore it!
中文: 而我们还能去探索它！

EN: Let's look for treasure. And intel. The top secret kind.
中文: 我们找找财宝吧。还有情报。那种绝密的情报。

EN: Why are those eyebots going on about gold?
中文: 为什么那些眼球机器人一直在唠叨黄金的事？

EN: I mean, gold is strategic commodity, but someone must be really obsessed with the metal.
中文: 我是说，黄金确实是战略物资，但肯定有人对这金属着了魔。

EN: Let's see if we can find any clues…
中文: 我们看看能不能找到什么线索……

EN: Rrraaawwrgggh!
中文: 嗷嗷嗷！

EN: Hey, those Mole rats have a nest made of old clothes. Let's take them!
中文: 嘿，那些鼹鼠有个用旧衣服搭的窝。咱们拿走吧！

EN: GOLD! In case you weren't aware, it's the best!
中文: 金子！要是你还不清楚，告诉你，它是最棒的！

EN: Beautiful and practical, truly the ultimate material!
中文: 美丽又实用，真是终极材料！

EN: Friendly reminder that the Enclave is a secret. Don't tell anyone!
中文: 友善提醒，英克雷是个秘密。别告诉任何人！

EN: Take all gold to the National Gold Reserves, or face heavy prosecution!
中文: 将所有黄金上缴国家黄金储备，否则将面临严厉起诉！

EN: Gold is good for wires, not much else.
中文: 黄金嘛，做电线挺好，别的用处不大。

EN: The Enclave is active?
中文: 英克雷还活跃着？

EN: I love gold! Can I have some of yours?
中文: 我爱金子！能分我一点你的吗？

EN: All Enclave personnel should make finding gold their top priority.
中文: 所有英克雷人员都应把寻找黄金作为第一要务。

EN: Remember: Gold Never Gets Old.
中文: 记住：黄金永不褪色。

EN: Hey, sweet! A working terminal!
中文: 嘿，太棒了！一台能用的终端机！

EN: I'll just do a quick word puzzle, uh, I mean, hack the system…
中文: 我这就来个小字谜，呃，我是说，破解系统……

EN: Aha! Got it. And it has the locations of other Enclave bases!
中文: 啊哈！搞定了。上面还有其他英克雷基地的位置！

EN: Uh… It says "Ping sent to all other Enclave servers." That's probably not great. Let's get out of here!
中文: 呃……上面写着“已向所有其他英克雷服务器发送了ping信号。”那恐怕不太好。咱们撤吧！

EN: Combat training 101! Lesson starts now!
中文: 战斗训练101！现在开课！

EN: Combat training 102, multiple enemies! Please demonstrate aptitude!
中文: 战斗训练102，多目标作战！请展示你的能力！

EN: Combat training 103, reinforced enemy! Show me what you got!
中文: 战斗训练103，强化型敌人！让我看看你的本事！

EN: The first Enclave location on our list is an old Vault-Tec vault. They're probably doing something really sinister, sullying our pristine walls and morals.
中文: 我们清单上的第一个英克雷据点是一座旧避难所科技避难所。他们八成在搞什么阴险勾当，玷污了我们洁净的墙壁与道德准则。

EN: Ghost Training
中文: 幽灵训练

EN: Disrupt the training program
中文: 破坏训练计划

EN: Investigate an Enclave training facility in an old vault.
中文: 调查一座老避难所里的英克雷训练设施。

EN: This is supposed to be that Enclave training grounds we found, right?
中文: 这里应该就是我们发现的英克雷训练场，对吧？

EN: I wonder what Enclave training is like. Probably boring and sadistic.
中文: 我好奇英克雷的训练是什么样的。八成又无聊又残忍。

EN: Let's find out!
中文: 咱们去看看吧！

EN: Welcome, recruits! Your training of yesterday begins… today!
中文: 欢迎，新兵！你们昨天的训练……从今天开始！

EN: Bzzzt, hostile sarcasm detected. Lesson number one: respect pre-war America!
中文: 哔——，检测到敌意嘲讽。第一课：尊重战前美利坚！

EN: Bzzzt, hostile intent detected.
中文: 哔——，检测到敌意。

EN: It isn't much, but it's what we've got! Please enjoy your stay.
中文: 虽然简陋，但这就是我们的一切！请尽情享受在这里的时光。

EN: Great, we can learn from centuries old dead guys.
中文: 太好了，我们可以向几百年前的死人学习了。

EN: Actually, we're here to shut you down!
中文: 事实上，我们是来关停你们的！

EN: Pre-war training? In this economy?
中文: 战前训练？在这种世道？

EN: Enjoy our exclusive and intrusive training regimen, based on only the best pre-war training videos.
中文: 敬请享受我们独家且侵入式的训练计划，它完全基于最棒的战前训练视频。

EN: Uhhh, you're not from the E-N-C-L-A-V-E, are you? Don't shoot!
中文: 呃呃，你们不是英-克-雷的人吧？别开枪！

EN: Oh, thanks! I sure hope I don't see you again!
中文: 哦，谢谢！我真心希望再也见不到你！

EN: Oh, no! But I used my pre-war deception training!
中文: 哦，不！但我可是受过战前欺诈训练的！

EN: Oh, sure! Here, it's my rainy day fund!
中文: 哦，当然！给，这是我的应急储备金！

EN: Sure, consider this your lucky day.
中文: 当然，就当你今天走运。

EN: Sounds like something an Enclave patsy would say.
中文: 听起来像是英克雷的走狗会说的话。

EN: Liar. Pay up and you can go.
中文: 骗子。把钱交出来，你就可以走了。

EN: I don't really want to be here! I was, uh, trapped? And brainwashed! Yeah!
中文: 我真不想待在这儿！我，呃，是被困住的？还被洗脑了！对！

EN: So can you please let me go while they're distracted?
中文: 所以他们分心的时候，你能放我走吗？

EN: Humans! Welcome to economics 101.
中文: 人类！欢迎来到经济学101。

EN: WRONG! The answer is… GOLD! With gold, you can buy tons of food and water!
中文: 错！答案是……黄金！有了黄金，你能买到成吨的食物和水！

EN: WRONG! The answer is… GOLD! It's shinier and more useful than whatever you said.
中文: 错！答案是……黄金！它比你刚才说的任何东西都更闪亮、更有用。

EN: WRONG! The answer is… GOLD! With gold, you can buy lots of guns!
中文: 错！答案是……黄金！有了黄金，你能买到一大堆枪！

EN: Water, of course. Food is a close second.
中文: 当然是水。食物紧随其后。

EN: Gold, of course. It's so shiny and useful.
中文: 当然是黄金。它多闪亮、多有用。

EN: Guns, of course. So I can take people's gold and food.
中文: 当然是枪。这样我就能抢别人的黄金和食物了。

EN: Pop Quiz! What is the most valuable item in the world?
中文: 随堂测验！世界上最有价值的东西是什么？

EN: Welcome to the Enclave old-timey training module database.
中文: 欢迎来到英克雷的老式训练模块数据库。

EN: Scallywags! No! Stay away from our precious database!
中文: 小坏蛋！不！离我们珍贵的数据库远点！

EN: Just the sound of their destruction, if you don't mind.
中文: 只是想听听它们被摧毁的声音，如果你不介意的话。

EN: What training module would you like to deafen yourselves with today?
中文: 你们今天想用哪个训练模块来震聋自己？

EN: Arrrrgh!
中文: 嗷嗷嗷！

EN: Hungry! So hungry!
中文: 饿！好饿！

EN: FOOD! EAT NOW!
中文: 食物！现在就吃！

EN: Our metal detectors picked up a heavy signal of pure gold at a nearby megastore building. Could be worth checking out!
中文: 我们的金属探测器在附近一座大型商场建筑里捕捉到了纯金的强烈信号。值得去查查看！

EN: Gold-R-Us
中文: 黄金卖场

EN: Find some gold!
中文: 找到一些金子！

EN: Look for gold at an old megastore building.
中文: 去一座旧的大型商场建筑里寻找黄金。

EN: The Overseer said we'd find some gold here.
中文: 监督者说我们在这儿能找到金子。

EN: But I don't smell gold…
中文: 可我闻不到金子的味道……

EN: I smell Feral Ghouls. Gotta be careful.
