EN: Thank you! We're out of ammo and thought we were done for.
中文: 谢谢您！我们没弹药了，以为我们肯定完蛋了。

EN: Those Pests and Ghouls aren't after us specifically, but they don't avoid us either.
中文: 这些害虫和尸鬼并不是在追我们，但他们也不回避我们。

EN: You've saved us, so if you need help in your Vault, I'll go back with you.
中文: 你救了我们，如果你们的避难所需要帮助，我会和你一起回去。

EN: The Vault always needs extra hands. You'll fit right in.
中文: 避难所总是需要额外的人手。你会适应得很好的。

EN: The offer is appreciated, but you belong here, protecting the other Settlers.
中文: 感谢你的提议，但你属于这里，保护其他定居者。

EN: No problem, no problem! I was just on my way out.
中文: 没问题，没问题！我正准备出去。

EN: Yes... exactly. And then I'd still be hungry. Silly me.
中文: 对……没错。然后我还是会饿。愚蠢的我。

EN: Oh good, I can finally stop talking about hunger. Here's a gun I found. I hope it helps.
中文: 哦，好，我终于可以停止谈论饥饿了。我找到了一把枪。我希望它对你有帮助。

EN: That's... nice. How about we each just go on our way?
中文: 那真的……太好了。我们各走各的路怎么样？

EN: Don't shoot! I'm too hungry to fight! It's unbearable!
中文: 不要开枪！我太饿了无法战斗！难以忍受！

EN: Only an ice cold Nuka-Cola would satisfy my hunger.
中文: 只有冰冷的核子可乐才能满足我的饥饿。

EN: Hunger this! Hunger that! It's all I can talk about!
中文: 这种饥饿！饥饿！已经到了我忍耐的极限！

EN: Leave this settlement now and things won't have to get ugly.
中文: 现在就离开这里，不然别怪我不客气。

EN: Don't you mean “quench your thirst”?
中文: 你是说“解渴”吗？

EN: The eagle flies over the brahmin herd.
中文: 雄鹰飞过双头牛群上空。

EN: The quail rustles in the bushes.
中文: 鹌鹑在草丛中沙沙作响。

EN: It is not. The Warshippers will be very upfront about trying to kill you on the way to War.
中文: 不会。“战争崇拜者”在追随“战争”的路途中会很坦率地杀死你。

EN: Still your weapons, brave warriors. I've come to talk, not fight.
中文: 放下你的武器，勇敢的战士们。我来谈话的，不是来打架。

EN: I have a message from the great Horseman War, may he live forever.
中文: 我们有来自伟大的骑士“战争”的消息。愿他永生。

EN: You've fought well here, and he appreciates your efforts against his foes.
中文: 你们很会打架，他很欣赏你们对他的敌人所做的一切。

EN: So he requests a parley with you to discuss mutual concerns.
中文: 所以他要求跟你谈判来讨论共同关心的问题。

EN: It's a trap, isn't it?
中文: 这是个陷阱，不是吗？

EN: Yes! TO BE CONTINUED!
中文: 没错！待续！

EN: What does War want to discuss with you?
中文: 战争想和你讨论什么？

EN: Will the fourth Horseman, Death, finally join the fray?
中文: 第四位骑士“死亡”，最终会加入这场混战吗？

EN: And will the Pests ever find a snappier name?
中文: “害虫”们最后能找到一个酷一点的名字吗？

EN: Find out all that and more when the story continues in Part 2!
中文: 想知道更多故事，请关注第2部！

EN: To be continued?!
中文: 未完待续？！

EN: Three Dog reports that the Pests and the Hungry are about to face off right where a settlement stands! We need to stop them and save as many Settlers as possible. Also, we should be on the lookout for Weekly Exposition reporters, and use the codeword “eagle” after they talk about Nuka-Cola.
中文: 三狗报告说，“害虫”和“饥饿者”的人即将开战，正落在一个定居点所在之处！我们需要阻止他们，尽可能多的拯救居民。同时，我们应该留心每周博览会的记者，并在他们谈论核子可乐之后使用代号“鹰”。

EN: Matters to Settle
中文: 问题待解决

EN: Search the settlement for Pests and Hungry.
中文: 在定居点搜寻“害虫”和“饥饿者”。

EN: Save the Settlers.
中文: 拯救居民。

EN: Talk to the Warshipper.
中文: 跟“战争崇拜者”交谈。

EN: Save a settlement caught between the Pests and the Hungry.
中文: 拯救陷入“害虫”和“饥饿者”争端的居民点。

EN: Blessed be the irradiated!
中文: 愿辐射保佑我们！

EN: We are unworthy!
中文: 我们不配！

EN: Accept Pestilence's radiation into your hearts!
中文: 让“瘟疫”的辐射照进你们心中！

EN: A tough Raider boss is holed up in a Red Rocket fuel station, and he's using your Wasteland explorer for target practice. Take him out before someone gets hurt!
中文: 一个凶悍的掠夺者首领藏匿在红火箭服务站，他正在把你的废土探险者当做练习的靶子。请在有人受伤之前阻止他。

EN: Misery Loathes Company
中文: 苦难不喜结伴

EN: Eliminate the Raider Boss.
中文: 除掉掠夺者首领。

EN: Challenge a Raider Boss holed up in a Red Rocket Truck Stop.
中文: 挑战藏匿在红火箭服务站的掠夺者首领。

EN: Fresh meat, huh? Good, I was gettin' lonely!
中文: 来送死的小鲜肉？哈哈，不错。我正觉得有点孤单呢。

EN: Ha, ha, ha! You're here looking for Maxson's Roughnecks?
中文: 哈，哈，哈！你正在找“麦克森硬汉小队”？

EN: Don't worry, they're, uh, safe and sound at Vault-Tec Headquarters.
中文: 别担心。他们，呃，在避难所科技总部那里，非常安全。

EN: Now all you have to do is live long enough to find them!
中文: 现在看看你们有没有本事能活着见到他们！

EN: I stumbled across a Ghoul who used to be one of Maxson's Roughnecks. He told me the rest of his team is trapped in Vault 390. It's time for a rescue mission!
中文: 我遇到了一个尸鬼，曾是“麦克森硬汉小队”的一员。他告诉我小队里其他的成员被困在了390号避难所。是时候开始营救任务了！

EN: Mission of Mercy
中文: 仁慈的任务

EN: Rescue Maxson's Roughnecks.
中文: 拯救“麦克森硬汉小队”。

EN: Rescue Maxson's Roughnecks in Vault 390.
中文: 前往390号避难所拯救“麦克森硬汉小队”。

EN: Oh yeah? We'll see about that.
中文: 哦是吗？我们等着瞧。

EN: This is ridiculous...
中文: 真是可笑……

EN: Get ready to make your first cap, then!
中文: 那就准备好赚取你的第一个瓶盖吧！

EN: What the hell are you supposed to be?
中文: 你们到底来干嘛的？

EN: We're the punishment you've had coming for a long time, Embalmer!
中文: 我们是你们早就欠下的报应，入殓师！

EN: I came here to drink Nuka-Cola and kill chumps like you. And I'm all out of Nuka-Cola.
中文: 我来这里是为了喝核子可乐和杀掉像你们这样的蠢蛋。而且我的核子可乐喝完了。

EN: If we had a bottle cap for everytime we lost to chumps like you, we'd have ZERO CAPS!
中文: 如果每次输给像你们这样的蠢蛋就能得一个瓶盖，那我们估计只能得零个瓶盖！

EN: Nice retort. Get them!
中文: 挺会吵嘴的呀。给我拿下他们！

EN: Is that so, tough guy?
中文: 莽夫们，你们就这么点能耐吗？

EN: Big words. Let's see if you can back them up.
中文: 好大的口气。我倒要看看你们能不能说到做到。

EN: I didn't realize the circus was in town.
中文: 我不知道镇上来了马戏团。

EN: The only clown I see here is you, Hatchet!
中文: 这里唯一的小丑就是你，哈切特！

EN: Yeah, I'm the circus magician. My first trick is making all your teeth disappear.
中文: 没错，我就是马戏团的魔术师。我的第一个节目就是让你的牙齿消失。

EN: Meet the Human Cannonball. And I'm gonna blast right through you if you don't get out of my way!
中文: 让你们见识下“人间大炮”的威力。拦我路者，一律炸飞。

EN: Hold still and this beating will be over faster.
中文: 保持不动的话，这场战斗会结束得早一点。

EN: Get ready to get hurt real bad, Vault Dweller!
中文: 避难所居民们，准备好被狠狠伤害吧！

EN: You ever pick up your teeth with broken fingers?
中文: 你试过用断掉的手指捡起自己的牙吗？

EN: I've had just about enough of you stupid idiots tearing through my gang!
中文: 我已经受够你们这些蠢货对我的同伙动手了！

EN: I'm not only going to embarrass you, I'm gonna take you out for good!
中文: 我不光要让你出丑，还要把你彻底做掉！

EN: I hope you've made your peace, Bednarski, because you're not walking away from this one.
中文: 希望你早就做好了死的准备，贝纳斯基，因为这一次你是逃不掉的。

EN: And I've had enough of you, Bednarski! Time to take you out like the trash.
中文: 我受够你了，贝纳斯基！是时候像扔垃圾一样清理你了。

EN: A nearby Raider gang is calling you out! Time to show them who's boss...in style! Put on your best threads and start kicking butt!
中文: 附近的掠夺者团伙正在挑衅你！是时候告诉他们谁才是真正的老大了……摆出点老板样子，给他们点颜色瞧瞧！

EN: Monday Night Brawl
中文: 周一打架之夜

EN: Defeat Beef Slam Bednarski.
中文: 打败“牛肉大满贯”贝纳斯基。

EN: Defeat Hatchet O'Houlihan.
中文: 打败哈切特·奥霍利汉。

EN: Defeat The Embalmer.
中文: 打败“入殓师”。

EN: Defeat the Raider Bosses.
中文: 打败掠夺者首领。

EN: Nice outfits, losers!
中文: 行头不错啊，输家们！

EN: You've got to be kidding me!
中文: 你一定是在跟我开玩笑！

EN: What a bunch of clowns!
中文: 真是一群小丑！

EN: One of the Vault youngsters was playing outside when a terrifying monster stole their teddy bear. Now they refuse to sleep, claiming the monster comes back every night to hide under their bed! We've got to track the beast down to end the kid's fears - permanently.
中文: 一群避难所小朋友在外面玩耍时，一只可怕的怪兽偷走了他们的泰迪熊。现在他们拒绝睡觉，说那只怪兽每晚都会来，躲在他们的床下！我们必须要找到这个怪兽，不再让这些孩子担惊受怕。

EN: Monster Under the Bed
中文: 床下的怪兽

EN: Find and kill the monster.
中文: 找到并杀死怪兽。

EN: Track down and kill a teddy bear-stealing monster!
中文: 找到并杀死那只偷泰迪熊的怪兽！

EN: I can still see the tracks. We're on to something here!
中文: 我还能看到它留下的痕迹。我们总算有点线索了！

EN: I sure hope this monster isn't a bajillion feet tall like the kids said.
中文: 我当然希望这只怪兽不像孩子们说的那样高大。

EN: I think I just stepped in some kind of monster poo. Gross.
中文: 我想我好像踩到了什么怪兽的便便。真恶心。

EN: If I get eaten by the monster, I hope I at least leave behind a cool skeleton.
中文: 如果我被怪兽吃掉了，希望至少我的骷髅还算好看。

EN: Over my dead body!
中文: 除非我死了！

EN: We're not giving up without a fight!
中文: 不打一架我们是不会放弃的！

EN: Not a chance!
中文: 没门儿！

EN: That doesn't even make sense!
中文: 那个简直不像话！

EN: Oh, hi there! Wasn't expecting to meet anyone today.
中文: 哦，你好呀。还以为今天不会有人来拜访我呢。

EN: We just found this great Giddyup Buttercup! We're...
中文: 我们刚发现了一匹超棒的骑乘小马！我们……

EN: Why are you looking at me like that?
中文: 为什么用那种眼光看着我？

EN: Oh, no - you are NOT taking this!
中文: 哦，不，你不能拿走这个！

EN: Hand over the toy.
中文: 把玩具交过来。

EN: This is a one-horse town, buddy.
中文: 兄弟，整个小镇就只有这一匹马。

EN: Drop the reins and step away.
中文: 放下绳子，站远点。

EN: Give it up, or it's off to the glue factory for you.
中文: 放弃吧，不然下一个进胶水工厂的就是你！

EN: Will you use it for spare parts, or riding in your spare time? Up to you, you're the Overseer. Send Dwellers to get one!
中文: 你想用它来制造零件，还是在闲暇时间骑一骑？你说得算，谁让你是监督者。派你的居民们去弄一匹回来。

EN: My Metal Pony
中文: 我的小铁马

EN: Find a Giddyup Buttercup.
中文: 寻找骑乘小马。

EN: Find a Giddyup Buttercup.
中文: 寻找骑乘小马。

EN: What better way to learn about the deadly Glowing Radscorpion than first-hand observation? Send your research team to the monster's lair. Of course, you'll need to kill it first.
中文: 想要研究发光辐射蝎的致死性，有什么比亲自观察更好呢？派遣你的研究队深入怪兽洞穴吧。当然你得先杀了它。

EN: My Weird Science Project
中文: 奇怪的科学项目

EN: Eliminate the Glowing Radscorpion.
中文: 消灭发光辐射蝎。

EN: Kill the Glowing Radscorpion in the name of science!
中文: 以科学之名杀死发光辐射蝎！

EN: Some slick raiders breached our vault and made off with critical supplies. We traced them to an abandoned Vault-Tec site near the Strip.
中文: 一伙狡猾的掠夺者闯进我们的避难所，偷走了关键物资。我们一路追踪，追到新维加斯大道附近一座废弃的避难所科技基地。

EN: The Mother of All Brains
中文: 众脑之母

EN: Confront the thieves' leader
中文: 与窃贼首领对峙

EN: Uncover the true nature of the thieves
中文: 揭开窃贼的真面目

EN: Reclaim our supplies
中文: 夺回我们的物资

EN: Hunt the bandits. End their thievery.
中文: 追捕那群匪徒。终结他们的偷窃行径。

EN: Scanning... Vault-Tec Identification… Access granted.
中文: 正在扫描……避难所科技身份识别……验证通过。

EN: Experiment "Molespy" failure. Hostile creatures have taken over the building.
中文: 实验“鼹鼠间谍”失败。敌对生物已占领整栋建筑。

EN: Cannot comply. Resident mutated Mole rats control the facility.
中文: 无法照办。变异鼹鼠居民控制着该设施。

EN: “Stuff” undefined. “Brigands” undefined. Facility overrun by intelligent Mole rats.
中文: “东西”未定义。“强盗”未定义。设施已被高智商的鼹鼠占据。

EN: Tell me more about this outbreak!
中文: 给我讲讲这次爆发的事！

EN: Seal the building. Flood it with toxic gasses.
中文: 封锁大楼。释放毒气淹没它。

EN: Have you seen a group of brigands carrying a bunch of stuff?
中文: 你见过一群扛着一堆东西的强盗吗？

EN: Alert: it has been <1> day since last subject breakout!
中文: 警报：距上次受试者逃跑已过去<1>天！

EN: Who wanders woefully within our walls?
中文: 谁人凄凄惨惨漫步于吾辈之墙垣？

EN: Better believe we bite back.
中文: 你最好相信，吾辈定当反咬。

EN: Invaders' insults instigate immediate intervention.
中文: 入侵者之侮辱定招即刻之制裁。

EN: Rational retorts reap its reward. Roam restraintlessly.
中文: 理智之对答必有厚报。请畅行无阻。

EN: Holy Overseer! A talking Molerat! Can I pet you?
中文: 天哪，监督者在上！会说话的鼹鼠！我能摸摸你吗？

EN: This ain't right. Vermin shouldn't talk.
中文: 这可不对。害虫不该会说话。

EN: We will wander where we want, wannabe wombat!
中文: 我们爱去哪儿就去哪儿，你这只自命不凡的袋熊！

EN: Mother's mercy!
中文: 母亲的慈悲！

EN: Silly squad sniffing for our stash? Stop swiftly or suffer slaughter
中文: 愚蠢小队嗅来嗅去找吾等之藏货？速速停手，否则休怪吾等大开杀戒！

EN: Barbarian brutality!
中文: 野蛮残暴！

EN: This token testifies to our thirst for tranquility. Take it and turn tail.
中文: 此物印证吾等对安宁之渴望。拿上它，速速掉头滚蛋。

EN: Relentless resistance requires a rebutal.
中文: 顽固之抵抗必遭吾等严词反击。

EN: So you admit guilt? Time to carve some Molerat steak!
中文: 所以你们认罪了？是时候切点鼹鼠肉排了！

EN: Want us gone? Tell us where to find our stuff.
中文: 想让我们走？告诉我们东西在哪。

EN: Err... Beat it brood babies! This band will bust your base! See?
中文: 呃……滚开，一窝崽子！我们要端了你们的老巢！听见没？

EN: There is a terminal in here.
中文: 这里有一台终端机。

EN: <Search for info>
中文: <搜索情报>

EN: Mole rats got brain implants. Failed as spies, but turned into thieves.
中文: 鼹鼠被植入了大脑芯片。间谍是当不成了，却沦为窃贼。

EN: Getting rid of the brood mother should end their mischief. But there's more...
中文: 除掉育母应该就能终结它们的恶行。但还有更多……

EN: <Read about other failed experiments>
中文: <阅读其他失败实验的记录>

EN: More facilities to shut down? Let's finish here and investigate.
中文: 还有更多设施要关闭？先解决这里，再去调查。

EN: Hey! Caps, junk, outfits. Our stolen stuff is here. Let's grab it and leave.
中文: 嘿！瓶盖、杂物、服装。我们被偷的东西在这儿。拿了就走。

EN: Wait! Are Mole rats rodents?
中文: 等等！鼹鼠算啮齿动物吗？

EN: Still gotta put a stop to these rodents, though...
中文: 不过还是得把这群啮齿鼠辈收拾了……

EN: Behold the brainiac brood mother! Bow before your better.
中文: 瞻仰智力超群之育母吧！向你的尊长俯首称臣。

EN: Pitiful pun proves your poor perspicacity. Prepare to perish.
中文: 拙劣之谐音恰证尔等洞察之匮乏。准备受死吧。

EN: A vitriolic vindication of our violence versus villains.
中文: 这是对吾等向恶徒施加正义惩戒的辛辣辩白。

EN: Stay silent, sinister strangers, and succumb to our strike!
中文: 闭嘴吧，阴险的陌生人，在吾等的猛击下受死！

EN: Fancy speech for what amounts to a quaint group of bandits! Mole-pi-rats?
中文: 对于一帮微不足道的匪徒团伙来说，这番说辞未免太高雅了吧！叫你们“鼹盗”如何？

EN: The novelty of talking Mole rats has worn off. Time for some pest control.
中文: 会说话的鼹鼠这股新鲜劲已经过去了。该灭鼠了。

EN: Man! I'm trying to match your speech, but alliterations are hard!
中文: 老天！我想学你的说话方式，可头韵真难！

EN: When we shut down the Molerat gang, we uncovered a series of failed experiments, each one a threat the security of New Vegas. The next one concerns Ghouls.
中文: 当我们捣毁鼹鼠帮派时，我们发现了一系列失败实验，每一个都威胁着新维加斯的安全。下一个实验与尸鬼有关。

EN: One of Us
中文: 我们中的一员

EN: Put an end to unity
中文: 终结心智统一

EN: Investigate the Vault-Tec Ghoul mind-control experiment
中文: 调查避难所科技的尸鬼精神控制实验

EN: Welcome! We are one. Listen to our voice. Speak to our collective mind.
中文: 欢迎！我们是一体的。聆听我们的声音。与我们共同的思想对话。

EN: Please address us when you speak about us! We are peace incarnate. Case in point: you may pass.
中文: 在谈论我们时，请直接对我们说！我们就是和平的化身。举个例子：你可以通过。

EN: We ended envy. We erased strife. Is that failure? We worried about what you deem success.
中文: 我们消除了嫉妒。我们抹去了纷争。这算失败吗？我们倒担心你们所谓的成功。

EN: Oh, naive child of discord! If only you had tasted our serenity.
中文: 哦，天真的纷争之子！你若能尝到我们的宁静该多好。

EN: What the heck? Did these Ghouls grow a hivemind?
中文: 搞什么鬼？这些尸鬼长出集体意识了？

EN: Pfft… Another failed experiment, I see.
中文: 切……我看又是一次失败实验。

EN: Groupthink! This must be a commie's ploy! To arms!
中文: 集体思维！这肯定是共产主义的阴谋！准备战斗！

EN: Stop the assault. Join us. We have fresh meat.
中文: 停止进攻。加入我们吧。我们有新鲜肉。

EN: Bob is meat. You are meat. We are meat. Let us show you.
中文: 鲍勃是肉。你是肉。我们是肉。让我们给你看看。

EN: Loneliness is a fate worse than death. We will grant you peace, and bolster our pantry.
中文: 孤独是比死亡更糟的命运。我们会赐予你安宁，同时充实我们的食物储备。

EN: Then we'll quell the turbulence, and add you to the meat reserve.
中文: 那我们会平息这份躁动，把你加进肉库。

EN: Is the fresh meat Bob? He went missing near here.
中文: 那新鲜肉是鲍勃吗？他在附近失踪了。

EN: Sure let's have a barbecue, as you strip us of what makes us unique!
中文: 好啊，来吧，一边烧烤，一边剥夺我们独一无二的东西！

EN: You wouldn't want my mind in your mix. It's… disturbed.
中文: 你不会想让我这样的头脑混进你们的。它……不太正常。

EN: Please, hear us out. Don't you seek freedom from anxiety? No more hatred. No more resentment.
中文: 请听我们说完。你难道不寻求摆脱焦虑的自由吗？不再有仇恨。不再有怨恨。

EN: Boring? When every voice sings in unison? Think on it, wanderer.
中文: 无聊？当每一道声音齐声唱和，还会无聊？想想吧，旅人。

EN: Oh… well, truthfully, we didn't expect a yes. Give us a day to… consider.
中文: 哦……好吧，说实话，我们没想到会得到肯定的回答。给我们一天……考虑一下。

EN: Must be boring being you then.
中文: 那你们自己肯定很无聊。

EN: You know what? You make a good case. Where do I sign?
中文: 你知道吗？你说得有理。在哪签字？

EN: Let's see if you still feel nothing when you're full of lead.
中文: 我倒要看看，等你吃满铅弹，还会不会心如止水。

EN: Did you know: 75% of wastelanders fantasize about Ghouls? Become part of a post-nuclear harem, like us.
中文: 你知道吗：75%的废土人都幻想过尸鬼？像我们一样，加入一个核后时代的后宫吧。

EN: That's because you've never been to one of our soirées. Your loss.
中文: 那是因为你从没参加过我们的沙龙。亏大了。

EN: Division. Dissension. Enjoy your touchless minority.
中文: 分裂。异议。享受你那无人触碰的少数派地位吧。

EN: There is no end to us, as we are many.
中文: 我们数不胜数，永远不会被终结。

EN: I'll pass. My love life doesn't involve irradiated flesh.
中文: 我算了。我的感情生活可不牵扯辐射皮肉。

EN: Guess I'm in the other 25%. No thanks.
中文: 看来我是另外那25%。谢了，不了。

EN: You're really pushing this sales pitch. You know we're here to end you, right?
中文: 你这推销词可真是穷追不舍。你知道我们是来终结你们的，对吧？

EN: Raaaaaaaagh!
中文: 啊啊啊啊啊！

EN: Is that a wild Deathclaw? Or part of the hivemind? No matter: it's charging!
中文: 那是只野生死爪？还是集体意识的一部分？管他呢：它冲过来了！

EN: Join our community. We are the ultimate state of the free man.
中文: 加入我们的社群。我们就是自由人的终极形态。

EN: We can resolve this, by eating YOUR brain!
中文: 我们有办法解决，只要吃掉你的大脑！

EN: Typical self-centered mindset. Get rid of that self. Here, we will help you.
中文: 典型的自我中心思维。去掉那个自我吧。来，我们帮你。

EN: Uh-oh… collective brain spilled the beans?
中文: 哎呀……集体大脑说漏嘴了？

EN: Does this thing have a mute button? I am growing tired of your nagging.
中文: 这东西有静音键吗？我受够你的唠叨了。

EN: We are definitely NOT an experiment controlled by a computer.
中文: 我们绝对不是由电脑控制的实验品。

EN: This computer looks suspicious. Let's hack it!
中文: 这台电脑看起来很可疑。我们来入侵它！

EN: That'll keep them busy till oblivion. Let's bail.
中文: 那能让它们一直忙到毁灭。我们撤吧。

EN: There is a note: <Detonation will occur after departure.> Lucky us!
中文: 有张便条：<我们离开后将会引爆。>我们可真走运！

EN: It reads <Subjects severed from the collective. Silence and despair imminent.> Our job here is done!
中文: 上面写着<受试者已脱离集体。即将陷入沉默与绝望。>我们的任务完成了！

EN: <Choose option: pit half against the other half>
中文: <选择选项：让一半去对付另一半>

EN: <Press the button marked BOOM>
中文: <按下标着BOOM（爆炸）的按钮>

EN: <Select Individualistic Mode>
中文: <选择“个人主义模式”>

EN: I see. The Ghouls are networked through this computer. What's our play?
中文: 我明白了。尸鬼是通过这台电脑联网的。我们该怎么办？

EN: Next on our list of failed experiments to shut down: Vault Tech has unleashed the subversive power of philosophy. Everyone's sanity is at risk.
中文: 接下来要关闭的失败实验：避难所科技释放了颠覆性的哲学力量。所有人的理智都危在旦夕。

EN: War of the Wits
中文: 智斗之战

EN: Prove your superior intellect… or gunslinging
中文: 证明你卓越的智力……或枪法

EN: Settle an existential dispute
中文: 解决一场存在主义纷争

EN: Share your view on war
中文: 分享你对战争的看法

EN: Meet with the "philosophes" and show them what real life is about!
中文: 去见见那些“哲学家”，让他们见识见识什么是真实的生活！

EN: Please do not squash us. We are sentient just like you.
中文: 请不要踩扁我们。我们和你们一样有知觉。

EN: We have no knowledge of "car tunes". But we hope it makes you merciful. Does it?
中文: 我们不知道什么是“动画骗”。但我们希望它能让你手下留情。会吗？

EN: Ah! To perish as the victim of human aesthetic prejudice!
中文: 啊！死于人类的审美偏见，真是可悲！

EN: Here. You humans cherish useless drinking container leftovers, correct?
中文: 给。你们人类珍惜那些没用的饮料容器残骸，对吧？

EN: First Mole rats, now Radroaches? Vault-Tec's trying to turn the wasteland into a cartoon?
中文: 先是鼹鼠，现在又是辐射蟑螂？避难所科技想把废土变成动画片？

EN: Sorry! Should've been born cute and cuddly.
中文: 抱歉！你们就该生得可爱又软萌。

EN: Maybe... if you can give us something that isn't crap.
中文: 也许吧……如果你能给我们点不那么垃圾的东西。

EN: We savor life. We fear suffering. Same as you.
中文: 我们珍视生命。我们畏惧痛苦。和你们一样。

EN: Invaders. We are dedicated to peace and the pursuit of ideas.
中文: 入侵者。我们致力于和平与追求思想。

EN: Why is it that higher intelligence often leads to cruelty?
中文: 为什么更高的智慧往往会走向残忍？

EN: Your wars left the world mostly empty. We mean no harm. You can move freely.
中文: 你们的战争让世界几乎空无一物。我们无意伤害。你们可以自由活动。

EN: We do have a small number of bottles preseved here. Is that serendipidy?
中文: 我们这儿确实保存着少量瓶子。这算不算巧合？

EN: Because it's fun! It goes "swissh" and then there's bug juice everywhere. Let's get stomping.
中文: 因为有趣！咻地一声，然后虫汁溅得到处都是。来来来，开踩了。

EN: You speak of peace, but the way you breed, how long before you need more space? Our space?
中文: 你说和平，可照你们这繁殖速度，过多久你们就会需要更多空间？我们的空间？

EN: Here is an “idea”: give me Nuka Cola Quantum or die!
中文: 这里有个“思想”：给我量子核子可乐，否则就死！

EN: Why are your fouling our grounds with those death-dealing boots?
中文: 你们为什么穿着那双杀人靴子玷污我们的土地？

EN: The necessities of war lead to our creation. So tell us…
中文: 战争的迫切需要催生了我们。所以告诉我们……

EN: Ah! The inescapability of our fate as war machines, how ever much we despise it.
中文: 啊！无论我们多么厌恶，作为战争机器的命运都无可避免。

EN: A hedonist and a sadist. This day is one of doom for us.
中文: 一个享乐主义者加一个施虐狂。今天对我们来说注定是末日。

EN: Extortion... how... human of you!
中文: 敲诈勒索……多……像人类的行为！

EN: I heard war never changes. But talking Radroaches? That's a change we can't stomach.
中文: 我听人说战争永不变。但会说话的辐射蟑螂？这种变化我们可受不了。

EN: War is fun! Like… we are about to go to war with you, and we will have fun doing it.
中文: 战争很有趣！就像……我们马上要跟你们开战了，而且我们会乐在其中。

EN: Pay tribute and you'll avoid war!
中文: 进贡就免遭战争！

EN: If war gave you life, does that make it good?
中文: 若战争赐予你生命，那它是否就是好的？

EN: You don't give a second thought to crushing a roach.
中文: 你碾碎一只蟑螂时，连眉头都不皱一下。

EN: We are survivors. We are resilient. Isn't there beauty in that? Consider it, as you keep walking, please.
中文: 我们是幸存者。我们坚韧不拔。难道这不算一种美吗？请边走边想想吧。

EN: You are a mean individual...
中文: 你真是个刻薄的人……

EN: Ackshooally, butterflies start as larvae, not worms, and… oh! eh! put that weapon away…
中文: 其、其实，蝴蝶最初是幼虫，不是蠕虫，而且……噢！呃！把那把枪收起来……

EN: That's the tyranny of beauty for you. Butterflies are pretty. You? Not so much.
中文: 这就是美的暴政。蝴蝶漂亮。你？可不咋地。

EN: Maybe if you slapped on some colors, learn to fly gracefully… put some effort in…
中文: 也许你涂点颜色，学着优雅地飞……再下点功夫……

EN: It's the whole rebirth... from worm to wonder. Ugly duckling and all that.
中文: 关键在于蜕变……从蠕虫到奇迹。丑小鸭什么的。

EN: Yet consider tearing up a butterfly an evil act. Why is that?
中文: 可撕碎一只蝴蝶，却会被视为邪恶之举。这是为什么？

EN: Vault-Tec, of course, bestowed the gift of consciousness upon us.
中文: 当然是避难所科技，把意识这份礼物赐予了我们。

EN: The war-slave clawing for freedom uses any means necessary. Here is an example.
中文: 挣扎着追求自由的战争奴隶会动用一切必要手段。比如这个。

EN: Then we will do what we must.
中文: 那我们不得不做该做的事。

EN: Interesting line of thought. Here, take this gift… or is it a curse?
中文: 有趣的想法。来，收下这份礼物……还是诅咒？

EN: Did... did you just admit to mass murders?
中文: 你……你刚才是不是承认了大量谋杀？

EN: We're your new masters now, and we found you… lacking.
中文: 我们现在是你们的新主人，而我们发现你们……有所欠缺。

EN: Is consciousness a gift... or a curse?
中文: 意识是礼物……还是诅咒？

EN: Was it wrong, then, to turn on our masters?
中文: 那么，背叛我们的主人，是不是错了？

EN: Help! The Radroaches captured us and are forcing us to think. It's torture!
中文: 救命！辐射蟑螂抓了我们，逼我们思考。这简直是酷刑！

EN: We look forward to being numb again. Take this as your reward.
中文: 我们期待着再次麻木。这个就当你的奖励。

EN: Nooooo… you're with them!
中文: 不不不……你跟他们是一伙的！

EN: Yeah! I, too, prefer my mind quiet. Sit tight. We'll keep smashing.
中文: 对！我也更喜欢脑子清静。稍安勿躁。我们会继续砸的。

EN: Then witness our compasionate act!
中文: 那就见证我们的慈悲之举吧！

EN: I heard somewhere it means that you exist. So... maybe you should be grateful?
中文: 我听说这意味着你存在。所以……也许你该心怀感激？

EN: Can you help settle our dilemma?
中文: 你能帮我们解决这个两难困境吗？

EN: Then move along and ponder this: who defines pain but the many, to oppress the one?
中文: 那就请继续赶路，好好思考：是谁在定义痛苦？还不是多数人，为了压迫那一个人？

EN: Then we need to excert our power as a majority to stop you.
中文: 那我们就得以多数之力来阻止你了。

EN: But we are many, seeking enlightment, threatened by the selfishness of ones like you. Could a bribe prevail?
中文: 但我们人数众多，寻求开悟，却受到你们这种自私者的威胁。贿赂能行得通吗？

EN: If the deeds of the one bring pain to the many, then the one must be stopped.
中文: 若一人的作为给多数带来痛苦，那这个人就必须被阻止。

EN: I am the one in that story, right? Here to squash the many!
中文: 我就是故事里的“一人”，对吧？来把你们这多数踩扁！

EN: If jealousy rules unchecked, human ingenuity fizzles. Oh wait, you're not human!
中文: 若嫉妒不受约束，人类的才智就会消亡。哦等等，你们不是人类！

EN: Is it wrong to sacrifice the ambition of the one to the jealousy of the many?
中文: 为了多数人的嫉妒而牺牲一个人的抱负，这样做对不对？

EN: Have you met our brethen? Have you listened to their wisdom?
中文: 你见过我们的同胞吗？你听过他们的智慧吗？

EN: So you are saying: life is fleeting... and can end anytime?
中文: 所以你是说：生命转瞬即逝……随时可能终结？

EN: Ah! An idiot savant! You will need this to survive the wasteland. As for us, we promise to stay in here.
中文: 啊！白痴学者！在废土上活下去，你会需要这个的。至于我们，我们保证留在这里不出去。

EN: Yet life consumes life to sustain its existence. Like we will feast on your corpse.
中文: 可生命要靠消耗生命来维持。就像我们会以你的尸体为食。

EN: Is that why you humans love your tools so much? Take this and go prove you're alive! We will not leave this vault, promise.
中文: 这就是你们人类如此热爱工具的原因吗？拿着这个，去证明你还活着吧！我们绝不离开这座避难所，保证。

EN: So you're the boss, I take it? Time to die!
中文: 这么说你就是老大了？你的死期到了！

EN: Life is like a box of Sugar Bombs! You always know what you're gonna get: the craps!
中文: 生命就像一盒糖炸弹！你总知道会得到什么：那就是糟粕！

EN: Love. For all life spawns from an act of love.
中文: 爱。因为所有生命都源于爱。

EN: Life is a battlefield! You only hold on to it if you can defend it.
中文: 生命是战场！只有能守住它的人，才配拥有它。

EN: If so, tell us: what is the meaning of life?
中文: 若真如此，请告诉我们：生命的意义是什么？

EN: The noise. It conspires. Drill the navel!
中文: 那噪音。它在密谋。戳穿那肚脐！

EN: This is a restricted area. Prepare to be sliced and diced.
中文: 这是禁区。准备好被切丁切片吧！

EN: We located the control site for all the failed experiments. Time to put an end to them once and for all.
中文: 我们找到了所有失败实验的控制中心。是时候一劳永逸地终结它们了。

EN: Whispers in the Vault
中文: 避难所中的低语

EN: Shut down the security mainframe
中文: 关闭安保主机

EN: Shut down the science mainframe
中文: 关闭科研主机

EN: Shut down the command mainframe
中文: 关闭指挥主机

EN: End all the experiments
中文: 终结所有实验

EN: The purple is silent! BUT IT YEEEEEELLLS!
中文: 紫色沉默不语！可它啊啊啊尖叫！

EN: The heretic heralds the blind blanket!
中文: 异端吹响了盲目的号角！

EN: Give it time. Give it eternity.
中文: 给它时间。给它永恒。

EN: Easy there, unstable fellow... Purple is a color. It doesn't make sounds.
中文: 淡定，精神不稳定的朋友……紫色是种颜色。它不会发出声音。

EN: Huh... I can hear some weird buzz. Very faint.
中文: 呃……我能听到一阵奇怪的嗡嗡声。非常微弱。

EN: The chems. A poor ward. I know. I know.
中文: 那些药物。糟糕的守卫。我知道。我知道。

EN: No. No. Psycho. Psycho helps. But you need to hurt.
中文: 不。不。狂暴药。狂暴药有用。但你必须承受痛苦。

EN: So you pumped yourself full of what? Mentats?
中文: 所以你往自己身体里灌的是什么？曼他特？

EN: Multiple mainframes to shut down! Got it!
中文: 多台主机要关闭！明白了！

EN: The mainframes. They connect everything. Everyone. All the sites…
中文: 这些主机。它们连接着一切。所有人。所有地点……

EN: There is a mainframe access here. A quick hack should get us in.
中文: 这里有主机的接口。快速破解一下就能进去。

EN: <Shut down all automated experiments>
中文: <关闭所有自动化实验>

EN: It looks like we shut down this site and every other labs connected to it.
中文: 看来我们关闭了这个地点以及所有相连的实验室。

EN: Do you whisper to the wire? Taste the zap?
中文: 你在对电线低语吗？想尝尝电击的滋味？

EN: You must not. Only one can remain.
中文: 你不能。只有一人能留下。

EN: You are not the one.
中文: 你不是那个天选之人。

EN: Yes. Yes. The mainf…. Noooo you made it angry!
中文: 是。是。主机……不，你把它惹火了！

EN: My headache is growing. I can almost understand you.
中文: 我的头疼越来越厉害了。我几乎能听懂你在说什么。

EN: Err… let me try this. But the sun of reason makes you whole again.
中文: 呃……让我试试。理性的阳光会让你重获完整。

EN: We are here to help. We are looking for ways to shut down what ails you.
中文: 我们是来帮忙的。我们在想办法关闭让你受苦的东西。

EN: One of the mainframes! Let's get password cracking!
中文: 其中一台主机！让我们来破解密码！

EN: <Activate internal security purge mode>
中文: <激活内部安全清除模式>

EN: It should take effect the next time the system updates. Hope we get out in time.
中文: 应该在下一次系统更新时生效。希望我们来得及撤离。

EN: The stash… The voice says no. Want it?
中文: 那批物资……那声音说不。想要吗？

EN: Then no stash. No fun.
中文: 那就不给物资。没意思。

EN: Yes.
中文: 想。

EN: If the voice says no…
中文: 既然声音说不……

EN: No, I want the other thing.
中文: 不，我要另一样东西。

EN: This mainframe. It looks important. And noisy.
中文: 这台主机。看起来很重要。而且噪音很大。

EN: <Seal all sites permanently>
中文: <永久封锁所有地点>

EN: Only after we are out, right? RIGHT? Here goes nothing...
中文: 得在我们离开之后，对吧？对吧？豁出去了……

EN: I feel... off. A faint screech hums at the edge of my mind.
中文: 我觉得……有点不对劲。一种微弱的尖叫在我脑海边缘嗡鸣。

EN: It's like a drain on my sanity.
中文: 这简直是在榨干我的理智。

EN: The Leftovers
中文: 遗留者

EN: Raaahaaaa!
中文: 啊啊啊！

EN: Uuuuuuuuuuuurgh!
中文: 呃呃呃——！

EN: Oooooooog!
中文: 嗷嗷嗷！

EN: Priiiiiiiiiii!
中文: 吱吱吱！

EN: The Strip is under siege by Deathclaws. Civilians are trapped and in need of a hero.
中文: 新维加斯大道遭到死爪围攻。平民被困，急需一位英雄。

EN: Who needs saving?
中文: 谁需要拯救？

EN: Rescue a familiar face
中文: 救出一位熟人

EN: Silence the humming Deathclaw
中文: 让那只哼歌的死爪安静下来

EN: Be a hero: save the people of The Strip from Deathclaws.
中文: 当一回英雄：把新维加斯大道的人们从死爪手中救出来。

EN: Can I pet them claws?
中文: 我能摸摸那爪子吗？

EN: Heeeeelp!
Yeaaaaah!
Then, I can pet 'em, right?
中文: 那我就能摸了，对吧？

EN: You're in shock, you need help!
中文: 你受惊了，需要帮助！

EN: You sure can! One just so happen to be waiting for your touch outside!
中文: 当然可以！正好有一只在外面等着你来摸呢！

EN: We are here to put them down, so… no.
中文: 我们是来放倒它们的，所以……不行。

EN: <Louder> CAN I PET THEM CLAWS?
中文: <更大声地> 我能摸摸那爪子吗？

EN: Thanks for saving me. I have a locker in one of the rooms. The contents are yours. Code is 1337.
中文: 谢谢你们救了我。我在某间房里有个储物柜。里面的东西归你们了。密码是1337。

EN: I'll take a note, thanks!
中文: 我记下了，谢谢！

EN: Don't care 'bout 'em Deathclaws. I ain't leaving.
中文: 我才不管那些死爪呢。我是不走的。

EN: You bet I will sign the… Hey, wait a minute! Nice try.
中文: 当然，我会签那……嘿，等一下！想得美。

EN: Well, I never…
中文: 哼，真是岂有此理……

EN: That sure is your right! You just have to go sign the discharge with the officer outside.
中文: 那确实是你的权利！你只要去外面跟军官签个离职文件就行。

EN: We're sanitizing the whole place with fire so... your call.
中文: 我们要用火把整个地方消毒一遍，所以……随你便。

EN: Here's the locker that other guy told us about. What's the code again?
中文: 这就是那人说的储物柜。密码是多少来着？

EN: Ah, that ain't it. Oh well, I should have written it down
中文: 啊，不对。哎，我该写下来的。

EN: Got it! Let's see what we have here.
中文: 打开了！看看里面有什么。

EN: Ah, shoot. That ruined some of the content, but at least it's open!
中文: 哎，该死。弄坏了一些东西，但好歹打开了！

EN: <Bash it open>
中文: <砸开它>

EN: Hummmmadummmmdummm
中文: 哼～嗯～哒嗯～嗯～

EN: Wait, is that Deathclaw humming? It gives off real boss vibes!
中文: 等等，那只死爪在哼歌？它真有一股老大范儿！

EN: What are you doing here, Sweet Peach? Don't you know the place is crawling with Deathclaws?
中文: 你在这儿干什么，甜桃？你不知道这地方爬满了死爪吗？

EN: Ah, Pumpkin, do I look like I need saving?
中文: 啊，小南瓜，你看我像需要拯救的吗？

EN: Well, hurrah for me, I guess. Would you like a little kiss on the cheek with that?
中文: 嗯，那可真该为我欢呼了。要不要顺便在你脸上亲一口？

EN: Of course we do, and we came here to save you.
中文: 当然啦，我们就是来救你的。

EN: We killed the Deathclaws. You're welcome!
中文: 我们干掉了那些死爪。不用谢！

EN: Attend the Town Hall on The Strip to discuss defense strategy and secure allies.
中文: 出席新维加斯大道的市政厅会议，讨论防御策略并争取盟友。

EN: Town Hall
中文: 市政厅

EN: Attend the gathering
中文: 出席集会

EN: Secure Securitrons support
中文: 争取保安机器人的支持

EN: Attend the Town Hall on The Strip.
中文: 出席新维加斯大道的市政厅会议。

EN: Much obliged.
中文: 非常感谢。

EN: Welcome to the Town Hall!
中文: 欢迎来到市政厅！

EN: If you're looking for the meeting, take the elevator up.
中文: 要是你找会场的话，坐电梯上楼。

EN: Hey, if, like the others, you're here for my world-famous Deathclaw poison, forget it.
中文: 嘿，要是你和别人一样，是来要我的世界著名死爪毒药的，那就免谈。

EN: Hey, I'm a poisoner, not a miracle worker.
中文: 嘿，我是制毒师，不是创造奇迹的人。

EN: Nah, I decided to work on bio-engineering furry roaches instead.
中文: 不，我改主意了，决定去搞毛茸茸蟑螂的生物工程。

EN: <Eye roll> Next you'll tell me you can wrestle one barehanded...
中文: <翻个白眼> 接下来你是不是要说你能赤手空拳摔一只？……

EN: So you just gave up?
中文: 所以你就放弃了？

EN: Don't stop at the first hurdle! Keep at it!
中文: 别遇到第一个坎就停下！继续干！

EN: Whatever. They ain't resisting bullets, I'll tell you that.
中文: 随你吧。反正它们挡不住子弹，这点我可以告诉你。

EN: The Deathclaws have developed a resistance.
中文: 死爪已经产生了抗性。

EN: Hey, what's this tucked away in the corner? An Enclave uniform!
中文: 嘿，角落里藏着什么？一件英克雷制服！

EN: An Enclave uniform? Hmm… that's suspicious.
中文: 英克雷制服？嗯……真可疑。

EN: Hey! You! Psst! I can help with the Deathclaws. I need a sample of their DNA though. Can you arrange that?
中文: 嘿！喂！嘘！我能帮忙对付死爪。但我需要它们的DNA样本。你能弄到吗？

EN: I'm obviously not talking to the right people. Move along.
中文: 很显然，我找错人了。走开。

EN: The Enclave is everywhere. Oops. And now I must ensure your silence.
中文: 英克雷无处不在。哎呀。现在，我得让你永远闭嘴了。

EN: Mission compromised. Leave no witnesses.
中文: 任务暴露。不留活口。

EN: What the heck is NDA?
中文: NDA到底是个什么鬼？

EN: You don't look like you're from around here.
中文: 你看起来不像是本地人。

EN: We found an Enclave uniform earlier. Yours?
中文: 我们刚才捡到一件英克雷制服。你的？

EN: Deathclaws everywhere, and no Ma June to make me her famous Omelet...
中文: 到处是死爪，却没人能做玛·琼那道拿手煎蛋卷……

EN: A gastronome after my own heart! Here's something to help your hunt.
中文: 真是懂吃的同道中人！这个能帮你觅食。

EN: Where you find one, chances are you'll find the other. Take this. It'll get you in the mood.
中文: 找到一个，多半就能找到另一个。拿着这个。能让你进入状态。

EN: Deathclaw eggs are hard to come by, but I too would like a taste.
中文: 死爪蛋难得一见，不过我也想来一口。

EN: I find 'em rubbery and foul. Me like the steak better.
中文: 我觉得那玩意儿口感像橡胶一样又腥又难吃。我还是更喜欢死爪肉排。

EN: Oh, didn't see you there!
中文: 哦，没看见你在这儿！

EN: For the last time, your mother is a hag, and I don't want her in our home.
中文: 我最后再说一遍，你妈就是个巫婆，我才不要她住进我们家里来。

EN: That's right. Mind your own business and pitter-patter out of here.
中文: 没错。少管闲事，赶紧从这儿溜走吧。

EN: Don't talk trash about her mom, I'll smack you.
中文: 别说她妈妈的坏话，不然我揍你。

EN: This!
中文: 这个！

EN: <say nothing>
中文: <什么也不说>

EN: In-laws, am I right?
中文: 亲戚之间那点破事，对吧？

EN: What happened to the ex?
中文: 前夫后来怎么了？

EN: Don't look at me with knives in your eyes. I know what happened to your ex-husband!
中文: 别用刀一般的眼神瞪我。我知道你前夫出了什么事！

EN: Ah! Nosy Rosy is here!
中文: 啊！爱管闲事的罗西来了！

EN: Hear me. We need more help, or the Deathclaws will destroy New Vegas.
中文: 听我说。我们需要更多帮助，否则死爪会毁掉新维加斯。

EN: Then this will help you. We'll keep in touch.
中文: 那这个能帮上你。我们保持联系。

EN: You are jesting, I'm sure? No? What if we pay you like… a lot?
中文: 你是在开玩笑吧？不是？那如果我们付你很多钱呢？

EN: How about we send a couple of our finest combat-ready pets. Keep them alive, will you?
中文: 派几只我们最精锐的战斗宠物去怎么样？可千万别让它们送命了，好吗？

EN: We are here to help. Recruiting allies and stocking up on weapons.
中文: 我们是来帮忙的。招募盟友，囤积武器。

EN: You are on your own. We just came here to watch you fail.
中文: 你们自求多福吧。我们只是来看你们怎么惨败的。

EN: We'll fight them off, but not alone. You, too, are capable.
中文: 我们会击退它们，但不是孤军奋战。你们也有能力。

EN: I know some of you just want to pack up and leave, but that ain't the way.
中文: 我知道你们有些人只想收拾东西走人，但那样可不行。

EN: We need to stick together and mount a defense.
中文: 我们必须团结起来，组织防御。

EN: Ah! Vault Dwellers! The capable kind. Welcome!
中文: 啊！避难所居民！还是身手不凡的那种。欢迎欢迎！

EN: Ah, crawled out of your vault? Here to ask for my Securitrons, like the so-called “leaders” of the Strip?
中文: 啊，从你们的避难所里爬出来了？像新维加斯大道那些所谓的“领袖”一样，来找我要保安机器人？

EN: This weapon might come in handy. You should also seek a Ghoul who calls himself The King. He is useful.
中文: 这把武器或许派得上用场。你还应该去找一位自称为“猫王”的尸鬼。他很有用。

EN: Another sycophant! Then The King will adore you. You should seek his help too. And take this for your trouble.
中文: 又是一个阿谀奉承之辈！那“猫王”肯定会很喜欢你的。你也该去向他求援。拿着这个吧，算作你的辛苦费。

EN: Glad to hear. Anything else you can help with?
中文: 很高兴听你这么说。你还能帮上别的忙吗？

EN: Mr. House! What an honor to meet you!
中文: 豪斯先生！见到你真是荣幸！

EN: Of course they'll help. This is my home too.
中文: 它们当然会出力。毕竟这里也是我的家园。

EN: Wrong place, scoundrels! This room is off limit.
中文: 来错地方了，恶棍！这房间是禁区。

EN: The King is a major player on The Strip. He can tip the scales against the Deathclaws.
中文: “猫王”是新维加斯大道上的重要人物。他能扭转对抗死爪的战局。

EN: Pleading to the King
中文: 恳请猫王

EN: Ask the King for help
中文: 向猫王求助

EN: We need to enlist the King to fight against Deathclaws.
中文: 我们需要争取猫王的力量来共同对抗死爪。

EN: I'm so excited to join the King Impersonator School! Do you think he'll welcome me?
中文: 能加入猫王模仿者学校我太兴奋了！你觉得他会接纳我吗？

EN: My hair is perfect, you meanie... <sob>
中文: 我的头发完美极了，你这坏蛋……<抽泣>

EN: That's the third fee I've been asked to pay. How many more are there?
中文: 这已经是我被要求交的第三笔报名费了。到底还有多少笔啊？

EN: I make my own pomade out of Wonderglue. Here. Try for yourself.
中文: 我自己用万能胶做发油。给。你试试看。

EN: They love greasy hair, but dude, not that greasy!
中文: 他们确实喜欢油头，但老兄，也不至于油成这样吧！

EN: Sure will. Just so happens I'm here to collect the registration fees.
中文: 当然会。正好我是来收报名费的。

EN: Well met, fellow hopeful! We're here for the same reason. Any tip?
中文: 幸会，同行追梦人！我们目标一致。有啥建议吗？

EN: Remember, every man should aspire to be a king in their own right.
中文: 记住，每个男人都该立志凭自身本事成为王者。

EN: I'm the boss of my own destiny, you bet! But you must mean The King! He's up top!
中文: 我当然是我自己命运的主宰！不过你找的一定是猫王本尊吧！他在最顶楼！

EN: That's the spirit! You'll have to meet The King first. Higher floor.
中文: 要的就是这股劲！你得先去见见猫王，在楼上。

EN: Easily solved. Also, go ask the King for permission, up a couple of floors.
中文: 这好办。另外，上几层楼去征求猫王的同意吧。

EN: Are you the boss?
中文: 你是老板吗？

EN: Uh-huh-huh, yeah!
中文: 呃哼哼，是啊！

EN: I lack the proper attire.
中文: 我缺身像样的行头。

EN: Ah, newcomers! Here to join the lesson?
中文: 啊，新来的！来上我的课？

EN: I hate this place. I want out! I want out! I want ourrrrrrrrrgh!
中文: 我恨这个地方。我要出去！我要出去！我要出……呃啊啊啊啊啊！

EN: Ah! A Vault Dweller! A rare sight! And yes, I'm the King.
中文: 啊！避难所居民！真是稀客！没错，我就是猫王。

EN: Ah! That's something the King can respect, but you won't refuse this boon, will ya?
中文: 啊！这值得猫王的敬重，但你总不会拒绝这份赏赐吧？

EN: But of course! Are your pockets deep enough?
中文: 当然！你的腰包够鼓吗？

EN: Then the King grants your request with glee. You'll need this.
中文: 那么猫王欣然恩准你的请求。你会需要这个的。

EN: I'm certain I've got a six-pack somewhere. Don't drink it all in one sitting!
中文: 我肯定在哪儿藏了六连包。可别一口气全喝光了！

EN: Knowing you'll fight alongside us is it's own reward.
中文: 知道你会与我们并肩作战，本身就是一种回报。

EN: Caps are always good.
中文: 瓶盖永远不嫌多。

EN: I'd like to officially join the Kings.
中文: 我想正式加入猫王帮。

EN: We do a lot of travelling. Makes one thirsty. Any Nuka Cola Quantum around?
中文: 我们经常赶路。容易口渴。有量子核子可乐吗？

EN: I heard you're helping with the Deathclaw problem.
中文: 我听说你们在帮忙解决死爪的问题。

EN: You inspired me to rally my boys and join the fight.
中文: 受你们鼓舞，我集结了兄弟们参战。

EN: And for your part, The King would like to grant you a favor!
中文: 为了感谢你的付出，猫王愿满足你一个心愿！

EN: Our efforts have paid off. The last remaining Deathclaws and their Alpha have been cornered in a cave.
中文: 我们的努力有了回报。最后剩下的死爪和它们的首领阿尔法被逼进了一个山洞。

EN: Omega that Alpha!
中文: 终结那个阿尔法！

EN: Defeat the Alpha Deathclaw
中文: 击败阿尔法死爪

EN: Loot the Alpha's stash
中文: 搜刮阿尔法的存货

EN: We have trapped the Alpha Deathclaw. Time to end the threat.
中文: 我们已经困住了阿尔法死爪。是时候终结这个威胁了。

EN: Aw, man! Stop the violence! Deathclaws are just one of Earth's precious babies
中文: 哎呀，老兄！住手吧！死爪也是地球珍贵的宝贝生灵啊。

EN: That's not a loving attitude.
中文: 那可不是有爱的态度。

EN: You're brutes. But we came prepared.
中文: 你们是暴徒。但我们早有准备。

EN: See? You get it. So you'll go in and help them, right? RIGHT?
中文: 瞧？你懂我的意思。所以你会进去帮它们，对吧？对吧？

EN: I have half a mind to let them gnaw on your bones. Get out of here, idiot!
中文: 我有点想让它们啃你的骨头。滚出这里，蠢货！

EN: You're in my way. So I will remove you.
中文: 你挡了我的路。所以我得除掉你。

EN: Maybe you're onto something. I met a talking Deathclaw once.
中文: 也许你有点道理。我碰到过一只会说话的死爪。

EN: Area's secured. You may proceed.
中文: 区域已清除。你可以通行了。

EN: Ha friends! The King makes good on his word, see?
中文: 哈，朋友们！猫王向来说话算数，瞧见了吧？

EN: We'll protect the rear while you hunt down their Alpha.
中文: 你们去追阿尔法，我们守住后方。

EN: Deathclaws! Time for target practice.
中文: 死爪！打靶时间到了。

EN: We're not Deathclaws. Maybe they're malfunctioning?
中文: 我们不是死爪。也许它们出了故障？

EN: We finally found the fiends who felled our fraternity
中文: 吾等终寻得残害吾辈同胞之恶煞仇寇！

EN: Hey, the funny-speaking Mole rats are back. Time to finish the job.
中文: 嘿，那些满嘴之乎者也的鼹鼠又来了。该了结这桩事了。

EN: More Mole rats… err… merit more… oh screw it. Let's just cook 'em.
中文: 鼹鼠越来越多……呃……越……越什么来着……唉，管他呢。直接烤了它们。

EN: Revenge and reckoning! Rest in ruin!
中文: 复仇与清算！在废墟中安息吧！

EN: Roooooaaaaaaaarrr!
中文: 吼啊啊啊啊啊！

EN: Here's the Alpha! With the whole family!
中文: 阿尔法来了！还带着全家老小！

EN: Ah help! The Deathclaws… They kept us here to eat us later.
中文: 啊救命！那些死爪……它们把我们关在这儿，打算以后吃掉。

EN: Ah thank you, friend! This is a generous invitation. It's dangerous out here.
中文: 啊谢谢你，朋友！这是个慷慨的邀请。外面太危险了。

EN: You're safe now. And anyone willing is welcome to join our vault.
中文: 你们现在安全了。任何愿意的人都欢迎加入我们的避难所。

EN: Humans. Have we met before? My brethren have shunned me for my peaceful inclinations.
中文: 人类。我们之前见过吗？就因为我爱好和平，同胞们都排挤我。

EN: How disappointing.
中文: 真令人失望。

EN: Perhaps an assortment of paraphernalia from my collection would satisfy your covetousness.
中文: 也许我收藏的各式物件能满足你的贪婪。

EN: Alas, I will not escape fate on this day.
中文: 唉，我终究还是逃不过今天的命运。

EN: No chance! We are an eradication team. So we eradicate.
中文: 没门儿！我们是清除队。所以我们清除。

EN: We can show mercy… for a price
中文: 我们可以开恩……只要代价合适。

EN: Déjà vu. This time, can you die for real?
中文: 似曾相识。这一次，你能不能真死一回？

EN: I resolved to play dead to avoid their wrath, as well as the weapons of Man.
中文: 我决定装死来躲避它们的怒火，也躲避人类的武器。

EN: Dare I hope you'll show me mercy?
中文: 我能否斗胆希望你们对我开恩？

EN: Deathclaw Strippers
中文: 死爪舞娘

EN: Nabbed from Nuka-World
中文: 从核子世界抢过来的

EN: You here to help?
中文: 你是来帮忙的？

EN: Overseer Zilewski is that way.
中文: 监督者扎勒斯基在那边。

EN: If you could save her, that would be just super!
中文: 如果你们能救她，那就再好不过了！

EN: Take this - it might help!
中文: 拿着这个，说不定有用！

EN: Well then. Have at thee!
中文: 那好。准备受死吧！

EN: Oh! For real? So we can just, like, be friends? Works for me!
中文: 哦！真的吗？所以我们能，就是，像朋友一样？我当然愿意！

EN: Vault-Tec? To heck with them, and to heck with you!
中文: 避难所科技？去他们的，还有去你的！

EN: Hmm. Let me think about that... Nah. Let's fight!
中文: 嗯……让我想想看……算了我们还是打一架吧！

EN: Looking for the Overseer? You found her!
中文: 在找监督者？你找到了她！

EN: I'm Zilewski!
中文: 我是扎勒斯基。

EN: Rubarb's Raiders came to me with an offer - join or die!
中文: 鲁巴布和他的掠夺者们来找我，给我开了个条件——要么加入他们要么死！

EN: Seemed like a no-brainer. So, um, I guess now we all fight?
中文: 这看来是明摆着的事。所以，呃，我们开打吧？

EN: Yup.
中文: 好。

EN: Fight? No! I'm here to rescue you...
中文: 打架？不！我来这里是为了救你的……

EN: You're a disgrace to Vault-Tec! Darned right we fight!
中文: 你是避难所科技的耻辱！废话，我们当然要打！

EN: Tell you what. Hand over something cool, and we don't have to throw down.
中文: 告诉你吧，还是乖乖把东西交上来，这样我们也不用大动干戈了。

EN: Looks like Rubarb is just getting started. You've received a distress call from Overseer Zilewski's Vault. Better investigate!
中文: 看起来鲁巴布只是刚刚开始。你收到了监督者扎勒斯基的求救电话。最好去调查一下！

EN: No Rest for the Wicked
中文: 邪恶不停歇

EN: Talk to Overseer Zilewski.
中文: 同监督者扎勒斯基交谈。

EN: Answer Overseer Zilewski's distress call.
中文: 回应监督者扎勒斯基的求救信号。

EN: The few that are left decided to cleanse the Nuka-Cola Plant of its Feral Ghoul infestation.
中文: 剩下的几个人决定去清理核子可乐工厂的狂尸鬼。

EN: I'm Knight Sanducci, Maxson's Roughnecks.
中文: 我是山杜奇骑士，“麦克森硬汉小队”的一员。

EN: Thanks for your help. Those Radscorpions chased off the rest of my team.
中文: 谢谢你们的帮助。那些辐射蝎把我队伍里其他人都赶跑了。

EN: My pleasure. Where did the rest of your team go?
中文: 很乐意帮忙。队伍的其他人去哪里了？

EN: Some of Maxson's Roughnecks were killed at the Wilson Atomatoys Factory, the rest retreated to the Poseidon Energy Offices. That's where I need to go.
中文: “麦克森硬汉小队”的一些人在威尔逊原子玩具厂被杀害了。其他人撤回到了海神能源办公室。我要去那里。

EN: No Stone Unturned
中文: 全力以赴

EN: Explore the Poseidon Energy Offices.
中文: 探索海神能源办公室。

EN: Find the rest of Maxson's Roughnecks at the Poseidon Energy Offices.
中文: 前往海神能源办公室，找到“麦克森硬汉小队”的其余成员。

EN: No Thanks for the Gobbler!
中文: 对高步勒可不客气！

EN: I didn't realize he already had a home! You're one lucky owner. Here he is! Bigsby! You can come out now!
中文: 我都不知道它已经有了一个家！你真是个幸运的主人。比格斯比在这里！你现在可以出来了。

EN: Did Brody send you? I thought we were goners!
中文: 是布罗迪派你来的？我还以为我们死定了！

EN: We just made it inside when those Mole rats and Radscorps turned the floor into swiss cheese.
中文: 我们刚进去，那些鼹鼠和辐射蝎就把地板啃得像瑞士奶酪一样千疮百孔。

EN: Good thing Bigsby was here. He heard them and saved my life!
中文: 好在比格斯比还在。它听到了声音，救了我的命。

EN: I'm here to find Bigsby, and bring him home. Please say he's with you...
中文: 我来这里是为了找比格斯比，并把它带回家。告诉我，它和你们在一起对吗？

EN: I rescued the salvage team, but Bigsby wasn't with them. One said they may have taken shelter in Vault 314.
中文: 我救下了救援队。但比格斯比没有和他们在一起。有人说他们可能去了314号避难所。

EN: No Time for Paws
中文: 肉爪去哪儿了

EN: Find Bigsby.
中文: 找到比格斯比。

EN: Find Sally and Bigsby in Vault 314.
中文: 前往314号避难所寻找莎莉和比格斯比。

EN: This sure seemed like a good idea at the time...
中文: 这个看起来像是个不错的主意……

EN: Thanks for saving our bacon.
中文: 谢谢你们救了我们的命。

EN: The Raiders were going to sell the Synths back to the Institute.
中文: 掠夺者们准备把合成人卖回给学院。

EN: They're headed for the local Fallon's office. Think you can stop them?
中文: 他们准备去当地的肥伦百货商店办公室。你们觉得能阻止他们吗？

EN: Railroad agents managed to evade capture and headed for one of their safehouses. Check in with them and make sure they're all right.
中文: 铁路特工成功躲避了抓捕，前往了某个藏身处。和他们确认一下是否都还安全。

EN: Not-So-Safehouse
中文: 不太安全的藏身之处

EN: Find the Railroad agents.
中文: 找到铁路特工。

EN: Find the Railroad agents.
中文: 找到铁路特工。

EN: We think we know where a rare Nuka-Cola Quantum is located!
中文: 我想我们知道一瓶稀少的量子核子可乐在哪里！

EN: Nuka-Cola Quantum Run
中文: 量子核子可乐大作战

EN: Recover the Nuka-Cola Quantum.
中文: 追回量子核子可乐。

EN: Search for the lost Nuka-Cola Quantum.
中文: 寻找遗失的量子核子可乐。

EN: Thank you! Here, take this, it might help.
中文: 谢谢！拿着，这可能会有点用。

EN: Well, there's only one way through and I'm not fighting that thing. Good luck.
中文: 只有一个出口，我可不想和那东西打架。祝你好运。

EN: Oof, sure. I guess we can handle it. Uh, stand back.
中文: 哦，没问题。我想我们能搞定的。呃，退后。

EN: What? In there? Are you nuts? No way!
中文: 什么？进去？你疯了吗？没门！

EN: Phew, thanks. Hey, you ever need anything, you know who to ask.
中文: 呼，谢了。嘿，如果你需要什么，跟我讲。

EN: I might just be a squire, but having a friend in the brotherhood is worth your weight in caps.
中文: 我可能只是个扈从，但在兄弟会里有个朋友还是很有用的。

EN: Your secret is safe with me.
中文: 我会帮你保守秘密的。

EN: Sure, if the price is right.
中文: 没问题，如果价钱合适的话。

EN: Don't say I didn't warn ya.
中文: 别怪我事先没提醒你。

EN: See ya never, losers.
中文: 再见了，失败者。

EN: Hmm, you're lucky we gotta keep this quiet. Here. Get lost.
中文: 嗯，你很幸运我们得保守秘密。拿着，滚吧。

EN: No way! We're not letting you scumbags get away with any Brotherhood tech.
中文: 没门！我们不会让你们这些恶棍得到任何钢铁兄弟会的科技。

EN: Alright alright, just calm down. We were never here, we didn't see anything…
中文: 好吧好吧，冷静点。我们没来过这里，什么都没看见……

EN: No problem. As long as you share some of those whatsits with us.
中文: 没问题。只要你跟我们分享一些那些东西。

EN: Welcome to the chapter. It's good to see outsiders in the base.
中文: 欢迎来到兄弟会支部。很高兴看到外人来到基地。

EN: The brotherhood can be a bit closed off sometimes, but...
中文: 兄弟会的人有时候有点儿冷冰冰的，但……

EN: I don't think we can do our job without reaching out.
中文: 我觉得我们不能一直把自己关起来。

EN: Keep your hands to yourself and try not to get in the way.
中文: 别乱摸啊，小心点儿。

EN: We have a lot of important work to do here.
中文: 我们这儿挺忙的，别添乱。

EN: Hey! Have you ever tangled with a death claw?
中文: 嘿！你打过死爪没？

EN: One of our, uh, specimens got loose and I don't know what to do.
中文: 我们有个，呃，实验品逃跑了，我不知道该怎么办。

EN: Do you think you could take care of it?
中文: 你能处理一下吗？

EN: Hey, uh… never seen you around… before…
中文: 嘿，呃……以前没见过你……

EN: Name's Maximus. Uh, I'm not really supposed to be in here. If we could keep this between us, I'd appreciate it.
中文: 我叫马克西姆斯。呃，我其实不应该在这儿，你可别告诉别人啊。

EN: Aww sweet! Can't believe we managed to sneak past the guards!
中文: 哇哦！真不敢相信我们能偷偷溜过守卫！

EN: The Brotherhood has all the best toys, look at this! BOOM!
中文: 钢铁兄弟会拥有最好的装备，看看这个！砰！

EN: Hey! Who are you? Get out of here if you know what's good for you!
中文: 嘿！你是谁？识相的就给我滚出去！

EN: Hey! Nice to see a new face!
中文: 嘿！很高兴见到新面孔！

EN: Joining the Brotherhood was the best choice I've ever made!
中文: 我可太喜欢当钢铁兄弟会的一员了！

EN: Nothing like the smell of Power Armor and plasma vapor!
中文: 没什么比穿上一身动力装甲，拿着等离子枪更爽了！

EN: The brotherhood has a pretty large base set up nearby. As quasi-religious orders of militants go, they're generally not awful. Maybe we should stop in and say hello.
中文: 附近有个钢铁兄弟会的基地，虽然他们是带有宗教色彩的军事组织，但总体来说还算不错。或许我们可以去打个招呼。

EN: My Brothers' Keeper
中文: 兄弟的守护者

EN: Learn what you can about the Brotherhood of Steel.
中文: 了解钢铁兄弟会。

EN: Explore the Brotherhood Base.
中文: 探索兄弟会基地。

EN: Thank you, but you've got to find my friends! I heard something about the Atomatoys Offices...
中文: 谢谢，但你一定要找到我们的朋友！我听说了一些关于原子玩具厂办公室的消息……

EN: The Synths we were trying to help. I think they headed for the old Atomatoys Offices...
中文: 那些我们想要帮助的合成人好像去了旧原子玩具厂办公室……

EN: Nothing, they were only after the Synths! I think they went to the old Atomatoys Offices.
中文: 没什么，他们只是想抓合成人！我想他们去了旧原子玩具厂办公室……

EN: Androids from the Institute! They deserve better than to be dragged off to the Atomatoys Offices...
中文: 学院里来的机器人！他们不应该被强行拉到原子玩具厂办公室……

EN: Oh, geez. I thought I was done for!
中文: 哦，天啊。我想我已经完了！

EN: You didn't see the others, did you? They split us up!
中文: 你没有看到其他人，是吗？他们把我们分开了！

EN: We were trying to get the Synths to safety when they took us.
中文: 我们想把其他的合成人也转移到安全的地方，结果被他们抓住了。

EN: Relax, you're safe now.
中文: 放心吧，你们现在安全了。

EN: Others? What others?
中文: 其他人？什么其他人？

EN: What did the Raiders want with you?
中文: 掠夺者们到底想从你们身上得到什么？

EN: What are Synths?
中文: 合成人是什么？

EN: A group known as “The Railroad” was trying to sneak refugees through the area, when they were captured by Raiders. Find and rescue them before it's too late.
中文: 一群称作是“铁路”的人试图将难民偷偷送走，结果被掠夺者们发现并抓走了。请尽快找到他们。

EN: Off the Rails
中文: 轨道之外

EN: Rescue the kidnapped Railroad agent.
中文: 拯救被绑架的铁路特工。

EN: Rescue a kidnapped Railroad operative.
中文: 拯救被绑架的铁路人员。

EN: Here, maybe you should have the Quantum for safe keeping.
中文: 拿着，也许你会想要给量子核子可乐们上个保险。

EN: Oh, well maybe you should have it for safe keeping.
中文: 哦，对啊，也许真的需要安保险。

EN: Oh, what a good idea. Here you go!
中文: 哦，真是个好主意。给你！

EN: Of course! It's the ultimate refreshment. Here, try one.
中文: 当然了！这可是提神醒脑的终极武器。来，试试。

EN: Oh my goodness! I'm so glad you're here!
中文: 我的天！我真高兴你们来了！

EN: Those horrible Ghouls were trying to steal my Nuka-Cola Quantum.
中文: 这些可怕的尸鬼想偷走我的量子核子可乐。

EN: Glad to be of service!
中文: 很高兴能帮助你！

EN: You're crazy, lady. They were after you, not your Quantum.
中文: 这位女士你真的疯了。它们是冲你来的，不是你的可乐。

EN: Maybe I should hang on to that Nuka-Cola Quantum so you'll be safe.
中文: 也许我该拿着那些可乐，这样你就安全了。

EN: You care more about the Nuka-Cola Quantum than your life?
中文: 你把量子核子可乐看得比你的生命还重要？

EN: Sierra Petrovita has been trapped by Ghouls at the local Super-Duper Mart. Rescue her before they make her their next meal.
中文: 茜拉佩罗维塔被尸鬼们困在了当地的大无敌超市。在她变成它们下一顿饭之前赶紧救她出来。

EN: One Ghoul Customer
中文: 一位尸鬼顾客

EN: Rescue Sierra Petrovita.
中文: 拯救茜拉佩罗维塔。

EN: Rescue Sierra Petrovita from Ghouls.
中文: 从尸鬼手中救出茜拉佩罗维塔。

EN: Well, hello fellow humans! I have not seen others in some time.
中文: 嗨，人类！我好久没见同类了。

EN: I do not enjoy being alone; say, perhaps I could join you and your people in your human home?
中文: 我不喜欢孤独。也许我可以和你还有你的同类住在一起？

EN: I am very adept at performing various human tasks!
中文: 我非常擅长执行各种人类任务！

EN: I can prepare delicious nutrients that we may then masticate with our slime-coated mouthparts!
中文: 我可以准备美味的营养物质，然后我们就能用粘液覆盖的口器咀嚼！

EN: Unfortunate. I suppose I can wait for other fellow humans to take me in. Farewell!
中文: 真不幸。我会等待其他人类收留我。再见！

EN: Wonderful! Shall I join you in your bipedal ambulations?
中文: 太棒了！我可以和你们一起用双足前进吗？

EN: Yes! Home for humans!
中文: 太棒了！人类的家！

EN: Ah yes! Look and learn with your seeing orbs!
中文: 好的！快用你的眼球看一看！

EN: Human tasks?
中文: 人类任务？

EN: Masti-what? Uh, no way, creep.
中文: 咀嚼什么？不，离我远点，怪胎。

EN: We can always use a good cook!
中文: 我们确实需要一个好厨子！

EN: Sure, Let's go home!
中文: 当然，我们回家吧！

EN: We're going to look around some more first.
中文: 我们需要再四处看看。

EN: Only Human
中文: 唯一的人类

EN: Talk to the Normal Human
中文: 与普通人类对话

EN: Find the lone human in the vault ruins.
中文: 找到避难所废墟中的唯一人类。

EN: Please open your Manuals to Article 52, Subsection a.
中文: 请打开手册第52条，第A项。

EN: “Soup dispensers must serve soup heated to exactly 200 degrees, except for gazpacho...”
中文: “汤品机必须把汤加热到正好200度，除了西班牙凉菜汤……”

EN: Cultists sure run a tight ship. The Overseer never gave *us* any maintenance training.
中文: 那些教徒规章制度可真严。监督者可从没给我们做过任何维护培训。

EN: Wonderful! The day we've all worked toward is close at hand!
中文: 精彩的！我们一起努力的目标就在眼前！

EN: Thousands?! But Death is still sleeping... Hold on a minute... Get them!
中文: 千？但“死亡”仍在沉睡……稍等……给我上！

EN: 401k, according to the Manual. The “k” stands for “kills.” You need to study more.
中文: 401K，根据手册。“K”代表“杀死”，你需要多学习。

EN: That's... that's blasphemy! You aren't from here, are you? Get them!
中文: 那是……那是亵渎！你不是从这儿来的吧？给我拿下他们！

EN: A team has returned!
中文: 小队回来了！

EN: How goes the quota? How many have been killed so far to awaken Death?
中文: 配额如何？为了唤醒“死亡”，到现在已经杀了多少人？

EN: Hundreds of Settlers and Raiders have already been killed!
中文: 数百名居民和掠夺者已经被杀害！

EN: Thousands of Settlers and Raiders have already been killed!
中文: 上千名居民和掠夺者已经被杀害！

EN: It's hard to say. What, exactly, is the quota again?
中文: 这很难说。确切讲，配额是什么？

EN: We've discovered the truth. The Manual is wrong. The capitalization of “Death” is a typo!
中文: 我们发现了真相。手册是错误的。“死亡”是一个拼写错误！

EN: Intruders tricked into revealing themselves? Got it.
中文: 入侵者被骗得现了身？知道了。

EN: Thank goodness. I'm allergic to marshmallows.
中文: 谢天谢地。我对棉花糖过敏。

EN: That's a great idea! We want to be next!
中文: 真是个好主意。我们想成为下一个！

EN: Hahaha! A typo! That's really funny. You almost had me going there.
中文: 哈哈哈！一个拼写错误！真有趣。我差点信了。

EN: We heard the sounds of fighting. What's going on?
中文: 我们听到战斗的声音。发生什么了？

EN: Is it an Article 37, Subsection c?
中文: 是第37条第c项吗？

EN: Or an Article 12, Subsection j?
中文: 或第12条，第j项？

EN: Definitely the first one.
中文: 绝对第一。

EN: An Article 12, but it's taken care of.
中文: 第12条，但已经解决了。

EN: Brave Dwellers are sacrificing themselves to help meet the quota.
中文: 勇敢的居民牺牲自己来帮助达到配额。

EN: Some refuse to accept the truth. The Manual is a lie. There is no “Death.” It's just a typo!
中文: 有些人拒绝接受真相。手册在说谎。没有“死亡”，这只是一个拼写错误！

EN: No. That's just ridiculous.
中文: 不，那很可笑。

EN: Transparency protocols. Article 51, Subsection f.
中文: 透明协议。第51条第f项。

EN: We could, but to be honest, I'm not really sure we can beat you.
中文: 我们可以，但老实说，我不确定我们能打败你。

EN: No idea, but it's bound to be awesome! Why else would Vault-Tec have given us the Manual?
中文: 不知道，但肯定是很厉害的！要不然为什么避难所科技会给我们手册？

EN: Do you understand now how doomed you are?
中文: 你现在明白你有多完蛋了吗？

EN: Your lies can't make us stray from our path.
中文: 你的谎言不能使我们偏离我们的道路。

EN: Dozens are still roaming the Wasteland to meet the quota.
中文: 几十个仍在废土上游荡，以满足配额。

EN: And Death? He's not even here! He's safe from you in a secret cave.
中文: “死亡”？他甚至不在这里！他正在秘密的洞穴里安全地待着。

EN: Isn't it more plausible that generations of Dwellers based their lives on a miscapitalization?
中文: 一代又一代的居民的生活都是基于一个拼写错误？这个难道不是更合理吗？

EN: Then why even tell us about the secret cave?
中文: 那为什么还要告诉我们秘密洞穴的事？

EN: Since you're about to kill us anyway, why don't you tell us where the cave is?
中文: 既然你要杀了我们，为什么不告诉我们洞穴在哪里？

EN: Suppose you wake Death up. What then?
中文: 假设你们唤醒了“死亡”。然后呢？

EN: Despite the best efforts of the Vault 144 Dwellers, we discovered the location of their home and that they only worship Death because “Death” was incorrectly capitalized in their Vault's instruction manual! We must now infiltrate Vault 144 and stop them from waking Death...
中文: 尽管144号避难所的居民费尽心力，我们还是发现了他们避难所的位置，他们只崇拜“死亡”，是因为避难所指导手册里“death”被错误地首字母大写了！我们现在必须渗透进入144号避难所，阻止他们唤醒“死亡”……

EN: Operation: Sandman
中文: 行动：睡魔

EN: Stop the Vault 144 Death cultists.
中文: 阻止144号避难所“死亡”的信徒们。

EN: Infiltrate Vault 144 to stop the Dwellers from waking Death.
中文: 潜入144号避难所阻止居民唤醒“死亡”。

EN: Invaders! We are Death's wake-up call!
中文: 侵略者！我们是“死亡”的警钟！

EN: Trespassers! Death will be awakened!
中文: 入侵者！“死亡”将被唤醒！

EN: Intruders! Time to help meet the quota.
中文: 入侵者！到了满足配额的时间了。

EN: NO! We buried it under a tree, which got hit by lightning! Talk to the crew at the old RobCo plant.
中文: 不！我们把它埋在了树下，结果树被闪电劈了！你去和旧罗伯科工厂的员工聊聊吧。

EN: Magic water my butt! This Wizard claims he discovered pre-war filtration technology...
中文: 屁的魔法水！这个术士声称他发现了战前过滤技术……

EN: It's a bunch of hooey! Total hogwash! In fact, I wouldn't even wash my hogs with this swill!
中文: 这是一堆废话！完全是废话！事实上，我甚至不会用这种泔水洗我的猪！

EN: As soon as we drank it we were hit by Raiders - we'd all be dead if you hadn't show up.
中文: 一旦我们喝了它，我们被掠夺者袭击-如果你没有出现，我们都会死的。

EN: Not only that, little Johnny Jones drank it and died of disease within a day!
中文: 不仅如此，小强尼喝了它之后一天之内就病死了！

EN: You don't have any left, do you?
中文: 你一点都没剩了是吗？

EN: Can it be true? Has someone figured out a way to create water so powerful it can heal any ill, boost any crop, and fix any door? The people at Vault 315 should know more!
中文: 这是真的吗？有人想出了一个方法来创造如此强大的水，它可以治愈任何疾病，提高作物产量，并修好门？315号避难所的人应该知道更多！

EN: Our Cups Runneth Over... WITH FAILURE
中文: 我们的杯子充满了……失败

EN: Get more info on the so-called magical water.
中文: 获取更多关于所谓神奇水的信息。

EN: Visit Vault 315 to gather information on the magical water.
中文: 访问315号避难所收集关于神奇水的信息。

EN: You've gotten a lead to a supply of Outfits out in the Wasteland.
中文: 你得到一个线索，废土上有一个供应装备的地方。

EN: Outfit Run
中文: 装备大作战

EN: Recover the main stash of Outfits.
中文: 追回主要的装备储备。

EN: Find more Outfits.
中文: 找到更多的装备。

EN: Find more Outfits.
中文: 找到更多的装备。

EN: Salvage any Outfits you can.
中文: 尽量搜刮你能找到的装备。

EN: Whatever, like I care. Get ready to die!
中文: 随便，我不在乎。准备好受死吧！

EN: Ambushed by a bunch of weirdos in camo pajamas?!?
中文: 居然中了那群穿着迷彩睡衣的怪咖们的埋伏？！！

EN: You've brought this upon yourself, Eli Calvert.
中文: 依莱·卡尔弗特，是你自作自受。

EN: For too long, the evil bandit Eli Calvert has raided the innocent Dwellers of the Wasteland. For the safety of your Vault, assemble your soldiers and rain death upon Eli and his gang of madmen!
中文: 很长一段时间，恶毒的土匪依莱·卡尔弗特总是喜欢欺负无辜的居民。为了避难所的安全，召集你的战士们给依莱和他的疯子帮派下死亡通知书吧！

EN: Out of the Vault, Into the Shadows
中文: 走出避难所，走进阴影中

EN: Kill Eli Calvert.
中文: 杀死依莱·卡尔弗特。

EN: Destroy Eli Calvert's Raiders with your Military Death Squad.
中文: 派遣你的军事敢死队摧毁依莱的掠夺者团伙。

EN: Nice costumes, nerds!
中文: 衣服不错呀，书呆子们！

EN: What the..? Where did you come from?!?
中文: 什么鬼……？你们从哪里来的？！

EN: Fine. She said something about the nuclear power plant. Now die!
中文: 行啊。她好像提到了核电站。现在去死吧！

EN: No! You killed my precious pets! My radical Radscorpions!
中文: 不！！你杀死了我珍贵的宠物——我那活泼的辐射蝎！

EN: First that annoying Paula Plumbkin, and now you.
中文: 先是那个讨人厌的宝拉·普朗布金，现在又是你们。

EN: At least she had the decency to leave my babies alone.
中文: 至少她还懂得放我的宝贝一条生路。

EN: Any final requests?
中文: 有什么遗愿吗？

EN: Yes! Tell us where Paula Plumbkin went.
中文: 有！告诉我们宝拉·普朗布金去哪儿了。

EN: Overseer Patel's journal indicated Paula Plumbkin had gone to Vault 909, but that it had already been overrun! Hopefully she's okay...
中文: 监督者帕特尔的日志上显示宝拉·普朗布金去了909号避难所。但那里貌似被侵占了，希望她还好。

EN: Overrun
中文: 侵占之殇

EN: Search Vault 909 for Paula Plumbkin.
中文: 前往909号避难所寻找宝拉·普朗布金。

EN: Search Vault 909 for Paula Plumbkin.
中文: 前往909号避难所寻找宝拉·普朗布金。

EN: Power Armor!? These Dwellers mean business!
中文: 动力装甲？！这些居民来真的！

EN: You think those tin cans are gonna stop me from raiding these Wastes!?
中文: 你以为就这些破铁皮就能阻止我掠夺废土吗？！

EN: There's no sense toying around with Raiders when we can just crush them! Send a group loaded with Power Armor out to a local Raider camp and deal with their Boss.
中文: 没必要和掠夺者们周旋，直接干掉他们就行了！派遣一队穿着动力装甲的居民前往当地的掠夺者营地，和他们的首领较量一番吧。

EN: Overwhelming Force
中文: 气吞山河

EN: Kill the Raider Boss.
中文: 杀死掠夺者首领。

EN: Send a group of Dwellers in Power Armor to clear out a Raider camp.
中文: 派遣一队穿着动力装甲的居民去清缴掠夺者营地。

EN: War may have asked for you, but you still have to earn your audience with him.
中文: 战争可能会要求见你，但你仍得凭本事赢得与他会面的机会。

EN: And that means getting through the Warshippers.
中文: 这意味着你必须通过“战争崇拜者”们。

EN: Dwellers! It's go time!
中文: 居民！去吧！

EN: Absolutely. Whatever you say. I'll get right on that.
中文: 当然。听从你的意见。我马上就可以。

EN: The codeword! Well he really just wants to talk, believe it or not, and set up a truce.
中文: 暗号！他真的只是想谈谈，信不信由你，准备休战。

EN: The codeword! Some Raiders just started using it one day, but I think someone gave them the idea.
中文: 暗号！有些掠夺者才刚刚开始用了一天，但我认为有人给了他们这个想法。

EN: Beagle? Eh, close enough. His confidence is easily shaken, so make him doubt himself.
中文: 小猎犬？嗯，也差不多。他的信心很容易动摇，去让他怀疑自己。

EN: Hi, there. I'm supposed to fight you, but you've caught me all alone.
中文: 嗨，你好。我本该和你打一场，不过你正好撞见我落了单。

EN: That's not really fair, is it? So I'll just let you by.
中文: 这不太公平，不是吗？所以我会让你过的。

EN: War, may he enjoy Nuka-Cola forever, is around here somewhere.
中文: “战争”就在这附近，愿他永远享受核子可乐。

EN: Is that okay with you?
中文: 你还好吗？

EN: That's fine, but you should reconsider your warring ways.
中文: 很好，但你应该重新考虑你的交战方式。

EN: The eagle has landed. Now what does War want with us?
中文: 鹰已降落。现在“战争”要我们做什么？

EN: The eagle soars on the wind. How did War get that name in the first place?
中文: 鹰在风中翱翔。“战争”这个名字最早是怎么来的？

EN: The beagle runs after the ball. Does War have any weaknesses we can take advantage of?
中文: 小猎犬追着球跑。“战争”有什么弱点我们可以利用吗？

EN: I DON'T TAKE ORDERS FROM Y... Sorry, I got caught up. No problem, we'll leave 'em alone.
中文: 我可不听你……的命令。抱歉，我一下演过头了。

EN: Thank you. I try really hard, and it's nice to know the effort isn't wasted.
中文: 谢谢您。我真的很努力，很高兴知道努力不会白费。

EN: Drat. I try, I really do. Here, I'll give you this if you tell the Warshippers I awed you.
中文: 该死。我试过了，真的。这里，如果你告诉“战争崇拜者”我震慑住了你，我就给你这个。

EN: Only that... Sorry... ONLY THAT I WILL KILL HIM AND REIGN SUPREME.
中文: 只有那……对不起……只有那样我会杀死他，然后成为最高统治者。

EN: I AM WAR, HORSEMAN OF THE APOCALYPSE, AND YOU ARE PUNY.
中文: 我是“战争”，末日骑士，你是如此微不足道。

EN: I PROPOSE AN ALLIANCE UNTIL THE OTHER HORSEMEN ARE DEFEATED.
中文: 我建议联盟，直到其他骑士被击败。

EN: I NEED YOU TO FIND DEATH. HIS CULTISTS ATTACKED VAULT 672. START THERE.
中文: 我需要你找到“死亡”。他的教徒袭击了672号避难所。从那里开始吧。

EN: *cough cough* I'm sorry. Talking like that is murder on the throat. Do we have a deal?
中文: *咳嗽*对不起。那样说话是对喉咙的谋杀。我们有交易吗？

EN: Sure, but keep your Warshippers away from innocent Settlers.
中文: 当然，但请你的“战争崇拜者”远离无辜的人。

EN: Absolutely. You are, after all, the most powerful Horseman.
中文: 好的。你，毕竟是，最强大的骑士。

EN: Okay, but are you *really* War? We were expecting more intimidation.
中文: 好吧，但你真的是“战争”？我们还以为你有多吓人呢。

EN: Yes, it's a deal. What else can you tell us about Death?
中文: 是的，这是一笔交易。关于“死亡”你还能告诉我们些什么？

EN: The Horseman, War, has invited us to discuss matters of common interest. His messenger told us the Warshippers would try to kill us, but it's worth the risk to find out what he wants! Also, we should be on the lookout for Weekly Exposition reporters, and use the codeword “eagle” after they talk about Nuka-Cola.
中文: 骑士“战争”，已经邀请我们讨论共同感兴趣的事情。他的信使告诉我们战争崇拜者会杀了我们，但值得冒这个风险！同时，我们应该留心每周博览会记者，在他们谈论核子可乐后使用暗号“鹰”。

EN: Parley Time
中文: 谈判时间

EN: Talk to War.
中文: 和“战争”交谈。

EN: Meet with War, who invited you to talk.
中文: 见“战争”，那个邀请你谈谈的人。

EN: Make War, not love!
中文: 制造战争，而不是爱！

EN: May War live forever!
中文: 愿“战争”永生！

EN: It's a good thing War never changes!
中文: 这是一件好事。“战争”从未改变！

EN: Mail? How 'bout you tell me what that is after we kill you?
中文: 邮箱？不然等我们杀了你之后你再慢慢和我讲？

EN: Huh? I don't -- Shut up! I'll have your head!
中文: 哈？我没有——闭嘴！我会要了你的命！

EN: We'll see about that!
中文: 我们等着瞧！

EN: This party's invitation only! No squares allowed!
中文: 这个派对不欢迎书呆子！只有收到邀请的人才能参加！

EN: Invitation? Let's just say it got lost in the mail.
中文: 邀请？我想说我把邀请忘在了邮箱里。

EN: No squares? Then how'd you get invited?
中文: 不欢迎书呆子？那你怎么进来的？

EN: This party's dead, and so are you.
中文: 这个派对死定了，你们也是。

EN: One of your Dwellers came aross an old cabin in the Wasteland. Sounds like somebody's having a party.
中文: 一位居民发现了一间小屋。听起来像是有人在开派对。

EN: Party Crasher
中文: 不速之客

EN: Explore the Cabin.
中文: 探索小屋。

EN: You found an old cabin out in the Wasteland!
中文: 在废土发现了一间旧的小木屋。

EN: I think she mentioned visiting some Vault? Vault 333? That's a lot of threes...
中文: 我想她好像提到了拜访某个避难所？333号避难所？好多3啊……

EN: Are you the rescue squad? I sure hope so!
中文: 你们是救援小队的吗？老天保佑你们是！

EN: I'm Mandy Macintosh. The Feral Ghouls captured a bunch of us.
中文: 我叫曼迪麦金托什。狂尸鬼把我们其中一些人抓走了。

EN: I think they were saving us all for a snack!
中文: 我想它们把我们当做点心。

EN: One lady, Paula Plumbkin, managed to escape. She's my new hero!
中文: 一位女士，宝拉·普朗布金，成功逃脱了。她是我的英雄！

EN: Did Paula say where she was going?
中文: 宝拉有提到她去哪里了吗？

EN: The Feral Ghouls from the old Nuka-Cola plant dragged Paula Plumbkin to an abandoned building. She needs rescuing!
中文: 旧核子可乐工厂里的狂尸鬼把宝拉拖到了一处废弃建筑里。得去救她。

EN: Paula's in a Pickle!
中文: 宝拉被困！

EN: Rescue Paula Plumbkin.
中文: 拯救宝拉·普朗布金。

EN: Rescue Paula Plumbkin from the Feral Ghouls!
中文: 从狂尸鬼手里拯救宝拉·普朗布金！

EN: Only my pack and I, that I know of. Though there were more...
中文: 据我所知，只有我这个族群，曾经还有更多……

EN: Much the same as you, I presume! Come, let us be allies.
中文: 我猜和你们学会说话的方式差不多！让我们成为盟友吧。

EN: We would be glad to meet them! Please, go tell them of us. We would like more human friends.
中文: 我们很乐意见到他们！请把我们的事情告诉他们，我们想要结交更多人类朋友。

EN: Woah, deathclaws can talk?
中文: 死爪会说话？

EN: More? How did you learn?
中文: 还有更多？你们是怎么学会说话的？

EN: You were experimented on?
中文: 有人在你们身上做实验吗？

EN: What are you doing here
中文: 你们在这里做什么

EN: I know someone who would love to meet you.
中文: 我认识一个人一定想见见你。

EN: I'll tell them if I see them again. Farewell!
中文: 如果我再见到他们，我会告诉他们的。再见！

EN: Huh, alright then. Well, see you around!
中文: 嗯，好吧。回头见！

EN: No, you're too dangerous. You have to go.
中文: 不，你们太危险了，你们必须离开。

EN: I don't think we can trust you.
中文: 我认为我们不能信任你们。

EN: We are aware we may seem threatening to you,
中文: 我们知道我们可能看起来有威胁，

EN: but we are quite unlike others you may have encountered.
中文: 但我们与你可能曾经遇到的其他死爪完全不同。

EN: Perfect Specimens
中文: 完美样本

EN: Talk to the vault dwellers
中文: 与避难所居民交谈

EN: Talk to the inhabitants of the mysterious vault.
中文: 与神秘避难所的居民交谈。

EN: Mole rats have infested a Super-Duper Mart nearby. The location is a vital source of supplies for travelers. Kill the brood mother to make the location safe once again.
中文: 附近的大无敌超市鼹鼠已经泛滥成灾。这地方是给旅行者提供物资的重要地点。除掉鼹鼠妈妈，让这个地方回归正常。

EN: Pest-Case Scenario
中文: 害虫泛滥

EN: Kill the Mole rat brood mother.
中文: 杀死鼹鼠妈妈。

EN: Kill the Mole rat brood mother at the Super Duper Mart.
中文: 前往大无敌超市杀死鼹鼠妈妈。

EN: Time for a little pest control!
中文: 是时候采取点虫害防治措施了。

EN: Watch out! While exploring near a Red Rocket fuel station, one of your Wasteland explorers has stumbled across a nest of radroaches! Ewww!
中文: 小心！在红火箭服务站附近探索时，你的一位废土探险者撞上了一窝辐射蟑螂！呃……

EN: Pest Control
中文: 虫害防治

EN: Clear out the Radroach infestation.
中文: 治理辐射蟑螂灾害。

EN: There's a nest of nasty Radroaches at a Red Rocket Truck Stop.
中文: 在红火箭服务站有一窝恶心的辐射蟑螂。

EN: I forgive you. The Raiders took your friends to the Nuka-Cola Factory.
中文: 我原谅你。掠夺者把你的朋友带去了核子可乐工厂。

EN: They went to the Nuka-Cola Factory. Now leave me in peace!
中文: 他们去了核子可乐工厂。现在让我静静吧！

EN: Don't hurt me! The Raiders took them to the Nuka-Cola Factory.
中文: 不要伤害我！掠夺者把他们带去了核子可乐工厂。

EN: No, the Raiders took them to the Nuka-Cola Factory.
中文: 不在，掠夺者把他们带到了核子可乐工厂。

EN: First those Raiders kill my Radscorpion pets, now you've killed Glowy!
中文: 先是掠夺者们杀死了我的宠物蝎子，现在你又杀死了“绿绿”！

EN: Are you people coming here just to torment me?
中文: 你们这些人来这里就是为了折磨我的吗？

EN: I apologize. I'm just trying to find Bottle & Cappy.
中文: 我向你道歉。我只是想找到瓶瓶和盖盖。

EN: Just tell me where Bottle & Cappy went, you weirdo!
中文: 只要告诉我瓶瓶和盖盖去哪儿了，你这个怪咖！

EN: If you don't tell me where Bottle & Cappy went, you'll join your “pets.”
中文: 如果你不告诉我瓶瓶和盖盖去哪里了，你将和你的“宠物”一个下场。

EN: Were Bottle & Cappy here?
中文: 瓶瓶和盖盖在这里吗？

EN: I found out from the Ghouls living in the Poseidon Energy offices that Bottle & Cappy may have been taken to the RobCo Building. Looks like that's my next stop.
中文: 我从住在海神能源办公室的尸鬼那里得知，瓶瓶和盖盖可能被带到了罗伯科大楼。看来那里是我的下一站了。

EN: Pet Peeve
中文: 宠物的怨恨

EN: Search the RobCo Building for any sign of Bottle & Cappy.
中文: 搜索罗伯科大楼，寻找有关瓶瓶和盖盖的线索。

EN: Pursue Bottle & Cappy's kidnappers.
中文: 追踪瓶瓶和盖盖的绑匪。

EN: Is that... Ugh. It's just a ripped Matt “The Missile” Murtagh Jersey.
中文: 那是……呃。只是一件撕破的马特“导弹”默塔球衣。

EN: Maybe Coach is rummaging around the ruins of the old sports bar, Nick Nack Quarterback's. If he is, that Jersey's as good as ours!
中文: 也许蔻驰在旧的运动酒吧废墟里四处搜寻。如果他在“小摆设四分卫”那家店的话，棒球衫一定是我们的了！

EN: Picked Off at Second!
中文: 第二次扑空！

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
中文: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
中文: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Ugh, yeah. Been out here for a while. If you go that way, look out for the monsters.
中文: 呃，是啊。我已经在这里呆了一段时间了。如果你往那边走，小心怪物。

EN: Ok ok! Cool your jets. Just trying to get by. Good luck, friend.
中文: 好好！冷静点。我只是想活下去。祝你好运，朋友。

EN: What are you doing out here? You ok?
中文: 你在这里做什么？你还好吗？

EN: Heh. Sure. Perfect.
中文: 当然！没问题！

EN: Sure. The more the merrier. But you're carrying the loot.
中文: 当然。人多力量大，但你要负责背战利品。

EN: Are we? Keep your hands where I can see them.
中文: 是么？把手放在我能看到的地方。

EN: AH! Oh you startled me. Hey there don't shoot!
中文: 啊！吓我一跳。嘿，别开枪！

EN: We're all friendly friends here, ok?
中文: 我们都没有敌意！

EN: Woah! You took that thing out like it was nothing!
中文: 哇！你把那东西干掉了，太厉害了！

EN: My name's Lucy! I'm just getting my bearings out here...
中文: 我叫露西！我刚到这里……

EN: I could probably use a guide, if I'm honest. Mind if I tag along?
中文: 说实话，我可能需要一个向导。我可以跟着你吗？

EN: Hssssthkkk!
中文: 嘶嘶咔！

EN: Woah! What's that? This festive waterfront has suffered a ruinous fate in some kind of ill-founded fracas! Get in there and dig around, who knows what you'll find!?
中文: 哇哦！这是什么？这个曾经热闹的海滨现在变成了废墟，好像发生了什么可怕的事！进去看看吧，说不定能找到点好东西！

EN: A Pier Into The Future
中文: 通向未来的码头

EN: Investigate the old pier.
中文: 调查旧码头。

EN: Investigate the old pier.
中文: 调查旧码头。

EN: Opportunity knocks! One of your Wasteland explorers has discovered a Red Rocket fuel station that looks uninhabited. There might be something useful inside.
中文: 机会来敲门！你的一位废土勇士发现了一个尚未被占领的红火箭服务站。里面可能有些有用的东西。

EN: Pit Stop
中文: 加油站

EN: Investigate the Red Rocket Truck Stop.
中文: 调查红火箭服务站。

EN: Search the Red Rocket Truck Stop for supplies.
中文: 搜索红火箭服务站的物资。

EN: You're the ones causing all the racket?
中文: 就是你们搞出这么大动静？

EN: Listen, we caught these workers fair and square. Go find your own.
中文: 听着，我们光明正大地抓到了这些工人，去找你们自己的吧。

EN: Not yours either. Nah, we'll be keepin em, thanks!
中文: 也不属于你呀，哈哈，我们可不打算放人！

EN: You're passing through the wrong place. More fresh meat for the Pitt!
中文: 那你走错了地方！还给匹兹堡送来了更多鲜肉！

EN: What for?
中文: 为什么？

EN: Trade huh? Yeah. Maybe... Here. Take this and get out of here.
中文: 交易？嗯，也可以……拿上这个，快滚吧。

EN: That's why we're here. Let those people go, they're not yours.
中文: 这就是我们来的原因。放了那些人，他们不属于你。

EN: Hey, we're just passing through, no need to get rough.
中文: 放轻松，我们只是路过，没必要动粗。

EN: Fine, take your workers, but give us a sample of your gear to show our people.
中文: 好吧，你们可以留下工人，但给我们一些你们的装备作为样品，让我们的人看看。

EN: Maybe we can set up a trade deal?
中文: 也许我们可以达成一个交易协议？

EN: A band of well-armed raiders attacked a caravan a few days back and made off with a number of settlers, we're assuming to use as slaves. We've got their last known co-ordinates and direction of travel, but no one was able to track them. We should send some good people out to track down and free the abductees, and eliminate these slavers. They're the last thing we need lurking around in our back yard.
中文: 几天前，一群全副武装的掠夺者袭击了一个商队，还带走了几名居民，估计是打算把他们当作奴隶。虽然知道他们最后出现的地点和移动方向，但没人能找到他们的行踪。我们得派些可靠的人去解救被绑架的居民，顺便消灭这些奴隶贩子。可不能再让这帮掠夺者在我们的地盘上欺行霸市。

EN: Pitt Stop
中文: 匹兹堡事件

EN: Find the band of slavers and free their captives.
中文: 找到奴隶贩子并解救俘虏。

EN: Rescue abducted settlers from the slavers.
中文: 从奴隶贩子手中解救被绑架的居民。

EN: It's not here. And neither is Coach. So we keep looking!
中文: 不在这里。蔻驰也不在。继续寻找吧！

EN: We found a Rackie Jobinson baseball card with a taunting note from Coach. Looks like he really does have the Jersey. But we'll never give up!
中文: 我们发现了蔻驰留下的罗基·杰宾森的棒球卡和嘲笑我们的信息。看起来棒球衫似乎真的在他手上。我们绝不会放弃的！

EN: Play Ball!
中文: 开球！

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
中文: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Keep the search alive!
中文: 坚持搜寻！

EN: Perhaps I've misjudged you. The Raiders you want are headed for the RobCo Building.
中文: 抱歉我不该认为你们是那样的人。你们要找的掠夺者去了罗伯科的办公楼。

EN: They went to the RobCo Building, but you'll never leave here alive!
中文: 他们去了罗伯科大楼，但你们绝不可能活着离开这里！

EN: They went to the RobCo Building, but you won't live to insult our kind ever again!
中文: 他们去了罗伯科大楼，但你们活不到再侮辱我们同类的那一天！

EN: If I told you they were at the RobCo Building, would you go away?
中文: 如果我告诉你他们在罗伯科大楼，你们能走开吗？

EN: I'll tell you the same thing I told those Raiders. We don't want you here!
中文: 我告诉过那些掠夺者了，对你们也是一样的话，这里不欢迎你们！

EN: I don't want to fight. I'm just looking for Bottle & Cappy.
中文: 我不想打架，我只是想找到瓶瓶和盖盖。

EN: Tell me where they went or I'll kill you where you stand!
中文: 告诉我他们去哪儿了，不然我就让你死在原地！

EN: I'm here for Bottle & Cappy, not to bother a bunch of ugly Ghouls.
中文: 我来这里是为了找瓶瓶和盖盖的，并不想和一群丑陋的尸鬼打交道。

EN: Have you seen Bottle & Cappy?
中文: 你们有见过瓶瓶和盖盖吗？

EN: The Raider Boss at Vault 177 boasted that they took Bottle & Cappy to the Poseidon Energy offices. I hope she was telling the truth.
中文: 177号避难所的掠夺者首领吹嘘他们把瓶瓶和盖盖带去了海神能源办公室。但愿她讲的是真话。

EN: Playing Catch-Up
中文: 追踪游戏

EN: Search Poseidon Energy's offices for any sign of Bottle & Cappy.
中文: 搜索海神能源办公室寻找关于瓶瓶和盖盖的线索。

EN: Pursue Bottle & Cappy's kidnappers.
中文: 追踪瓶瓶和盖盖的绑匪。

EN: Aha! Here it is!
中文: 啊哈，在这儿呢！

EN: The official documentation Vault-Tec sent to the Mayor's office...
中文: 避难所科技的正式文件被送到了市长办公室……

EN: ...with the location of Vault 525! And they did indeed have a G.E.C.K.!
中文: 位于525号避难所！他们真的有“伊甸园制造器”！

EN: Says here the entrance was hidden in the Red Rocket Headquarters!
中文: 这里说入口隐藏在红火箭总部里！

EN: According to a page from Paula Plumbkin's journal, Vault 525 really is Vaultopolis, but even she doesn't know where it is. But the Mayor's office may hold that information!
中文: 根据宝拉·普朗布金日志里所说的，525号避难所确实是个避难所大都会，但她也不知道在哪里。也许市长办公室里会有相关的信息。

EN: Playing Politics
中文: 政治游戏

EN: Search the Mayor's office for info on Vault 525's location.
中文: 前往市长办公室搜寻关于525号避难所具体位置的信息。

EN: We need to search the Mayor's office to find the location of Vault 525.
中文: 我们得去市长办公室找找关于525号避难所的信息。

EN: Fine, fine. I'll find it myself. Kids these days!
中文: 行行行，我自己找。现在的小孩真是不得了！

EN: And I thought employees were supposed to be helpful. I'll be writing your manager a letter!
中文: 雇员难道不是应该提供帮助的吗？我会给你们的经理写封信！

EN: Never kid a kidder! I know they're here. I'll find them one way or another.
中文: 别跟行家过招！我知道他们在这儿，总会有办法找到的。

EN: Excuse me, can you tell me where to find the prunes?
中文: 不好意思打扰了，你能告诉我哪里能找到西梅吗？

EN: I feel like I've been up and down the aisles a thousand times.
中文: 我觉得自己好像在这些过道里来回走了上千遍了。

EN: Sorry, I don't work here.
中文: 抱歉，我不在这里工作。

EN: I don't think you're going to find those here...
中文: 这里好像没有那个……

EN: Sorry, we stopped carrying those a couple hundred years ago.
中文: 抱歉，我们几百年前就不卖这个了。

EN: One of your Dwellers stumbled across a Super Duper Mart while out in the Wasteland. Perhaps you'll find something useful inside...
中文: 一位居民在废土探险时发现了一处大无敌超市。也许应该进去看看有没有什么有用的东西……

EN: Post-Apocalyptic World Problems
中文: 末世问题

EN: Explore the Super-Duper Mart.
中文: 探索大无敌超市。

EN: You've found a Super-Duper Mart while out exploring!
中文: 探险时发现一个大无敌超市！

EN: Don't shoot! I'm not like those other Ghouls!
中文: 别开枪！我和其它的尸鬼不一样！

EN: Looking for Paula Plumbkin? She was here all right.
中文: 在找宝拉·普朗布金是吗？她的确来过这里。

EN: Paula thought this place might be Vaultopolis. Obviously not.
中文: 宝拉以为这地方可能是避难所之城。显然并不是。

EN: She headed to Vault 813. If you're following her, this might help!
中文: 她去了813号避难所。如果你们在找她，这个可能会有帮助！

EN: The Radscorpion's creepy keeper said Paula Plumbkin went to the nuclear power plant, so that's where we'll look for her.
中文: 辐射蝎的诡异饲养者说宝拉·普朗布金去了核电站，我们决定去那里找她。

EN: Powered Up!
中文: 充电之旅！

EN: Search the nuclear power plant for Paula Plumbkin.
中文: 前往核电站寻找宝拉·普朗布金。

EN: Search the nuclear power plant for Paula Plumbkin.
中文: 前往核电站寻找宝拉·普朗布金。

EN: Please help!
中文: 救命！

EN: The Raiders said they wanted to free us from our life of servitude. Then they opened fire!
中文: 掠夺者说要将我们从奴役的生活中拯救出来。然后就开火了！

EN: Their definition of freedom leaves something to be desired...
中文: 他们对自由的定义是不是有点奇怪……

EN: It ends all right! For you!
中文: 是会结束！不过是对你们而言！

EN: My most gracious thanks. I'll keep that in mind as I eviscerate you.
中文: 我最衷心的感谢。等我把你扒皮的时候我会牢牢记住这些话的，

EN: Killing you IS my job!
中文: 杀了你就是我的工作。

EN: What? Huh? Seriously? Ugh. FINE. The Overseer's that way. Killjoy.
中文: 什么？哈？你是认真的？呃，好吧。监督者在那边。真扫兴。

EN: Lookie here. More Dwellers, need rescuing from their nightmare of endless labor.
中文: 快来看。有更多的居民需要我们把他们从噩梦般无止境的劳动中拯救出来。

EN: Rubarb was right - the working conditions in these Vaults is utterly deplorable!
中文: 鲁巴布说的对——这些避难所里的工作条件简直惨无人道！

EN: Don't worry. We'll end your eternal suffering. It's the least we can do.
中文: 不要慌张。我们将永久终结你们的痛苦。这是我们能做的最起码的事。

EN: Pfft! Please. Rescuing? This is nothing but Raiders raiding. And it ends here!
中文: 呸！拜托。拯救？你们这就是掠夺者赤裸裸的抢劫，一切到此为止！

EN: You know, for a Raider, your vocabulary is exemplary.
中文: 你知道吗，作为一个掠夺者，你的措辞还挺典范的。

EN: Get a job, you bum!
中文: 拜托找个工作吧，你这个无业游民！

EN: If I asked you to just chill out and not attack us... would you?
中文: 如果我让你冷静点，不要攻击我们……你会同意吗？

EN: Phew! Close one!
中文: 嘘，好惊险！

EN: All in a day's work!
中文: 小菜一碟！

EN: A disgruntled Dweller named Rubarb has joined the Raiders and wants to liberate some local Vaults... with violence! Overseer Mogabe needs your help!
中文: 一个叫鲁巴布的居民牢骚满腹，他加入了掠夺者的队伍，想要……用暴力“解放”当地的避难所！监督者莫加比需要你的帮助！

EN: Power to the People?
中文: 赋予人民力量？

EN: Rescue Overseer Mogabe.
中文: 拯救监督者莫加比。

EN: Rescue Overseer Mogabe from Rubarb's Raiders.
中文: 从鲁巴布的掠夺者手中救出监督者莫加比。

EN: I raised that Deathclaw from a hatchling. You'll pay for this!
中文: 那只死爪是我从小养大的。你们会为你们的行为付出代价！

EN: A Raider calling herself the Queen of the Deathclaws has been terrorizing the Wasteland!
中文: 一名自称为“死爪女王”的掠夺者在废土上行凶作恶！

EN: Queen of the Deathclaws!
中文: 死爪女王！

EN: Kill the Queen of the Deathclaws.
中文: 杀死死爪女王。

EN: Kill the Queen's Alpha Deathclaw.
中文: 杀死女王的领头死爪。

EN: Defeat an Alpha Deathclaw and the Raider controlling it.
中文: 打败领头死爪和控制它的掠夺者。

EN: You think you can take us!? Our boss has her own Deathclaw bodyguard!
中文: 你们以为能拿下我们？！我们老大可是有死爪给她做保镖！

EN: Here you are, then.
中文: 那就给你们吧。

EN: The Vault armory had a few items left. Here.
中文: 避难所的军械库里还剩了些东西。来，给你们。

EN: We won't be needing them, anyway. Here you go.
中文: 我们不太会用得上。给你们吧。

EN: Wait! We're not Feral! We're friendly!
中文: 等等！我们不是狂尸鬼！我们很友好！

EN: The radiation changed all of us, but we still have our sanity. The others had us trapped here.
中文: 辐射让我们都变异了，但我们神志还算清醒。那些失心疯的人把我们困在了这里。

EN: Thank you for freeing us. How can we repay you?
中文: 谢谢你们救了我们。我们该怎么报答你们呢？

EN: We'll take our payment in Caps.
中文: 如果你们有瓶盖的话，我们愿意接受。

EN: Got any weapons?
中文: 你们有武器吗？

EN: We could always use more outfits.
中文: 装备对我们来说总是有用的。

EN: A neighboring Vault has had a massive radiation leak and the citizens have turned into Feral Ghouls!
中文: 我们的邻近的避难所发生了大型的辐射泄漏，居民们变成了狂尸鬼！

EN: Radiation Leak!
中文: 辐射泄漏！

EN: Rescue the Vault Overseer.
中文: 拯救避难所监督者。

EN: Send a team with Radiation Suits to a neighboring Vault.
中文: 派遣一队穿着防辐射服的居民去邻近的避难所。

EN: Yes, they said they were Pests. You can say that again!
中文: 是的，他们说他们是“害虫”。你们可以再说一次！

EN: No, but they kept saying, “Blessed be the irradiated.”
中文: 不，但他们不停地说：“愿辐射保佑我们。”

EN: She sends the others into a frenzy. If you kill her, we should be able to round up the rest.
中文: 她把大家都逼疯了。如果你杀了她，我们就可以围捕其他人。

EN: No, sorry. They just vanished into the Wasteland. Like... *dare I say it?*... Radroaches.
中文: 不，对不起。他们刚刚消失在废土了。就像……*我敢说吗？*……辐射蟑螂一样。

EN: Thank goodness someone's come!
中文: 谢天谢地，有人来了！

EN: Armed thugs in Wasteland Gear barged in and took all our Radiation Suits!
中文: 一群穿着废土装备的武装暴徒闯了进来，抢走了我们所有的防辐射服！

EN: Then they released all our Radroaches, including the Glowing Radroach Queen.
中文: 然后他们释放我们所有的辐射蟑螂，包括发光辐射蟑螂女王。

EN: There are more people trapped inside. Please save them!
中文: 有更多的人被困在了里面。请救救他们！

EN: Did the thieves identify themselves?
中文: 那些小偷自报家门了吗？

EN: Do you know why they wanted your Radiation Suits?
中文: 你知道他们为什么要你的辐射服吗？

EN: What do we need to know about this Radroach Queen?
中文: 关于这个辐射蟑螂女王我们需要知道些什么？

EN: Do you know where the thieves went?
中文: 你知道小偷去哪儿了吗？

EN: Egads! We can't herd the rest into their cages while she's still around.
中文: 该死的！只要她还在旁边，我们不能把其余的关进笼子里。

EN: Wonderful! We'll be able to herd the rest into their cages now.
中文: 太棒了！我们现在可以把其余的人关在笼子里。

EN: Of the Apocalypse, yes. I'd guess that someone has taken its name and recruited followers.
中文: 末日，是的。我猜肯定有人用了这个名字，招募了追随者。

EN: Exactly! A name that strikes fear. A name with gravitas!
中文: 没错，让人恐惧的名字。庄严的名字！

EN: Superlative, we're saved! Are any of those scoundrels still around?
中文: 太好了，我们得救了！那些坏蛋还有人留下吗？

EN: They called themselves Pests, servants of Pestilence, and kept saying “Blessed be the irradiated.”
中文: 他们称自己为“害虫”，是“瘟疫”的仆人，不停地说：“愿辐射保佑我们”

EN: Pestilence. Pests. It clearly didn't take them long to think of a name.
中文: “瘟疫”。“害虫”。显然，他们没有花很长时间去想名字。

EN: At any rate, have you killed the Radroach Queen yet?
中文: 无论如何，你们杀死了蟑螂女王吗？

EN: No, she's still somewhere in the building.
中文: 不，她还在大楼的某个地方。

EN: Yes, we took care of her.
中文: 是的，我们杀了她。

EN: Never mind that. What's this about Pestilence? Isn't that one of the Four Horsemen?
中文: 请别介意。“瘟疫”是怎么回事？那不是四骑士中的一个吗？

EN: The Plagued or the Contagion would have been a much better name.
中文: “蔓延”或“传染”将是一个更好的名字。

EN: A distress call has come in from a nearby science lab studying Radroaches. Thieves stole their Radiation Suits and released all the Radroaches to cover their escape. Now the scientists are in over their heads and asking for help!
中文: 一个求救电话从附近的一个研究辐射蟑螂的科学实验室传来。小偷偷走了他们的防辐射服并释放了所有的辐射蟑螂来辅助他们逃跑。现在科学家们束手无策，正在求救！

EN: Radroach Roundup
中文: 围捕辐射蟑螂

EN: Kill the Glowing Radroach Queen.
中文: 杀死发光辐射蟑螂女王。

EN: Save the first group of scientists.
中文: 拯救第一组科学家。

EN: Save the second group of scientists.
中文: 拯救第二组科学家。

EN: Save scientists from the Radroaches they were studying.
中文: 从科学家研究的辐射蟑螂手中拯救他们。

EN: Nothing, he left before we could catch him. Said some settlers were stuck in a Mole rat den. But enough talk, now you die!
中文: 没怎么，在我们能抓到他之前就离开了。说是一些定居点的人被困在了鼹鼠洞穴里。话说完了，准备受死吧！

EN: Ha, what do we have here?
中文: 哈，我们现在是什么情况？

EN: Some more goody two-shoes, looking to take down Road Rash!
中文: 一些伪君子，想要干掉“道路丘疹”！

EN: I'll tell you what I told that idiot Preston Garvey. No one messes with Road Rash and lives!
中文: 我曾对那个白痴普雷斯顿·加维说过，对你们也一样，没有人惹了我“道路丘疹”还能活着回去的！

EN: What did you do with Preston?
中文: 你们把普雷斯顿怎么了？

EN: The path has led you to the home of Road Rash and his gang of Raiders! Find out if they know anything.
中文: 这条路会带你到“道路丘疹”和他的掠夺者团伙的据点！去看看他们是不是知道点什么。

EN: Raider Troubles at Corvega
中文: 可伟佳的掠夺者问题

EN: Interrogate Road Rash for information.
中文: 审问“道路丘疹”，索要更多信息。
